abandon.example: They had to abandon the old car by the road.
abandon.exampleZh: 他们不得不把旧车丢弃在路边。

abbreviation.example: I could not understand the abbreviation on the sign, so I asked my teacher.
abbreviation.exampleZh: 我看不懂牌子上的缩写，所以问了老师。

abide.example: We must abide by the rules even when no one is watching.
abide.exampleZh: 即使没有人看着，我们也必须遵守规则。

ability.example: She has the ability to learn new things very quickly.
ability.exampleZh: 她有很快学习新事物的能力。

abnormal.example: The doctor said the test results were abnormal and asked for more tests.
abnormal.exampleZh: 医生说检查结果异常，并要求做更多检查。

aboard.example: All the passengers were safely aboard the ship before it left the port.
aboard.exampleZh: 所有乘客在船离开港口前都安全上了船。

abolish.example: Many people want to abolish the old law because it is unfair.
abolish.exampleZh: 许多人想废除这条旧法律，因为它不公平。

abortion.example: The new law on abortion has caused a lot of public debate.
abortion.exampleZh: 这项关于堕胎的新法律引发了大量公众讨论。

abound.example: Fresh fruits and vegetables abound in this small town market.
abound.exampleZh: 这个小镇的市场上盛产新鲜水果和蔬菜。

about.example: I read a book about animals and then walked about the park.
about.exampleZh: 我读了一本关于动物的书，然后在公园里四处走了走。

above.example: The bird is flying above the tall trees in our garden.
above.exampleZh: 那只鸟正飞在我们花园里高大的树木上方。

abroad.example: She wants to study abroad next year and learn a new language.
abroad.exampleZh: 她想明年出国留学并学习一门新语言。

abrupt.example: The car made an abrupt stop and everyone inside was thrown forward.
abrupt.exampleZh: 汽车突然刹车，里面的每个人都向前冲了一下。

absence.example: His absence from the meeting made everyone wonder where he was.
absence.exampleZh: 他缺席会议，让大家都想知道他去了哪里。

absent.example: He was absent from class yesterday because he had a bad cold.
absent.exampleZh: 他昨天因为重感冒没来上课。

absolute.example: The king had absolute power over everyone in the land.
absolute.exampleZh: 国王对这片土地上的所有人拥有绝对权力。

absorb.example: The dry soil can absorb the rain very quickly after a storm.
absorb.exampleZh: 干燥的土壤能在暴风雨后很快吸收雨水。

abstain.example: He decided to abstain from alcohol for a month to stay healthy.
abstain.exampleZh: 他决定戒酒一个月以保持健康。

abstract.example: The abstract of the paper is short and easy to read.
abstract.exampleZh: 这篇论文的摘要很短，也很容易读。

absurd.example: It is absurd to blame the weather for your own mistakes.
absurd.exampleZh: 把你自己犯的错归咎于天气，这很荒谬。

abundance.example: There is an abundance of fresh fruit in the market today.
abundance.exampleZh: 今天市场上有大量新鲜水果。

abundant.example: Fresh water is abundant in this area, so people never worry about it.
abundant.exampleZh: 这个地区淡水资源充足，所以人们从不为水发愁。

abuse.example: Some people abuse their power and treat others badly at work.
abuse.exampleZh: 有些人滥用权力，在工作中恶劣对待他人。

academic.example: She is a well-known academic and teaches history at a large university.
academic.exampleZh: 她是一位知名学者，在一所大型大学教历史。

academy.example: My sister studies music at a famous academy in our city.
academy.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我们城市一所著名的学院学习音乐。

accelerate.example: The new plan may accelerate the work and save us time.
accelerate.exampleZh: 新计划可能会加快工作进度，并为我们节省时间。

accent.example: She speaks English with a slight French accent.
accent.exampleZh: 她说英语带一点法国口音。

accept.example: I accept your kind offer and will start the work tomorrow.
accept.exampleZh: 我接受你的好意，明天就开始工作。

acceptance.example: Her acceptance of the new job made her family very happy.
acceptance.exampleZh: 她接受这份新工作让她的家人非常高兴。

access.example: Students can get free access to the library every day.
access.exampleZh: 学生每天可以免费进入图书馆。

accessory.example: She bought a small accessory to match her new dress for the party.
accessory.exampleZh: 她买了一个小配件来搭配她参加派对的新裙子。

accident.example: I saw a bad car accident on the way home yesterday.
accident.exampleZh: 昨天我在回家的路上看到了一场严重的车祸。

accidental.example: The fire was accidental, and no one was hurt in the small kitchen.
accidental.exampleZh: 这场火灾是意外发生的，小厨房里没有人受伤。

acclaim.example: The young singer won great acclaim for her performance at the school concert.
acclaim.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手因在学校音乐会上的表演赢得了极大赞誉。

accommodate.example: The new hall can accommodate up to five hundred people.
accommodate.exampleZh: 这个新大厅最多能容纳五百人。

accommodation.example: We found cheap accommodation near the train station for our trip.
accommodation.exampleZh: 我们为旅行在火车站附近找到了便宜的住处。

accompany.example: My mother will accompany me to the hospital tomorrow morning.
accompany.exampleZh: 我母亲明天早上会陪我去医院。

accomplish.example: We worked hard every day and finally accomplished our main goal.
accomplish.exampleZh: 我们每天努力工作，最终实现了我们的主要目标。

accord.example: The two sides reached an accord after a long and friendly talk.
accord.exampleZh: 经过长时间友好交谈，双方达成了一致。

accordance.example: We cleaned the room in accordance with the school rules.
accordance.exampleZh: 我们按照学校规定打扫了房间。

account.example: Please check your bank account and tell me the total amount.
account.exampleZh: 请查看你的银行账户，并告诉我总金额。

accountant.example: My sister works as an accountant in a small bank downtown.
accountant.exampleZh: 我姐姐在市中心一家小银行当会计。

accumulate.example: Over the years, he accumulated a lot of knowledge about old cars.
accumulate.exampleZh: 多年来，他积累了很多关于老式汽车的知识。

accuracy.example: The accuracy of this test is very important for doctors.
accuracy.exampleZh: 这项测试的准确性对医生来说非常重要。

accurate.example: The weather report was accurate, so we took umbrellas with us.
accurate.exampleZh: 天气预报很准确，所以我们带上了雨伞。

accuse.example: The teacher accused him of cheating on the test, but he said nothing.
accuse.exampleZh: 老师指控他考试作弊，但他什么也没说。

accustom.example: It takes time to accustom yourself to a new school.
accustom.exampleZh: 适应一所新学校需要时间。

accustomed.example: She is accustomed to getting up early every morning.
accustomed.exampleZh: 她习惯了每天早上早起。

ache.example: After the long run, I had a dull ache in my left knee.
ache.exampleZh: 长跑之后，我的左膝有轻微的疼痛。

achieve.example: She worked hard every day to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.
achieve.exampleZh: 她每天努力，只为实现成为医生的梦想。

achievement.example: Her hard work and good grades were a great achievement for the young student.
achievement.exampleZh: 她的努力和好成绩对这名年轻学生来说是很大的成就。

acid.example: The acid in the lemon makes the soup taste too sour.
acid.exampleZh: 柠檬里的酸让这汤尝起来太酸了。

acknowledge.example: Please acknowledge receipt of this email by replying to me today.
acknowledge.exampleZh: 请今天回复我，确认收到这封邮件。

acquaint.example: I will acquaint you with the new rules before Monday.
acquaint.exampleZh: 我会在周一之前让你熟悉这些新规定。

acquaintance.example: She is an old acquaintance of my mother and visits us often.
acquaintance.exampleZh: 她是我母亲的老熟人，经常来看我们。

acquire.example: Children acquire language skills quickly when they talk with friends every day.
acquire.exampleZh: 孩子们每天和朋友交谈时，会很快学到语言技能。

acquisition.example: The company's latest acquisition will help it grow in Asian markets.
acquisition.exampleZh: 该公司最近的一次收购将帮助它在亚洲市场发展。

acre.example: My uncle owns a small farm of about twenty acres.
acre.exampleZh: 我叔叔有一个大约二十英亩的小农场。

act.example: She will act in the school play next week.
act.exampleZh: 她下周将在这部校园戏剧中演出。

action.example: His quick action saved the little boy from the river.
action.exampleZh: 他的迅速行动把小男孩从河里救了上来。

activate.example: You can activate the camera by pressing this small button.
activate.exampleZh: 你可以按下这个小按钮来启动相机。

active.example: She is very active in the school sports club and loves running.
active.exampleZh: 她在学校体育社团里非常活跃，而且喜欢跑步。

actual.example: The actual cost was much higher than we expected.
actual.exampleZh: 实际成本比我们预期的高得多。

acute.example: There is an acute shortage of clean water in that region.
acute.exampleZh: 那个地区严重缺乏干净的水。

adapt.example: It takes time to adapt to a new school.
adapt.exampleZh: 适应一所新学校需要时间。

adaptation.example: The film is a good adaptation of a famous book.
adaptation.exampleZh: 这部电影是一部著名书籍的优秀改编本。

add.example: Please add some sugar to my coffee and stir it well.
add.exampleZh: 请往我的咖啡里加些糖，并把它搅拌均匀。

addict.example: He became an addict after taking drugs for several months.
addict.exampleZh: 他吸毒几个月后就上瘾了。

addition.example: In addition to English, she also speaks French and Spanish.
addition.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还会说法语和西班牙语。

additional.example: We paid an additional fee for the extra luggage.
additional.exampleZh: 我们为超出的行李支付了额外的费用。

address.example: Please write your address on this form before you mail it.
address.exampleZh: 寄出之前，请在这张表格上写下你的地址。

adequate.example: The room was small but adequate for two people and their bags.
adequate.exampleZh: 房间不大，但对两个人和他们的行李来说已经足够了。

adhere.example: The tape will adhere firmly to the wall if you press it down.
adhere.exampleZh: 如果你用力按压，胶带就会牢牢黏附在墙上。

adjacent.example: The hotel is adjacent to the train station, so it is easy to find.
adjacent.exampleZh: 这家酒店毗邻火车站，所以很容易找到。

adjective.example: In English, an adjective describes a noun or a pronoun.
adjective.exampleZh: 在英语中，形容词用来描述名词或代词。

adjoin.example: Our small garden adjoins the park, so we often walk there.
adjoin.exampleZh: 我们的小花园与公园毗连，所以我们常去那里散步。

adjust.example: Please adjust the chair before you sit down.
adjust.exampleZh: 坐下前请把椅子调一下。

administer.example: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient this morning.
administer.exampleZh: 护士今天早上会给这位病人用药。

administration.example: The administration of the new law will begin next month.
administration.exampleZh: 新法律的施行将于下个月开始。

admire.example: Many young students admire their teachers and want to learn from them.
admire.exampleZh: 许多年轻学生钦佩他们的老师，并想向他们学习。

admission.example: The museum charges a small admission fee for children under twelve.
admission.exampleZh: 博物馆对十二岁以下儿童收取少量入场费。

admit.example: He admitted that he made a mistake and said sorry to everyone.
admit.exampleZh: 他承认自己犯了错误，并向大家道了歉。

adolescent.example: As an adolescent, he often felt shy and unsure of himself.
adolescent.exampleZh: 作为一个青少年，他常常感到害羞和缺乏自信。

adopt.example: They decided to adopt a child from the local orphanage last year.
adopt.exampleZh: 他们去年决定从当地孤儿院领养一个孩子。

adult.example: Every adult should take care of their own health and money.
adult.exampleZh: 每个成年人都应该照顾好自己的健康和钱财。

advance.example: The team made great advances in the project last year.
advance.exampleZh: 团队去年在这个项目上取得了很大进展。

advanced.example: This school uses advanced computers to help students learn faster.
advanced.exampleZh: 这所学校使用先进的电脑帮助学生更快地学习。

advantage.example: One big advantage of living near the office is that you can walk to work.
advantage.exampleZh: 住在办公室附近的一大好处是你可以步行去上班。

adventure.example: Our trip to the mountains turned into a real adventure.
adventure.exampleZh: 我们的山区之行变成了一次真正的冒险。

adverb.example: In this sentence, the word quickly is an adverb.
adverb.exampleZh: 在这个句子里，quickly 这个词是副词。

advertise.example: They advertise their new products on TV and online.
advertise.exampleZh: 他们在电视和网络上为新产品做广告。

advertisement.example: I saw a funny advertisement for a new phone on TV last night.
advertisement.exampleZh: 昨晚我在电视上看到一个有趣的新手机广告。

advice.example: My teacher gave me good advice about how to study English.
advice.exampleZh: 我的老师给了我关于如何学习英语的好建议。

advisable.example: It is advisable to check the weather before you go out.
advisable.exampleZh: 出门前查看天气是明智的。

advise.example: I advise you to see a doctor before the pain gets worse.
advise.exampleZh: 我建议你在疼痛加重之前去看医生。

adviser.example: My adviser helped me choose the right classes for next year.
adviser.exampleZh: 我的指导教师帮我挑选了明年的合适课程。

advocate.example: She is a strong advocate for clean water and often advocates for change.
advocate.exampleZh: 她是清洁用水的坚定拥护者，并经常为此倡导变革。

aerial.example: The aerial view of the city shows many small parks.
aerial.exampleZh: 这座城市的空中俯视图显示出许多小公园。

aesthetic.example: The new library has a clean aesthetic design that students really like.
aesthetic.exampleZh: 新图书馆有着简洁的审美设计，学生们很喜欢。

affair.example: The whole affair was over before anyone could explain what had happened.
affair.exampleZh: 整个事件在任何人有机会解释发生了什么之前就结束了。

affect.example: The bad weather will affect our travel plans tomorrow.
affect.exampleZh: 恶劣天气会影响我们明天的出行计划。

affection.example: She felt great affection for the old dog that followed her home.
affection.exampleZh: 她对那只跟着她回家的老狗产生了深厚的感情。

affiliate.example: The small clinic is an affiliate of the large city hospital.
affiliate.exampleZh: 这家小诊所是那家大市立医院的附属机构。

affirm.example: The doctor affirmed that the test results were correct.
affirm.exampleZh: 医生确认了检测结果正确无误。

afford.example: We cannot afford a new car this year.

afraid.example: I am afraid of big dogs, so I stay away from them.
afraid.exampleZh: 我害怕大狗，所以我远离它们。

after.example: We went home after the movie ended.
after.exampleZh: 电影结束后我们就回家了。

afternoon.example: I have two classes this afternoon, so I cannot go shopping with you.
afternoon.exampleZh: 我今天下午有两节课，所以不能和你一起去购物。

afterward.example: We had dinner and afterward went for a long walk in the park.
afterward.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，后来去公园散了很久的步。

again.example: She read the letter again because she missed a word.
again.exampleZh: 她又读了一遍这封信，因为她漏看了一个词。

against.example: Many people voted against the new plan at the town meeting.
against.exampleZh: 许多人在镇民会议上投票反对这项新计划。

age.example: Children under the age of six can enter the museum for free.
age.exampleZh: 六岁以下的儿童可以免费进入博物馆。

agency.example: She went to a travel agency to book a cheap flight.
agency.exampleZh: 她去了一家旅行社预订一张便宜的机票。

agenda.example: The manager put the new plan on the agenda for Monday.
agenda.exampleZh: 经理把新计划列入了周一的议事日程。

agent.example: The travel agent booked a cheap flight and a hotel for us.
agent.exampleZh: 旅行社代理人为我们订了便宜的航班和一家酒店。

aggravate.example: Staying up late will aggravate your headache.

aggregate.example: The aggregate of all the scores was much higher than we expected.
aggregate.exampleZh: 所有分数的总和比我们预期的高得多。

aggressive.example: His aggressive behavior at the meeting made everyone feel uncomfortable.
aggressive.exampleZh: 他在会上挑衅的行为让所有人都感到不舒服。

agitate.example: The bad news agitated her so much that she could not sleep.
agitate.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让她非常不安，以至于睡不着觉。

agony.example: She cried for hours because the pain in her leg was pure agony.
agony.exampleZh: 她哭了几个小时，因为腿上的疼痛让她痛苦不堪。

agree.example: I agree with you, so let us start the work now.
agree.exampleZh: 我同意你的看法，那我们现在就开始这项工作吧。

agreeable.example: The weather was very agreeable, so we took a long walk outside.
agreeable.exampleZh: 天气非常宜人，所以我们在外面散步了很久。

agreement.example: The two companies signed an agreement to share the costs.
agreement.exampleZh: 两家公司签署了一项协议来分摊成本。

agriculture.example: My grandfather works in agriculture and grows rice and vegetables.
agriculture.exampleZh: 我的祖父从事农业，种植水稻和蔬菜。

ahead.example: We need to plan ahead if we want to finish the work on time.
ahead.exampleZh: 如果我们想按时完成工作，就需要提前做好计划。

aid.example: The nurse gave him first aid after the small accident.
aid.exampleZh: 那次小事故后，护士给他做了急救。

aim.example: Our main aim is to help students learn English well.
aim.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是帮助学生学好英语。

air.example: The room feels fresh after we air it in the morning.
air.exampleZh: 早上给房间通通风后，它感觉清新了。

aircraft.example: The aircraft landed safely at the airport after a long flight.
aircraft.exampleZh: 这架飞机在长途飞行后安全降落在机场。

airline.example: My father works for a big airline and he often flies to other countries.
airline.exampleZh: 我父亲在一家大型航空公司工作，他经常飞往其他国家。

airplane.example: The airplane is very big and it can fly high in the sky.
airplane.exampleZh: 这架飞机很大，它能在天空中飞得很高。

airport.example: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.
airport.exampleZh: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达了机场。

alarm.example: The fire alarm woke everyone up, so we left the building quickly.
alarm.exampleZh: 火警警报把大家都吵醒了，所以我们迅速离开了大楼。

album.example: She keeps all her old family photos in a big album.
album.exampleZh: 她把所有旧的家庭照片都保存在一本大相册里。

alcohol.example: Doctors say too much alcohol is bad for your health.
alcohol.exampleZh: 医生说喝太多酒对健康有害。

alert.example: The dog stays alert at night and barks at strange sounds.
alert.exampleZh: 这只狗夜里保持警觉，听到奇怪的声音就会叫。

alien.example: The strange food tasted alien to me at first.
alien.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的食物起初让我觉得陌生。

alienate.example: His constant criticism began to alienate his closest friends and family.
alienate.exampleZh: 他不断的批评开始让他最亲近的朋友和家人疏远。

alike.example: The two sisters look very much alike and often wear the same clothes.
alike.exampleZh: 这两姐妹长得非常相像，而且经常穿同样的衣服。

alive.example: The old tree is still alive, and it gives us shade every summer.
alive.exampleZh: 那棵老树仍然活着，每年夏天都为我们提供阴凉。

all.example: We ate all the cake after school.
all.exampleZh: 放学后我们把整块蛋糕都吃完了。

allege.example: They allege that he took the money without any proof.
allege.exampleZh: 他们宣称他拿了钱，却没有任何证据。

alleviate.example: A warm drink can alleviate the pain of a sore throat.
alleviate.exampleZh: 一杯热饮可以减轻喉咙痛。

alliance.example: The two small countries formed an alliance to protect each other.
alliance.exampleZh: 这两个小国结成联盟以互相保护。

allocate.example: The teacher will allocate ten minutes for each group to speak.
allocate.exampleZh: 老师将给每个小组分配十分钟发言时间。

allow.example: My parents allow me to play computer games on weekends.
allow.exampleZh: 我父母允许我在周末玩电脑游戏。

allowance.example: My parents give me a small allowance every week for bus fare.
allowance.exampleZh: 父母每周给我一点零用钱用来坐公交车。

alloy.example: This ring is made of an alloy of gold and silver.
alloy.exampleZh: 这枚戒指是由金和银的合金制成的。

ally.example: The two countries have been close allies for many years since the war.
ally.exampleZh: 自战争以来，这两个国家多年来一直是亲密盟友。

almost.example: I almost missed the last bus home last night.
almost.exampleZh: 我昨晚几乎错过了回家的末班公交车。

alone.example: She lives alone in a small house near the river.
alone.exampleZh: 她独自住在河边的一所小房子里。

along.example: We walked along the river and talked for an hour.
along.exampleZh: 我们沿着河边散步，聊了一个小时。

alongside.example: She walked alongside the river and talked with her old friend.
alongside.exampleZh: 她沿着河边走，一边和她的老朋友聊天。

alphabet.example: Children learn the alphabet before they learn to read simple words.
alphabet.exampleZh: 孩子们在学习阅读简单单词之前先学习字母表。

already.example: I have already finished my homework and now I can watch TV.
already.exampleZh: 我已经做完作业了，现在可以看电视了。

also.example: She speaks French and also knows a little Spanish.
also.exampleZh: 她会说法语，也懂一点西班牙语。

alter.example: We had to alter the plan because of the bad weather.
alter.exampleZh: 由于天气恶劣，我们不得不改变计划。

alteration.example: The dress needs a small alteration before the wedding.
alteration.exampleZh: 这条裙子在婚礼前需要做一点小小的改动。

alternate.example: The two nurses alternate shifts every week so no one gets too tired.
alternate.exampleZh: 两名护士每周轮流换班，这样谁都不会太累。

alternative.example: We need an alternative plan because the first one will not work.
alternative.exampleZh: 我们需要一个替代方案，因为第一个方案行不通。

although.example: Although it was raining, we still went to the park.
although.exampleZh: 虽然当时在下雨，我们还是去了公园。

altitude.example: The plane is flying at a high altitude above the clouds.
altitude.exampleZh: 飞机正在云层上方的高海拔处飞行。

altogether.example: The trip was altogether too expensive, so we stayed home instead.
altogether.exampleZh: 这次旅行总共太贵了，所以我们待在家里。

aluminum.example: This light box is made of aluminum, so it is easy to carry.
aluminum.exampleZh: 这个轻便的盒子是用铝制成的，所以很容易携带。

always.example: She always drinks a cup of tea in the morning.

amateur.example: He is an amateur at tennis, but he plays every weekend.
amateur.exampleZh: 他是网球业余爱好者，但每个周末都打球。

amaze.example: The young boy's magic tricks never fail to amaze his teachers.
amaze.exampleZh: 那个小男孩的魔术总能令他的老师们大为惊奇。

ambassador.example: The ambassador met the students and talked about his work in China.
ambassador.exampleZh: 大使会见了学生们，并谈到了他在中国的工作。

ambiguous.example: His answer was ambiguous, so nobody knew what he really meant.
ambiguous.exampleZh: 他的回答模棱两可，所以没人知道他真正的意思。

ambition.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help people in her town.
ambition.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助她所在小镇上的人们。

ambitious.example: She is an ambitious young woman who wants to lead the company.
ambitious.exampleZh: 她是一位有雄心的年轻女性，想要领导这家公司。

ambulance.example: The ambulance came quickly and took the sick man to the hospital.
ambulance.exampleZh: 救护车很快赶来，把那个病人送到了医院。

amend.example: The company decided to amend its rules after the workers complained.
amend.exampleZh: 工人们提出抱怨后，公司决定修改其规定。

america.example: My uncle lives in America and works in a big hotel.
america.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在美国，在一家大酒店工作。

amid.example: She smiled amid the noise and confusion of the busy market.
amid.exampleZh: 在熙熙攘攘的市场的喧闹与混乱之中，她微笑着。

ammunition.example: The soldiers carried enough ammunition to last through the long battle.
ammunition.exampleZh: 士兵们携带了足够的弹药，以支撑漫长的战斗。

among.example: She found her keys among the books on the desk.
among.exampleZh: 她在桌上的书堆中找到了她的钥匙。

amount.example: The total amount of water in the tank is quite small.
amount.exampleZh: 水箱里的水总量相当少。

ample.example: We have ample time to finish the work before Friday.
ample.exampleZh: 我们有足够的时间在周五之前完成这项工作。

amplify.example: The teacher used a microphone to amplify her voice in the large hall.
amplify.exampleZh: 老师用麦克风在宽敞的大厅里放大自己的声音。

amuse.example: The funny clown amuses the children at the birthday party.
amuse.exampleZh: 那个滑稽的小丑在生日聚会上逗孩子们发笑。

analogy.example: He used a simple analogy to explain how the machine works.
analogy.exampleZh: 他用一个简单的类比来解释这台机器是如何运作的。

analyse.example: The teacher asked us to analyse the poem's meaning.
analyse.exampleZh: 老师让我们分析这首诗的含义。

analysis.example: The teacher gave a clear analysis of the poem in class today.
analysis.exampleZh: 老师今天在课堂上对这首诗做了清晰的分析。

analytic.example: She has an analytic mind and solves hard problems quickly.
analytic.exampleZh: 她有一个善于分析的头脑，能很快解决难题。

ancestor.example: My ancestors lived in a small village near the river long ago.
ancestor.exampleZh: 很久以前，我的祖先住在河边的一个小村庄里。

anchor.example: The ship dropped its anchor near the small island and stayed there all night.
anchor.exampleZh: 那艘船在小岛附近抛下锚，并在那里停了一整夜。

ancient.example: This ancient tree is older than our whole town.
ancient.exampleZh: 这棵古老的树比我们整个镇子还要老。

and.example: I bought bread and milk, and then we went home together.
and.exampleZh: 我买了面包和牛奶，然后我们一起回家了。

angel.example: My little sister is an angel who always helps other people.
angel.exampleZh: 我的小妹妹是个天使，总是帮助别人。

anger.example: His loud words filled the small room with anger and fear.
anger.exampleZh: 他大声的话语让这个小房间里充满了愤怒和恐惧。

angle.example: The camera was placed at a low angle to make the tree look taller.
angle.exampleZh: 相机被放在一个低角度位置，让那棵树看起来更高。

angry.example: My father was angry with me because I came home very late last night.
angry.exampleZh: 我父亲生我的气，因为我昨晚很晚才回家。

animal.example: The zoo has many wild animals from Africa and Asia.
animal.exampleZh: 这家动物园有许多来自非洲和亚洲的野生动物。

ankle.example: I hurt my ankle while playing basketball with my friends yesterday.
ankle.exampleZh: 昨天我和朋友们打篮球时伤了脚踝。

anniversary.example: We had a small party for our parents' fiftieth wedding anniversary.
anniversary.exampleZh: 我们为父母的五十周年结婚纪念日办了一个小型聚会。

announce.example: They will announce the winners on the radio tonight.
announce.exampleZh: 他们今晚会在收音机上宣布获胜者。

annoy.example: Please stop making that noise, or you will annoy everyone in the room.
annoy.exampleZh: 请别再制造那种噪音了，否则你会惹恼房间里的每个人。

annual.example: The company holds an annual meeting for all its workers in June.
annual.exampleZh: 公司在六月为全体员工举行年度会议。

anonymous.example: The anonymous letter gave no clue about who sent it.
anonymous.exampleZh: 这封匿名信没有提供任何关于寄信人的线索。

another.example: I don't like this shirt, so please show me another one.
another.exampleZh: 我不喜欢这件衬衫，请再给我拿一件。

answer.example: Please answer my question before you leave the room.
answer.exampleZh: 请在离开房间之前回答我的问题。

ant.example: A small black ant is carrying a piece of bread across the floor.
ant.exampleZh: 一只小黑蚂蚁正拖着一块面包穿过地板。

antarctic.example: The Antarctic is very cold and covered with ice all year.
antarctic.exampleZh: 南极地区非常寒冷，全年被冰覆盖。

anticipate.example: We anticipate a busy day at the shop before the holiday.
anticipate.exampleZh: 我们预计节前店里会忙碌一天。

antique.example: The antique clock on the wall still keeps good time.
antique.exampleZh: 墙上的那座古董钟依然走时准确。

anxiety.example: She felt a lot of anxiety before her first day at the new job.
anxiety.exampleZh: 在新工作的第一天之前，她感到非常焦虑。

anxious.example: She feels anxious about the exam and cannot sleep well.
anxious.exampleZh: 她对考试感到焦虑，睡不好觉。

any.example: Do you have any questions about the lesson today?
any.exampleZh: 关于今天的课你还有什么问题吗？

anybody.example: Anybody can join the club if they pay the small fee.
anybody.exampleZh: 任何人只要支付一小笔费用就可以加入这个俱乐部。

anyhow.example: It was raining, but anyhow we decided to go for a walk.
anyhow.exampleZh: 当时正在下雨，但不管怎样我们还是决定去散步。

anyone.example: Anyone can learn to cook simple meals with a little practice.
anyone.exampleZh: 任何人只要稍加练习都能学会做简单的饭菜。

anything.example: You can ask me anything if you do not understand the lesson.
anything.exampleZh: 如果你不懂这节课，你可以问我任何问题。

anyway.example: It was raining hard, but we went out to play anyway.
anyway.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，但我们还是出去玩了。

anywhere.example: I can't find my keys anywhere in this room.
anywhere.exampleZh: 我在这个房间里到处都找不到我的钥匙。

apart.example: The two houses are only a few meters apart.
apart.exampleZh: 这两栋房子只相隔几米。

apartment.example: My new apartment is small but very bright and clean.
apartment.exampleZh: 我的新公寓很小，但非常明亮整洁。

apologize.example: You should apologize to her for being late yesterday.
apologize.exampleZh: 你应该为昨天迟到向她道歉。

apology.example: He said sorry, but his apology did not sound honest to me.
apology.exampleZh: 他说了抱歉，但他的道歉在我听来并不真诚。

apparatus.example: The doctor carefully cleaned the apparatus before every test.
apparatus.exampleZh: 医生每次检测前都仔细清洁这套器械。

apparent.example: It soon became apparent that the team needed more help.
apparent.exampleZh: 很快就可以明显看出，这个团队需要更多帮助。

appeal.example: The new park has great appeal for families with young children.
appeal.exampleZh: 这座新公园对有幼儿的家庭很有吸引力。

appear.example: A tall man appeared at the door and asked for you.
appear.exampleZh: 一个高个子男人出现在门口，问起了你。

appearance.example: Her sudden appearance at the party surprised all of us.
appearance.exampleZh: 她在聚会上的突然出现让我们所有人都很惊讶。

appendix.example: The appendix at the end of the book explains these special terms.
appendix.exampleZh: 书末的附录解释了这些专业术语。

appetite.example: The smell of hot soup gave me a big appetite for dinner.
appetite.exampleZh: 热汤的香味让我对晚饭有了很大的食欲。

applaud.example: The students stood up to applaud the teacher after her speech.
applaud.exampleZh: 演讲结束后，学生们站起来为老师鼓掌。

applause.example: The audience gave the singer loud applause after her last song.
applause.exampleZh: 那位歌手唱完最后一首歌后，观众给了她热烈的掌声。

appliance.example: The kitchen has many useful appliances, such as a fridge and a microwave.
appliance.exampleZh: 厨房里有很多实用的器具，比如冰箱和微波炉。

applicable.example: This rule is applicable to every student in our school.
applicable.exampleZh: 这条规则适用于我们学校的每一位学生。

applicant.example: The job applicant waited outside the office for his interview.
applicant.exampleZh: 那位求职者在外面的办公室外等候面试。

application.example: You can fill out an application for the job online.
application.exampleZh: 你可以在网上填写这份工作的申请书。

apply.example: I want to apply for a job at that small bookshop.
apply.exampleZh: 我想申请那家小书店的一份工作。

appoint.example: The manager will appoint a new team leader next week.
appoint.exampleZh: 经理下周将任命一位新的团队负责人。

appointment.example: I have a doctor's appointment at three o'clock this afternoon.
appointment.exampleZh: 我今天下午三点有一个看医生的预约。

appraisal.example: The bank made an appraisal of the house before giving us the loan.
appraisal.exampleZh: 银行在给我们贷款之前对房子进行了估价。

appreciate.example: I really appreciate your help with my English homework.
appreciate.exampleZh: 我非常感激你帮我做英语作业。

approach.example: We need a better approach to this difficult problem.
approach.exampleZh: 我们需要用更好的方法来处理这个难题。

appropriate.example: It is not appropriate to take things that do not belong to you.
appropriate.exampleZh: 拿不属于自己的东西是不恰当的。

approval.example: The plan cannot start without the approval of the manager.
approval.exampleZh: 没有经理的批准，这个计划就无法开始。

approve.example: My parents approve of my plan to study abroad next year.
approve.exampleZh: 我父母赞成我明年出国留学的计划。

approximate.example: The approximate cost of the trip is two hundred dollars.
approximate.exampleZh: 这次旅行的大约费用是两百美元。

april.example: We will go to the beach in April when the weather gets warm.
april.exampleZh: 四月天气变暖时我们会去海滩。

apt.example: Her apt answer showed how smart she really was.
apt.exampleZh: 她贴切的回答显示出她有多聪明。

arbitrary.example: The teacher made an arbitrary decision to change the rules for everyone.
arbitrary.exampleZh: 老师武断地决定为所有人更改规则。

architect.example: The architect designed a bright new library for our small town.
architect.exampleZh: 这位建筑师为我们的小镇设计了一座明亮的新图书馆。

architecture.example: The architecture of this old church is very beautiful and famous.
architecture.exampleZh: 这座古老教堂的建筑风格非常美丽且著名。

archive.example: She saved the old letters in the archive for future research.
archive.exampleZh: 她把那些旧信件保存在档案馆里，供日后研究使用。

arctic.example: The arctic winter is long, and the cold wind never stops.
arctic.exampleZh: 北极的冬天很漫长，寒风从不停歇。

are.example: You are a good student and you work very hard every day.
are.exampleZh: 你是个好学生，你每天都非常努力。

area.example: This area of the park is very quiet in the morning.
area.exampleZh: 公园的这一区域在早晨非常安静。

argue.example: They often argue about small things, but they are still good friends.
argue.exampleZh: 他们经常为小事争吵，但仍然是好朋友。

argument.example: They had a long argument about money, but nobody was really angry.
argument.exampleZh: 他们就钱的事争论了很久，但没有人真的生气。

arise.example: Small problems often arise when people do not talk to each other.
arise.exampleZh: 当人们不互相交流时，小问题往往会出现。

arithmetic.example: I am good at simple arithmetic but I still find fractions difficult.
arithmetic.exampleZh: 我擅长简单的算术，但仍然觉得分数很难。

arm.example: He held the baby in his arms and smiled.
arm.exampleZh: 他把婴儿抱在怀里，笑了。

army.example: My brother joined the army after he finished school last year.
army.exampleZh: 我哥哥去年完成学业后参军了。

around.example: We walked around the lake and took many photos.
around.exampleZh: 我们绕着湖散步，拍了很多照片。

arrange.example: I will arrange the chairs and tables for the meeting tomorrow morning.
arrange.exampleZh: 我会为明天上午的会议安排好桌椅。

arrangement.example: We made an arrangement to meet at the station on Friday.
arrangement.exampleZh: 我们安排好了周五在车站见面。

array.example: The store has a wide array of fresh fruit and vegetables.
array.exampleZh: 这家店有各种各样新鲜的蔬菜和水果。

arrest.example: The police arrested the thief near the bank last night.
arrest.exampleZh: 警察昨晚在银行附近逮捕了那个小偷。

arrival.example: We waited at the airport for her arrival, but the plane was late.
arrival.exampleZh: 我们在机场等待她的到来，但飞机晚点了。

arrive.example: We will arrive at the station before the train leaves.
arrive.exampleZh: 我们会在火车开走之前到达车站。

arrow.example: The arrow hit the target right in the middle.
arrow.exampleZh: 那支箭正好射中了靶子的正中央。

art.example: She studies art at school and wants to become a painter.
art.exampleZh: 她在学校学习美术，想成为一名画家。

article.example: I read an interesting article about healthy eating in the newspaper yesterday.
article.exampleZh: 我昨天在报纸上读到了一篇关于健康饮食的有趣文章。

artificial.example: The flowers on the table are artificial, but they look very real.
artificial.exampleZh: 桌上的花是人造的，但看起来非常逼真。

artist.example: The young artist painted a beautiful picture of the quiet lake near her home.
artist.exampleZh: 这位年轻的艺术家为她家附近宁静的湖泊画了一幅美丽的画。

artistic.example: She has artistic talent and loves to paint colorful pictures.
artistic.exampleZh: 她有艺术天赋，喜欢画色彩丰富的画。

as.example: As I was walking home, I saw an old friend.
as.exampleZh: 当我正走回家时，我看见了一位老朋友。

ash.example: The old house was burned to ash in the fire.
ash.exampleZh: 那栋老房子在大火中被烧成了灰烬。

ashamed.example: I felt ashamed when I forgot my mother's birthday again.
ashamed.exampleZh: 当我再次忘记母亲的生日时，我感到很惭愧。

asian.example: Many Asian students study English at our school every day.
asian.exampleZh: 许多亚洲学生每天在我们学校学习英语。

aside.example: He stepped aside to let the old man pass.
aside.exampleZh: 他往旁边让了一步，让那位老人过去。

ask.example: I will ask my teacher for help after class.

asparagus.example: My mother cooks asparagus with eggs for dinner every Friday.
asparagus.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周五晚餐都用鸡蛋炒芦笋。

aspect.example: One important aspect of this job is working well with other people.
aspect.exampleZh: 这份工作的一个重要方面是能与他人良好合作。

aspiration.example: Her aspiration is to become a doctor and help people in need.
aspiration.exampleZh: 她的志向是成为一名医生，帮助有需要的人。

assault.example: The police arrested a man for the assault on a young woman last night.
assault.exampleZh: 警方逮捕了一名昨晚袭击一名年轻女子的男子。

assemble.example: We will assemble the new chairs in the living room after lunch.
assemble.exampleZh: 午饭后我们将在客厅里组装这些新椅子。

assembly.example: The workers finished the assembly of the new machine before noon.
assembly.exampleZh: 工人们在中午前完成了新机器的装配。

assert.example: She asserted that the plan would work, and everyone trusted her.
assert.exampleZh: 她断言这个计划会成功，大家都相信了她。

assess.example: Teachers assess students with short tests at the end of each month.
assess.exampleZh: 老师每个月末用简短的测验来评估学生。

asset.example: Her patience is a great asset when she works with young children.
asset.exampleZh: 她和幼儿相处时，耐心是她的一大优点。

assign.example: The teacher will assign a new task to each student tomorrow.
assign.exampleZh: 老师明天会给每个学生分配一项新任务。

assignment.example: Our teacher gave us a math assignment that is due tomorrow.
assignment.exampleZh: 老师给我们布置了一份明天要交的数学作业。

assist.example: The nurse helped assist the old man with his shoes.
assist.exampleZh: 护士帮忙协助那位老人穿鞋。

assistance.example: She asked her friend for assistance with moving the heavy boxes.
assistance.exampleZh: 她请朋友帮忙搬那些沉重的箱子。

assistant.example: She works as an assistant in a small office near her home.
assistant.exampleZh: 她在离家不远处的一家小办公室里当助理。

associate.example: I always associate this song with my happy school days.
associate.exampleZh: 我总是把这首歌和我快乐的校园时光联系起来。

association.example: She joined a local art association and made many new friends there.
association.exampleZh: 她加入了一个当地的艺术协会，并在那里结交了许多新朋友。

assume.example: I assume you will come to the meeting tomorrow morning.
assume.exampleZh: 我假定你明天早上会来参加会议。

assumption.example: Your plan is based on an assumption that may not be true.
assumption.exampleZh: 你的计划建立在一个可能并不成立的假设之上。

assurance.example: She gave me her assurance that the work would be finished by Friday.
assurance.exampleZh: 她向我保证工作会在周五前完成。

assure.example: I assure you that everything will be ready on time.
assure.exampleZh: 我向你保证一切都会按时准备好。

asteroid.example: Scientists say a large asteroid may pass close to Earth next year.
asteroid.exampleZh: 科学家说一颗大型小行星明年可能会靠近地球。

astonish.example: The young boy's perfect answer did astonish his teacher and the whole class.
astonish.exampleZh: 那个小男孩的完美回答确实让他的老师和全班同学都感到惊讶。

astronaut.example: The astronaut floated slowly through the space station and smiled at the camera.
astronaut.exampleZh: 那名宇航员在空间站里缓缓漂浮，对着镜头微笑。

astronomy.example: She studies astronomy at night and knows many stars by name.
astronomy.exampleZh: 她晚上学习天文学，能叫出许多星星的名字。

at.example: I usually get up at seven and go to school by bus.
at.exampleZh: 我通常七点起床，然后坐公交车去学校。

athlete.example: The young athlete runs fast every morning before school.
athlete.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员每天早上上学前都跑得很快。

atlantic.example: They crossed the Atlantic by boat in the old days.
atlantic.exampleZh: 过去，他们乘船横渡大西洋。

atlas.example: I looked at the atlas to find the small country on the map.
atlas.exampleZh: 我看着地图册，在地图上找到了那个小国家。

atmosphere.example: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere at night.
atmosphere.exampleZh: 这家餐厅晚上有一种温暖友好的气氛。

atom.example: A single atom is too small for us to see with our eyes.
atom.exampleZh: 单个原子太小了，我们用肉眼看不到。

atomic.example: The scientist studied the atomic structure of the new metal very carefully.
atomic.exampleZh: 科学家非常仔细地研究了这种新金属的原子结构。

attach.example: Please attach the file to your email before you send it.
attach.exampleZh: 请在发送邮件之前把文件附上。

attack.example: The dog may attack if you get too close to its food.
attack.exampleZh: 如果你离它的食物太近，那只狗可能会攻击你。

attain.example: She worked hard for years and finally attained her goal.
attain.exampleZh: 她多年努力，最终达到了自己的目标。

attempt.example: She made a brave attempt to save the drowning boy from the cold river.
attempt.exampleZh: 她勇敢地尝试把那个溺水的男孩从冰冷的河里救上来。

attend.example: I will attend the meeting tomorrow morning and listen carefully.
attend.exampleZh: 我明天上午会出席会议并认真听讲。

attention.example: The teacher asked the class to pay attention to the new words.
attention.exampleZh: 老师让全班注意这些新单词。

attitude.example: Her attitude toward the new plan is very positive and open.
attitude.exampleZh: 她对这个新计划的态度非常积极和开放。

attorney.example: Her attorney said she would speak to the judge tomorrow morning.
attorney.exampleZh: 她的律师说她明天上午会和法官谈。

attract.example: The new museum attracts many visitors from other cities every year.
attract.exampleZh: 这座新博物馆每年吸引许多来自其他城市的游客。

attraction.example: The old castle is a popular attraction for visitors in summer.
attraction.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡是夏季游客们喜爱的热门景点。

attractive.example: The new park is very attractive, so many families go there on weekends.
attractive.exampleZh: 这个新公园非常迷人，所以许多家庭周末都去那里。

attribute.example: She attributes her success to hard work and a little luck.
attribute.exampleZh: 她把她的成功归因于努力工作和一点运气。

audience.example: The audience clapped loudly when the singer finished her song.
audience.exampleZh: 歌手唱完歌后，观众热烈鼓掌。

audio.example: The audio on my new laptop is clear and loud enough for movies.
audio.exampleZh: 我的新笔记本电脑的音频清晰，看电影时音量也够大。

audit.example: The company will audit its accounts at the end of every year.
audit.exampleZh: 公司将在每年年底审计其账目。

august.example: My sister's birthday is in August, and we plan a small family party.
august.exampleZh: 我妹妹的生日在八月，我们计划办一个小型的家庭聚会。

aunt.example: My aunt makes very good cakes for us every weekend.
aunt.exampleZh: 我姑母每个周末都给我们做很好吃的蛋糕。

australia.example: My cousin is studying at a university in Australia this year.
australia.exampleZh: 我的表弟今年在澳大利亚的一所大学学习。

authentic.example: This painting is authentic, so the museum will buy it for a high price.
authentic.exampleZh: 这幅画是真迹，所以博物馆会出高价买下它。

author.example: The author of this book lives in a small town near the sea.
author.exampleZh: 这本书的作者住在海边的一个小镇上。

authority.example: The local authority is responsible for keeping the streets clean and safe.
authority.exampleZh: 当地政府部门负责保持街道清洁和安全。

auto.example: My father drives his auto to work every morning.
auto.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的汽车去上班。

automatic.example: The doors in this building are automatic, so they open when you walk near them.
automatic.exampleZh: 这栋楼的门是自动的，你走近时它们就会打开。

automobile.example: My father drives an automobile to work every morning.
automobile.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开汽车去上班。

autonomy.example: The small town was given autonomy to make its own local rules.
autonomy.exampleZh: 这个小镇获得了制定本地规则的自治权。

autumn.example: The leaves turn yellow and red in autumn, so the park looks very beautiful.
autumn.exampleZh: 秋天树叶变黄变红，所以公园看上去非常美丽。

auxiliary.example: The hospital has an auxiliary power supply in case of emergency.
auxiliary.exampleZh: 医院有一套备用电源，以备紧急情况使用。

avail.example: His advice did not avail him much when the deal fell through.
avail.exampleZh: 交易失败时，他的建议并没有给他带来多少帮助。

available.example: Is this room available for the meeting this afternoon?
available.exampleZh: 今天下午这个房间可以用来开会吗？

avenue.example: This quiet avenue is a good way to reach the park.
avenue.exampleZh: 这条安静的林荫道是通往公园的好路径。

average.example: His test score was above the average for the whole class.
average.exampleZh: 他的考试成绩高于全班的平均水平。

avert.example: Quick action helped avert a serious accident on the busy road.
avert.exampleZh: 迅速的行动帮助避免了繁忙道路上的严重事故。

aviation.example: My uncle works in aviation and helps build parts for small planes.
aviation.exampleZh: 我叔叔在航空业工作，帮忙制造小型飞机的零件。

avoid.example: You should avoid eating too much sugar every day.
avoid.exampleZh: 你应该避免每天吃太多糖。

awake.example: I was still awake when the phone rang at midnight.
awake.exampleZh: 午夜电话铃响的时候，我还是醒着的。

award.example: The school gave her an award for her hard work.
award.exampleZh: 学校因她的努力而给她颁发了奖项。

aware.example: She was not aware of the danger until her friend warned her.
aware.exampleZh: 直到朋友警告她，她才意识到危险。

awful.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed home all day.
awful.exampleZh: 天气糟糕透了，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

awkward.example: It was an awkward moment because nobody knew what to say.
awkward.exampleZh: 那是个尴尬的时刻，因为没人知道该说什么。

ax.example: The man used an ax to cut the wood into small pieces.
ax.exampleZh: 那个人用斧子把木头砍成小块。

axis.example: The earth turns around its axis once every twenty-four hours.
axis.exampleZh: 地球每二十四小时绕自己的轴旋转一圈。

baby.example: The baby is sleeping quietly in the small bed.
baby.exampleZh: 婴儿正在小床上安静地睡觉。

bachelor.example: My uncle is still a bachelor and he lives alone in a small apartment.
bachelor.exampleZh: 我叔叔还是个单身汉，他独自住在一间小公寓里。

back.example: My back hurts after I sit in the same chair all day.
back.exampleZh: 我在同一把椅子上坐了一整天，后背疼。

background.example: She comes from a poor background but works very hard.
background.exampleZh: 她出身贫寒，但工作非常努力。

backward.example: He took a backward step and almost fell over the chair.
backward.exampleZh: 他向后退了一步，差点被椅子绊倒。

bacon.example: She fried some bacon for breakfast and made a cup of coffee.
bacon.exampleZh: 她早餐煎了些咸肉，还煮了一杯咖啡。

bacteria.example: Some bacteria can make people sick if the food is not kept cold.
bacteria.exampleZh: 如果食物没有冷藏，一些细菌会让人生病。

bacterium.example: This bacterium is very small and can only be seen under a microscope.
bacterium.exampleZh: 这种细菌非常小，只有在显微镜下才能看到。

bad.example: Smoking is bad for your health and can cause serious problems.
bad.exampleZh: 吸烟对健康有害，可能导致严重的问题。

badge.example: Every student must wear a badge on the first day of school.
badge.exampleZh: 每个学生在开学第一天都必须佩戴徽章。

badly.example: He badly hurt his leg in the accident yesterday.
badly.exampleZh: 他昨天在事故中腿部受了重伤。

badminton.example: My sister and I play badminton in the park every Sunday morning.
badminton.exampleZh: 我和姐姐每个星期天早上都在公园里打羽毛球。

bag.example: She put the apples in a paper bag and went home.
bag.exampleZh: 她把苹果装进一个纸袋里，然后回家了。

baggage.example: He carried his heavy baggage up the stairs to the small hotel room.
baggage.exampleZh: 他提着沉重的行李上楼，来到那间小小的旅馆房间。

bake.example: My mother likes to bake cookies for us on Sundays.
bake.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在周日给我们烤饼干。

bakery.example: Every morning my mother buys fresh bread at the small bakery near our house.
bakery.exampleZh: 每天早上我妈妈都在我们家附近的小面包店买新鲜面包。

balance.example: Please check the balance in your bank account before you pay the bill.
balance.exampleZh: 付账单之前，请先查看你银行账户里的余额。

balcony.example: We drank coffee on the balcony and watched the busy street below.
balcony.exampleZh: 我们在阳台上喝咖啡，看着下面繁忙的街道。

bald.example: My uncle is bald, so he always wears a hat in summer.
bald.exampleZh: 我叔叔是秃头，所以他夏天总是戴帽子。

ball.example: The boy kicked the ball across the grass and scored a goal.
ball.exampleZh: 男孩把球踢过草地，进了一个球。

ballet.example: My sister and I watched a famous ballet at the theater last night.
ballet.exampleZh: 昨晚我和姐姐在剧院观看了一场著名的芭蕾舞剧。

balloon.example: The little girl let go of her red balloon and it flew away.
balloon.exampleZh: 小女孩松开了她的红气球，它飞走了。

ballot.example: Voters put their ballots into the box and wait for the results.
ballot.exampleZh: 选民把选票投入箱中，然后等待结果。

ban.example: The city has decided to ban cars in the old town this summer.
ban.exampleZh: 市政府已决定今年夏天在旧城区禁止汽车通行。

banana.example: My little sister likes to eat a banana with her breakfast every morning.
banana.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢每天早上吃一根香蕉当早餐。

band.example: The band played loud music, and the singer began to dance.
band.exampleZh: 乐队演奏着响亮的音乐，歌手开始跳舞。

bandage.example: The nurse put a bandage on my arm after the small accident.
bandage.exampleZh: 那次小意外之后，护士在我胳膊上缠了绷带。

bang.example: She heard a loud bang and ran to the window.
bang.exampleZh: 她听到一声巨响，便跑向窗户。

bank.example: I put my money in the bank near my house every month.
bank.exampleZh: 我每个月都把 钱存进我家附近的银行。

bankrupt.example: The company went bankrupt after losing its biggest customer last year.
bankrupt.exampleZh: 这家公司在去年失去最大的客户后破产了。

banner.example: The students hung a large banner across the front of the school gate.
banner.exampleZh: 学生们在学校大门前挂起了一条大横幅。

bar.example: We met at the bar near my house and talked for two hours.
bar.exampleZh: 我们在我家附近的酒吧见面，聊了两个小时。

barbecue.example: We had a barbecue in the park with our friends last Saturday.
barbecue.exampleZh: 上周六我们和朋友在公园里进行了一次烧烤野餐。

barber.example: The barber cut my hair short and neat for the summer.
barber.exampleZh: 理发师把我的头发剪得又短又利落，适合夏天。

bare.example: He walked on the hot sand with bare feet and smiled.
bare.exampleZh: 他光着脚走在滚烫的沙子上，笑了。

barely.example: She barely had time to eat before the bus arrived.
barely.exampleZh: 公交车到之前，她几乎没有时间吃饭。

bargain.example: She got a great bargain on that red coat yesterday.
bargain.exampleZh: 她昨天买那件红色外套时捡了个大便宜。

bark.example: The dog likes to bark at strangers, but it never bites anyone.
bark.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢对陌生人吠叫，但它从不咬人。

barn.example: The farmer keeps his cows and horses in the old red barn.
barn.exampleZh: 农夫把牛和马养在那座旧红色谷仓里。

barrel.example: He filled the old wooden barrel with fresh water from the well.
barrel.exampleZh: 他把井里的清水灌满了那个旧木桶。

barrier.example: Language is often a barrier for people who move to a new country.
barrier.exampleZh: 对于搬到新国家的人来说，语言往往是一个障碍。

base.example: The small team set up a base near the lake last week.
base.exampleZh: 这个小团队上周在湖边建立了一个基地。

baseball.example: My brother plays baseball with his friends every Saturday morning in the park.
baseball.exampleZh: 我哥哥每个星期六早上都和朋友在公园里打棒球。

basement.example: The old boxes are still in the basement under our house.
basement.exampleZh: 那些旧箱子还在我们家房子下面的地下室里。

basic.example: Water and food are basic needs for every living thing.
basic.exampleZh: 水和食物是每种生物的基本需求。

basin.example: She filled the basin with warm water to wash her face.
basin.exampleZh: 她往脸盆里倒满温水洗脸。

basis.example: Trust is the basis of every good friendship.
basis.exampleZh: 信任是一切良好友谊的基础。

basket.example: She put the fresh apples into a large basket on the table.
basket.exampleZh: 她把新鲜的苹果放进桌上的一个大篮子里。

basketball.example: My brother and I play basketball in the park every Saturday morning.
basketball.exampleZh: 我哥哥和我每周六早上都在公园里打篮球。

bat.example: The boy hit the ball with a wooden bat and ran to first base.
bat.exampleZh: 男孩用木制球棒击球，然后跑向一垒。

batch.example: The factory made a new batch of toys this morning.
batch.exampleZh: 今天早上工厂生产了一批新玩具。

bath.example: She gives the baby a warm bath before bed every night.
bath.exampleZh: 她每天晚上睡前给宝宝洗个温水澡。

bathe.example: Every night she bathes her baby in warm water before bed.
bathe.exampleZh: 每天晚上她在睡前用温水给婴儿洗澡。

bathroom.example: The bathroom is next to my bedroom on the second floor.
bathroom.exampleZh: 浴室在二楼我卧室的旁边。

battery.example: My phone battery dies quickly when I play games.
battery.exampleZh: 我玩游戏的时候手机电池很快就没电了。

battle.example: The soldiers fought a long battle for peace and freedom.
battle.exampleZh: 士兵们为和平与自由进行了一场漫长的战斗。

bay.example: The small boat is safe in the bay near our town.
bay.exampleZh: 小船在我们镇附近的海湾里很安全。

be.example: I want to be a teacher when I grow up.
be.exampleZh: 我长大后想成为一名老师。

beach.example: We walked along the beach and found many small shells.
beach.exampleZh: 我们沿着海滩散步，找到了许多小贝壳。

beam.example: The wooden beam across the ceiling started to shake during the storm.
beam.exampleZh: 暴风雨中，横跨天花板的那根木梁开始晃动。

bean.example: My mother cooks bean soup with carrots and potatoes every Sunday.
bean.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都用胡萝卜和土豆煮豆子汤。

bear.example: I cannot bear the noise from the street outside my window.
bear.exampleZh: 我无法忍受窗外街道上传来的噪音。

beard.example: My grandfather has a long white beard and wears glasses.
beard.exampleZh: 我祖父留着长长的白胡子，戴着眼镜。

beast.example: The hungry beast came out of the dark forest at night.
beast.exampleZh: 那只饥饿的野兽在夜里从黑暗的森林中出来了。

beat.example: The drummer kept a steady beat while the band played their new song.
beat.exampleZh: 乐队演奏新歌时，鼓手保持着稳定的节拍。

beautiful.example: The garden looks beautiful in spring when all the flowers open.
beautiful.exampleZh: 春天百花盛开时，这个花园看起来很美。

beauty.example: She loves the beauty of the mountains in the early morning.
beauty.exampleZh: 她喜爱清晨群山的美丽。

because.example: I stayed home because I felt sick this morning.
because.exampleZh: 我今天早上感觉不舒服，所以待在家里。

become.example: She wants to become a doctor when she grows up.
become.exampleZh: 她长大后想成为一名医生。

bed.example: The cat is sleeping on my bed.
bed.exampleZh: 那只猫正睡在我的床上。

bedroom.example: My bedroom is small but very clean and bright.
bedroom.exampleZh: 我的卧室很小，但非常干净明亮。

bee.example: A bee flew into the garden and landed on a yellow flower.
bee.exampleZh: 一只蜜蜂飞进花园，落在一朵黄花上。

beef.example: My mother cooks beef with potatoes for dinner every Sunday.
beef.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期日都做土豆炖牛肉当晚餐。

beer.example: After work, he opened a cold beer and sat down to watch the game.
beer.exampleZh: 下班后，他打开一罐冰啤酒，坐下来看比赛。

before.example: I always wash my hands before I eat dinner with my family.
before.exampleZh: 我和家人吃晚饭前总是先洗手。

beg.example: The poor man had to beg for money on the street every day.
beg.exampleZh: 那个可怜的人每天不得不在街上乞讨钱财。

begin.example: We will begin the meeting at nine tomorrow morning.
begin.exampleZh: 我们明天上午九点开始开会。

beginning.example: The beginning of the book is easy to read.
beginning.exampleZh: 这本书的开头部分很容易读。

behalf.example: I spoke on behalf of my whole family at the meeting.
behalf.exampleZh: 我在会上代表我全家发言。

behave.example: The children behave well when their teacher is in the room.
behave.exampleZh: 老师在教室里的时候，孩子们表现很好。

behavior.example: His behavior in class today was very good.
behavior.exampleZh: 他今天在课堂上的表现非常好。

behind.example: The little boy hid behind the door and waited for his mother.
behind.exampleZh: 小男孩躲在门后等着他妈妈。

being.example: Every human being needs love and respect from other people.
being.exampleZh: 每个人都需他人的爱与尊重。

belief.example: Her belief in her team helped them win the game.
belief.exampleZh: 她对团队的信任帮助他们赢得了比赛。

believe.example: I believe he is a good teacher.

bell.example: The school bell rings at eight every morning.
bell.exampleZh: 学校的铃每天早晨八点响。

belly.example: The little boy ate too much and his belly felt very full.
belly.exampleZh: 小男孩吃得太多了，他的肚子感觉很胀。

belong.example: This book does not belong to me, so please give it back to the library.
belong.exampleZh: 这本书不是我的，请把它还给图书馆。

beloved.example: She lost her beloved grandmother last winter and still misses her.
beloved.exampleZh: 去年冬天她失去了深爱的祖母，至今仍很想念她。

below.example: The temperature is below zero, so the water in the lake is frozen.
below.exampleZh: 气温低于零度，所以湖里的水结冰了。

belt.example: He wore a black leather belt with his new blue jeans.
belt.exampleZh: 他穿着新蓝色牛仔裤，系着一条黑色皮带。

bench.example: The old man sat on a wooden bench in the park.
bench.exampleZh: 老人在公园里坐在一条木制长椅上。

bend.example: Please bend your knees slowly before you lift the heavy box.
bend.exampleZh: 抬起重箱子之前，请慢慢弯曲你的膝盖。

beneath.example: The cat is sleeping beneath the old wooden table.
beneath.exampleZh: 猫正在那张旧木桌下面睡觉。

beneficial.example: Regular exercise is beneficial to both your body and your mind.
beneficial.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的身体和心理都有益。

benefit.example: Regular exercise can benefit people of all ages in many ways.
benefit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能在很多方面有益于各个年龄段的人。

bent.example: He has a natural bent for music and plays several instruments.
bent.exampleZh: 他有音乐天赋，会演奏几种乐器。

beside.example: She sat beside the window and read a book all afternoon.
beside.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，整个下午都在看书。

besides.example: Besides English, she also speaks French and a little Chinese.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还会说法语和一点中文。

best.example: She is my best friend at school.
best.exampleZh: 她是我在学校里最好的朋友。

bet.example: I bet ten dollars that our team will win the game tomorrow.
bet.exampleZh: 我赌十美元我们队明天会赢得比赛。

betray.example: I will never betray my friend's trust, even when it is difficult.
betray.exampleZh: 即使很难，我也永远不会辜负朋友的信任。

better.example: Regular exercise will help you sleep better and feel more energetic every day.
better.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能帮助你睡得更好，每天感觉更有精力。

between.example: There is a small park between the school and the library.
between.exampleZh: 学校和图书馆之间有一个小公园。

bewilder.example: The many strange signs in the old city bewilder most new visitors.
bewilder.exampleZh: 老城里众多奇怪的标志让大多数新游客感到困惑。

beyond.example: The small village lies beyond those green hills.
beyond.exampleZh: 那个小村庄位于那些绿色山丘的那一边。

bias.example: His parents tried not to bias him against people from other countries.
bias.exampleZh: 他的父母尽量不让他对来自其他国家的人产生偏见。

bible.example: She reads the bible every night before going to bed.
bible.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会读圣经。

bicycle.example: My father gave me a new bicycle for my birthday last week.
bicycle.exampleZh: 上周我爸爸送了我一辆新自行车作为生日礼物。

bid.example: The company will bid for the new road project next week.
bid.exampleZh: 这家公司下周将为这条新道路项目投标。

big.example: This is a big problem for our small team to solve.
big.exampleZh: 对我们这个小团队来说，解决这个问题很不容易。

bill.example: He paid the bill at the restaurant before leaving with his friends.
bill.exampleZh: 他和朋友们离开前在餐厅付了账。

billion.example: The company spent one billion dollars on a new factory last year.
billion.exampleZh: 这家公司去年花十亿美元建了一座新工厂。

bin.example: Please put the empty bottle in the bin near the door.
bin.exampleZh: 请把空瓶子放进门口附近的垃圾箱里。

binary.example: The computer stores all data in a binary system of ones and zeros.
binary.exampleZh: 计算机用由一和零组成的二进位系统存储所有数据。

bind.example: The rules bind all new members to follow the club's safety guide.
bind.exampleZh: 这些规则约束所有新成员遵守俱乐部的安全指南。

biology.example: She wants to study biology because she loves animals and plants.
biology.exampleZh: 她想学习生物学，因为她喜欢动物和植物。

bird.example: A small bird is singing in the tree outside my window.
bird.exampleZh: 一只小鸟正在我窗外的树上唱歌。

birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby boy last week.
birth.exampleZh: 她上周生了一个健康的男婴。

birthday.example: My little sister's birthday is next Sunday, and we are planning a small party.
birthday.exampleZh: 我妹妹的生日在下周日，我们正打算办一个小派对。

biscuit.example: My little sister ate a biscuit and drank some warm milk.
biscuit.exampleZh: 我妹妹吃了一块饼干，还喝了一些温牛奶。

bit.example: I only need a bit of sugar in my tea.
bit.exampleZh: 我的茶里只需要放一点点糖。

bite.example: The little dog tried to bite my shoe this morning.
bite.exampleZh: 那只小狗今天早上想咬我的鞋。

bitter.example: The medicine tastes bitter, but it will help you feel better soon.
bitter.exampleZh: 这药尝起来很苦，但它很快会让你好起来。

black.example: She wore a black dress to the party last night.
black.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿着一件黑色连衣裙去参加聚会。

blackboard.example: Our teacher writes new English words on the blackboard every morning.
blackboard.exampleZh: 我们老师每天早上在黑板上写新的英语单词。

blade.example: Be careful with that knife because its blade is very sharp.
blade.exampleZh: 小心那把刀，因为它的刀刃非常锋利。

blame.example: Don't blame him for the mistake because he is new here.
blame.exampleZh: 不要因为这个错误而责怪他，因为他是新来的。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space at the top of the page.
blank.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面顶端的空白处。

blanket.example: She put a warm blanket on the bed because the room was cold.
blanket.exampleZh: 她在床上铺了一条温暖的毛毯，因为房间很冷。

blast.example: The bomb blast broke every window in the old school building.
blast.exampleZh: 炸弹爆炸震碎了那所老学校教学楼的所有窗户。

blaze.example: The fire began to blaze brightly in the cold night wind.
blaze.exampleZh: 火在寒冷的夜风中开始熊熊燃烧。

bleed.example: The cut on his hand began to bleed after he fell.
bleed.exampleZh: 他摔倒后，手上的伤口开始流血。

blend.example: Blend the eggs and sugar together, then add the flour slowly.
blend.exampleZh: 把鸡蛋和糖混合在一起，然后慢慢加入面粉。

bless.example: May God bless you and your family with good health.
bless.exampleZh: 愿上帝祝福你和你的家人身体健康。

blind.example: The accident left him blind in one eye, but he still works.
blind.exampleZh: 那次事故使他一只眼睛失明，但他仍然在工作。

block.example: A fallen tree can block the road after a heavy storm.
block.exampleZh: 一场大暴雨过后，倒下的树会阻塞道路。

blood.example: The doctor took some blood from his arm to run a test.
blood.exampleZh: 医生从他的手臂上取了一些血来做化验。

bloody.example: That was a bloody difficult exam, and I am glad it is over.
bloody.exampleZh: 那场考试非常难，我很高兴它结束了。

bloom.example: The garden looks beautiful when the flowers bloom in early spring.
bloom.exampleZh: 早春花开时，花园看起来很美。

blossom.example: The apple trees blossom every spring, and their pink flowers smell sweet.
blossom.exampleZh: 苹果树每年春天开花，粉色的花朵散发着甜香。

blow.example: The wind can blow very hard on cold winter nights.
blow.exampleZh: 寒冷的冬夜里，风有时会刮得很大。

blue.example: The sky is blue and clear after the rain today.
blue.exampleZh: 今天雨后，天空湛蓝而晴朗。

blur.example: Tears blurred my eyes, and the words on the page became a blur.
blur.exampleZh: 泪水模糊了我的双眼，书页上的字变得模糊不清。

blush.example: She began to blush when everyone looked at her new dress.
blush.exampleZh: 当所有人都看她的新裙子时，她开始脸红了。

board.example: The board voted to build a new school next year.
board.exampleZh: 董事会投票决定明年建一所新学校。

boast.example: He likes to boast about his new car, but nobody believes him.
boast.exampleZh: 他喜欢吹嘘自己的新车，但没人相信他。

boat.example: Every morning my father takes a small boat across the river to work.
boat.exampleZh: 每天早上我父亲坐一条小船过河去上班。

body.example: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
body.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能让你的身体保持强壮健康。

boil.example: Water will boil faster if you put a lid on the pot.
boil.exampleZh: 如果你给锅盖上盖子，水会沸腾得更快。

bold.example: The bold student raised his hand and asked the teacher a hard question.
bold.exampleZh: 那个大胆的学生举手向老师提了一个难题。

bolt.example: He shut the door and pushed the bolt across before going to bed.
bolt.exampleZh: 他关上门，在上床睡觉前把插销推上。

bomb.example: The old bomb was found in the garden and the police closed the street.
bomb.exampleZh: 那颗旧炸弹在花园里被发现，警察封锁了街道。

bond.example: The bond between the mother and her child grew stronger over the years.
bond.exampleZh: 母亲和孩子之间的纽带随着岁月流逝变得更强。

bone.example: The dog is chewing a big bone in the garden.
bone.exampleZh: 那只狗正在花园里啃一块大骨头。

bonus.example: The company gave every worker a small bonus at the end of the year.
bonus.exampleZh: 公司在年底给每位员工发了一笔小额奖金。

book.example: I want to book a table for two at the new restaurant tonight.
book.exampleZh: 我想今晚在那家新餐厅预订一张两人桌。

boom.example: The city's economy began to boom after the new port opened.
boom.exampleZh: 新港口开放后，这座城市的经济开始繁荣起来。

boost.example: The new policy will boost sales and help small shops grow.
boost.exampleZh: 新政策将促进销售，帮助小店发展。

boot.example: My new boots are wet because I walked in the rain.
boot.exampleZh: 我的新靴子湿了，因为我在雨中走路。

border.example: The river forms the border between the two small countries.
border.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两个小国之间的边界。

bore.example: The long speech began to bore the students, so some of them fell asleep.
bore.exampleZh: 那场冗长的演讲开始让学生们厌烦，所以有些人睡着了。

boring.example: This movie is so boring that I fell asleep in the middle.
boring.exampleZh: 这部电影太无聊了，我中场就睡着了。

born.example: She was born in a small town near the sea.
born.exampleZh: 她出生在海边的一个小镇上。

borrow.example: Can I borrow your pen for a minute, please?
borrow.exampleZh: 我能借用一下你的笔吗？

boss.example: My boss is very kind, and he often helps us with our work.
boss.exampleZh: 我的老板很和善，他经常帮助我们完成工作。

both.example: Both of my parents like tea, and both my sisters do too.
both.exampleZh: 我父母都喜欢喝茶，我的两个姐姐也都喜欢。

bother.example: Sorry to bother you, but I need your help with this problem.
bother.exampleZh: 不好意思打扰你，但我需要你帮我解决这个问题。

bottle.example: She put the cold water in a clean bottle for the trip.
bottle.exampleZh: 她把冷水装进一个干净的瓶子里，准备旅行时喝。

bottom.example: The keys are at the bottom of my blue bag.
bottom.exampleZh: 钥匙在我蓝色包的底部。

bounce.example: The ball can bounce very high on this hard floor.
bounce.exampleZh: 球在这种硬地板上能弹得非常高。

bound.example: The train is bound for the north, and the children jumped with joy.
bound.exampleZh: 火车开往北方，孩子们高兴地跳了起来。

boundary.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two small towns.
boundary.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两个小镇之间的天然分界线。

bow.example: He gave a polite bow and then left the room.
bow.exampleZh: 他礼貌地鞠了一躬，然后离开了房间。

bowl.example: She put the hot soup in a large bowl on the table.
bowl.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在一个大碗里，放在桌上。

box.example: She put the old books in a box and carried it upstairs.
box.exampleZh: 她把旧书放进一个箱子里，然后把它搬到了楼上。

boy.example: The boy likes to play football with his friends after school.
boy.exampleZh: 这个男孩喜欢放学后和朋友们踢足球。

boycott.example: Many people boycotted the company after the news about its poor working conditions.
boycott.exampleZh: 在关于其恶劣工作条件的新闻传出后，许多人抵制了这家公司。

brain.example: The human brain is very complex and needs a lot of energy to work well.
brain.exampleZh: 人类的大脑非常复杂，需要大量能量才能良好运转。

brake.example: The driver hit the brake hard when a dog ran into the road.
brake.exampleZh: 一只狗跑到路上时，司机猛踩了刹车。

branch.example: The bird sat on a high branch of the old tree.
branch.exampleZh: 那只鸟停在老树的一根高枝上。

brand.example: This brand of coffee is very popular with young people.
brand.exampleZh: 这个牌子的咖啡很受年轻人欢迎。

brass.example: The old band played music on brass instruments all night.
brass.exampleZh: 这支老乐队整晚用铜管乐器演奏音乐。

brave.example: The brave girl saved a small cat from the cold river.
brave.exampleZh: 那个勇敢的女孩从冰冷的河里救出了一只小猫。

bread.example: I buy fresh bread from the small shop near my house every morning.
bread.exampleZh: 我每天早上都从家附近的小店买新鲜面包。

breadth.example: Her breadth of knowledge makes her a great teacher.
breadth.exampleZh: 她广博的知识使她成为一名优秀的老师。

break.example: Let's take a short break after we break the ice.
break.exampleZh: 我们打破僵局之后就休息一下。

breakdown.example: The breakdown of the old machine stopped all work in the factory.
breakdown.exampleZh: 那台旧机器故障导致工厂所有工作都停了下来。

breakfast.example: I eat breakfast with my family before I go to work.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我上班前和家人一起吃早餐。

breast.example: The baby rested its head against its mother's breast and fell asleep.
breast.exampleZh: 婴儿把头靠在母亲的胸前，睡着了。

breath.example: Take a deep breath and slowly count to ten.
breath.exampleZh: 深吸一口气，然后慢慢数到十。

breathe.example: She closed her eyes and took a moment to breathe slowly.
breathe.exampleZh: 她闭上眼睛，慢慢呼吸了一会儿。

breed.example: Farmers breed these animals for their meat and milk.
breed.exampleZh: 农民饲养这些动物以获取肉和奶。

breeze.example: A gentle breeze came through the open window and cooled the room.
breeze.exampleZh: 一阵微风从敞开的窗户吹进来，让房间凉爽起来。

brick.example: The old house was built with red brick and strong wood.
brick.exampleZh: 那座老房子是用红砖和结实的木头建成的。

bride.example: The bride looked very happy at her wedding today.
bride.exampleZh: 新娘在今天的婚礼上看起来非常幸福。

bridge.example: A small bridge crosses the river near our house.
bridge.exampleZh: 我们家附近的河上有一座小桥。

brief.example: The manager gave a brief talk about the new plan.
brief.exampleZh: 经理就新计划作了简短的讲话。

briefcase.example: He put his laptop into his black briefcase and left the office.
briefcase.exampleZh: 他把笔记本电脑放进黑色公文包里，然后离开了办公室。

bright.example: The bright morning sun made the whole room warm and cheerful.
bright.exampleZh: 明亮的晨光让整个房间变得温暖又欢快。

brilliant.example: She is a brilliant student who always helps her classmates.
brilliant.exampleZh: 她是个才华横溢的学生，总是帮助同学。

bring.example: Please bring your notebook to class tomorrow morning.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天早上把你的笔记本带到课堂上。

brisk.example: We took a brisk walk in the cold morning air.
brisk.exampleZh: 我们在寒冷的晨风中轻快地散步。

broad.example: The river is very broad here, so it is hard to cross.
broad.exampleZh: 这里的河面非常宽阔，所以很难过去。

broadcast.example: The station will broadcast the game live on Saturday night.
broadcast.exampleZh: 电视台将在周六晚上直播这场比赛。

brochure.example: I picked up a brochure about the museum at the front desk.
brochure.exampleZh: 我在前台拿了一本关于博物馆的小册子。

broker.example: My broker helped me buy my first house last year.
broker.exampleZh: 我的经纪人去年帮我买下了第一套房子。

broom.example: She used a broom to clean the floor after lunch.
broom.exampleZh: 午饭后她用扫帚打扫地板。

brother.example: My brother and I play football in the park every Sunday.
brother.exampleZh: 我哥哥和我每个星期天都在公园踢足球。

brow.example: He wiped the sweat from his brow and looked at the long road ahead.
brow.exampleZh: 他擦去额头上的汗水，望着前方漫长的路。

brown.example: The leaves turn brown in autumn and fall from the tall trees in the park.
brown.exampleZh: 秋天树叶变成棕色，从公园里高大的树上落下来。

browse.example: On Sunday mornings I like to browse the old bookshop near my home.
browse.exampleZh: 星期天早上我喜欢到我家附近的旧书店随便翻阅书籍。

brush.example: She used a small brush to clean the mud off her shoes.
brush.exampleZh: 她用一把小刷子把鞋子上的泥刷掉。

bubble.example: Children love to blow bubbles in the water and watch them float up.
bubble.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在水里吹泡泡，看着它们向上飘。

bucket.example: She filled the bucket with water and carried it to the garden.
bucket.exampleZh: 她把水桶装满水，然后把它提到花园里。

budget.example: We must keep our monthly budget low to save money for a new house.
budget.exampleZh: 我们必须把每月预算控制在较低水平，以便为买新房存钱。

build.example: They plan to build a new school near the park next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建一所新学校。

building.example: The new building near my school is very tall and modern.
building.exampleZh: 我学校附近的那栋新大楼又高又现代。

bulb.example: She turned off the bright bulb and went to bed early.
bulb.exampleZh: 她关掉了明亮的电灯泡，早早上床睡觉了。

bulk.example: The bulk of the work is already finished.
bulk.exampleZh: 这项工作的大部分已经完成了。

bullet.example: The police found a bullet near the broken window last night.
bullet.exampleZh: 警方昨晚在破碎的窗户附近发现了一颗子弹。

bulletin.example: The school put a bulletin on the door about the holiday schedule.
bulletin.exampleZh: 学校在门上贴了一张关于假期安排的公告。

bump.example: Be careful not to bump your head on the low door.
bump.exampleZh: 小心别撞到那扇低矮的门上。

bunch.example: She bought a bunch of bananas and shared them with her friends.
bunch.exampleZh: 她买了一串香蕉，和朋友们一起分着吃。

bundle.example: She put the old newspapers in a bundle and carried them outside.
bundle.exampleZh: 她把旧报纸捆成一捆，搬到了外面。

burden.example: She has to carry the burden of caring for her whole family alone.
burden.exampleZh: 她不得不独自承担照顾全家人的重担。

bureau.example: The travel bureau can help you find a cheap hotel near the station.
bureau.exampleZh: 旅行社可以帮你在车站附近找一家便宜的旅馆。

burn.example: Be careful with that pan because it is very hot and can burn your hand.
burn.exampleZh: 小心那个平底锅，它很烫，会烫伤你的手。

burst.example: The water pipe burst in the cold night, so we called a plumber for help.
burst.exampleZh: 水管在寒冷的夜里爆裂了，所以我们打电话叫水管工来帮忙。

bury.example: The dog likes to bury its bone in the garden.
bury.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢把骨头埋在花园里。

bus.example: I take the bus to school every morning at seven.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上七点乘公共汽车去学校。

bush.example: There is a small brown bird in the bush near my house.
bush.exampleZh: 我家附近的灌木丛里有一只棕色的小鸟。

business.example: My father runs a small business in the city center.
business.exampleZh: 我父亲在市中心经营一家小商店。

busy.example: My mother is too busy to cook dinner tonight.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈今晚太忙了，没时间做晚饭。

but.example: I want to go to the party, but I have too much work to do tonight.
but.exampleZh: 我想去参加聚会，但今晚我有太多工作要做。

butcher.example: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces for us.
butcher.exampleZh: 屠夫把肉切成了小块给我们。

butter.example: I like to put butter on my warm bread in the morning.
butter.exampleZh: 早上我喜欢在热面包上涂黄油。

butterfly.example: A colorful butterfly landed gently on the flower in our garden.
butterfly.exampleZh: 一只色彩斑斓的蝴蝶轻轻落在我们花园里的花上。

button.example: Please press the red button to start the machine.
button.exampleZh: 请按红色按钮来启动机器。

buy.example: I want to buy a new phone this week.
buy.exampleZh: 我这个星期想买一部新手机。

buzz.example: There is a buzz of excitement in the office today.
buzz.exampleZh: 今天办公室里充满了兴奋的嗡嗡议论声。

by.example: I go to school by bus every morning.
by.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐公共汽车去上学。

bypass.example: Drivers can bypass the busy city center by taking the new road.
bypass.exampleZh: 司机们可以走这条新路绕过繁忙的市中心。

cabin.example: We stayed in a small wooden cabin near the lake last summer.
cabin.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们住在湖边一间小木屋里。

cabinet.example: She put the clean cups and plates in the kitchen cabinet.
cabinet.exampleZh: 她把干净的杯子和盘子放进厨房的橱柜里。

cable.example: The workers used a strong cable to pull the boat to the shore.
cable.exampleZh: 工人们用一根结实的缆绳把船拉到了岸边。

calcium.example: Milk and cheese are good sources of calcium for growing children.
calcium.exampleZh: 牛奶和奶酪是成长中孩子获取钙的良好来源。

calculate.example: We need to calculate the cost before we buy the new computer.
calculate.exampleZh: 我们需要在买新电脑之前计算一下费用。

calendar.example: I write all my appointments on the calendar by my desk.
calendar.exampleZh: 我把所有预约都写在我桌子旁的日历上。

calm.example: She stayed calm and helped the children get out of the house.
calm.exampleZh: 她保持镇静，帮助孩子们离开了房子。

calorie.example: This small cake has over three hundred calories in it.
calorie.exampleZh: 这个小蛋糕里含有三百多卡路里。

camp.example: We set up camp near the river and stayed there for two nights.
camp.exampleZh: 我们在河边扎营，在那里待了两个晚上。

campaign.example: The students started a campaign to keep the school clean and green.
campaign.exampleZh: 学生们发起了一场让学校保持清洁和绿色的运动。

campus.example: The new library is in the middle of our campus.
campus.exampleZh: 新图书馆在我们校园的中央。

canal.example: The old canal carries water to the farms outside the city.
canal.exampleZh: 这条古老的运河把水输送到城外的农田。

cancel.example: I had to cancel my trip because I felt sick.
cancel.exampleZh: 我因为生病不得不取消旅行。

cancer.example: Smoking for many years can increase the risk of lung cancer.
cancer.exampleZh: 多年吸烟会增加患肺癌的风险。

candidate.example: Each candidate must give a short speech before the final vote.
candidate.exampleZh: 每位候选人都必须在最终投票前做一个简短的演讲。

canteen.example: We eat lunch in the school canteen every day.
canteen.exampleZh: 我们每天在学校食堂吃午饭。

capable.example: She is capable of doing the job well on her own.
capable.exampleZh: 她有能力独自把这份工作做好。

capacity.example: This small room has the capacity to hold ten people.
capacity.exampleZh: 这个小房间能容纳十个人。

capture.example: The police worked hard to capture the thief who stole the money.
capture.exampleZh: 警方努力抓捕那个偷钱的小偷。

carbohydrate.example: Rice and bread are rich in carbohydrate, which gives us energy.
carbohydrate.exampleZh: 米饭和面包富含碳水化合物，能为我们提供能量。

carbon.example: Carbon is an important element found in all living things.
carbon.exampleZh: 碳是存在于所有生物体内的重要元素。

career.example: She wants to build a career in medicine after she finishes school.
career.exampleZh: 她想在完成学业后投身医学事业。

careful.example: Please be careful when you cross this busy street.
careful.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的马路时请小心。

careless.example: He is careless with his homework and often makes small mistakes.
careless.exampleZh: 他做作业很粗心，经常犯小错误。

cargo.example: The ship carried a heavy cargo of grain across the sea.
cargo.exampleZh: 这艘船载着沉重的谷物货物横渡大海。

carnival.example: We went to the carnival and saw many games, rides and bright lights.
carnival.exampleZh: 我们去了嘉年华，看到了许多游戏、游乐设施和明亮的灯光。

carpenter.example: The carpenter made a small wooden table for our kitchen.
carpenter.exampleZh: 木匠为我们的厨房做了一张小木桌。

carpet.example: The old cat likes to sleep on the soft carpet by the door.
carpet.exampleZh: 那只老猫喜欢睡在门边柔软的地毯上。

carriage.example: The old carriage moved slowly along the quiet country road.
carriage.exampleZh: 那辆旧马车沿着安静的乡间小路缓缓前行。

carrier.example: The airline is a major carrier in Asia.
carrier.exampleZh: 这家航空公司是亚洲的一家主要运输公司。

carry.example: She always carries a small notebook and a pen to every class.
carry.exampleZh: 她每次上课总是带着一个小本子和一支笔。

cartoon.example: My little sister watches a funny cartoon every morning before school.
cartoon.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上上学前都会看一部有趣的动画片。

cash.example: I paid for the coffee in cash because the card machine was broken.
cash.exampleZh: 我用现金付了咖啡的钱，因为刷卡机坏了。

cast.example: The director will cast a famous actor in the new film.
cast.exampleZh: 导演将在这部新电影中选用一位著名演员。

casual.example: He wore casual clothes to the party and felt relaxed.
casual.exampleZh: 他穿着随意的衣服去参加聚会，感到很放松。

catalog.example: The library has a catalog of all its new books.
catalog.exampleZh: 图书馆有一份所有新书的目录。

catch.example: I run fast to catch the early bus every morning.
catch.exampleZh: 我每天早上跑得很快去赶早班公交车。

category.example: This book belongs to a different category than the other ones.
category.exampleZh: 这本书属于与其他几本不同的类别。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps a lot of cattle on his small farm.
cattle.exampleZh: 这个农夫在他的小农场里养了很多牛。

cause.example: Careless driving can cause serious accidents on the road.
cause.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶可能会在路上造成严重事故。

caution.example: Please use caution when you cross this busy street.
caution.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的街道时请小心。

cautious.example: She is cautious when she walks on the wet floor.
cautious.exampleZh: 她走在湿滑的地板上时很小心。

cease.example: The rain finally ceased and the children went out to play.
cease.exampleZh: 雨终于停了，孩子们出去玩了。

ceiling.example: The lamp hangs from the ceiling above the kitchen table.
ceiling.exampleZh: 那盏灯挂在天花板上，位于厨房餐桌上方。

celebrate.example: We celebrate her birthday with a small cake and a happy song.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们用一个小蛋糕和一首欢快的歌来庆祝她的生日。

cell.example: Each cell in the body has a special job to do.
cell.exampleZh: 身体里的每个细胞都有特定的任务要完成。

cement.example: The workers used cement to build a strong wall around the garden.
cement.exampleZh: 工人们用水泥在花园周围砌了一堵坚固的墙。

cemetery.example: We walked through the old cemetery and read the names on the stones.
cemetery.exampleZh: 我们走过那座古老的公墓，读着墓碑上的名字。

census.example: The government takes a census of the population every ten years.
census.exampleZh: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。

centigrade.example: The temperature outside is twenty degrees centigrade today.
centigrade.exampleZh: 今天外面的温度是二十摄氏度。

centimeter.example: The small box is only ten centimeters long and five centimeters wide.
centimeter.exampleZh: 这个小盒子只有十厘米长、五厘米宽。

central.example: The library is in a central spot on our small campus.
central.exampleZh: 图书馆在我们小校区的一个中心位置。

centre.example: The new library stands at the centre of our small town.
centre.exampleZh: 新图书馆坐落在我们小镇的中心。

century.example: The old church was built in the nineteenth century and still stands today.
century.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于十九世纪，至今依然矗立。

cereal.example: I eat cereal with milk every morning before I go to school.
cereal.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前都吃麦片加牛奶。

ceremony.example: The wedding ceremony will begin at ten o'clock this morning.
ceremony.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式将于今天上午十点开始。

certain.example: I am certain that she will come to the party tonight.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定她今晚会来参加派对。

certainty.example: There is no certainty that the plan will work.
certainty.exampleZh: 这个计划是否会成功并没有把握。

certificate.example: You need a birth certificate to get a passport.
certificate.exampleZh: 你需要出生证明才能办护照。

certify.example: The doctor must certify that he is fit to work.
certify.exampleZh: 医生必须证明他适合工作。

chain.example: She used a strong chain to tie her bike to the tree.
chain.exampleZh: 她用一条结实的链条把自行车拴在树上。

chairman.example: The chairman opened the meeting and asked everyone to sit down.
chairman.exampleZh: 主席宣布会议开始，并请大家坐下。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge, but I enjoy it.
challenge.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是个很大的挑战，但我很享受。

chamber.example: The meeting was held in a large chamber on the second floor.
chamber.exampleZh: 会议在二楼的一间大会议室里举行。

champion.example: She is a champion of clean energy and works hard to support it.
champion.exampleZh: 她是清洁能源的拥护者，并努力支持它。

chance.example: There is a good chance that we will finish the work today.
chance.exampleZh: 我们今天很有可能完成这项工作。

change.example: I want to change my old phone and buy a new one.
change.exampleZh: 我想换掉我的旧手机，买一部新的。

channel.example: This TV channel shows many interesting programs for children every day.
channel.exampleZh: 这个电视频道每天播放许多有趣的儿童节目。

chant.example: The fans began to chant the team's name after the winning goal.
chant.exampleZh: 获胜进球后，球迷们开始反复呼喊球队的名字。

chaos.example: After the storm, the whole town was in complete chaos for days.
chaos.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，整个小镇连续几天都陷入了彻底的混乱。

chap.example: The young chap next door helped me fix my old bike.
chap.exampleZh: 隔壁那个小伙子帮我修好了我的旧自行车。

chapter.example: We read the first chapter of the book in class today.
chapter.exampleZh: 我们今天在课上读了这本书的第一章。

character.example: Her kind and honest character makes everyone in the class like her.
character.exampleZh: 她善良诚实的性格让班上每个人都喜欢她。

characteristic.example: Kindness is a characteristic of good teachers.
characteristic.exampleZh: 善良是好老师的一个特征。

characterize.example: Scientists often characterize this region as dry and windy.
characterize.exampleZh: 科学家通常把这一地区描述为干燥多风。

charge.example: They will charge us ten dollars for the extra battery.
charge.exampleZh: 那块备用电池他们要多收我们十美元。

charity.example: She gave all her old clothes to charity last week.
charity.exampleZh: 她上周把所有旧衣服都捐给了慈善机构。

charm.example: Her warm smile and kind words have a special charm for everyone.
charm.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑和亲切的话语对每个人来说都有一种特别的魅力。

chart.example: The teacher drew a simple chart to show how the numbers changed.
chart.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的图表来说明这些数字是如何变化的。

charter.example: The school rented a charter bus every morning for the students.
charter.exampleZh: 学校每天早上为学生租一辆包租巴士。

chase.example: The dog likes to chase the ball across the garden.
chase.exampleZh: 那只狗喜欢在花园里追着球跑。

chat.example: We often chat about our weekend plans after work.
chat.exampleZh: 我们常常在下班后聊周末的安排。

cheap.example: This cheap shirt looks nice, but it feels rough on my skin.
cheap.exampleZh: 这件便宜的衬衫看起来不错，但穿在皮肤上感觉很粗糙。

cheat.example: It is wrong to cheat on a test.
cheat.exampleZh: 在考试中作弊是不对的。

check.example: Please check the bill before you pay it.
check.exampleZh: 请在付款前核对一下账单。

cheer.example: The fans began to cheer loudly when their team scored the winning goal.
cheer.exampleZh: 当他们的球队踢进致胜一球时，球迷们开始大声欢呼。

cheese.example: I like cheese on my bread and a glass of milk.
cheese.exampleZh: 我喜欢在面包上放奶酪，再配一杯牛奶。

chef.example: The chef in our hotel makes very good soup every morning.
chef.exampleZh: 我们酒店的主厨每天早上都做非常好喝的汤。

chemical.example: This chemical is dangerous, so keep it away from children and food.
chemical.exampleZh: 这种化学品很危险，所以要让它远离儿童和食物。

cheque.example: I paid the shop with a cheque because I had no cash.
cheque.exampleZh: 因为我没有现金，所以用支票付了商店的钱。

cherish.example: I will always cherish the happy memories of our time together.
cherish.exampleZh: 我会永远珍视我们在一起的美好回忆。

chess.example: My brother and I play chess every Sunday afternoon at home.
chess.exampleZh: 我和弟弟每个星期天下午都在家下国际象棋。

chest.example: He put his hand on his chest and took a deep breath.
chest.exampleZh: 他把手放在胸口，深吸了一口气。

chew.example: Please chew your food slowly before you swallow it.
chew.exampleZh: 请慢慢咀嚼食物，然后再咽下去。

chief.example: The chief reason we moved here is to be near our family.
chief.exampleZh: 我们搬到这里的主要原因是想离家人近一些。

childhood.example: I spent a happy childhood in a small town near the sea.
childhood.exampleZh: 我在海边的一个小镇上度过了快乐的童年。

chill.example: Please keep the soup in the fridge so it can chill before dinner.
chill.exampleZh: 请把汤放进冰箱里，让它在晚饭前冷却。

chin.example: He rested his chin on his hand and listened to the story.
chin.exampleZh: 他用手托着下巴，听着这个故事。

chip.example: He ate a bag of chips while fixing the computer chip.
chip.exampleZh: 他一边修电脑芯片，一边吃了一袋薯条。

chocolate.example: She gave me a box of chocolate for my birthday.
chocolate.exampleZh: 她送了我一盒巧克力作为生日礼物。

choice.example: She made a good choice and bought the cheaper train ticket.
choice.exampleZh: 她做出了一个好选择，买了那张更便宜的火车票。

choke.example: The thick smoke made him choke and he could not breathe.
choke.exampleZh: 浓烟让他窒息，无法呼吸。

choose.example: Please choose one book from the shelf before we leave.
choose.exampleZh: 在我们离开之前，请从书架上选一本书。

chop.example: Please chop the onions into small pieces before you cook them.
chop.exampleZh: 请把洋葱剁成小块，然后再煮。

chord.example: She played a soft chord on the old piano and everyone smiled.
chord.exampleZh: 她在旧钢琴上弹了一个柔和的和弦，大家都笑了。

chorus.example: The whole school sang the chorus together at the end of the song.
chorus.exampleZh: 歌曲结尾时，全校师生一起唱了副歌。

christian.example: My neighbor is a Christian, and he goes to church every Sunday.
christian.exampleZh: 我的邻居是基督教徒，他每个星期天都去教堂。

chronic.example: He has a chronic cough that never seems to go away.
chronic.exampleZh: 他有一种似乎总也好不了的慢性咳嗽。

chunk.example: He cut the meat into a large chunk and put it in the pot.
chunk.exampleZh: 他把肉切成一大块，放进了锅里。

cigar.example: My grandfather used to smoke a cigar on the porch after dinner.
cigar.exampleZh: 我祖父过去常在晚饭后到门廊上抽一支雪茄。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema to see a new film last night.
cinema.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去电影院看了一部新电影。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle and sang songs.
circle.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圈唱歌。

circuit.example: The current flows around the circuit and lights the small bulb.
circuit.exampleZh: 电流沿着电路流动，点亮了那只小灯泡。

circular.example: The children sat around a circular table and shared their lunch.
circular.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在一张圆桌旁，分享他们的午餐。
