circulate.example: Blood circulates through the body and carries oxygen to every cell.
circulate.exampleZh: 血液在体内循环，把氧气输送到每一个细胞。

circumstance.example: In this difficult circumstance, we must stay calm and help each other.
circumstance.exampleZh: 在这种困难的情况下，我们必须保持冷静并互相帮助。

cite.example: Please cite the book you used in your report.
cite.exampleZh: 请引用你在报告中使用的这本书。

citizen.example: Every citizen has the right to vote in the local election.
citizen.exampleZh: 每个公民都有权在地方选举中投票。

civil.example: Every citizen has civil rights and civil duties under the law.
civil.exampleZh: 每个公民在法律下都享有公民权利并承担公民义务。

civilian.example: The soldiers helped the civilians leave the city before the fighting started.
civilian.exampleZh: 士兵们在战斗开始前帮助平民离开了这座城市。

civilize.example: Teachers try to civilize young children by teaching them good manners.
civilize.exampleZh: 老师通过教孩子们礼貌来教化他们。

claim.example: She claims that the lost bag is hers.
claim.exampleZh: 她声称那个丢失的包是她的。

clamp.example: He used a metal clamp to hold the two boards together tightly.
clamp.exampleZh: 他用一个金属夹子把两块木板紧紧地夹在一起。

clap.example: The children clap their hands and sing a happy song.
clap.exampleZh: 孩子们拍着手，唱着一首快乐的歌。

clarify.example: Please clarify the main point of your question before we start.
clarify.exampleZh: 请在我们开始之前弄清楚你问题的主要意思。

clarity.example: The clarity of her writing makes the report easy to read.
clarity.exampleZh: 她写作的清晰性使这份报告易于阅读。

clash.example: The two teams will clash again in the final match next week.
clash.exampleZh: 这两支球队下周将在决赛中再次交锋。

classic.example: This old film is a classic story that many people still love today.
classic.exampleZh: 这部老电影是一个经典故事，许多人至今仍然喜爱。

classical.example: She enjoys classical music while studying in the library.
classical.exampleZh: 她在图书馆学习时喜欢听古典音乐。

classification.example: The classification of these animals into groups helps students learn faster.
classification.exampleZh: 把这些动物分类成不同组别有助于学生学得更快。

classify.example: We classify the books into three groups by their subjects.
classify.exampleZh: 我们按科目把这些书分成三组。

clause.example: The contract has a clause about working hours.
clause.exampleZh: 这份合同有一条关于工作时间的条款。

claw.example: The cat used its sharp claw to catch the small fish.
claw.exampleZh: 猫用锋利的爪子抓住了那条小鱼。

clay.example: The children made small animals from wet clay in the garden.
clay.exampleZh: 孩子们在花园里用湿黏土做小动物。

clean.example: Please help me clean the dirty kitchen table after dinner.
clean.exampleZh: 晚饭后请帮我擦干净那张脏的厨房餐桌。

clear.example: The sky is clear today, so we can see the mountains.
clear.exampleZh: 今天天空晴朗，所以我们可以看到群山。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk helped me find my room key.
clerk.exampleZh: 前台的职员帮我找到了房间钥匙。

clever.example: She is a clever girl and always finds quick answers.
clever.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的女孩，总能很快想出答案。

click.example: Click the icon twice to open the file on your computer.
click.exampleZh: 在电脑上双击这个图标就可以打开文件。

client.example: The lawyer met with his new client to discuss the contract details.
client.exampleZh: 律师与他的新客户见面，讨论合同的细节。

cliff.example: The small house sits on top of a steep cliff.
cliff.exampleZh: 那座小房子坐落在陡峭的悬崖顶上。

climate.example: The climate in this city is warm and wet all year.
climate.exampleZh: 这座城市的气候全年温暖潮湿。

climb.example: Every morning the old man climbs the hill behind his house slowly.
climb.exampleZh: 每天早上，那位老人都会慢慢地爬上他家后面的小山。

cling.example: The child likes to cling to her mother's hand in busy streets.
cling.exampleZh: 在繁忙的街上，那个孩子喜欢紧紧抓住妈妈的手。

clinic.example: The small clinic near my house is open every day.
clinic.exampleZh: 我家附近的小诊所每天都开门。

clip.example: She used a small clip to hold the papers together on her desk.
clip.exampleZh: 她用一个小夹子把桌上的文件夹在一起。

cloak.example: He wore a dark cloak over his shoulders to stay warm.
cloak.exampleZh: 他在肩上披了一件深色斗篷来保暖。

clock.example: The clock on the wall is five minutes fast today.
clock.exampleZh: 墙上的钟今天快了五分钟。

clockwise.example: Turn the handle clockwise to open the door, and it will open easily.
clockwise.exampleZh: 顺时针转动把手来开门，门就会轻松打开。

clone.example: Scientists made a clone of the sheep, and the copy looked the same.
clone.exampleZh: 科学家克隆了这只羊，复制出来的羊看起来一模一样。

close.example: Please close the door and come sit close to me.
close.exampleZh: 请关上门，然后过来坐在我旁边。

closet.example: She keeps her winter coats in the closet near the front door.
closet.exampleZh: 她把冬天的外套放在前门附近的壁橱里。

cloth.example: She wiped the table with a clean cloth after dinner.
cloth.exampleZh: 晚饭后她用一块干净的布擦了桌子。

cloud.example: A dark cloud moved across the sky before the rain came.
cloud.exampleZh: 下雨前，一片乌云从天空中飘过。

cloudy.example: The sky is cloudy today, so we will stay at home.
cloudy.exampleZh: 今天天空多云，所以我们会待在家里。

club.example: He joined a chess club at school and made many new friends there.
club.exampleZh: 他在学校加入了国际象棋俱乐部，并在那里结交了许多新朋友。

clue.example: The police found an important clue near the old house.
clue.exampleZh: 警方在那栋老房子附近发现了一条重要线索。

clumsy.example: His clumsy attempt to fix the chair made the problem worse.
clumsy.exampleZh: 他笨手笨脚地想修好椅子，结果反而更糟了。

cluster.example: A cluster of grapes hangs from the branch in the garden.
cluster.exampleZh: 花园里的树枝上挂着一串葡萄。

clutch.example: She had to clutch her bag tightly when the bus started to move.
clutch.exampleZh: 公交车开动时，她不得不紧紧抓住自己的包。

coach.example: Our coach takes the team to the park and trains them every morning.
coach.exampleZh: 我们的教练每天早上带队伍去公园训练他们。

coal.example: The old train still burns coal to make steam for its engine.
coal.exampleZh: 那列老火车仍然烧煤来为其引擎产生蒸汽。

coalition.example: The two parties formed a coalition to win the election.
coalition.exampleZh: 两个政党组成了联盟以赢得选举。

coarse.example: The coarse cloth feels rough against my skin.
coarse.exampleZh: 这块粗糙的布贴在我皮肤上感觉很扎。

coast.example: We walked along the coast and watched the big waves hit the rocks.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着巨浪拍打岩石。

coat.example: He put on a warm coat and walked to the bus stop.
coat.exampleZh: 他穿上暖和的外套，走向公交车站。

cocaine.example: The police found cocaine hidden in his car at the airport.
cocaine.exampleZh: 警方在机场发现他的车里藏有可卡因。

cock.example: The old cock crowed loudly every morning before the sun came up.
cock.exampleZh: 那只老公鸡每天早晨在太阳升起前大声啼叫。

cocktail.example: She made a fresh fruit cocktail for the party last night.
cocktail.exampleZh: 她昨晚为聚会做了一份新鲜水果鸡尾酒。

code.example: The spy wrote the secret message in a simple code only his friend could read.
code.exampleZh: 那名间谍用一种只有他朋友能读懂的简单密码写下了这条秘密信息。

coffee.example: I drink a cup of hot coffee every morning before work.
coffee.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会喝一杯热咖啡。

coherent.example: Her essay is coherent and easy to follow from start to finish.
coherent.exampleZh: 她的文章条理清楚，从头到尾都很容易理解。

coil.example: A snake can coil its body around a branch and rest there.
coil.exampleZh: 蛇可以把身体盘绕在树枝上，在那里休息。

coin.example: He put a coin into the small machine and got a drink.
coin.exampleZh: 他把一枚硬币放进小机器里，得到了一瓶饮料。

coincide.example: Our holidays happen to coincide this year, so we can travel together.
coincide.exampleZh: 今年我们的假期碰巧时间重合，所以我们可以一起旅行。

cold.example: The cold wind made everyone stay inside the warm house all day.
cold.exampleZh: 寒风让大家整天都待在温暖的房子里。

collaborate.example: The two teams collaborate closely to finish the project on time.
collaborate.exampleZh: 两个团队紧密合作，以按时完成这个项目。

collapse.example: The old building collapsed after the heavy rain, and many people were hurt.
collapse.exampleZh: 大雨过后那栋老楼倒塌了，许多人受了伤。

collar.example: The dog wore a red collar around its neck.
collar.exampleZh: 那只狗的脖子上戴着一个红色的项圈。

colleague.example: My colleague helps me with difficult work every day.
colleague.exampleZh: 我的同事每天都帮我处理困难的工作。

collect.example: Every summer, the children collect shells and stones on the beach.
collect.exampleZh: 每年夏天，孩子们都会在海滩上收集贝壳和石头。

collective.example: The team made a collective decision to finish the work early.
collective.exampleZh: 团队做出了集体决定，要提早完成这项工作。

college.example: My sister studies math at a small college near our home.
college.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我们家附近的一所小学院学习数学。

collide.example: The two cars collided on the icy road this morning.
collide.exampleZh: 今天早上两辆汽车在结冰的路上相撞了。

collision.example: The two cars slowed down to avoid a collision on the busy road.
collision.exampleZh: 两辆汽车减速以避免在繁忙的道路上发生碰撞。

colonial.example: The country was under colonial rule for more than a hundred years.
colonial.exampleZh: 这个国家被殖民统治了一百多年。

colony.example: The small colony of ants built its home under the old tree.
colony.exampleZh: 那一小群蚂蚁在老树下筑起了巢。

colour.example: The bright colour of the sky changes as the sun goes down.
colour.exampleZh: 天空的明亮颜色随着太阳落下而变化。

column.example: The old building has a tall stone column near the front door.
column.exampleZh: 这座老建筑的前门附近有一根高大的石柱。

comb.example: She combed through all the old papers to find the missing letter.
comb.exampleZh: 她仔细翻查了所有旧文件，想找到那封丢失的信。

combat.example: Doctors are working hard to combat the spread of the disease.
combat.exampleZh: 医生们正在努力防止疾病的传播。

combination.example: The safe opens only with the right combination of numbers.
combination.exampleZh: 只有使用正确的数字组合才能打开这个保险柜。

combine.example: If you combine the two small teams, the work will be much faster.
combine.exampleZh: 如果你把这两个小团队联合起来，工作会快得多。

comedy.example: I like to watch a comedy with my friends on weekends.
comedy.exampleZh: 我喜欢在周末和朋友们一起看喜剧。

comet.example: Last night we saw a bright comet in the sky above our town.
comet.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在小镇上方的天空中看到了一颗明亮的彗星。

comfort.example: Her kind words gave him great comfort after the bad news.
comfort.exampleZh: 听到坏消息后，她温暖的话语给了他很大的安慰。

comic.example: My little brother likes to read a comic book before bed.
comic.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢在睡前看一本连环漫画。

command.example: The officer gave a command and the soldiers moved quickly.
command.exampleZh: 军官下达了一道命令，士兵们迅速行动。

commemorate.example: Every year the whole town gathers to commemorate the soldiers who died in the war.
commemorate.exampleZh: 每年全镇的人都会聚在一起，纪念在战争中阵亡的士兵。

commence.example: The meeting will commence at nine tomorrow morning in the main hall.
commence.exampleZh: 会议将于明天上午九点在大厅开始。

commend.example: My teacher commended me for helping the new student in class.
commend.exampleZh: 老师表扬我在课堂上帮助了新同学。

comment.example: Please leave a comment below and tell me what you think.
comment.exampleZh: 请在下方留下评论，告诉我你的想法。

commentary.example: The sports commentary on the radio made the game easy to follow.
commentary.exampleZh: 收音机里的体育实况解说让这场比赛很容易听懂。

commerce.example: Online commerce has changed the way small shops sell their goods.
commerce.exampleZh: 网络商务改变了小商店销售商品的方式。

commercial.example: The commercial was very funny, so everyone laughed at it.
commercial.exampleZh: 这个商业广告非常有趣，所以大家都笑了。

commission.example: The government set up a commission to study the problem.
commission.exampleZh: 政府成立了一个委员会来研究这个问题。

commit.example: He did not want to commit himself to such a long project.
commit.exampleZh: 他不想让自己承担这么长期的项目。

commitment.example: She made a strong commitment to finish the project on time.
commitment.exampleZh: 她郑重承诺按时完成这个项目。

committee.example: The committee will meet on Friday to discuss the new plan.
committee.exampleZh: 委员会将于周五开会讨论这项新计划。

commodity.example: Clean water is a valuable commodity in many dry parts of the world.
commodity.exampleZh: 在世界许多干旱地区，干净的水是一种宝贵的商品。

common.example: It is common for students to study in the library after class.
common.exampleZh: 学生下课后在图书馆学习是很常见的。

commonplace.example: Such careless mistakes are commonplace in his work.
commonplace.exampleZh: 这类粗心的错误在他的工作中很常见。

communicate.example: We use simple words to communicate with our new friends.
communicate.exampleZh: 我们用简单的词与新朋友交流。

communication.example: Good communication between parents and children helps the whole family stay happy.
communication.exampleZh: 父母和孩子之间良好的沟通有助于全家人保持快乐。

community.example: Our community has a small park where children often play after school.
community.exampleZh: 我们社区有一个小公园，孩子们放学后经常在那里玩。

commute.example: She commutes to work by train every morning.
commute.exampleZh: 她每天早上坐火车通勤上班。

compact.example: This compact camera fits easily into my small bag.
compact.exampleZh: 这台小巧的相机很容易放进我的小包里。

companion.example: A dog can be a loyal companion for people who live alone.
companion.exampleZh: 狗可以成为独居者的忠实伙伴。

company.example: My father works for a small company in the city.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在城里一家小公司工作。

comparable.example: These two phones are comparable in price but not in quality.
comparable.exampleZh: 这两部手机在价格上可比，但质量上不可比。

comparative.example: This book gives a comparative study of two simple languages.
comparative.exampleZh: 这本书对两种简单的语言进行了比较研究。

compare.example: Please compare these two pictures and tell me what is different.
compare.exampleZh: 请比较这两张图片，告诉我有什么不同。

comparison.example: A comparison of the two pictures shows that they are almost the same.
comparison.exampleZh: 对这两幅图片的比较表明它们几乎是一样的。

compass.example: A compass helps you find the right direction when you are lost.
compass.exampleZh: 当你迷路时，指南针能帮你找到正确的方向。

compassion.example: She felt great compassion for the lost child and gently took his hand.
compassion.exampleZh: 她对那个走失的孩子深感同情，轻轻牵起了他的手。

compel.example: Bad weather compelled us to stay at home all weekend.
compel.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气迫使我们整个周末都待在家里。

compensate.example: The company will compensate the workers for their lost wages.
compensate.exampleZh: 公司将会赔偿工人们的工资损失。

compete.example: Small shops often compete with big supermarkets on price and service.
compete.exampleZh: 小店常常在价格和服务上与大超市竞争。

competent.example: She is a competent teacher and her students all like her.
competent.exampleZh: 她是一位称职的老师，她的学生都喜欢她。

competition.example: There is a lot of competition between the two shops on our street.
competition.exampleZh: 我们街上的两家商店之间竞争很激烈。

competitive.example: The job market is very competitive this year for new students.
competitive.exampleZh: 今年的就业市场对应届毕业生来说竞争非常激烈。

complain.example: My neighbors often complain about the loud music from the party.
complain.exampleZh: 我的邻居们经常抱怨派对上吵闹的音乐。

complaint.example: The customer made a complaint about the cold soup.
complaint.exampleZh: 顾客对凉了的汤提出了投诉。

complement.example: The bright colors complement the dark wood in the living room.
complement.exampleZh: 明亮的色彩与客厅里的深色木头相得益彰。

complete.example: Our team must complete the report before Friday so the work is complete.
complete.exampleZh: 我们团队必须在周五前完成报告，这样工作才算完整。

complex.example: This math problem is too complex for young students to solve alone.
complex.exampleZh: 这道数学题太复杂了，年轻学生无法独自解决。

complexity.example: The complexity of this game makes it hard for young children.
complexity.exampleZh: 这个游戏的复杂性让年幼的孩子很难玩。

complicate.example: Please do not complicate things by adding more rules.
complicate.exampleZh: 请不要通过增加更多规则把事情复杂化。

complicated.example: This math problem is too complicated for me to solve alone.
complicated.exampleZh: 这道数学题太复杂了，我一个人解不出来。

component.example: Each component of the machine is small and easy to replace.
component.exampleZh: 这台机器的每个部件都很小，容易更换。

compose.example: She composed a short song for her students to sing.
compose.exampleZh: 她为学生们创作了一首短歌来演唱。

composer.example: The composer wrote a beautiful song for the school concert.
composer.exampleZh: 这位作曲家为学校音乐会写了一首优美的歌曲。

composition.example: My teacher said my composition was good and read it to the class.
composition.exampleZh: 老师说我的作文写得不错，还读给全班听。

compound.example: Water is a simple compound made of hydrogen and oxygen.
compound.exampleZh: 水是一种由氢和氧组成的简单化合物。

comprehend.example: It is hard for young children to comprehend such a difficult idea.
comprehend.exampleZh: 小孩子很难理解这样一个困难的观念。

comprehension.example: His comprehension of the problem helped the whole team find a quick answer.
comprehension.exampleZh: 他对这个问题的理解帮助整个团队迅速找到了答案。

comprehensive.example: The book gives a comprehensive view of modern Chinese history.
comprehensive.exampleZh: 这本书对现代中国历史做了全面的介绍。

compress.example: You can compress the files to make them smaller before sending.
compress.exampleZh: 你可以在发送前压缩这些文件，使它们变小。

comprise.example: The team comprises five students from different countries.
comprise.exampleZh: 这个团队由来自不同国家的五名学生组成。

compromise.example: Both sides had to compromise to reach a deal that everyone could accept.
compromise.exampleZh: 双方不得不做出妥协，以达成一项大家都能接受的协议。

compulsory.example: All students must take the compulsory English course in their first year.
compulsory.exampleZh: 所有学生第一年都必须修这门英语必修课。

compute.example: We can compute the total cost of the trip before we book the tickets.
compute.exampleZh: 我们可以在订票之前估算这次旅行的总费用。

conceal.example: Tom tried to conceal his fear when he walked into the dark room.
conceal.exampleZh: 汤姆走进那个黑暗的房间时，试图隐藏自己的恐惧。

concede.example: He had to concede that his plan was not perfect.
concede.exampleZh: 他不得不承认他的计划并不完美。

conceited.example: He is too conceited to admit that he made a mistake.
conceited.exampleZh: 他太自负了，不肯承认自己犯了错。

conceive.example: She could not conceive of a life without her family.
conceive.exampleZh: 她无法设想没有家人的生活。

concentrate.example: I cannot concentrate on my work when the room is noisy.
concentrate.exampleZh: 房间很吵的时候，我无法专心工作。

concept.example: The idea of freedom is a hard concept for young children to understand.
concept.exampleZh: 自由这个观念对幼儿来说是一个难以理解的概念。

concern.example: This question concerns all of us, so we should talk about it.
concern.exampleZh: 这个问题涉及我们所有人，所以我们应该讨论一下。

concerning.example: I have a question concerning the new rules.
concerning.exampleZh: 我有一个关于新规定的问题。

concert.example: We went to a concert last night and heard some beautiful music.
concert.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去听了一场音乐会，听到了几首优美的乐曲。

concession.example: Both sides made a concession to end the long argument.
concession.exampleZh: 双方都做出了让步，以结束这场长时间的争论。

concise.example: Her answer was concise and easy to understand.
concise.exampleZh: 她的回答简明扼要，容易理解。

conclude.example: After reading the report, we concluded that the plan was too expensive.
conclude.exampleZh: 读完报告后，我们得出结论：这个计划太贵了。

conclusion.example: After a long discussion, we finally reached a clear conclusion.
conclusion.exampleZh: 经过长时间的讨论，我们终于得出了一个明确的结论。

concrete.example: We need concrete plans, not just ideas about what to do next.
concrete.exampleZh: 我们需要具体的计划，而不只是关于下一步该怎么做的想法。

condemn.example: Many people condemned the plan because it would hurt poor families.
condemn.exampleZh: 许多人谴责这项计划，因为它会伤害贫困家庭。

condense.example: Steam will condense into water when it cools down.
condense.exampleZh: 水蒸气冷却后会凝结成水。

condition.example: The car is old but its condition is still very good.
condition.exampleZh: 这辆车虽然旧，但状况仍然很好。

conduct.example: The teacher will conduct a simple test of how heat moves through metal.
conduct.exampleZh: 老师将进行一个简单的实验，测试热量如何通过金属传导。

conductor.example: The conductor raised his hands and the orchestra began to play.
conductor.exampleZh: 指挥抬起双手，管弦乐队开始演奏。

conference.example: She went to a conference in Beijing last week to meet other teachers.
conference.exampleZh: 她上周去北京参加了一个会议，与其他老师见面。

confess.example: He finally confessed that he had taken the money from the drawer.
confess.exampleZh: 他终于承认自己从抽屉里拿走了那笔钱。

confidence.example: She spoke with great confidence during her first job interview.
confidence.exampleZh: 她在第一次求职面试中充满自信地讲话。

confident.example: She feels confident about the test because she studied hard all week.
confident.exampleZh: 她对这次考试很有信心，因为她整周都在努力学习。

confine.example: The doctor told him to confine his activities to light walking for now.
confine.exampleZh: 医生让他目前把活动限制在轻度散步范围内。

confirm.example: Please confirm your booking by email before Friday.
confirm.exampleZh: 请在周五之前通过电子邮件确认您的预订。

conflict.example: There is a serious conflict between the two teams about the new plan.
conflict.exampleZh: 两个团队在 new plan 上存在严重冲突。

conform.example: All new students must conform to the school's rules and study hard.
conform.exampleZh: 所有新生都必须遵守学校的规定并努力学习。

confront.example: We must confront the problem before it gets worse.
confront.exampleZh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前面对它。

confuse.example: The teacher's long explanation confused many students in the class.
confuse.exampleZh: 老师冗长的讲解让班上许多学生感到困惑。

confusion.example: There was some confusion about the new rules at first.
confusion.exampleZh: 起初大家对新的规定有些困惑。

congratulate.example: I called my best friend to congratulate him on his new job.
congratulate.exampleZh: 我打电话给我最好的朋友，祝贺他找到了新工作。

congress.example: The congress will meet next week to discuss the new law.
congress.exampleZh: 代表大会将于下周开会讨论这项新法律。

conjunction.example: The word and is a common conjunction in English.
conjunction.exampleZh: 单词 and 在英语中是一个常见的连词。

connect.example: This bridge connects the two small towns across the river.
connect.exampleZh: 这座桥连接着河两岸的两个小镇。

connection.example: There is a strong connection between daily exercise and good health.
connection.exampleZh: 每天锻炼与身体健康之间有很强的联系。

conquer.example: She worked hard to conquer her fear of speaking in public.
conquer.exampleZh: 她努力克服了自己当众讲话的恐惧。

conscience.example: His conscience would not let him lie to his old friend.
conscience.exampleZh: 他的良心不允许他对老朋友撒谎。

conscious.example: She was conscious of the danger and walked home quickly.
conscious.exampleZh: 她意识到了危险，于是快步走回了家。

consensus.example: The group finally reached a consensus after a long and friendly discussion.
consensus.exampleZh: 经过长时间友好的讨论，这个小组终于达成了共识。

consent.example: Her parents gave their consent for the school trip.
consent.exampleZh: 她的父母同意了这次学校旅行。

consequence.example: One bad decision can have serious consequences for the whole team.
consequence.exampleZh: 一个糟糕的决定可能会给整个团队带来严重的后果。

consequently.example: It rained hard, and consequently the match was put off.
consequently.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛被推迟了。

conservation.example: Water conservation is important for every family in our city.
conservation.exampleZh: 节约用水对我们城市的每个家庭都很重要。

conservative.example: My conservative father always saves his money instead of spending it.
conservative.exampleZh: 我保守的父亲总是把钱存起来，而不是花掉。

consider.example: We should consider all the facts before we make a decision.
consider.exampleZh: 在做决定之前，我们应该考虑所有事实。

considerable.example: The storm caused considerable damage to the small village last night.
considerable.exampleZh: 昨晚的暴风雨给这个小村庄造成了相当大的破坏。

considerate.example: She is very considerate and always helps her friends when they need it.
considerate.exampleZh: 她非常体贴，总是在朋友们需要时伸出援手。

consideration.example: Money is an important consideration when you choose a new job.
consideration.exampleZh: 在选择新工作时，钱是一个重要的考虑因素。

consist.example: The team consists of five students and two teachers.
consist.exampleZh: 这个团队由五名学生和两名老师组成。

consistent.example: Her work is consistent and always gets good results.
consistent.exampleZh: 她的工作始终如一，总能取得好结果。

console.example: She tried to console her friend after the bad news.
console.exampleZh: 听到坏消息后，她试着安慰她的朋友。

consolidate.example: We need to consolidate our gains before we move forward.
consolidate.exampleZh: 在继续前进之前，我们需要巩固已有的成果。

constant.example: The baby needs constant care from her mother.
constant.exampleZh: 这个婴儿需要母亲不断的照料。

constitute.example: These ten members constitute the new committee.
constitute.exampleZh: 这十名成员组成了新的委员会。

constitution.example: The new constitution gives every citizen the right to vote.
constitution.exampleZh: 新宪法赋予每个公民投票权。

construct.example: The workers will construct a new bridge across the river next year.
construct.exampleZh: 工人们明年将在河上建造一座新桥。

construction.example: The construction of the new bridge took three years to finish.
construction.exampleZh: 这座新桥的建造花了三年时间才完成。

consult.example: You should consult your doctor before you take this new medicine.
consult.exampleZh: 在服用这种新药之前，你应该咨询你的医生。

consultant.example: The company hired a consultant to help them improve their sales plan.
consultant.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来帮助他们改进销售计划。

consume.example: Cars consume a lot of fuel in big cities every day.
consume.exampleZh: 在大城市里，汽车每天消耗大量燃料。

consumer.example: The new phone is popular with young consumers in many countries.
consumer.exampleZh: 这款新手机在许多国家受到年轻消费者的欢迎。

consumption.example: The rapid growth of energy consumption has become a serious problem for many countries.
consumption.exampleZh: 能源消费的快速增长已成为许多国家面临的严重问题。

contact.example: Please give me your phone number so I can contact you later.
contact.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码给我，这样我以后可以联系你。

contain.example: This box can contain all the old books and toys.
contain.exampleZh: 这个箱子能装下所有旧书和玩具。

container.example: She put the fresh fruit into a clean plastic container and closed the lid.
container.exampleZh: 她把新鲜水果放进一个干净的塑料容器里，然后盖上了盖子。

contemporary.example: This contemporary music is popular with young people in our city.
contemporary.exampleZh: 这种当代音乐在我们城市的年轻人中很受欢迎。

contend.example: Two teams will contend for the prize this weekend.
contend.exampleZh: 两支队伍本周末将争夺这个奖项。

content.example: She read the content of the letter and felt very happy.
content.exampleZh: 她读了信的内容，感到非常高兴。

contest.example: She won the singing contest last year and now teaches music.
contest.exampleZh: 她去年赢得了歌唱比赛，现在教音乐。

context.example: You can often guess a new word's meaning from its context.
context.exampleZh: 你通常可以根据上下文猜出一个生词的意思。

continent.example: Africa is a large continent with many different countries and languages.
continent.exampleZh: 非洲是一个拥有许多不同国家和语言的大陆。

continual.example: The continual noise from the street makes it hard to sleep.
continual.exampleZh: 街上不断的噪音让人难以入睡。

continue.example: We will continue to work on this project until it is finished.
continue.exampleZh: 我们将继续做这个项目，直到它完成。

continuous.example: The rain was continuous for three days and flooded the roads.
continuous.exampleZh: 雨连续下了三天，把道路都淹了。

contract.example: She signed a two-year contract with the company before starting work.
contract.exampleZh: 她在开始工作前与公司签了一份为期两年的合同。

contradict.example: His actions contradict what he said in the meeting yesterday.
contradict.exampleZh: 他的行为与昨天在会上说的相矛盾。

contrary.example: His actions were contrary to what he had promised us last week.
contrary.exampleZh: 他的行为与上周向我们承诺的相反。

contrast.example: The contrast between the two pictures is easy to see.
contrast.exampleZh: 这两幅图片之间的对比很容易看出来。

contribute.example: Many people contribute money to help the poor children in the village.
contribute.exampleZh: 许多人捐钱帮助村里的贫困儿童。

contribution.example: Her contribution to the school fund helped many poor students.
contribution.exampleZh: 她对学校基金的捐款帮助了许多贫困学生。

control.example: The teacher cannot control the noisy class, so she asks for help.
control.exampleZh: 老师无法控制吵闹的班级，所以她请求帮助。

controversial.example: This is a controversial plan, and many people do not agree with it.
controversial.exampleZh: 这是一个有争议的计划，很多人不同意它。

controversy.example: The new school rule caused a lot of controversy among parents and teachers.
controversy.exampleZh: 这项新校规在家长和老师之间引起了很大争议。

convenience.example: This small shop is open late for the convenience of local people.
convenience.exampleZh: 这家小店营业到很晚，为的是方便当地居民。

convenient.example: This small shop is very convenient for people who live nearby.
convenient.exampleZh: 这家小店对住在附近的人来说很方便。

convention.example: It is a convention in our office to wear a suit on Mondays.
convention.exampleZh: 周一穿西装是我们办公室的一个惯例。

conventional.example: He prefers conventional methods even when new tools are available.
conventional.exampleZh: 即使有新的工具可用，他仍然偏好传统的方法。

conversation.example: I had a long conversation with my teacher about my future plans.
conversation.exampleZh: 我和老师就我的未来计划进行了一次长谈。

conversely.example: He likes cold weather, but conversely, his sister loves hot summer days.
conversely.exampleZh: 他喜欢寒冷的天气，但反过来，他妹妹却喜欢炎热的夏日。

conversion.example: The conversion of the old factory into a library took two years.
conversion.exampleZh: 把旧工厂改造成图书馆花了两年时间。

convert.example: We plan to convert the old factory into a small library.
convert.exampleZh: 我们计划把这座旧工厂改造成一个小图书馆。

convey.example: I use simple words to convey my ideas to the class.
convey.exampleZh: 我用简单的词向全班同学传达我的想法。

convict.example: The judge will convict him of theft and send him to prison.
convict.exampleZh: 法官将以盗窃罪判他有罪，并把他送进监狱。

conviction.example: His strong conviction helped him face the many difficulties ahead.
conviction.exampleZh: 他坚定的信念帮助他面对前方的许多困难。

convince.example: She tried to convince her parents to let her study abroad next year.
convince.exampleZh: 她试着说服父母让她明年出国留学。

cook.example: My mother likes to cook chicken soup for us on cold days.
cook.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在寒冷的日子里给我们煮鸡汤。

cool.example: The soup is still too hot, so please cool it down before serving.
cool.exampleZh: 这汤还太烫，所以请在端上桌之前把它晾凉。

cooperate.example: Good teams cooperate with each other to finish the work on time.
cooperate.exampleZh: 优秀的团队会互相配合，按时完成工作。

coordinate.example: She coordinates the work of the two teams every week.
coordinate.exampleZh: 她每周协调这两个团队的工作。

cop.example: The cop stopped the car and asked the driver for his license.
cop.exampleZh: 警察拦下那辆车，要求司机出示驾照。

cope.example: She learned to cope with a lot of stress at work.
cope.exampleZh: 她学会了应付工作中的大量压力。

copper.example: The old roof was made of copper and it looked green after many years.
copper.exampleZh: 那个旧屋顶是铜做的，多年后看起来变绿了。

copy.example: Please make a copy of this page and give it to me.
copy.exampleZh: 请把这一页复制一份并交给我。

core.example: The core of the problem is a lack of trust between the two sides.
core.exampleZh: 问题的核心是双方之间缺乏信任。

corn.example: My family grows corn on a small farm near the river.
corn.exampleZh: 我家在河边的一个小农场里种玉米。

corner.example: She waited for me at the corner of the street.

corporate.example: Our corporate office is in the city center and has many employees.
corporate.exampleZh: 我们公司的办公室在市中心，有很多员工。

corporation.example: She works for a large corporation in the city center.
corporation.exampleZh: 她在市中心一家大公司工作。

correct.example: Please correct the mistakes in your homework before you hand it in.
correct.exampleZh: 请在交作业之前改正其中的错误。

correlate.example: These two sets of data clearly correlate with each other.
correlate.exampleZh: 这两组数据明显相互关联。

correspond.example: These two lists do not correspond with each other.
correspond.exampleZh: 这两份清单彼此不一致。

correspondence.example: The two old friends kept up a warm correspondence for over thirty years.
correspondence.exampleZh: 这两位老朋友保持了三十多年的温暖通信。

corridor.example: She walked down the long corridor to her office.
corridor.exampleZh: 她沿着长长的走廊走向自己的办公室。

corrupt.example: The corrupt official took money from poor people and lost his job.
corrupt.exampleZh: 那个贪污的官员从穷人那里收钱，结果丢了工作。

cost.example: The cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
cost.exampleZh: 这次旅行的费用比我们预期的要高。

costly.example: Buying a car can be costly if you do not plan your budget carefully.
costly.exampleZh: 如果你不仔细规划预算，买车可能会代价很高。

costume.example: She wore a beautiful costume to the school party last night.
costume.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一身漂亮的戏装去参加学校的聚会。

cottage.example: My grandmother lives in a small cottage near the lake.
cottage.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在湖边的一座小屋里。

cotton.example: My shirt is made of soft cotton and it feels very comfortable.
cotton.exampleZh: 我的衬衫是柔软棉布做的，穿起来很舒服。

couch.example: The cat is sleeping on the couch next to the window.
couch.exampleZh: 那只猫正睡在窗边的长沙发上。

cough.example: He has a bad cough, so he stayed home from school today.
cough.exampleZh: 他咳嗽得很厉害，所以今天没去上学。

could.example: When I was young, I could run very fast and swim well.
could.exampleZh: 我年轻时能跑得很快，游泳也很好。

council.example: The city council will meet on Monday to discuss the new park.
council.exampleZh: 市议会将于周一开会讨论新公园的事。

counsel.example: His counsel helped me make the right choice about my new job.
counsel.exampleZh: 他的忠告帮我做出了关于新工作的正确选择。

count.example: Please count the books on the desk and tell me the total number.
count.exampleZh: 请数一下桌子上的书，并告诉我总数。

counter.example: She put the money on the counter and left the shop.
counter.exampleZh: 她把钱放在柜台上，然后离开了商店。

country.example: My country is very big, and I love its people.
country.exampleZh: 我的国家很大，我爱它的人民。

countryside.example: My grandparents live in the countryside and grow their own vegetables.
countryside.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在乡下，自己种蔬菜。

county.example: This county has many small farms and a quiet river.
county.exampleZh: 这个县有许多小农场和一条安静的河。

couple.example: The young couple bought a small house near the river last year.
couple.exampleZh: 这对年轻夫妇去年在河边买了一栋小房子。

courage.example: It takes great courage to speak the truth in front of everyone.
courage.exampleZh: 在众人面前说出真相需要极大的勇气。

course.example: This course teaches students how to write clear English sentences.
course.exampleZh: 这门课程教学生如何写出清晰的英语句子。

court.example: The court will decide the case next week after hearing both sides.
court.exampleZh: 法院将在听取双方陈述后于下周对此案作出裁决。

courtesy.example: He always treats his neighbors with great courtesy and respect.
courtesy.exampleZh: 他总是非常礼貌、非常尊重地对待他的邻居。

cousin.example: My cousin lives in another city and visits us every summer.
cousin.exampleZh: 我的表弟住在另一个城市，每年夏天都来看我们。

cover.example: The reporter will cover the election live from the city center tonight.
cover.exampleZh: 记者今晚将在市中心对选举进行现场报道。

coverage.example: The new plan offers good coverage for families with young children.
coverage.exampleZh: 这项新计划为有幼儿的家庭提供了良好的保险范围。

coward.example: He was called a coward because he ran away from the fight.
coward.exampleZh: 他因为在打斗中逃跑而被称为懦夫。

crack.example: The old cup has a small crack near the top edge.
crack.exampleZh: 那个旧杯子靠近杯口的地方有一道小裂缝。

craft.example: She learned the craft from her grandmother many years ago.
craft.exampleZh: 她多年前从祖母那里学会了这门手艺。

craftsman.example: The old craftsman made a beautiful wooden chair for my family.
craftsman.exampleZh: 这位老工匠为我家做了一把漂亮的木椅。

crane.example: A tall crane lifted the heavy boxes onto the truck.
crane.exampleZh: 一台高大的起重机把沉重的箱子吊上了卡车。

crash.example: The old car crashed into a tree near the bank and made a loud noise.
crash.exampleZh: 那辆旧车在银行附近撞上了一棵树，发出了很大的响声。

crass.example: His crass joke made everyone at the dinner table feel uncomfortable.
crass.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的玩笑让餐桌上的每个人都感到不舒服。

crawl.example: The baby can crawl across the floor to reach her toys.
crawl.exampleZh: 婴儿能爬过地板去够她的玩具。

crazy.example: My brother is crazy about football and watches every game on TV.
crazy.exampleZh: 我弟弟对足球着迷，每场比赛都在电视上看。

cream.example: She likes to put cream in her morning coffee and on her face.
cream.exampleZh: 她喜欢在早晨的咖啡里加奶油，也喜欢在脸上涂面霜。

create.example: The new factory will create many jobs for people in our town.
create.exampleZh: 这家新工厂将为我们镇上的人们创造许多就业机会。

creative.example: She has a creative way of solving simple problems at work.
creative.exampleZh: 她在工作中解决简单问题时有很有创造性的方法。

creature.example: The strange creature lives deep in the dark forest and only comes out at night.
creature.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的生物住在黑暗的森林深处，只在夜间出来。

credit.example: She bought the car on credit and will pay the money back next year.
credit.exampleZh: 她用信贷买了这辆车，明年会把钱还上。

creep.example: The cat likes to creep quietly along the garden wall at night.
creep.exampleZh: 那只猫喜欢在夜里沿着花园的墙悄悄爬行。

crew.example: The whole crew worked hard to keep the ship clean and safe.
crew.exampleZh: 全体船员努力保持船上的清洁与安全。

crime.example: The police are working hard to reduce crime in our city.
crime.exampleZh: 警方正在努力减少我们城市的犯罪。

criminal.example: The police caught the criminal near the bank last night.
criminal.exampleZh: 警察昨晚在银行附近抓住了那名罪犯。

crisis.example: The company is in a serious financial crisis and may have to close soon.
crisis.exampleZh: 这家公司正处于严重的财务危机中，可能很快就得关门。

crisp.example: The apple is fresh and crisp, and it tastes very good.
crisp.exampleZh: 这个苹果新鲜又脆，味道非常好。

critic.example: The critic wrote a long article about the new film.
critic.exampleZh: 这位评论家写了一篇关于这部新电影的长文章。

critical.example: Clean water is critical for the health of every child.
critical.exampleZh: 清洁的水对每个孩子的健康都至关重要。

criticism.example: The teacher gave me some useful criticism on my essay.
criticism.exampleZh: 老师对我的作文提出了一些有用的批评。

criticize.example: My teacher criticized my report because it was too short.
criticize.exampleZh: 我的老师批评我的报告，因为它太短了。

crop.example: The farmer hopes his rice crop will be very good this year.
crop.exampleZh: 这位农民希望今年的稻子收成会非常好。

cross.example: Be careful when you cross this busy street after school.
cross.exampleZh: 放学后穿过这条繁忙的街道时要小心。

crowd.example: A large crowd of people waited outside the station for the last bus.
crowd.exampleZh: 一大群人在车站外等最后一班公交车。

crown.example: The young queen wore a golden crown at the ceremony.
crown.exampleZh: 年轻的女王在仪式上戴着一顶金色的王冠。

crucial.example: Getting enough sleep is crucial for students before a big exam.
crucial.exampleZh: 考试前获得充足的睡眠对学生来说至关重要。

crude.example: The table was crude, but it was strong enough for daily use.
crude.exampleZh: 这张桌子很粗糙，但足够结实，日常使用没问题。

cruel.example: It is cruel to leave a small dog alone in the cold.
cruel.exampleZh: 把一只小狗独自留在寒冷中是很残忍的。

cruise.example: We took a cruise along the coast and stopped at three small islands.
cruise.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸乘船游览，在三个小岛停留。

crush.example: The heavy machine can crush rocks into small pieces in seconds.
crush.exampleZh: 这台重型机器能在几秒钟内把岩石压碎成小块。

crust.example: The bread has a hard brown crust and a soft inside.
crust.exampleZh: 这块面包有一层硬硬的棕色外皮，里面很软。

cry.example: The baby began to cry when she could not find her mother.
cry.exampleZh: 宝宝找不到妈妈时开始哭了起来。

crystal.example: This clear crystal is hard and shines in the sun.
crystal.exampleZh: 这块透明的水晶很坚硬，在阳光下闪闪发亮。

cube.example: The child built a small house with a red cube and two blue cubes.
cube.exampleZh: 孩子用一个红色立方体和两个蓝色立方体搭了一座小房子。

cue.example: The teacher gave me a cue, so I began to speak.
cue.exampleZh: 老师给了我一个提示，于是我开始发言。

cultivate.example: Farmers cultivate the land and grow rice every year.
cultivate.exampleZh: 农民耕种土地，每年种植水稻。

culture.example: Chinese culture has a long history and is loved by people all over the world.
culture.exampleZh: 中国文化历史悠久，受到全世界人民的喜爱。

cunning.example: The cunning fox found a clever way to open the gate.
cunning.exampleZh: 那只狡猾的狐狸找到了一个巧妙的方法打开大门。

cupboard.example: The clean plates are in the kitchen cupboard next to the sink.
cupboard.exampleZh: 干净的盘子在厨房水槽旁边的碗柜里。

curb.example: The city hopes to curb traffic and pollution in the busy downtown area.
curb.exampleZh: 市政府希望控制繁忙市中心的交通和污染。

cure.example: The new drug can cure this disease in just a few weeks.
cure.exampleZh: 这种新药能在短短几周内治愈这种疾病。

curiosity.example: Her curiosity about the old house made her open the door.
curiosity.exampleZh: 她对那座老房子的好奇心让她打开了那扇门。

curious.example: The little girl is curious about the stars in the night sky.
curious.exampleZh: 那个小女孩对夜空中的星星感到好奇。

currency.example: The country's currency has become stronger against the dollar this year.
currency.exampleZh: 今年这个国家的货币对美元走强了。

current.example: The current is strong in this river, so swimming here is not safe.
current.exampleZh: 这条河的水流很急，所以在这里游泳不安全。

curriculum.example: The school has added coding to its curriculum this year.
curriculum.exampleZh: 学校今年把编程加入了课程。

curse.example: He began to curse loudly when he saw the broken window.
curse.exampleZh: 他看到破窗户时开始大声咒骂。

curtain.example: She drew the curtain to block the bright morning sun.
curtain.exampleZh: 她拉上窗帘，挡住早晨明亮的阳光。

curve.example: The road makes a sharp curve near the old bridge.
curve.exampleZh: 这条路在老桥附近有一处急转弯。

cushion.example: She put a soft cushion on the chair before she sat down.
cushion.exampleZh: 她坐下前在椅子上放了一个软坐垫。

custom.example: It is a local custom to give guests tea when they arrive.
custom.exampleZh: 客人到来时奉茶是当地的一种习俗。

customary.example: It is customary to bring a small gift when visiting friends.
customary.exampleZh: 拜访朋友时带一份小礼物是习惯做法。

customer.example: The customer asked the shop owner for a cheaper price.
customer.exampleZh: 这位顾客向店主提出要便宜一点的价格。

cycle.example: The water cycle moves water from the earth to the sky and back.
cycle.exampleZh: 水循环使水从地球升到天空，再回到地面。

cylinder.example: The engine has four cylinders, and each one burns fuel to make power.
cylinder.exampleZh: 这个发动机有四个汽缸，每个汽缸燃烧燃料来产生动力。

daily.example: I read the daily news before I go to work.
daily.exampleZh: 我上班前会看每日新闻。

dairy.example: We buy milk and cheese at the dairy near our house.
dairy.exampleZh: 我们在家附近的乳品店买牛奶和奶酪。

dam.example: The old dam holds back the river and keeps the village safe.
dam.exampleZh: 这座旧水坝拦住了河水，保护了村庄的安全。

damage.example: The storm caused serious damage to many houses near the sea.
damage.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨给海边的许多房屋造成了严重损坏。

damn.example: He did not damn anyone, but he did blame the whole team for the loss.
damn.exampleZh: 他并没有谴责任何人，但他确实把失利归咎于整个团队。

damp.example: The old towel still feels damp because it never dried in the shade.
damp.exampleZh: 那条旧毛巾摸起来还是潮的，因为它在阴凉处一直没干。

danger.example: The broken bridge is a danger to everyone who walks across it.
danger.exampleZh: 这座断裂的桥对每个走过它的人来说都是危险。

dangerous.example: It is dangerous to swim in this river after heavy rain.
dangerous.exampleZh: 大雨过后在这条河里游泳很危险。

dare.example: She does not dare to tell her parents the truth.
dare.exampleZh: 她不敢把真相告诉父母。

dark.example: The room was very dark, so we turned on a small light.
dark.exampleZh: 房间很暗，所以我们打开了一盏小灯。

darling.example: My darling, would you like to take a walk with me after dinner?
darling.exampleZh: 亲爱的，晚饭后你愿意和我一起散散步吗？

dash.example: He made a dash for the bus but missed it.
dash.exampleZh: 他冲向公共汽车，但没赶上。

data.example: The scientists looked at the data carefully before they made their final decision.
data.exampleZh: 科学家们在做出最终决定之前仔细查看了这些数据。

database.example: She saved all the student names in a small database.
database.exampleZh: 她把所有学生的名字保存在一个小型数据库里。

date.example: Please write the date on your homework before you give it to me.
date.exampleZh: 请在你把作业交给我之前在上面写上日期。

daughter.example: Their daughter is a doctor in the city.
daughter.exampleZh: 他们的女儿是城里的一名医生。

dawn.example: The truth began to dawn on me after I read the old letter.
dawn.exampleZh: 读完那封旧信后，我才渐渐明白了真相。

daylight.example: The room is bright because daylight comes in through the big window.
daylight.exampleZh: 房间很亮，因为日光从大窗户照进来。

dazzle.example: The bright stage lights dazzle the singer and make her blink.
dazzle.exampleZh: 明亮的舞台灯光使这位歌手目眩，让她直眨眼。

dead.example: The old tree in our garden is dead now.
dead.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树现在已经死了。

deadline.example: The deadline for the report is next Friday.
deadline.exampleZh: 这份报告的截止日期是下周五。

deadly.example: The snake's bite can be deadly if you do not get help quickly.
deadly.exampleZh: 如果不尽快求助，这种蛇的咬伤可能会致命。

deaf.example: The old man is deaf in one ear, so he cannot hear well.
deaf.exampleZh: 那位老人一只耳朵聋了，所以听不太清楚。

deal.example: I will deal with this problem after lunch today.
deal.exampleZh: 今天午饭后我会处理这个问题。

dealer.example: The car dealer sold us a used car at a good price.
dealer.exampleZh: 这位汽车经销商以优惠的价格卖给我们一辆二手车。

dean.example: The dean welcomed the new students to the college on Monday morning.
dean.exampleZh: 院长在周一上午欢迎新生来到学院。

dear.example: My dear mother always keeps my old letters in a small box.
dear.exampleZh: 我亲爱的母亲总是把我以前的信件保存在一个小盒子里。

death.example: His death made the whole family very sad.
death.exampleZh: 他的死让全家人都非常伤心。

debate.example: The students had a long debate about school rules yesterday.
debate.exampleZh: 学生们昨天就校规进行了长时间的辩论。

debris.example: After the storm, debris covered the road and blocked our car.
debris.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，碎片覆盖了道路，挡住了我们的车。

debt.example: He is working two jobs to pay off his debt.
debt.exampleZh: 他打两份工来还清债务。

debut.example: Her debut as a singer was a great success last night.
debut.exampleZh: 她昨晚作为歌手的首次登台非常成功。

decade.example: My father worked in this small town for more than a decade.
decade.exampleZh: 我父亲在这个小镇工作了十多年。

decay.example: The old wooden house began to decay after years of rain and wind.
decay.exampleZh: 那座老木屋在多年风雨之后开始腐朽。

deceit.example: His deceit hurt the friends who had trusted him for years.
deceit.exampleZh: 他的欺骗伤害了那些多年来信任他的朋友。

deceive.example: He tried to deceive his friends, but they soon learned the truth.
deceive.exampleZh: 他试图欺骗他的朋友，但他们很快就知道了真相。

decent.example: He is a decent man who always helps his friends.
decent.exampleZh: 他是个正派的人，总是帮助朋友。

deception.example: She used deception to get the money from her old friend.
deception.exampleZh: 她用欺骗手段从老朋友那里骗到了钱。

decibel.example: The noise from the street was over 80 decibels last night.
decibel.exampleZh: 昨晚街上的噪音超过了80分贝。

decide.example: We must decide where to go for the holiday this year.
decide.exampleZh: 我们必须决定今年去哪里度假。

decidedly.example: She was decidedly happy when she heard the good news today.
decidedly.exampleZh: 她今天听到这个好消息时，显然非常开心。

decimal.example: The number 3.14 is a decimal that we use in math class.
decimal.exampleZh: 3.14 是一个我们在数学课上使用的小数。

decision.example: She made a quick decision to take the early train.
decision.exampleZh: 她很快决定乘坐早班火车。

decisive.example: Her support was decisive in helping us win the match.
decisive.exampleZh: 她的支持对我们赢得比赛起了决定性作用。

declaration.example: The two countries signed a declaration of peace after the long war.
declaration.exampleZh: 两国在长期战争后签署了一份和平宣言。

declare.example: The company will declare its new plan tomorrow morning.
declare.exampleZh: 公司将于明天上午宣布其新计划。

decline.example: Sales began to decline after the company raised its prices last year.
decline.exampleZh: 去年公司提价后，销量开始下降。

decorate.example: We will decorate the classroom with colorful paper stars for the school party.
decorate.exampleZh: 为了学校的聚会，我们会用彩纸星星装饰教室。

decorative.example: She put a decorative bowl on the table.
decorative.exampleZh: 她在桌上放了一个装饰性的碗。

decrease.example: The number of students in our class began to decrease last year.
decrease.exampleZh: 我们班的学生人数去年开始减少。

dedicate.example: She decided to dedicate her free time to helping children learn to read.
dedicate.exampleZh: 她决定把自己的空闲时间用来帮助孩子们学习阅读。

deduce.example: We can deduce from the dark clouds that it will rain soon.
deduce.exampleZh: 我们可以从乌云推断出很快要下雨了。

deduct.example: The company will deduct the tax from your pay every month.
deduct.exampleZh: 公司每个月会从你的工资中扣除税款。

deed.example: His good deed helped the old man get home safely.
deed.exampleZh: 他的善举帮助那位老人安全到家。

deem.example: Most people deem this plan too risky to try right now.
deem.exampleZh: 大多数人认为这个计划风险太大，现在不宜尝试。

deep.example: The lake is deep, and the water is very cold.

deer.example: We saw a deer standing quietly near the trees in the park.
deer.exampleZh: 我们看到一只鹿静静地站在公园的树旁。

default.example: If you do not pay on time, you will default on the loan.
default.exampleZh: 如果你不按时付款，你就会违约不还贷款。

defeat.example: Our team worked hard and defeated the strong rival in the final game.
defeat.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，在决赛中击败了强大的对手。

defect.example: The only defect in this old chair is a small crack in the leg.
defect.exampleZh: 这把旧椅子唯一的瑕疵是椅腿上有一道小裂缝。

defend.example: The soldiers fought bravely to defend their country from the enemy.
defend.exampleZh: 士兵们勇敢作战，保卫他们的国家不受敌人侵犯。

defendant.example: The defendant told the judge that he was at home that night.
defendant.exampleZh: 被告告诉法官，那天晚上他在家里。

defense.example: The team worked hard on defense and won the game.
defense.exampleZh: 球队在防守上很努力，赢得了比赛。

defiance.example: His quiet defiance surprised everyone in the room.
defiance.exampleZh: 他无声的违抗让房间里的每个人都很吃惊。

deficiency.example: A deficiency of vitamin C can make you feel tired and weak.
deficiency.exampleZh: 缺乏维生素C会让你感到疲倦和虚弱。

deficit.example: The company had a large deficit last year and had to cut costs.
deficit.exampleZh: 公司去年出现了巨额亏损，不得不削减成本。

define.example: The teacher asked us to define the new word in simple English.
define.exampleZh: 老师让我们用简单的英语给这个新词下定义。

definite.example: We need a definite answer before we make the final plan.
definite.exampleZh: 在我们制定最终计划之前，我们需要一个明确的答复。

definition.example: The teacher gave a clear definition of the word before the test.
definition.exampleZh: 老师在测验前给这个词下了一个清晰的定义。

definitive.example: The judge's definitive ruling ended the long debate.
definitive.exampleZh: 法官的最终裁决结束了这场漫长的争论。

defy.example: Few people dare to defy the strict rules of the small village.
defy.exampleZh: 很少有人敢违抗这个小村庄的严格规定。

degenerate.example: The old building slowly degenerated into a dark and dangerous place.
degenerate.exampleZh: 这座老建筑慢慢退化成了一个昏暗而危险的地方。

degree.example: She has a high degree of skill in drawing.

delay.example: The heavy rain may delay our flight by two hours.
delay.exampleZh: 大雨可能会使我们的航班延误两个小时。

delegate.example: The manager will delegate the task to a team member tomorrow.
delegate.exampleZh: 经理明天会把这项任务委派给一名团队成员。

delegation.example: The manager sent a small delegation to the meeting in Beijing.
delegation.exampleZh: 经理派了一个小型代表团去北京参加会议。

delete.example: Please delete the old files on this computer before you leave.
delete.exampleZh: 请在离开前删除这台电脑上的旧文件。

deliberate.example: Her deliberate choice of words showed that she had thought about it carefully.
deliberate.exampleZh: 她审慎的措辞表明她已仔细考虑过此事。

delicate.example: The delicate glass bird broke when it fell off the table.
delicate.exampleZh: 那只精致的玻璃鸟从桌上掉下来时摔碎了。

delicious.example: This soup is delicious and very easy to make at home.
delicious.exampleZh: 这道汤很美味，而且在家做起来很简单。

delight.example: The children shouted with delight when they saw the snow.
delight.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时高兴地欢呼起来。

delightful.example: We had a delightful afternoon at the park with our dog.
delightful.exampleZh: 我们和狗在公园度过了一个愉快的下午。

deliver.example: The postman will deliver the letters to our house this morning.
deliver.exampleZh: 邮递员今天上午会把信送到我们家。

delivery.example: The store promises free delivery on every order over fifty dollars.
delivery.exampleZh: 这家商店承诺，凡超过五十美元的订单都可免费送货。

demand.example: The workers made a demand for better pay and safer working conditions.
demand.exampleZh: 工人们提出了提高工资和改善安全条件的要求。

democracy.example: In a democracy, people can vote and choose their own leaders.
democracy.exampleZh: 在民主国家，人们可以投票并选择自己的领导人。

democratic.example: The country held a free and democratic election last year.
democratic.exampleZh: 这个国家去年举行了一场自由民主的选举。

demonstrate.example: The teacher will demonstrate the experiment to the whole class tomorrow.
demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师明天将向全班演示这个实验。

demonstration.example: The teacher gave a simple demonstration of how the new machine works.
demonstration.exampleZh: 老师简单演示了这台新机器是如何运作的。

denial.example: His quick denial of the mistake made everyone in the room suspicious.
denial.exampleZh: 他对这个错误的迅速否认让房间里的每个人都起了疑心。

denounce.example: Many people denounced the plan because it would harm the local environment.
denounce.exampleZh: 许多人谴责这项计划，因为它会损害当地环境。

dense.example: The city has a dense population and many tall buildings.
dense.exampleZh: 这座城市人口稠密，还有许多高楼。

density.example: The density of the city is very high in the old town.
density.exampleZh: 老城区的城市密度非常高。

deny.example: She did not deny the mistake, but she refused to say sorry to anyone.
deny.exampleZh: 她没有否认这个错误，但她拒绝向任何人道歉。

depart.example: The train will depart from the station at eight tomorrow morning.
depart.exampleZh: 火车将于明天早上八点从车站出发。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a large company.
department.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司的销售部工作。

departure.example: Our departure from the hotel is at seven tomorrow morning.
departure.exampleZh: 我们明天早上七点离开酒店。

depend.example: We depend on our parents for love and support when we are young.
depend.exampleZh: 我们小时候依靠父母给予关爱和支持。

dependent.example: Young children are dependent on their parents for food and shelter.
dependent.exampleZh: 幼儿依靠父母获得食物和住所。

depict.example: The book depicts the life of a young farmer in simple words.
depict.exampleZh: 这本书用简单的文字描绘了一个年轻农民的生活。

deposit.example: I deposit some money in the bank every month.
deposit.exampleZh: 我每个月都在银行存一些钱。

depress.example: The bad weather and the long delay began to depress everyone in the group.
depress.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气和长时间的延误开始让团队里的每个人感到沮丧。

depression.example: He felt a deep sense of depression after losing his job last year.
depression.exampleZh: 去年失业后，他感到深深的沮丧。

deprive.example: The new law may deprive many families of their homes.
deprive.exampleZh: 这项新法律可能会剥夺许多家庭的住房。

depth.example: The lake has a depth of about twenty meters near the middle.
depth.exampleZh: 这个湖中部附近的水深大约有二十米。

deputy.example: The deputy took charge of the meeting while the manager was away.
deputy.exampleZh: 经理不在时，副手主持了这次会议。

derive.example: Many English words derive from Latin and Greek roots.
derive.exampleZh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和希腊语词根。

descend.example: The plane began to descend slowly toward the runway.
descend.exampleZh: 飞机开始缓慢地向跑道下降。

descendant.example: She is a descendant of a famous family from the south.
descendant.exampleZh: 她是南方一个有名家族的后代。

descent.example: The steep descent from the mountain took us almost two hours.
descent.exampleZh: 从山上陡峭的下坡路花了我们将近两个小时。

describe.example: Please describe your new teacher in a few simple words.
describe.exampleZh: 请用几个简单的词描述一下你的新老师。

description.example: The description of the new phone was very clear and easy to understand.
description.exampleZh: 这款新手机的说明非常清楚，很容易理解。

desert.example: The soldier chose to desert his post and walked into the desert alone.
desert.exampleZh: 这名士兵选择擅离职守，独自走进了沙漠。

deserve.example: Good teachers deserve respect from all their students.
deserve.exampleZh: 好老师值得所有学生的尊重。

design.example: She wants to design a small garden behind her new house.
design.exampleZh: 她想在新房子后面设计一个小花园。

designate.example: They will designate this room as the new meeting place.
designate.exampleZh: 他们将指定这个房间作为新的会议场所。

desirable.example: A quiet home near the park is desirable for most young families.
desirable.exampleZh: 对大多数年轻家庭来说，公园附近一套安静的房子是值得向往的。

desire.example: She has a strong desire to learn English well.
desire.exampleZh: 她有一个学好英语的强烈愿望。

desk.example: I put my books on the desk and sit down to study.
desk.exampleZh: 我把书放在书桌上，然后坐下来学习。

desolate.example: The old house stood alone on a desolate hill far from town.
desolate.exampleZh: 那座老房子孤零零地立在远离城镇的荒凉山丘上。

despair.example: After losing the game, she felt deep despair and could not sleep.
despair.exampleZh: 输掉比赛后，她感到深深的绝望，无法入睡。

desperate.example: She was desperate for help after losing her keys.
desperate.exampleZh: 她丢了钥匙后极度渴望得到帮助。

despise.example: I despise people who are cruel to animals.
despise.exampleZh: 我鄙视那些虐待动物的人。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, the children played outside all afternoon.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，孩子们还是在外面玩了一下午。

dessert.example: We had ice cream for dessert after dinner last night.
dessert.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

destination.example: Our final destination is a small town near the sea.
destination.exampleZh: 我们最终的目的地是海边的一个小镇。

destined.example: She always believed she was destined to become a writer.
destined.exampleZh: 她一直相信自己命中注定要成为一名作家。

destiny.example: She believes that destiny brought them together in that small town.
destiny.exampleZh: 她相信是命运在那个小镇上让他们走到了一起。

destroy.example: The big fire destroyed the old house yesterday.
destroy.exampleZh: 大火昨天摧毁了那座老房子。

destruction.example: The storm caused great destruction to homes and trees across the small town.
destruction.exampleZh: 这场风暴给小镇上的房屋和树木造成了巨大的破坏。

detach.example: You can detach the keyboard from the tablet and carry it on its own.
detach.exampleZh: 你可以把键盘从平板电脑上拆下来，单独携带。

detail.example: Please tell me every detail of your trip to Japan.
detail.exampleZh: 请把你日本之行的每个细节都告诉我。

detect.example: The police used a special machine to detect the hidden camera in the room.
detect.exampleZh: 警方用一台特殊机器探测房间里的隐藏摄像头。

detective.example: The detective asked my neighbors many questions about the missing car.
detective.exampleZh: 那名侦探向我的邻居们问了许多关于失踪汽车的问题。

deteriorate.example: His health began to deteriorate rapidly after he stopped taking the medicine.
deteriorate.exampleZh: 他停药后健康状况开始迅速恶化。

determination.example: Her determination helped her finish the hard work on time.
determination.exampleZh: 她的决心帮助她按时完成了这项艰难的工作。

determine.example: We need more tests to determine the cause of the problem.
determine.exampleZh: 我们需要更多测试来确定问题的原因。

develop.example: Scientists are trying to develop a new drug for this disease.
develop.exampleZh: 科学家们正试图研发一种治疗这种疾病的新药。

development.example: The development of new technology has changed our daily lives.
development.exampleZh: 新技术的发展已经改变了我们的日常生活。

deviate.example: He never deviates from his daily plan, even on busy days.
deviate.exampleZh: 即使在忙碌的日子里，他也从不偏离自己的日常计划。

device.example: This small device helps us measure the temperature of the water.
device.exampleZh: 这个小装置帮助我们测量水的温度。

devil.example: In the old story, a devil comes to the village to test the people.
devil.exampleZh: 在那个古老的故事里，一个魔鬼来到村子里考验人们。

devise.example: Our team must devise a simple plan to cut costs this month.
devise.exampleZh: 我们团队必须想出一个简单的方案来削减这个月的成本。

devote.example: She devotes much of her free time to helping older people in her town.
devote.exampleZh: 她把大部分空闲时间用来帮助镇上年纪大的人。

diagnose.example: Doctors can diagnose the illness early and give the right treatment.
diagnose.exampleZh: 医生能够及早诊断这种疾病，并给出正确的治疗方法。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram on the board to explain the water cycle.
diagram.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一张简单的示意图来解释水循环。

dial.example: She dialed the number on the old phone and waited for an answer.
dial.exampleZh: 她拨了那台旧电话上的号码，然后等着有人接。

dialect.example: My grandmother speaks a dialect that I cannot fully understand.
dialect.exampleZh: 我奶奶说一种我听不太懂的方言。

dialogue.example: The two leaders had a honest dialogue about the new trade rules.
dialogue.exampleZh: 两位领导人就新的贸易规则进行了坦诚的对话。

diameter.example: The diameter of this circular table is about one meter.
diameter.exampleZh: 这张圆桌的直径大约是一米。

diamond.example: She wore a small diamond on her finger at the party.
diamond.exampleZh: 她在聚会上手指上戴着一颗小钻石。

diary.example: She writes in her diary every night before she goes to bed.
diary.exampleZh: 她每天晚上睡觉前都会在日记本上写日记。

dictate.example: The teacher asked us to dictate the new words to our partners.
dictate.exampleZh: 老师让我们把新单词口述给搭档。

die.example: The old man died in his sleep at home last night.
die.exampleZh: 那位老人昨晚在家中睡觉时去世了。

diet.example: A healthy diet with fresh fruit and vegetables helps you stay strong.
diet.exampleZh: 多吃新鲜水果和蔬菜的健康饮食有助于你保持强壮。

differ.example: Their opinions differ, but they are still good friends.
differ.exampleZh: 他们的意见不同，但仍然是好朋友。

difference.example: There is a big difference between the two answers.
difference.exampleZh: 这两个答案之间有很大的差异。

different.example: My sister and I go to different schools this year.
different.exampleZh: 今年我和妹妹上不同的学校。

differentiate.example: It is hard to differentiate these two words without more context.
differentiate.exampleZh: 没有更多上下文，很难区分这两个词。

difficult.example: This question is very difficult for me to answer.
difficult.exampleZh: 这个问题对我来说很难回答。

difficulty.example: She had some difficulty finding the right answer to the question.
difficulty.exampleZh: 她找到这个问题的正确答案有些困难。

dig.example: The dog likes to dig in the soft garden soil every morning.
dig.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢每天早上在松软的园土里挖来挖去。

digest.example: It takes time to digest all this new information.
digest.exampleZh: 消化所有这些新信息需要时间。

digital.example: This shop sells digital cameras and phones at low prices.
digital.exampleZh: 这家店以低价出售数码相机和手机。

dignity.example: Everyone should treat old people with dignity and respect.
dignity.exampleZh: 每个人都应该以尊严和尊重对待老人。

dilemma.example: She faced a real dilemma when both job offers came at the same time.
dilemma.exampleZh: 两份工作同时到来时，她面临一个真正的两难处境。

diligent.example: She is a diligent student and always finishes her homework on time.
diligent.exampleZh: 她是个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。

dim.example: The room was dim, so I could not read the small words.
dim.exampleZh: 房间里光线昏暗，所以我看不清那些小字。

dimension.example: We measured every dimension of the room before buying new furniture.
dimension.exampleZh: 我们在买新家具之前量了房间的每一个尺寸。

diminish.example: The pain will diminish after you take this medicine and rest.
diminish.exampleZh: 吃了这个药并休息后，疼痛会减轻。

dine.example: We often dine at the small restaurant near our home on Sundays.
dine.exampleZh: 我们星期天常在家附近的那家小餐馆用餐。

dinner.example: We usually have dinner at seven in the evening.
dinner.exampleZh: 我们通常晚上七点吃晚饭。

dip.example: She likes to dip her bread in the hot soup.
dip.exampleZh: 她喜欢把面包蘸进热汤里。

diploma.example: She showed her diploma to the manager and got the job.
diploma.exampleZh: 她把毕业文凭拿给经理看，得到了那份工作。

diplomatic.example: She gave a diplomatic answer so that no one would feel upset.
diplomatic.exampleZh: 她给了一个有策略的回答，这样谁都不会感到不快。

direct.example: The teacher gave us direct instructions and told us to start now.
direct.exampleZh: 老师给了我们直接的指示，并让我们现在就开始。

direction.example: Please read the directions before you use this new machine.
direction.exampleZh: 使用这台新机器前，请先阅读用法说明。

directly.example: She went directly home after work because she felt tired.
directly.exampleZh: 她下班后直接回家了，因为她觉得累。

director.example: The director asked the actors to try the scene again.
director.exampleZh: 导演让演员们把这个场景再试一次。

dirt.example: Wash the dirt off your hands before you eat dinner.
dirt.exampleZh: 吃晚饭前把手上的污物洗掉。

dirty.example: His dirty shoes made the whole floor messy after the long walk.
dirty.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，他那双脏鞋把整个地板都弄脏了。

disabled.example: The building has a special door for disabled people who use a wheelchair.
disabled.exampleZh: 这栋楼为使用轮椅的残疾人设有一扇专用门。

disagree.example: I disagree with you on this plan, but we can still talk about it.
disagree.exampleZh: 我不同意你对这个计划的看法，但我们仍然可以讨论一下。

disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds and the sky turned gray.
disappear.exampleZh: 太阳消失在云层后面，天空变成了灰色。

disappoint.example: I hope this news will not disappoint you too much.
disappoint.exampleZh: 我希望这个消息不会让你太失望。

disaster.example: The flood was a terrible disaster for everyone in the small town.
disaster.exampleZh: 这场洪水对小镇上的每个人来说都是一场可怕的灾难。

discard.example: Please discard the old papers in that box.
discard.exampleZh: 请把那个箱子里的旧文件丢弃。

discern.example: It is hard to discern the truth from all these reports.
discern.exampleZh: 很难从所有这些报告里辨别出真相。

discharge.example: The factory must not discharge waste water into the river.
discharge.exampleZh: 这家工厂不得向河里排放废水。

discipline.example: Learning a new language requires patience, discipline, and daily practice.
discipline.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要耐心、自律和每日练习。

disclose.example: The company refused to disclose the names of its new investors.
disclose.exampleZh: 公司拒绝透露新投资者的姓名。

disco.example: We danced all night at the disco near our hotel.
disco.exampleZh: 我们在酒店附近的迪斯科舞厅跳了一整晚的舞。

discount.example: The store gave me a discount on the new shoes.
discount.exampleZh: 这家店给我买的新鞋打了折。

discourage.example: Bad weather should not discourage you from trying again tomorrow.
discourage.exampleZh: 坏天气不应该使你泄气而不敢明天再试。

discourse.example: Her lecture was a clear discourse on how language shapes everyday life.
discourse.exampleZh: 她的讲座是一篇关于语言如何塑造日常生活的清晰论述。

discover.example: Scientists hope to discover a new way to clean dirty water.
discover.exampleZh: 科学家们希望发现一种净化脏水的新方法。

discovery.example: The discovery of the new planet made scientists very happy.
discovery.exampleZh: 这颗新行星的发现让科学家们非常高兴。

discreet.example: Please be discreet about this news and do not tell anyone else.
discreet.exampleZh: 请对这个消息保持谨慎，不要告诉其他任何人。

discrepancy.example: There is a small discrepancy between the two reports.
discrepancy.exampleZh: 这两份报告之间有一个小的差异。

discrimination.example: She has good taste and shows discrimination when choosing clothes.
discrimination.exampleZh: 她品味很好，挑衣服时很有鉴别力。

discuss.example: We often discuss our plans at dinner.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们经常在晚饭时讨论我们的计划。

discussion.example: We had a long discussion about the plan after lunch.
discussion.exampleZh: 午饭后我们对该计划进行了长时间的讨论。

disease.example: The doctor said this disease can spread quickly through dirty water.
disease.exampleZh: 医生说这种疾病可以通过脏水迅速传播。

disguise.example: He tried to disguise his voice so no one would know him.
disguise.exampleZh: 他试图伪装自己的声音，这样没人会认出他。

disgust.example: I felt disgust when I saw the dirty food on the table.
disgust.exampleZh: 看到桌上那些脏食物时，我感到很厌恶。

dish.example: She put the hot dish on the table and called everyone to eat.
dish.exampleZh: 她把热菜放在桌上，然后叫大家来吃饭。

dishonest.example: It is dishonest to take money that does not belong to you.
dishonest.exampleZh: 拿走不属于你的钱是不诚实的。

disk.example: He saved all the photos on a disk.
disk.exampleZh: 他把所有照片都存在一张磁盘上。

dislike.example: I dislike cold weather, but my brother enjoys it very much.
dislike.exampleZh: 我不喜欢寒冷的天气，但我弟弟非常喜欢。

dismay.example: To her dismay, the heavy rain ruined their outdoor wedding plans.
dismay.exampleZh: 令她沮丧的是，大雨毁了他们的户外婚礼计划。

dismiss.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers for always arriving late to work.
dismiss.exampleZh: 经理决定解雇两名总是上班迟到的工人。

disorder.example: The heavy storm left the small town in complete disorder.
disorder.exampleZh: 那场猛烈的暴风雨使这个小镇陷入了完全的混乱。

dispatch.example: The police will dispatch a team to the scene at once.
dispatch.exampleZh: 警方将立即派遣一队人马赶赴现场。

disperse.example: The wind helped disperse the smoke from the fire.
disperse.exampleZh: 风帮助驱散了火产生的烟。

displace.example: New machines often displace workers in old factories.
displace.exampleZh: 新机器常常取代旧工厂里的工人。

display.example: Please display your ticket at the entrance so everyone can see it.
display.exampleZh: 请在入口处展示你的票，以便大家都能看到。

disposal.example: The safe disposal of waste is important for every city.
disposal.exampleZh: 安全处理垃圾对每个城市都很重要。

dispose.example: We must dispose of the old chairs before the new ones arrive.
dispose.exampleZh: 我们必须在新的椅子送到之前把旧椅子处理掉。

disposition.example: His cheerful disposition makes him easy to work with.
disposition.exampleZh: 他开朗的性情使他很容易与人共事。

dispute.example: The two countries are still trying to settle their dispute over the border.
dispute.exampleZh: 这两个国家仍在努力解决它们之间的边界争端。

disrupt.example: The loud noise outside may disrupt the students during the test.
disrupt.exampleZh: 外面的巨大噪音可能会在考试期间打扰学生。

dissolve.example: Stir the sugar into the warm water until it dissolves completely.
dissolve.exampleZh: 把糖搅入温水中，直到它完全溶解。

distance.example: The distance between the two cities is about a hundred miles.
distance.exampleZh: 这两座城市之间的距离大约是一百英里。

distant.example: My best friend moved to a distant city last year.
distant.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友去年搬到了一座遥远的城市。

distinct.example: There are two distinct groups of students in this class.
distinct.exampleZh: 这个班里有两组截然不同的学生。

distinction.example: There is a clear distinction between the two words.
distinction.exampleZh: 这两个词之间有明显的区别。

distinguish.example: Small children cannot easily distinguish between a real coin and a toy one.
distinguish.exampleZh: 小孩子不容易分辨真硬币和玩具硬币。

distort.example: The article distorts the facts to make the story more exciting.
distort.exampleZh: 这篇文章歪曲事实，让故事更吸引人。

distract.example: Loud music can distract students when they try to study at home.
distract.exampleZh: 当学生们在家试图学习时，大声的音乐会让他们分心。

distress.example: The loss of her old dog caused her great distress.
distress.exampleZh: 老伴去世让她非常痛苦。

distribute.example: The teacher will distribute the new books to all the students tomorrow morning.
distribute.exampleZh: 老师明天早上会把新书分发给所有学生。

district.example: Our school is in a quiet district near the river.
district.exampleZh: 我们学校位于河边一个安静的区。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb me while I am working in my room.
disturb.exampleZh: 我在房间里工作时，请不要打扰我。

disturbance.example: The loud music caused a disturbance late at night.
disturbance.exampleZh: 响亮的音乐在深夜引起了骚乱。

ditch.example: Rain water flows through a deep ditch beside the road.
ditch.exampleZh: 雨水沿着路边一条深深的沟渠流过。

dive.example: She likes to dive into the pool before breakfast every morning.
dive.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早饭前跳进泳池里潜水。

diverse.example: Our school has students from diverse countries and cultures around the world.
diverse.exampleZh: 我们学校有来自世界各地不同国家和文化的学生。

diversion.example: The road was closed, so we had to take a diversion through the quiet town.
diversion.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，所以我们不得不绕行穿过那个安静的小镇。

divert.example: The police diverted traffic to avoid the flooded road.
divert.exampleZh: 警察引导车辆改道以避开被洪水淹没的道路。

divide.example: Please divide the cake into six equal pieces for the children.
divide.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕分成六等份给孩子们。

division.example: The manager divided the work among the team, and each division finished on time.
division.exampleZh: 经理把工作分配给团队，每个部门都按时完成了。

divorce.example: Their divorce was hard for the whole family, but they are friends now.
divorce.exampleZh: 他们的离婚对整个家庭来说很难，但他们现在是朋友。

dizzy.example: After spinning around three times, I felt dizzy and had to sit down.
dizzy.exampleZh: 转了三圈之后，我感到头晕，只好坐下来。

do.example: What do you want to do this weekend?

dock.example: The small boat is tied to the dock near the harbor.
dock.exampleZh: 小船被拴在港口附近的码头上。

doctor.example: The doctor told me to rest at home for two days.
doctor.exampleZh: 医生让我在家休息两天。

doctrine.example: The church teaches this doctrine to all its members.
doctrine.exampleZh: 教会向所有成员传授这一教义。

document.example: Please keep this document in a safe place for future use.
document.exampleZh: 请把这份文件放在安全的地方，以备将来使用。

documentary.example: We watched a documentary about wild animals in Africa last night.
documentary.exampleZh: 我们昨晚看了一部关于非洲野生动物的纪录片。

dog.example: The dog runs in the park every morning with my little brother.
dog.exampleZh: 这只狗每天早上和我弟弟一起在公园里跑。

doll.example: The little girl sleeps with her favorite doll every night.
doll.exampleZh: 这个小女孩每天晚上都抱着她最喜欢的玩偶睡觉。

dollar.example: I only have one dollar in my pocket today.
dollar.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只有一美元。

dolphin.example: The dolphin jumped high out of the water and made everyone smile.
dolphin.exampleZh: 那只海豚高高跃出水面，让每个人都笑了。

domain.example: Online safety is an important part of this new domain of study.
domain.exampleZh: 网络安全是这个新研究领域的重要组成部分。

dome.example: The old church has a large white dome on its roof.
dome.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂屋顶上有一个巨大的白色穹顶。

domestic.example: She spends her weekends doing domestic chores like cooking and cleaning the house.
domestic.exampleZh: 她周末都用来做家务，比如做饭和打扫房子。

dominant.example: This team is the dominant force in the local league.
dominant.exampleZh: 这支球队是当地联赛中占优势的力量。

dominate.example: Big companies often dominate the market and control the prices.
dominate.exampleZh: 大公司常常主导市场并控制价格。

donate.example: Many people donate money to help children in poor areas go to school.
donate.exampleZh: 许多人捐钱帮助贫困地区的孩子上学。

donkey.example: My father says he is not a donkey, but he never changes his mind.
donkey.exampleZh: 我父亲说他不是笨蛋，但他从不改变主意。

doom.example: Bad choices can doom a young man to a life of trouble.
doom.exampleZh: 错误的选择会使一个年轻人一生陷入困境。

door.example: Please close the door when you leave the room.
door.exampleZh: 离开房间时请把门关上。

dormant.example: The old volcano has been dormant for many years and people now farm nearby.
dormant.exampleZh: 这座古老的火山已经休眠多年，如今人们在附近种地。

dormitory.example: My dormitory is on the third floor and has two big windows.
dormitory.exampleZh: 我的宿舍在三楼，有两扇大窗户。

dose.example: The doctor told him to take a small dose of the medicine twice a day.
dose.exampleZh: 医生告诉他每天服用两次小剂量的这种药。

dot.example: There is a small red dot in the middle of the white paper.
dot.exampleZh: 白纸中间有一个小红点。

double.example: We booked a double room and asked them to double the blankets.
double.exampleZh: 我们订了一间双人房，并要求他们把毯子加倍。

doubt.example: I doubt he will come to the meeting today.
doubt.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今天不会来开会。

doubtful.example: I am doubtful that he can finish the work today.
doubtful.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今天能否完成这项工作。

downstairs.example: I left my bag downstairs in the kitchen this morning.
downstairs.exampleZh: 今天早上我把包落在楼下的厨房里了。

downward.example: The path slopes downward toward the river, so be careful.
downward.exampleZh: 小路向下倾斜通向河边，所以小心点。

dozen.example: She bought a dozen eggs and a loaf of bread at the store.
dozen.exampleZh: 她在商店买了一打鸡蛋和一条面包。

draft.example: She wrote a draft of the report before the meeting.
draft.exampleZh: 她在会议前写了一份报告的草稿。

drag.example: He had to drag the heavy box across the room.
drag.exampleZh: 他不得不把那个沉重的箱子拖过房间。

dragon.example: The dragon in the old story breathes fire and guards a cave.
dragon.exampleZh: 那个古老故事里的龙会喷火，并守护着一个洞穴。

drain.example: Heavy rain drained the water from the flooded streets.
drain.exampleZh: 大雨把被淹街道上的水排走了。

drama.example: The drama at school today was very exciting for everyone.
drama.exampleZh: 今天学校里的那场戏剧性事件让每个人都很兴奋。

dramatic.example: The movie's dramatic ending surprised everyone in the theater.
dramatic.exampleZh: 这部电影戏剧性的结局让影院里的每个人都很惊讶。

drastic.example: The city made drastic changes to its traffic rules last year.
drastic.exampleZh: 这座城市去年对交通规则做出了重大改变。

draw.example: She likes to draw pictures of animals in her notebook.
draw.exampleZh: 她喜欢在笔记本上画动物的图画。

drawback.example: The only drawback of this job is the long hours and low pay.
drawback.exampleZh: 这份工作唯一的缺点就是工作时间长而且工资低。

drawer.example: The keys are in the top drawer of my desk.
drawer.exampleZh: 钥匙在我书桌最上面的抽屉里。

drawing.example: She is drawing a picture of her cat on the white paper.
drawing.exampleZh: 她正在白纸上画一幅她的猫的图画。

dread.example: I dread going to the dentist because the pain always frightens me.
dread.exampleZh: 我害怕去看牙医，因为那种疼痛总让我恐惧。

dream.example: Her dream is to become a teacher in a small village.
dream.exampleZh: 她的梦想是成为一个小村庄里的老师。

dress.example: She wears a beautiful dress to the party every year.
dress.exampleZh: 她每年都穿一条漂亮的连衣裙去参加聚会。

drift.example: Cold air can drift through the open window at night.
drift.exampleZh: 夜晚，冷空气会从敞开的窗户飘进来。

drill.example: The workers used a drill to make holes in the wall.
drill.exampleZh: 工人们用钻头在墙上钻孔。

drink.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before I go to work.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都喝一杯水。

drip.example: Water began to drip from the old roof into a small bucket.
drip.exampleZh: 水开始从旧屋顶滴落进一个小桶里。

drive.example: My father drives me to school every morning before work.
drive.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前开车送我去学校。

driver.example: The driver stopped the bus in front of the school.
driver.exampleZh: 司机把公交车停在了学校门口。

drop.example: Be careful not to drop the glass on the hard floor.
drop.exampleZh: 小心别把玻璃杯掉在硬地板上。

drought.example: The long drought killed most of the crops on our farm this summer.
drought.exampleZh: 这场漫长的干旱杀死了我们农场今年夏天的大部分庄稼。

drown.example: The loud music drowned out her voice, so nobody could hear her.
drown.exampleZh: 嘈杂的音乐淹没了她的声音，所以没人能听见她说话。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a drug to help him sleep.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种药帮助他入睡。

drum.example: He played the drum in the school band every Friday afternoon.
drum.exampleZh: 他每周五下午在学校乐队里打鼓。

drunk.example: He got drunk at the party and could not find his way home.
drunk.exampleZh: 他在聚会上喝醉了，找不到回家的路。

dry.example: The dry weather made the small river become dry last summer.
dry.exampleZh: 干旱的天气让那条小河去年夏天变干了。

dub.example: Many people dub him the king of the small screen for his funny shows.
dub.exampleZh: 很多人因为他那些搞笑的节目而戏称他为小荧屏之王。

dubious.example: I am dubious about his plan because it seems too simple.
dubious.exampleZh: 我对他的计划持怀疑态度，因为它看起来太简单了。

duck.example: The little duck swims in the pond behind our house every morning.
duck.exampleZh: 那只小鸭子每天早上都在我们房子后面的池塘里游泳。

due.example: The report is due on Friday, so please finish it soon.
due.exampleZh: 报告周五到期，所以请尽快完成。

dull.example: The story was so dull that I fell asleep on the sofa.
dull.exampleZh: 这个故事太无趣了，我在沙发上睡着了。

dumb.example: It was dumb to leave my keys in the car.
dumb.exampleZh: 把钥匙落在车里真是愚蠢。

dump.example: Please do not dump your old furniture into the river.
dump.exampleZh: 请不要把你的旧家具倒进河里。

duplicate.example: Please duplicate this file and put the copy in a safe place.
duplicate.exampleZh: 请复制这个文件，并把副本放在安全的地方。

durable.example: This bag is durable and will last for many years.
durable.exampleZh: 这个包很耐用，能用很多年。

during.example: I fell asleep twice during the long meeting this morning.
during.exampleZh: 今天上午那个漫长的会议期间我睡着了两次。

dusk.example: The children went home at dusk because the street lights came on.
dusk.exampleZh: 孩子们在黄昏时回家了，因为路灯亮了起来。

dust.example: A thick layer of dust covered the old wooden table in the corner.
dust.exampleZh: 角落里那张旧木桌上积了厚厚一层灰尘。

duty.example: It is my duty to help my parents at home.
duty.exampleZh: 在家帮助父母是我的责任。

dwarf.example: The big tree dwarfs the small house next to it.
dwarf.exampleZh: 那棵大树使旁边的小房子相形见绌。

dwell.example: Many small animals dwell in the dark caves near the river.
dwell.exampleZh: 许多小动物栖息在河边的黑暗洞穴里。

dwelling.example: Their new dwelling is small but warm and close to the river.
dwelling.exampleZh: 他们的新住所虽小，但很温暖，而且靠近河边。

dye.example: She used a natural dye to color the old white shirt blue.
dye.exampleZh: 她用一种天然染料把那件旧白衬衫染成了蓝色。

dynamic.example: Our city is dynamic and full of new ideas and energy.
dynamic.exampleZh: 我们的城市充满活力，满是新想法和能量。

dynasty.example: The Tang dynasty was a great time for art and poetry.
dynasty.exampleZh: 唐朝是艺术和诗歌的辉煌时期。

e-mail.example: I sent the report to my teacher by e-mail this morning.
e-mail.exampleZh: 我今天早上通过电子邮件把报告发给了老师。

eager.example: The children are eager to open their gifts on Christmas morning.
eager.exampleZh: 孩子们热切地想在圣诞早晨打开礼物。

eagle.example: The eagle flew high above the mountains and looked for fish in the river.
eagle.exampleZh: 那只鹰在群山之上高高飞翔，在河里寻找鱼。

ear.example: My left ear hurts a little after I swim in the cold water.
ear.exampleZh: 在冷水里游泳后，我的左耳有点疼。

early.example: She gets up early every morning to run before work.
early.exampleZh: 她每天早上起得很早，上班前去跑步。

earn.example: She works hard every day to earn money for her family.
earn.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，为家人挣钱。

earnest.example: She gave an earnest answer to every question the teacher asked.
earnest.exampleZh: 她对老师提出的每个问题都给出了认真的回答。

earth.example: The earth moves around the sun once every year.
earth.exampleZh: 地球每年绕太阳转一圈。

earthquake.example: A strong earthquake shook the city early this morning.
earthquake.exampleZh: 今天一大早，一场强烈的地震震动了这座城市。

ease.example: This soft chair helps me relax with ease after a long day.
ease.exampleZh: 这张柔软的椅子让我在漫长的一天后轻松放松。

eastern.example: The sun rises in the eastern sky every morning.
eastern.exampleZh: 太阳每天早晨从东方的天空升起。

easy.example: This easy test only takes ten minutes, so please do not worry.
easy.exampleZh: 这个容易的测试只需十分钟，所以请不要担心。

eat.example: We usually eat dinner together at seven every evening.
eat.exampleZh: 我们通常每天晚上七点一起吃饭。

echo.example: The echo of our voices came back from the empty hall.
echo.exampleZh: 我们的声音从空荡的大厅里传回来，形成了回声。

economic.example: The country has seen strong economic growth over the past ten years.
economic.exampleZh: 过去十年里，这个国家的经济增长强劲。

economical.example: This small car is economical and cheap to run every day.
economical.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车很省油，日常使用成本也低。

economy.example: The country's economy is growing fast and more people can find jobs.
economy.exampleZh: 这个国家的经济增长很快，更多人能找到工作。

ecosystem.example: Pollution in the river can harm the entire ecosystem.
ecosystem.exampleZh: 河流中的污染会损害整个生态系统。

edge.example: Be careful near the edge of the cliff because it is very steep.
edge.exampleZh: 在悬崖边缘附近要小心，因为那里非常陡峭。

edition.example: This new edition of the book has more pictures for young readers.
edition.exampleZh: 这本书的新版本为年轻读者增加了更多图片。

editor.example: The editor read my story and fixed a few small mistakes.
editor.exampleZh: 编辑读了我的故事，并改正了几处小错误。

editorial.example: The newspaper published an editorial about the need for cleaner city parks.
editorial.exampleZh: 报纸发表了一篇关于需要更清洁的城市公园的社论。

educate.example: Parents and teachers should educate children to be kind and honest.
educate.exampleZh: 家长和老师应该教育孩子善良诚实。

education.example: My parents believe that a good education can change a person's life.
education.exampleZh: 我父母相信，良好的教育能改变一个人的一生。

effect.example: The new rule had a big effect on how we work.
effect.exampleZh: 新规定对我们的工作方式有很大影响。

effective.example: The new medicine is very effective against coughs and colds.
effective.exampleZh: 这种新药对咳嗽和感冒非常有效。

efficiency.example: Good planning can improve the efficiency of our daily work.
efficiency.exampleZh: 良好的计划能提高我们日常工作的效率。

efficient.example: She is very efficient at her job and always finishes work early.
efficient.exampleZh: 她工作很高效，总是提前完成工作。

effort.example: Her efforts to learn English made the whole class proud.
effort.exampleZh: 她学习英语的努力让全班都感到骄傲。

egg.example: I eat an egg every morning before I go to school.
egg.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃一个鸡蛋。

ego.example: His big ego makes it hard for him to accept advice.
ego.exampleZh: 他强烈的自负让他很难接受别人的建议。

elaborate.example: She gave an elaborate answer and then elaborated on her plan.
elaborate.exampleZh: 她给出了详尽的回答，然后详细阐述了她的计划。

elastic.example: This old rubber band is still elastic enough to stretch.
elastic.exampleZh: 这根旧橡皮圈仍然很有弹性，可以拉伸。

elbow.example: He hurt his elbow when he fell off the bike.
elbow.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来时伤了肘部。

elder.example: Children should listen to their elders and learn from their experience.
elder.exampleZh: 孩子们应该听长辈的话，并从他们的经验中学习。

elderly.example: The elderly man walks slowly with a stick in the park.
