elderly.exampleZh: 这位年长的男士在公园里拄着拐杖慢慢地走。

elect.example: The members will elect a new leader at the meeting next week.
elect.exampleZh: 成员们将在下周的会议上选举一位新领导。

election.example: The election for class president will be held next Friday.
election.exampleZh: 班长选举将于下周五举行。

electric.example: Electric cars are becoming more common on city roads today.
electric.exampleZh: 如今，电动汽车在城市道路上越来越常见。

electrical.example: The electrical wiring in this old house needs to be replaced.
electrical.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的电线需要更换。

electricity.example: The storm cut off our electricity for two days last week.
electricity.exampleZh: 上周的暴风雨让我们停电了两天。

electron.example: Every atom has a nucleus with electrons moving around it.
electron.exampleZh: 每个原子都有一个原子核，电子围绕它运动。

electronic.example: My electronic dictionary helps me learn new English words every day.
electronic.exampleZh: 我的电子词典每天帮我学习新的英语单词。

elegant.example: Her elegant dress made her stand out at the party.
elegant.exampleZh: 她那件优雅的连衣裙让她在聚会上显得格外出众。

element.example: Water is made of two elements, hydrogen and oxygen.
element.exampleZh: 水由氢和氧两种元素组成。

elementary.example: Children learn basic math and reading in elementary school.
elementary.exampleZh: 孩子们在小学学习基础数学和阅读。

elephant.example: The elephant is very big and drinks a lot of water every day.
elephant.exampleZh: 这头大象非常大，每天喝很多水。

elevate.example: They plan to elevate the old bridge to let bigger boats pass.
elevate.exampleZh: 他们计划抬高这座旧桥，让更大的船能够通过。

elevator.example: She took the elevator to the tenth floor after lunch.
elevator.exampleZh: 午饭后她乘电梯去了十楼。

eligible.example: Only students over eighteen are eligible to join this program.
eligible.exampleZh: 只有十八岁以上的学生才有资格参加这个项目。

eliminate.example: We must eliminate waste to save money and time.
eliminate.exampleZh: 我们必须消除浪费，以节省金钱和时间。

elite.example: Only a small elite can afford to live in this expensive city.
elite.exampleZh: 只有少数精英才住得起这座昂贵的城市。

eloquent.example: Her eloquent speech made everyone in the room quiet and thoughtful.
eloquent.exampleZh: 她雄辩的演讲让房间里的每个人都安静下来并陷入思考。

else.example: Is there anything else you want to eat before we go home?
else.exampleZh: 在我们回家之前，你还想吃点别的吗？

elsewhere.example: She did not like the noisy room, so she looked for a quiet place elsewhere.
elsewhere.exampleZh: 她不喜欢那个吵闹的房间，所以去别处找了一个安静的地方。

embark.example: We will embark on a long journey by ship tomorrow morning.
embark.exampleZh: 我们明天早上将乘船开始一段漫长的旅程。

embarrass.example: Please do not ask him such personal questions, or you will embarrass him.
embarrass.exampleZh: 请不要问他这么私人的问题，否则你会让他尴尬。

embassy.example: She went to the embassy to get a visa for her trip.
embassy.exampleZh: 她去大使馆办理旅行签证。

embed.example: The workers embed small stones in the wet cement to make a path.
embed.exampleZh: 工人们把小块石头嵌入湿水泥中，做成一条小路。

embody.example: Her daily actions embody the values she teaches to her students.
embody.exampleZh: 她的日常行为体现了她教给学生的那些价值观。

embrace.example: She gave her old friend a warm embrace at the airport.
embrace.exampleZh: 她在机场给了老朋友一个温暖的拥抱。

emerge.example: New problems emerge when we try to fix old ones.
emerge.exampleZh: 当我们试图解决旧问题时，新的问题就会出现。

emergency.example: Call this number in an emergency and a doctor will come quickly.
emergency.exampleZh: 遇到紧急情况请拨打这个号码，医生会很快赶来。

emigrate.example: My uncle decided to emigrate to Canada with his family last year.
emigrate.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年决定和家人移居加拿大。

emit.example: The old car emits a lot of smoke every morning.
emit.exampleZh: 那辆旧车每天早上排出大量烟雾。

emotion.example: She smiled with strong emotion when she saw her old friends.
emotion.exampleZh: 她看到老朋友时，带着强烈的情感笑了。

emotional.example: She got very emotional when she said goodbye to her old friends.
emotional.exampleZh: 她和老朋友告别时非常激动。

emperor.example: The emperor lived in a large palace with his family.
emperor.exampleZh: 皇帝和他的家人住在一座大宫殿里。

emphasis.example: The teacher put great emphasis on reading every day.
emphasis.exampleZh: 老师非常强调每天阅读。

emphasize.example: Teachers often emphasize the importance of reading every day.
emphasize.exampleZh: 老师经常强调每天阅读的重要性。

empire.example: The old empire was very large and had many soldiers.
empire.exampleZh: 这个古老的帝国幅员辽阔，拥有许多士兵。

empirical.example: The study gives empirical evidence that regular exercise improves sleep quality.
empirical.exampleZh: 这项研究提供了实证依据，证明规律运动能改善睡眠质量。

employ.example: Many small shops employ young people to help during busy holidays.
employ.exampleZh: 许多小商店在忙碌的节假日期间雇用年轻人帮忙。

employee.example: The company hired a new employee to work in the sales department.
employee.exampleZh: 公司雇了一名新员工在销售部工作。

employer.example: My employer gives all workers a short break every morning.
employer.exampleZh: 我的雇主每天早上给所有工人一次短暂的休息。

employment.example: He is looking for employment in a small town near his home.
employment.exampleZh: 他正在离家不远的一个小镇上找工作。

empty.example: The empty box is on the table, and the water empties slowly.
empty.exampleZh: 空盒子在桌上，水慢慢流空。

enable.example: This app enables users to learn new words quickly.
enable.exampleZh: 这个应用使用户能够快速学习新单词。

enact.example: The government will enact a new law to protect the forests next year.
enact.exampleZh: 政府明年将颁布一项新法律来保护森林。

enclose.example: Please enclose your photo with the form and send it back to us.
enclose.exampleZh: 请将你的照片随表格一起附上，然后寄回给我们。

encounter.example: I met an old friend by chance, a happy encounter in the park.
encounter.exampleZh: 我偶然遇到一位老朋友，那是公园里一次愉快的相遇。

encourage.example: My parents always encourage me to try new things.
encourage.exampleZh: 我的父母总是鼓励我尝试新事物。

end.example: We waited for the end of the movie and then went home.
end.exampleZh: 我们等到电影结束，然后就回家了。

endanger.example: Smoking can endanger your health and the health of people around you.
endanger.exampleZh: 吸烟会危及你自己的健康以及周围人的健康。

endeavor.example: We must endeavor to finish this work before Friday.
endeavor.exampleZh: 我们必须努力在周五前完成这项工作。

ending.example: The movie has a happy ending that made everyone smile.
ending.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个让大家都微笑的快乐结局。

endless.example: The baby's crying seemed endless, and nobody in the house could sleep.
endless.exampleZh: 婴儿的哭声似乎没完没了，家里没人能睡着。

endure.example: She had to endure a long wait at the busy train station.
endure.exampleZh: 她不得不在繁忙的火车站忍受漫长的等待。

enemy.example: The soldiers fought bravely against a strong enemy in the mountains.
enemy.exampleZh: 士兵们在山里勇敢地对抗强大的敌人。

energy.example: Young children often have more energy than their parents do.
energy.exampleZh: 小孩子往往比他们的父母更有精力。

enforce.example: The school must enforce the new rules for all students.
enforce.exampleZh: 学校必须对所有学生执行这些新规定。

engage.example: She plans to engage a tutor for her son this summer.
engage.exampleZh: 她打算今年夏天给儿子请一位家教。

engine.example: The engine of the old car makes a loud noise every morning.
engine.exampleZh: 这辆旧汽车的发动机每天早上都发出很大的噪音。

engineer.example: My uncle is an engineer and he builds roads and bridges.
engineer.exampleZh: 我叔叔是一名工程师，他修建道路和桥梁。

engineering.example: My brother studies engineering at a big university in the north.
engineering.exampleZh: 我哥哥在北方的一所大型大学学习工程学。

enhance.example: Good lighting can greatly enhance the beauty of a small room.
enhance.exampleZh: 良好的照明能大大提升小房间的美感。

enjoy.example: I really enjoy reading books in the park on sunny days.
enjoy.exampleZh: 在晴朗的日子里，我很喜欢在公园里读书。

enlarge.example: We plan to enlarge the small garden behind our house next spring.
enlarge.exampleZh: 我们打算明年春天把房后的小花园扩大。

enormous.example: The elephant is an enormous animal with very big ears.
enormous.exampleZh: 大象是一种耳朵非常大的巨大动物。

enough.example: This room is big enough for all of us to sit in.
enough.exampleZh: 这个房间足够大，我们所有人都能坐得下。

enquire.example: I will enquire about the train times at the station.
enquire.exampleZh: 我会在车站询问火车时刻。

enrich.example: Reading good books can enrich your life in many simple ways.
enrich.exampleZh: 读好书能在许多简单的方面丰富你的人生。

enroll.example: New students must enroll at the front office before they start classes.
enroll.exampleZh: 新生必须在开始上课前到前台注册。

ensure.example: We must ensure that all the doors are locked before we leave.
ensure.exampleZh: 我们离开前必须确保所有门都锁好了。

entail.example: This new job will entail a lot of travel and long hours.
entail.exampleZh: 这份新工作需要大量出差和长时间工作。

enter.example: Please enter the room quietly and sit down.
enter.exampleZh: 请安静地进入房间并坐下。

enterprise.example: She works for a small enterprise that makes parts for cars.
enterprise.exampleZh: 她在一家生产汽车零部件的小企业工作。

entertain.example: We often entertain friends at home with simple food and music.
entertain.exampleZh: 我们经常在家用简单的食物和音乐招待朋友。

entertainment.example: Watching movies is my favorite form of entertainment on weekends.
entertainment.exampleZh: 看电影是我周末最喜欢的娱乐方式。

enthusiasm.example: Her enthusiasm for teaching makes every class interesting and fun.
enthusiasm.exampleZh: 她对教学的热情让每堂课都有趣又好玩。

enthusiastic.example: She is very enthusiastic about her new job at the bookstore.
enthusiastic.exampleZh: 她对书店的新工作非常热情。

entire.example: She spent the entire day cleaning the house with her family.
entire.exampleZh: 她花了一整天时间和家人一起打扫房子。

entitle.example: This ticket will entitle you to a free drink at the show.
entitle.exampleZh: 这张票将使你有权在演出时免费获得一杯饮料。

entrance.example: We waited for our friends at the main entrance of the school.
entrance.exampleZh: 我们在学校正门等朋友。

entry.example: The guard checked my entry pass at the main gate.
entry.exampleZh: 警卫在大门口检查了我的入场通行证。

envelope.example: She put the letter into a white envelope and mailed it.
envelope.exampleZh: 她把信放进一个白色信封里寄了出去。

environment.example: We must protect the environment for our children and for the future.
environment.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代和未来保护环境。

environmental.example: We must protect the environmental health of our city and its rivers.
environmental.exampleZh: 我们必须保护我们的城市及其河流的环境健康。

envisage.example: We envisage a small house near the sea in a few years.
envisage.exampleZh: 我们设想几年后在海边有一栋小房子。

envy.example: She felt envy when her friend got a better job.
envy.exampleZh: 她的朋友找到更好的工作时，她感到很羡慕。

episode.example: That funny episode happened when we were traveling in Italy last summer.
episode.exampleZh: 那段有趣的经历发生在去年夏天我们在意大利旅行的时候。

equal.example: All students should get an equal chance to answer questions in class.
equal.exampleZh: 所有学生都应该有机会在课堂上平等地回答问题。

equality.example: We believe in equality for all people, no matter who they are.
equality.exampleZh: 我们相信所有人都享有平等，无论他们是谁。

equation.example: This math equation is hard, so please help me solve it.
equation.exampleZh: 这个数学方程式很难，所以请帮我解一下。

equip.example: We equip every new student with a laptop and a study guide.
equip.exampleZh: 我们为每位新生配备一台笔记本电脑和一本学习指南。

equipment.example: The workers moved all the heavy equipment into the new room.
equipment.exampleZh: 工人们把所有沉重的设备搬进了新房间。

equivalent.example: One mile is equivalent to about one and a half kilometers.
equivalent.exampleZh: 一英里大约相当于一点五公里。

era.example: The internet has changed the way we live in this new era.
era.exampleZh: 互联网改变了我们在这个新时代的生活方式。

erase.example: Please erase the wrong answer and write the correct one again.
erase.exampleZh: 请擦掉错误的答案，再写一遍正确的。

erect.example: They erected a small wooden house near the river last year.
erect.exampleZh: 他们去年在河边建了一座小木屋。

erosion.example: Wind and rain can cause serious erosion of the soil on this hill.
erosion.exampleZh: 风雨会导致这座山上的土壤严重流失。

error.example: Everyone makes an error sometimes, so learn from it and try again.
error.exampleZh: 每个人有时都会犯错，所以要从错误中学习并再次尝试。

erupt.example: The volcano could erupt at any time, so the village was evacuated.
erupt.exampleZh: 这座火山随时可能喷发，因此村民被疏散了。

escape.example: The small bird tried to escape from the cage but could not.
escape.exampleZh: 那只小鸟试图从笼子里逃脱，但没能成功。

especially.example: I love fruit, especially apples and oranges in summer.
especially.exampleZh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是夏天的苹果和橙子。

essay.example: She wrote a short essay about her best friend for the class.
essay.exampleZh: 她为这节课写了一篇关于她最好朋友的短文。

essence.example: The essence of his idea is simple and easy to understand.
essence.exampleZh: 他想法中的本质很简单，也容易理解。

essential.example: Water is essential for life, so we must protect it.
essential.exampleZh: 水对生命至关重要，所以我们必须保护它。

establish.example: The two countries agreed to establish a new trade office this year.
establish.exampleZh: 两国同意今年设立一个新的贸易办事处。

establishment.example: The establishment of the new school took two years.
establishment.exampleZh: 这所新学校的建立花了两年时间。

estate.example: Her father left a large estate to her and her brother.
estate.exampleZh: 她父亲留给她和她哥哥一大笔遗产。

estimate.example: We estimate that the repair will take two weeks.
estimate.exampleZh: 我们估计维修需要两周时间。

eternal.example: Their eternal love story is told to every child in the village.
eternal.exampleZh: 他们永恒的爱情故事被讲给村里的每个孩子听。

ethics.example: Business ethics is an important topic in every company today.
ethics.exampleZh: 商业道德如今是每家公司的重要课题。

ethnic.example: This city is home to many ethnic groups from different parts of the world.
ethnic.exampleZh: 这座城市是来自世界各地的许多族群的家园。

evacuate.example: The teacher helped the students evacuate the building quickly when the fire alarm rang.
evacuate.exampleZh: 火警响起时，老师帮助学生们迅速撤离了教学楼。

evaluate.example: Teachers evaluate our work at the end of every term.
evaluate.exampleZh: 老师在每学期末评价我们的作业。

evaporate.example: The water in the small lake will evaporate quickly under the hot summer sun.
evaporate.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏日阳光下，小湖里的水会很快蒸发。

eve.example: On the eve of the big exam, she felt both nervous and excited.
eve.exampleZh: 大考前夜，她既紧张又兴奋。

even.example: She was so tired that she could not even walk home.
even.exampleZh: 她太累了，甚至走不回家。

evening.example: We take a walk after dinner every evening.
evening.exampleZh: 我们每天晚饭后都会去散步。

event.example: The school sports event was great fun for all the students.
event.exampleZh: 学校的运动会项目对所有学生来说都非常有趣。

eventually.example: After many tries, he eventually learned how to ride a bike.
eventually.exampleZh: 经过多次尝试，他终于学会了骑自行车。

ever.example: Have you ever been to Beijing with your family?
ever.exampleZh: 你曾经和家人一起去过北京吗？

every.example: Every student in our class has a new English book.
every.exampleZh: 我们班的每个学生都有一本新的英语书。

evidence.example: There is no clear evidence that he took the money.
evidence.exampleZh: 没有明确的证据表明他拿了那笔钱。

evident.example: It is evident that she works very hard every day.
evident.exampleZh: 很明显，她每天都工作得非常努力。

evil.example: In the story, the evil king made life hard for everyone in the village.
evil.exampleZh: 在故事里，那个邪恶的国王让村里每个人的生活都很艰难。

evoke.example: The old song always evokes happy memories of my childhood summers.
evoke.exampleZh: 这首老歌总能唤起我对童年夏天的快乐回忆。

evolution.example: The evolution of language is a long and slow process.
evolution.exampleZh: 语言的演变是一个漫长而缓慢的过程。

evolve.example: Small changes in language evolve slowly over many years.
evolve.exampleZh: 语言中的小变化会在许多年里慢慢演变。

exact.example: Please give me the exact time of the meeting tomorrow.
exact.exampleZh: 请告诉我明天会议的确切时间。

exaggerate.example: He tends to exaggerate the difficulty of the test when he talks about it.
exaggerate.exampleZh: 他谈起那场考试时总爱夸大其难度。

examine.example: The doctor will examine my eyes carefully this afternoon at the hospital.
examine.exampleZh: 医生今天下午会在医院仔细检查我的眼睛。

example.example: This is a good example for all of us to follow.
example.exampleZh: 这是一个值得我们大家学习的好榜样。

exceed.example: His score may exceed 90 if he studies a little harder.
exceed.exampleZh: 如果他再努力一点学习，他的分数可能会超过90分。

exceedingly.example: The exam was exceedingly difficult for most of the students in our class.
exceedingly.exampleZh: 这次考试对我们班大多数学生来说极其困难。

excel.example: She seems to excel at every subject she studies in school.
excel.exampleZh: 她在学校里似乎每一门学科都很擅长。

excellent.example: She is an excellent teacher and her students love her class.
excellent.exampleZh: 她是一位优秀的老师，她的学生都喜欢她的课。

except.example: Everyone in my class went to the museum except me.
except.exampleZh: 我们班除了我，其他人都去了博物馆。

exception.example: There is one exception to this simple rule for young children.
exception.exampleZh: 这条针对幼儿的简单规则有一个例外。

exceptional.example: Her work on the project was exceptional, and everyone praised it.
exceptional.exampleZh: 她在这个项目上的表现非常杰出，大家都称赞她。

excess.example: An excess of sugar in your diet is bad for your health.
excess.exampleZh: 饮食中摄入过多的糖对你的健康有害。

excessive.example: Excessive noise from the street kept me awake all night.
excessive.exampleZh: 街上过分的噪音让我整夜无法入睡。

exchange.example: We can exchange gifts at the party and talk about our plans.
exchange.exampleZh: 我们可以在聚会上交换礼物，并聊聊我们的计划。

excite.example: The good news excited all the children in the small village.
excite.exampleZh: 这个好消息让小村子里的所有孩子都很兴奋。

excitement.example: The children jumped up and down with excitement when they saw the snow.
excitement.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时兴奋地跳上跳下。

exciting.example: The football game last night was very exciting for all of us.
exciting.exampleZh: 昨晚的足球比赛对我们所有人来说都非常激动人心。

exclaim.example: She looked at the gift and exclaimed with joy.
exclaim.exampleZh: 她看着礼物，高兴地叫了起来。

exclude.example: The new rules exclude students under twelve from joining the club.
exclude.exampleZh: 新规定把十二岁以下的学生排除在俱乐部之外。

exclusive.example: This room is for the exclusive use of hotel guests.
exclusive.exampleZh: 这个房间仅供酒店客人专用。

excursion.example: Our class went on a short excursion to the nearby hills last week.
excursion.exampleZh: 我们班上周去附近的山里进行了一次短途远足。

excuse.example: Please excuse me for being late; I had to wait for the bus.
excuse.exampleZh: 请原谅我迟到了，我得等公交车。

execute.example: They will execute the new plan next week after the final meeting.
execute.exampleZh: 他们将在最后一次会议后于下周执行这个新计划。

executive.example: The executive met with the managers to discuss the new plan.
executive.exampleZh: 这位执行官与经理们会面，讨论新计划。

exemplify.example: These three students exemplify the hard work and honesty we value.
exemplify.exampleZh: 这三位学生例证了我们所重视的勤奋与诚实。

exempt.example: Students with a doctor's note are exempt from the physical education class.
exempt.exampleZh: 有医生证明的学生可以免除体育课。

exercise.example: Daily exercise and practice help you learn new skills well.
exercise.exampleZh: 每天锻炼和练习能帮助你很好地学习新技能。

exert.example: Teachers exert a strong influence on the children in their classes.
exert.exampleZh: 老师对班里的孩子有着很大的影响。

exhaust.example: The long trip exhausted the children, and the car's exhaust woke them up.
exhaust.exampleZh: 长途旅行使孩子们筋疲力尽，而汽车的废气把他们吵醒了。

exhibit.example: The museum will exhibit these old paintings next month.
exhibit.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将展出这些古老的画作。

exhibition.example: We went to an art exhibition in the city last Sunday.
exhibition.exampleZh: 上周日我们去了城里的一场艺术展览。

exile.example: After many years in exile, the writer finally returned to his home country.
exile.exampleZh: 在流亡多年之后，这位作家终于回到了自己的祖国。

exist.example: Many people believe that life may exist on other planets.
exist.exampleZh: 许多人相信其他星球上可能存在生命。

existence.example: The existence of life on other planets is still a mystery.
existence.exampleZh: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍然是个谜。

exit.example: Please use the exit on the left when you leave the building.
exit.exampleZh: 你离开大楼时请使用左边的出口。

exotic.example: This garden is full of exotic flowers from warm countries.
exotic.exampleZh: 这个花园里满是来自温暖国家的奇异花卉。

expand.example: The company plans to expand its business into two new cities next year.
expand.exampleZh: 公司计划明年将业务扩展到两个新城市。

expansion.example: The company's rapid expansion into Asia created many new jobs last year.
expansion.exampleZh: 公司去年迅速向亚洲扩张，创造了许多新的就业机会。

expect.example: We expect the train to arrive on time today.
expect.exampleZh: 我们预计火车今天会准时到达。

expectation.example: Her parents have high expectations for her future.
expectation.exampleZh: 她的父母对她的未来抱有很高的期望。

expedition.example: The scientist joined an expedition to study animals in the cold north.
expedition.exampleZh: 这位科学家加入了一支考察队，去寒冷的北方研究动物。

expel.example: The school decided to expel the student for breaking the rules.
expel.exampleZh: 学校决定因违反规定而开除这名学生。

expenditure.example: The school spent a large part of its yearly expenditure on new books.
expenditure.exampleZh: 学校把年度经费的很大一部分花在了新书上。

expense.example: The trip was expensive, so we shared every expense with each other.
expense.exampleZh: 这次旅行很贵，所以我们彼此分担了每一笔费用。

expensive.example: This car is too expensive for me to buy.
expensive.exampleZh: 这辆车太贵了，我买不起。

experience.example: She has a lot of experience in teaching young children.
experience.exampleZh: 她在教幼儿方面有很多经验。

experiment.example: We did a simple experiment in science class today.
experiment.exampleZh: 今天我们在科学课上做了一个简单的实验。

experimental.example: This is an experimental drug, so doctors are watching the patients carefully.
experimental.exampleZh: 这是一种试验性药物，因此医生们正在密切观察病人。

expert.example: She is an expert in computer science and often helps her students.
expert.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学方面的专家，经常帮助她的学生。

expertise.example: Her expertise in computer science helped the team finish the project quickly.
expertise.exampleZh: 她在计算机科学方面的专长帮助团队迅速完成了项目。

expire.example: My passport will expire at the end of next month.
expire.exampleZh: 我的护照将在下个月底到期。

explain.example: The teacher will explain the rule to us again.
explain.exampleZh: 老师会再给我们解释一遍这条规则。

explanation.example: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the difficult word.
explanation.exampleZh: 老师对这个难词作了清楚的解释。

explicit.example: She made her plan explicit to everyone at the meeting.
explicit.exampleZh: 她在会上向大家明确说明了她的计划。

explode.example: The old building exploded early this morning, and no one was hurt.
explode.exampleZh: 那栋旧楼今天清晨爆炸了，但没有人受伤。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit young workers by making them work very long hours every day.
exploit.exampleZh: 一些公司通过让年轻员工每天工作很长时间来剥削他们。

exploration.example: Space exploration helps us learn more about the planets and stars.
exploration.exampleZh: 太空探索帮助我们更多地了解行星和恒星。

explore.example: Scientists want to explore the deep ocean to learn more about life there.
explore.exampleZh: 科学家们想要探索深海，以了解更多那里的生命。

explosion.example: The gas explosion destroyed two houses and hurt several people on the same street.
explosion.exampleZh: 那场燃气爆炸摧毁了两栋房屋，还伤及同一条街上的几个人。

explosive.example: The scientists were careful with the explosive chemicals in the lab.
explosive.exampleZh: 科学家们在实验室里对爆炸性化学品非常小心。

export.example: China exports many goods to other countries every year.
export.exampleZh: 中国每年向其他国家出口许多商品。

expose.example: The report exposed serious problems in the local water supply.
expose.exampleZh: 该报告揭露了当地供水中的严重问题。

exposure.example: Long exposure to sunlight can harm your skin.
exposure.exampleZh: 长时间接触阳光会伤害你的皮肤。

express.example: I cannot express how happy I am to see you again today.
express.exampleZh: 我无法表达今天再次见到你我有多开心。

expression.example: Her happy expression showed that she really liked the small gift.
expression.exampleZh: 她开心的表情说明她真的很喜欢这份小礼物。

exquisite.example: She wore an exquisite dress to the party last night.
exquisite.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条精美的连衣裙去参加聚会。

extend.example: We plan to extend the garden to the back of the house.
extend.exampleZh: 我们打算把花园扩展到房子的后面。

extension.example: The phone in my office has an extension for long calls.
extension.exampleZh: 我办公室的电话有一个用于长时间通话的分机。

extensive.example: The library has an extensive collection of books about ancient history.
extensive.exampleZh: 这家图书馆有大量关于古代历史的藏书。

extent.example: The extent of the damage was much worse than we expected.
extent.exampleZh: 损失的程度比我们预想的严重得多。

exterior.example: The exterior walls of the old house need a fresh coat of paint.
exterior.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的外墙需要刷一层新漆。

external.example: The external walls of the old house need a fresh coat of paint.
external.exampleZh: 这座老房子的外墙需要重新刷一层漆。

extinct.example: Many large animals became extinct long before humans built the first cities.
extinct.exampleZh: 许多大型动物在人类建造第一座城市之前很久就已灭绝了。

extinguish.example: Firefighters worked all night to extinguish the fire in the old building.
extinguish.exampleZh: 消防员工作了一整夜，扑灭旧楼里的大火。

extra.example: The hotel charges extra for breakfast, so we usually eat outside.
extra.exampleZh: 酒店早餐要额外收费，所以我们通常在外面吃。

extract.example: We extract juice from fresh oranges every morning.
extract.exampleZh: 我们每天早上从新鲜橙子中榨取果汁。

extraordinary.example: She has an extraordinary talent for making people feel welcome.
extraordinary.exampleZh: 她有一种非凡的天赋，能让人感到宾至如归。

extravagant.example: She thinks it is too extravagant to buy such an expensive bag.
extravagant.exampleZh: 她觉得买这么贵的包太奢侈了。

extreme.example: That place has extreme weather, so it is hard to live there.
extreme.exampleZh: 那个地方天气极端，所以很难在那里生活。

eye.example: She closed her eyes and fell asleep on the bus.
eye.exampleZh: 她在公交车上闭上眼睛睡着了。

fable.example: My grandfather told me a fable about a clever fox and a proud lion.
fable.exampleZh: 我的祖父给我讲了一个关于聪明的狐狸和骄傲的狮子的寓言。

fabric.example: The soft fabric of this shirt feels very good on my skin.
fabric.exampleZh: 这件衬衫柔软的面料贴在我的皮肤上感觉很好。

fabricate.example: He tried to fabricate a story about where he was that night.
fabricate.exampleZh: 他试图编造一个关于那晚他在哪里的说法。

fabulous.example: We had a fabulous time at the beach last weekend.
fabulous.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海滩上玩得非常开心。

face.example: She washed her face and looked out the window at the street.
face.exampleZh: 她洗了把脸，然后望向窗外的街道。

facet.example: This problem has many facets, so we need to discuss it carefully.
facet.exampleZh: 这个问题有很多方面，所以我们需要仔细讨论。

facilitate.example: New roads will facilitate trade between the two small towns.
facilitate.exampleZh: 新道路将促进这两个小镇之间的贸易。

facility.example: The school has a new sports facility for its students.
facility.exampleZh: 学校为学生新建了一座体育设施。

fact.example: The fact is that we still need more time to finish the work.
fact.exampleZh: 事实是我们仍然需要更多时间来完成这项工作。

faction.example: The party split into two factions after a bitter argument over money.
faction.exampleZh: 该党在激烈的金钱争执后分裂成了两个派系。

factor.example: Time is an important factor when we make a plan.
factor.exampleZh: 我们制定计划时，时间是重要的因素。

factory.example: My father works in a large factory near our home.
factory.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们家附近的一家大工厂工作。

faculty.example: The faculty meets every month to discuss new courses and student needs.
faculty.exampleZh: 全体教员每月开会讨论新课程和学生需求。

fade.example: The color of my old shirt began to fade after many washes.
fade.exampleZh: 我那件旧衬衫的颜色在多次洗涤后开始褪色。

fahrenheit.example: Water freezes at thirty-two degrees Fahrenheit on this old thermometer.
fahrenheit.exampleZh: 在这支旧温度计上，水在华氏三十二度结冰。

fail.example: If you fail the test, you can try again next month.
fail.exampleZh: 如果这次考试不及格，你下个月可以再试一次。

faint.example: The old man felt faint in the hot sun and sat down.
faint.exampleZh: 那位老人在烈日下感到头晕，便坐了下来。

fair.example: The weather is fair today, so let's go to the fair.
fair.exampleZh: 今天天气晴朗，我们去集市吧。

faith.example: She has great faith in her teacher and always follows his advice.
faith.exampleZh: 她非常信任她的老师，总是听从他的建议。

faithful.example: A faithful friend always stands by you when times are hard.
faithful.exampleZh: 忠实的朋友在你困难时总会支持你。

fake.example: The bag is fake, but it looks almost real.
fake.exampleZh: 这个包是假的，但看起来几乎和真的一样。

fame.example: Her sudden fame made it hard for her to live a normal life.
fame.exampleZh: 突然而来的名声让她难以过上正常的生活。

familiar.example: This street looks very familiar to me, but I cannot remember its name.
familiar.exampleZh: 这条街我看起来很熟悉，但我想不起它的名字。

famine.example: The long famine left many families without food or hope.
famine.exampleZh: 漫长的饥荒让许多家庭失去了食物和希望。

famous.example: This small town is famous for its beautiful old bridge.
famous.exampleZh: 这个小镇因其美丽的古桥而闻名。

fan.example: The fan in my room is broken, so it is very hot.
fan.exampleZh: 我房间里的风扇坏了，所以很热。

fanatic.example: My brother is a football fanatic who never misses a match.
fanatic.exampleZh: 我弟弟是个足球狂热迷，从不错过任何一场比赛。

fancy.example: She wore a fancy dress to her friend's birthday party last night.
fancy.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一条精致的连衣裙去参加朋友的生日聚会。

fantastic.example: We had a fantastic time at the beach last weekend.
fantastic.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海滩玩得非常开心。

fantasy.example: She likes to read fantasy stories before she goes to sleep.
fantasy.exampleZh: 她喜欢在睡前读奇幻故事。

far.example: The school is not far from my home, so we walk there.
far.exampleZh: 学校离我家不远，所以我们走路去那里。

fare.example: Bus fare is cheap here, and people often walk to work.
fare.exampleZh: 这里的公交车费很便宜，人们常常步行去上班。

farewell.example: We had a small party to say farewell to our teacher.
farewell.exampleZh: 我们办了一个小聚会，向老师告别。

farm.example: My uncle works on a small farm and grows rice there.
farm.exampleZh: 我叔叔在一个小农场工作，在那里种水稻。

farther.example: The school is farther from my house than the park.
farther.exampleZh: 学校离我家比公园更远。

fascinate.example: The magic show fascinated all the children at the party.
fascinate.exampleZh: 那场魔术表演让聚会上的所有孩子都着迷了。

fascism.example: The history class taught us how fascism rose in Europe before the war.
fascism.exampleZh: 历史课教我们了解法西斯主义在战前欧洲是如何崛起的。

fashion.example: She always wears clothes that are in fashion this year.
fashion.exampleZh: 她总是穿着今年流行的衣服。

fashionable.example: Short skirts are very fashionable among young women this year.
fashionable.exampleZh: 今年短裙在年轻女性中很流行。

fast.example: The fast car went down the road and stopped near my house.
fast.exampleZh: 那辆快车沿着路开下去，停在了我家附近。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
fasten.exampleZh: 飞机起飞前请系好安全带。

fatal.example: The driver made one fatal mistake and lost control of the car.
fatal.exampleZh: 司机犯了一个致命的错误，失去了对汽车的控制。

fate.example: She believed that fate had brought them together after so many years apart.
fate.exampleZh: 她相信是命运让他们在分别多年之后重新走到一起。

father.example: My father taught me how to ride a bike last summer.
father.exampleZh: 去年夏天，父亲教我骑自行车。

fatigue.example: After a long day of work, he felt great fatigue and went to bed early.
fatigue.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，他感到非常疲劳，于是早早地上床睡觉了。

fault.example: It is not your fault that the old machine stopped working.
fault.exampleZh: 这台旧机器停止运转不是你的错。

faulty.example: This faulty machine stops working after a few minutes every time.
faulty.exampleZh: 这台有故障的机器每次运行几分钟后就会停止工作。

favor.example: She asked her friend for a favor and he agreed to help.
favor.exampleZh: 她请朋友帮个忙，他同意帮忙。

favorable.example: The weather was favorable, so we went for a long walk.
favorable.exampleZh: 天气很有利，所以我们去长时间散步了。

favorite.example: This is my favorite song, and I listen to it every day.
favorite.exampleZh: 这是我最喜欢的歌，我每天都听。

fear.example: She has a great fear of the dark, so she sleeps with a light on.
fear.exampleZh: 她非常怕黑，所以睡觉时开着灯。

feasible.example: It is not feasible to finish the whole project in one week.
feasible.exampleZh: 在一周内完成整个项目是不可行的。

feast.example: We had a big feast with our family on New Year's Day.
feast.exampleZh: 新年那天我们和家人享用了一顿丰盛的筵席。

feat.example: Climbing that mountain alone was a great feat for the young boy.
feat.exampleZh: 独自爬上那座山对这个小男孩来说是一项伟大的壮举。

feather.example: The bird has a bright red feather on its head.
feather.exampleZh: 这只鸟头上有一根鲜红色的羽毛。

feature.example: The best feature of this phone is its long battery life.
feature.exampleZh: 这款手机最大的特色是它超长的电池续航。

february.example: My birthday is in February, and it is often very cold then.
february.exampleZh: 我的生日在二月，那时通常很冷。

federal.example: The federal government makes laws that all states must follow.
federal.exampleZh: 联邦政府制定所有州都必须遵守的法律。

fee.example: The school charges a small fee for each music lesson.
fee.exampleZh: 学校每节音乐课收取少量费用。

feeble.example: Grandpa felt feeble after his long illness and needed help walking.
feeble.exampleZh: 爷爷久病之后感到虚弱，走路需要人搀扶。

feed.example: Every morning the farmer feeds the chickens before he starts his work.
feed.exampleZh: 每天早上，农夫在开始干活前先喂鸡。

feedback.example: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my English writing.
feedback.exampleZh: 老师对我的英语写作给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I feel happy when I touch the soft cat.
feel.exampleZh: 当我摸到那只柔软的猫时，我感到很开心。

feeling.example: I have a strange feeling that we have met somewhere before.
feeling.exampleZh: 我有一种奇怪的感觉，我们以前在什么地方见过。

fellow.example: My fellow workers are friendly and always help me with my tasks.
fellow.exampleZh: 我的同事们很友好，总是帮我完成工作。

fellowship.example: The small group meets every week to enjoy friendship and fellowship together.
fellowship.exampleZh: 这个小组每周聚会，一起享受友谊和伙伴情谊。

female.example: The female doctor spoke to the students about healthy eating.
female.exampleZh: 这位女医生向学生们讲述了健康饮食。

feminine.example: She likes feminine colors like pink and soft purple for her bedroom walls.
feminine.exampleZh: 她喜欢粉色和柔和的紫色这类女性化的颜色，用来刷卧室的墙。

fence.example: The old wooden fence around our garden keeps the dogs out.
fence.exampleZh: 我们花园周围那道旧木栅栏能把狗挡在外面。

ferrous.example: This old factory makes ferrous parts for cars and machines.
ferrous.exampleZh: 这家老工厂生产用于汽车和机器的含铁零件。

ferry.example: We took the ferry across the river and watched the birds fly by.
ferry.exampleZh: 我们乘渡船过河，看着鸟儿飞过。

fertile.example: The land near the river is very fertile and good for farming.
fertile.exampleZh: 河边的土地非常肥沃，很适合耕种。

fertilizer.example: The farmer put fertilizer on his fields before planting the corn.
fertilizer.exampleZh: 农民在种玉米之前给田地施了肥。

festival.example: Our town holds a music festival every summer near the river.
festival.exampleZh: 我们镇每年夏天都会在河边举办音乐节。

fetch.example: Could you fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen?
fetch.exampleZh: 你能去厨房给我拿一杯水来吗？

fever.example: She has a high fever and needs to stay in bed today.
fever.exampleZh: 她发高烧，今天需要卧床休息。

few.example: Few people know the old road to the lake.
few.exampleZh: 很少有人知道通往湖边的那条老路。

fiber.example: Fruit and vegetables are good sources of fiber for your body.
fiber.exampleZh: 水果和蔬菜是你身体所需纤维的良好来源。

fiction.example: This story is fiction, not a true story.
fiction.exampleZh: 这个故事是虚构的，不是真实的故事。

field.example: The farmer grows rice in the field behind his small house.
field.exampleZh: 农民在他小屋后面的田地里种水稻。

fierce.example: The fierce dog barked at everyone who walked past the gate.
fierce.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗对每个经过大门的人狂吠。

fifth.example: She lives on the fifth floor of our small apartment building.
fifth.exampleZh: 她住在我们这栋小公寓楼的第五层。

fight.example: The two brothers often fight, but they always make up soon after.
fight.exampleZh: 两兄弟经常打架，但很快就和好了。

fighter.example: The old fighter told us stories about the war.
fighter.exampleZh: 那位老战士给我们讲了战争时期的故事。

figure.example: The figure in the report shows how the numbers changed over time.
figure.exampleZh: 报告中的图形显示了这些数字随时间的变化。

file.example: Please file these papers in the blue folder on my desk.
file.exampleZh: 请把这些文件归档到我桌上的蓝色文件夹里。

fill.example: Please fill the glass with water before you put it on the table.
fill.exampleZh: 请把杯子装满水，然后再放到桌子上。

film.example: We watched a funny film about a family trip to the beach.
film.exampleZh: 我们看了一部关于一家人去海滩旅行的有趣电影。

filter.example: You can use this filter to make the water clean and safe.
filter.exampleZh: 你可以用这个过滤器让水变得干净又安全。

filth.example: The floor was covered with filth after the party ended.
filth.exampleZh: 聚会结束后，地板上满是污物。

final.example: This is my final answer, and I will not change it.
final.exampleZh: 这是我的最终答案，我不会再改变它。

finance.example: The company needs more finance to build a new factory.
finance.exampleZh: 公司需要更多资金来建一座新工厂。

financial.example: The company has serious financial problems this year.
financial.exampleZh: 这家公司今年有严重的财务问题。

find.example: I cannot find my keys in the living room.
find.exampleZh: 我在客厅里找不到我的钥匙。

finding.example: The new study reports an important finding about how children learn.
finding.exampleZh: 这项新研究报告了一个关于儿童如何学习的重要发现。

fine.example: The weather is fine today, so we will go for a walk.
fine.exampleZh: 今天天气晴朗，所以我们会去散步。

finger.example: She cut her finger while cooking dinner last night.
finger.exampleZh: 她昨晚做晚饭时切到了手指。

finish.example: I will finish my homework before dinner and then watch television.
finish.exampleZh: 我会在晚饭前完成作业，然后看电视。

finite.example: Water and time are finite resources, so we must use them carefully.
finite.exampleZh: 水和时间都是有限的资源，所以我们必须谨慎地使用它们。

fire.example: The fire in the old house spread quickly, so the family called for help.
fire.exampleZh: 老房子里的火蔓延得很快，所以这家人打电话求助。

firm.example: She works for a small firm that makes firm and strong chairs.
firm.exampleZh: 她在一家小公司上班，那家公司生产坚固结实的椅子。

first.example: This is my first time visiting Beijing with my family.
first.exampleZh: 这是我第一次和家人一起游览北京。

fish.example: We caught a big fish in the river yesterday.
fish.exampleZh: 昨天我们在河里钓到了一条大鱼。

fisherman.example: The old fisherman went to the sea early every morning to catch fish.
fisherman.exampleZh: 那位老渔民每天清晨都去海边捕鱼。

fist.example: He hit the table with his fist and everyone stopped talking.
fist.exampleZh: 他用拳头砸了一下桌子，大家都停止了说话。

fit.example: This old coat does not fit me well, so I need a new one.
fit.exampleZh: 这件旧外套不太合我的身，所以我需要一件新的。

fitness.example: Regular exercise is important for your fitness and your health.
fitness.exampleZh: 规律的运动对你的体能和健康都很重要。

fitting.example: It is fitting to wear comfortable shoes when you try on a new suit.
fitting.exampleZh: 试穿新西装时穿舒适的鞋子是恰当的。

five.example: My little sister is five years old and she starts school this year.
five.exampleZh: 我妹妹五岁了，她今年开始上学。

fix.example: My father will fix the old chair this afternoon.
fix.exampleZh: 我父亲今天下午会修好那把旧椅子。

flag.example: The flag is flying high above the school building today.
flag.exampleZh: 今天旗帜在学校建筑上方高高飘扬。

flame.example: The flame of the campfire kept us warm all night.
flame.exampleZh: 篝火的火焰让我们整夜都很温暖。

flank.example: The small shop sits on the flank of the hill, near the old road.
flank.exampleZh: 那家小店坐落在山坡的侧面，靠近那条老路。

flash.example: A bright flash of lightning lit up the whole sky last night.
flash.exampleZh: 昨晚一道明亮的闪电照亮了整个天空。

flat.example: We live in a small flat on the third floor.
flat.exampleZh: 我们住在三楼的一间小公寓里。

flatter.example: He tried to flatter his boss to get a better job.
flatter.exampleZh: 他试图讨好老板，以求得到一份更好的工作。

flavor.example: This soup has a rich flavor and my family loves it.
flavor.exampleZh: 这汤味道浓郁，我的家人都很喜欢。

flaw.example: One small flaw in the plan could cause trouble for everyone.
flaw.exampleZh: 计划中的一个小缺点可能会给每个人带来麻烦。

flee.example: The thief tried to flee when he saw the police officers.
flee.exampleZh: 小偷看到警察时试图逃走。

fleet.example: The company has a large fleet of trucks that deliver goods every day.
fleet.exampleZh: 这家公司拥有一支大型车队，每天运送货物。

flesh.example: The flesh of the peach is soft and sweet.
flesh.exampleZh: 桃子的果肉柔软又香甜。

flexible.example: My work hours are flexible, so I can pick up my kids.
flexible.exampleZh: 我的工作时间很灵活，所以我可以去接孩子。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing was delayed for two hours because of heavy snow.
flight.exampleZh: 由于大雪，我们飞往北京的航班延误了两个小时。

fling.example: She decided to fling her old notebooks into the fire.
fling.exampleZh: 她决定把旧笔记本猛扔进火里。

float.example: The small boat will float on the quiet water near the yellow buoy.
float.exampleZh: 小船会漂浮在黄色浮标附近的平静水面上。

flock.example: A flock of birds flew over the trees and disappeared into the sky.
flock.exampleZh: 一群鸟飞过树梢，消失在天空中。

flood.example: Heavy rain can flood the small streets and the old houses near the river.
flood.exampleZh: 大雨会淹没河边的小街道和旧房子。

floor.example: Her keys fell on the kitchen floor near the table.
floor.exampleZh: 她的钥匙掉在厨房桌子旁边的地板上。

flour.example: My mother bought some flour to make bread for us.
flour.exampleZh: 我妈妈买了一些面粉给我们做面包。

flourish.example: Small shops flourish when the local people keep buying things from them.
flourish.exampleZh: 当当地人一直从他们那里买东西时，小商店就会兴旺起来。

flow.example: The river flows slowly through the small town and into the sea.
flow.exampleZh: 这条河缓缓流经这个小镇，然后流入大海。

flower.example: The small flower in our garden opens early every spring morning.
flower.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那朵小花每年春天的早晨都会早早开放。

fluid.example: The doctor told her to drink more fluids and get some rest.
fluid.exampleZh: 医生让她多喝些液体，多休息。

flush.example: The warm room made her face flush, so she quickly opened a window.
flush.exampleZh: 温暖的房间让她脸红了，于是她赶紧打开一扇窗。

fly.example: The little bird can fly high in the blue sky.
fly.exampleZh: 那只小鸟能在蓝天中飞得很高。

foam.example: Soap and water mix to make white foam in the sink.
foam.exampleZh: 肥皂和水混合后在水槽里形成白色泡沫。

focus.example: Please focus on your homework and turn off the TV.
focus.exampleZh: 请专注于你的作业，把电视关掉。

fog.example: The thick fog covered the road, so we drove home very slowly.
fog.exampleZh: 浓雾笼罩着道路，所以我们开车回家开得很慢。

foil.example: She wrapped the leftover cake in foil and put it in the fridge.
foil.exampleZh: 她把剩下的蛋糕用锡纸包好，放进了冰箱。

fold.example: She helped me fold the clean clothes and put them in the drawer.
fold.exampleZh: 她帮我叠好干净的衣服，然后把它们放进抽屉里。

folk.example: Many folk in this small town still sing the old songs.
folk.exampleZh: 这个小镇上的许多人仍然会唱那些老歌。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way.
follow.exampleZh: 请跟着我，我来给你指路。

following.example: The following morning, we visited the old museum with our teacher.
following.exampleZh: 第二天早上，我们和老师一起参观了那座旧博物馆。

fond.example: She is very fond of her little dog and takes it for a walk every day.
fond.exampleZh: 她非常喜欢她的小狗，每天都带它去散步。

food.example: We need to buy enough food for the whole family this week.
food.exampleZh: 这周我们需要为全家人买足够的食物。

fool.example: Don't be a fool and believe everything he says.
fool.exampleZh: 别犯傻，不要相信他说的每一句话。

foolish.example: It was foolish of me to leave my keys at home.
foolish.exampleZh: 我把钥匙忘在家里，真是太傻了。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk today.
foot.exampleZh: 今天走了很长的路后，我的左脚疼。

football.example: My brother plays football with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
football.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六下午都和他的朋友们踢足球。

footstep.example: I heard footsteps behind me and turned around quickly.
footstep.exampleZh: 我听到身后有脚步声，便迅速转过身。

for.example: I bought a gift for my sister because she loves books.
for.exampleZh: 我给妹妹买了一份礼物，因为她喜欢书。

forbid.example: Her parents forbid her to go out alone at night.
forbid.exampleZh: 她父母不许她夜里独自外出。

force.example: The police used force to stop the crowd.
force.exampleZh: 警察使用暴力阻止了人群。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
forecast.exampleZh: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

forehead.example: She put her hand on his forehead to check for a fever.
forehead.exampleZh: 她把手放在他的额头上，看看有没有发烧。

foreign.example: She finds it hard to understand foreign customs and foreign ways of thinking.
foreign.exampleZh: 她发现很难理解外国的习俗和外国人的思维方式。

foreigner.example: As a foreigner, he often asks his friends for help with Chinese.
foreigner.exampleZh: 作为一个外国人，他经常请朋友帮他学中文。

foremost.example: She is one of the foremost experts on climate change today.
foremost.exampleZh: 她是当今气候变化领域最重要的专家之一。

forerunner.example: The small radio was a forerunner of the modern smartphone.
forerunner.exampleZh: 那台小收音机是现代智能手机的先驱。

foresee.example: No one can foresee what will happen in the next few years.
foresee.exampleZh: 没有人能预见未来几年会发生什么。

forest.example: We walked through the forest and saw many tall trees and small birds.
forest.exampleZh: 我们穿过森林，看到许多高大的树木和小鸟。

forever.example: She said she would love him forever, no matter what happened.
forever.exampleZh: 她说无论发生什么，她都会永远爱他。

forge.example: He used fire and a hammer to forge a strong iron knife.
forge.exampleZh: 他用火和锤子锻造了一把结实的铁刀。

forget.example: Don't forget to close the window before you leave the house.
forget.exampleZh: 离开家之前别忘了关窗户。

forgive.example: I hope you can forgive me for being late again.
forgive.exampleZh: 我希望你能原谅我又迟到了。

fork.example: Use a fork to eat the salad on your plate.
fork.exampleZh: 用叉子吃你盘子里的沙拉。

form.example: This cake has the same round form as a ball.
form.exampleZh: 这块蛋糕的形状和球一样圆。

formal.example: This is a formal letter, so please use polite words.
formal.exampleZh: 这是一封正式的信件，所以请使用礼貌的词语。

format.example: Please save the report in a new format before you send it.
format.exampleZh: 发送之前，请把这份报告保存成一种新格式。

formation.example: The formation of ice on the lake took only one cold night.
formation.exampleZh: 湖面上冰的形成只花了一个寒冷的夜晚。

former.example: My former teacher is now a writer in Beijing.
former.exampleZh: 我以前的老师现在是北京的一名作家。

formula.example: This is a simple formula for making bread at home.
formula.exampleZh: 这是在家里做面包的一个简单配方。

formulate.example: The team will formulate a clear plan before the meeting starts.
formulate.exampleZh: 团队会在会议开始前制定一个清晰的计划。

forsake.example: He would never forsake his old friends, even in hard times.
forsake.exampleZh: 即使在困难时期，他也绝不会抛弃老朋友。

forth.example: The sun came forth from behind the clouds after the rain.
forth.exampleZh: 雨后太阳从云后露了出来。

forthcoming.example: The forthcoming meeting will help us plan the new project.
forthcoming.exampleZh: 即将到来的会议将帮助我们规划新项目。

fortnight.example: We will go on a trip in a fortnight.

fortunate.example: I feel very fortunate to have such kind and helpful friends.
fortunate.exampleZh: 能有这样善良又乐于助人的朋友，我感到非常幸运。

fortune.example: He moved to the city to make his fortune.
fortune.exampleZh: 他搬到城里去闯荡发财。

forty.example: My grandmother has lived in this small town for forty years.
forty.exampleZh: 我的祖母在这个小镇上住了四十年。

forum.example: She asked a question about the new rules on the school forum.
forum.exampleZh: 她在学校论坛上问了一个关于新规定的问题。

forward.example: Please forward this email to your manager before Friday.
forward.exampleZh: 请在周五之前把这封邮件转发给你的经理。

fossil.example: The scientist found an old fossil in the rock near the river.
fossil.exampleZh: 科学家在河边的岩石里发现了一块古老的化石。

foster.example: Good teachers foster a love of learning in their students.
foster.exampleZh: 好老师会培养学生的求知热情。

foul.example: The foul smell from the old garbage can made everyone leave the room.
foul.exampleZh: 旧垃圾桶里难闻的气味让每个人都离开了房间。

found.example: They found a small school for poor children in 1990.
found.exampleZh: 他们于1990年为贫困儿童创办了一所小学校。

foundation.example: Trust is the foundation of every good friendship.
foundation.exampleZh: 信任是每一段良好友谊的基础。

founder.example: The founder of the small school still visits the children every year.
founder.exampleZh: 这所小学校的创始人每年仍会来看望孩子们。

fountain.example: The children laughed as they ran around the fountain in the park.
fountain.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园的喷泉周围奔跑，笑个不停。

four.example: There are four people in my family and we all like sports.
four.exampleZh: 我家有四口人，我们都喜欢运动。

fourteen.example: My sister is fourteen years old and she loves playing basketball.
fourteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十四岁，她喜欢打篮球。

fox.example: The fox ran quickly across the field and hid behind a big tree.
fox.exampleZh: 那只狐狸飞快地跑过田野，躲到了一棵大树后面。

fraction.example: Only a small fraction of the students came to the meeting.
fraction.exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生来参加了会议。

fracture.example: The doctor said the small bone fracture in his arm would heal soon.
fracture.exampleZh: 医生说，他手臂上的小骨折很快就会愈合。

fragile.example: Be careful with that fragile glass vase on the table.
fragile.exampleZh: 小心桌上那个易碎的玻璃花瓶。

fragment.example: She found a fragment of glass on the kitchen floor after the storm.
fragment.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，她在厨房地板上发现了一块玻璃碎片。

frame.example: The old window frame is made of wood and needs a new coat of paint.
frame.exampleZh: 这个旧窗框是木制的，需要刷一层新漆。

framework.example: This framework helps us understand how the whole system works.
framework.exampleZh: 这个框架帮助我们理解整个系统是如何运作的。

frank.example: My frank friend always tells me the truth, even when it is hard.
frank.exampleZh: 我那位直率的朋友总是对我说实话，即使这很难。

fraud.example: He lost all his money because of a bank fraud last year.
fraud.exampleZh: 去年他因一起银行诈骗案损失了全部积蓄。

free.example: The concert is free, so we can go with our friends tonight.
free.exampleZh: 这场音乐会免费，所以我们今晚可以和朋友们一起去。

freedom.example: She left home to find the freedom to make her own choices.
freedom.exampleZh: 她离开家，去寻找自己做决定的自由。

freeway.example: The freeway was busy, so we drove slowly and carefully.
freeway.exampleZh: 高速公路上车很多，所以我们开得又慢又小心。

freeze.example: The water in the lake will freeze when the weather gets very cold.
freeze.exampleZh: 天气变得很冷时，湖里的水就会结冰。

freight.example: The train carries freight across the country every day.
freight.exampleZh: 这列火车每天运送货物穿越全国。

frequency.example: The frequency of buses here is very high in the morning.
frequency.exampleZh: 这里早上公交车的频率很高。

frequent.example: Sudden headaches are a frequent problem for people who work long hours.
frequent.exampleZh: 突发头痛是长时间工作的人经常遇到的问题。

fresh.example: We bought some fresh fruit and vegetables at the small market.
fresh.exampleZh: 我们在那个小市场买了一些新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

friction.example: There was some friction between the two teams at the start of the project.
friction.exampleZh: 项目开始时，两个团队之间出现了一些摩擦。

friday.example: We will have a math test next Friday morning.
friday.exampleZh: 我们下周五上午将有一场数学考试。

fridge.example: Please put the milk in the fridge before you leave.
fridge.exampleZh: 你走之前请把牛奶放进冰箱。

friend.example: She is my best friend and we play together every day.
friend.exampleZh: 她是我最好的朋友，我们每天都一起玩。

friendly.example: Our new neighbors are very friendly and often help us.
friendly.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居非常友好，经常帮助我们。

friendship.example: True friendship is built on trust, honesty, and the time you spend together.
friendship.exampleZh: 真正的友谊建立在信任、诚实和你们共度的时光之上。

frighten.example: The loud noise did not frighten the little girl at all.
frighten.exampleZh: 那声巨响一点儿也没有吓到那个小女孩。

fringe.example: She cut her fringe short before the wedding last week.
fringe.exampleZh: 她在上周婚礼前把刘海剪短了。

frog.example: A small green frog jumped into the pond near our house.
frog.exampleZh: 一只绿色的小青蛙跳进了我们家附近的池塘里。

from.example: I walk to school from my home every morning.
from.exampleZh: 我每天早上从家走到学校。

front.example: The front of the old house faces a small garden.
front.exampleZh: 这座老房子的正面朝着一座小花园。

frontier.example: The village sits near the frontier, where the two countries meet.
frontier.exampleZh: 这个村庄位于边境附近，两国在那里交界。

frost.example: The frost covered the grass and made the roads very slippery.
frost.exampleZh: 霜覆盖了草地，使道路变得很滑。

frown.example: She gave a frown when she saw the messy room.
frown.exampleZh: 她看到凌乱的房间时皱了皱眉。

fruit.example: Eating fresh fruit every day is good for your health.
fruit.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜水果对你的健康有益。

fruitful.example: Our long talk was fruitful and helped us solve the problem.
fruitful.exampleZh: 我们的长谈富有成效，帮助我们解决了问题。

frustrate.example: Long delays and unclear rules often frustrate even the most patient workers.
frustrate.exampleZh: 长时间的延误和不清楚的规则常常让最有耐心的员工也感到沮丧。

fry.example: I like to fry two eggs in the pan for breakfast.
fry.exampleZh: 我喜欢在平底锅里煎两个鸡蛋当早餐。

fuel.example: The new policy will fuel economic growth across the region.
fuel.exampleZh: 新政策将刺激整个地区的经济增长。

fulfill.example: She worked hard every day to fulfill her dream of becoming a doctor.
fulfill.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，以实现成为医生的梦想。

full.example: The glass is full of cold water from the fridge.
full.exampleZh: 杯子里装满了冰箱里的冷水。

fun.example: We had a lot of fun at the beach last Saturday.
fun.exampleZh: 上周六我们在海滩上玩得很开心。

function.example: The main function of this small tool is to cut paper.
function.exampleZh: 这个小工具的主要功能是剪纸。

fund.example: The school used the fund to buy new books for the library.
fund.exampleZh: 学校用这笔基金为图书馆购买了新书。

fundamental.example: Good health is fundamental to a happy life for everyone.
fundamental.exampleZh: 良好的健康是每个人幸福生活的基础。

funeral.example: Many people came to the funeral to say goodbye to their old friend.
funeral.exampleZh: 许多人来参加葬礼，向他们的老朋友告别。

funny.example: It is funny that my dog hides his toys under the bed.
funny.exampleZh: 我的狗把玩具藏在床底下，这很有趣。

fur.example: The soft fur of the cat feels warm on cold nights.
fur.exampleZh: 猫柔软的毛在寒冷的夜晚摸起来很暖和。

furious.example: He was furious when he found out that someone had broken his favorite cup.
furious.exampleZh: 当他发现有人打碎了他最喜欢的杯子时，他勃然大怒。

furnish.example: They will furnish the new office with desks and chairs next week.
furnish.exampleZh: 他们下周会用桌椅布置新办公室。

furniture.example: We bought new furniture for the living room last week.
furniture.exampleZh: 上周我们为客厅买了新家具。

further.example: We need to study this problem further before we make a decision.
further.exampleZh: 在做决定之前，我们需要进一步研究这个问题。

furthermore.example: The car is fast; furthermore, it is very safe for new drivers.
furthermore.exampleZh: 这辆车很快，而且对新手司机来说非常安全。

fury.example: She could not hide her fury when she saw the broken window.
fury.exampleZh: 当她看到破碎的窗户时，她无法掩饰自己的狂怒。

fuse.example: The bomb had a short fuse, so the soldiers moved away quickly.
fuse.exampleZh: 那颗炸弹的引信很短，所以士兵们迅速撤离了。

fusion.example: The fusion of these two companies created a much larger business.
fusion.exampleZh: 这两家公司的合并造就了一个规模大得多的企业。

fuss.example: Don't make a fuss about small things; it only makes everyone tired.
fuss.exampleZh: 别为小事大惊小怪，那只会让大家都累。

future.example: I hope to have a good job in the future.
future.exampleZh: 我希望将来能有一份好工作。

gain.example: She gained useful experience from her first job in the city.
gain.exampleZh: 她从自己在城里的第一份工作中获得了有用的经验。

gallery.example: We walked through the gallery and looked at many old paintings.
gallery.exampleZh: 我们穿过画廊，看了许多古老的画作。

gallon.example: We bought two gallons of milk for the family breakfast.
gallon.exampleZh: 我们为全家早餐买了两加仑牛奶。

gamble.example: He likes to gamble on card games with his friends every weekend.
gamble.exampleZh: 他喜欢每个周末和朋友们玩牌赌博。

game.example: The children play a fun game in the park after school.
game.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩一个有趣的游戏。

gang.example: A gang of kids played football in the park all afternoon.
gang.exampleZh: 一帮孩子在公园里踢了一下午足球。

gap.example: There is a large gap between the two teams.
gap.exampleZh: 两队之间有很大的差距。

garage.example: My father parks his old car in the garage every night.
garage.exampleZh: 我父亲每天晚上把他的旧车停在车库里。

garbage.example: Please put the garbage in the bin outside the door.
garbage.exampleZh: 请把垃圾放到门外的垃圾桶里。

garden.example: My grandmother grows many beautiful flowers in her small garden.
garden.exampleZh: 我的祖母在她的小花园里种了许多美丽的花。

gardener.example: My grandfather is a keen gardener and grows tomatoes every summer.
gardener.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一位热心的园艺爱好者，每年夏天都种西红柿。

garment.example: She wore a warm garment over her dress on that cold night.
garment.exampleZh: 那个寒冷的夜晚，她在连衣裙外面穿了一件暖和的外衣。

gas.example: The gas from the stove makes the kitchen warm and bright.
gas.exampleZh: 炉子里的煤气使厨房温暖而明亮。

gasoline.example: The car ran out of gasoline, so we stopped at a gas station.
gasoline.exampleZh: 汽车没油了，所以我们在一个加油站停了下来。

gate.example: The gate to the garden is locked at night.
gate.exampleZh: 花园的大门晚上是锁着的。

gather.example: People gather in the square every evening to watch the street dancers.
gather.exampleZh: 人们每天晚上聚集在广场上观看街头舞者的表演。

gauge.example: The engineer checked the gauge to measure the pressure inside the old pipe.
gauge.exampleZh: 工程师检查了仪表，以测量旧管道内的压力。

gay.example: The old song made everyone feel gay and happy at the party last night.
gay.exampleZh: 昨晚的聚会上，这首老歌让每个人都感到快乐欢快。

gaze.example: She stood at the window and gazed at the falling snow.
gaze.exampleZh: 她站在窗前，凝视着飘落的雪。

gear.example: He changed gear before the car went up the hill.

gender.example: Please write your name and gender on this form.
gender.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和性别。

gene.example: Each gene in your body helps decide how you look and grow.
gene.exampleZh: 你身体里的每个基因都影响着你的外貌和生长发育。

general.example: The general idea is easy to understand, but the details are quite hard.
general.exampleZh: 总体思路很容易理解，但细节相当难。

generalize.example: We can generalize from these few examples to the whole group.
generalize.exampleZh: 我们可以从这几个例子中归纳出适用于整个群体的规律。

generally.example: People generally eat more slowly at home than in restaurants.
generally.exampleZh: 人们在家里吃饭通常比在餐馆里吃得慢一些。

generate.example: The new factory will generate many jobs for people in the small town.
generate.exampleZh: 这座新工厂将为小镇上的人们带来许多工作岗位。

generation.example: This song is popular with the younger generation.
generation.exampleZh: 这首歌在年轻一代中很受欢迎。

generator.example: The old generator in the basement still works well during power cuts.
generator.exampleZh: 地下室里的那台老发电机在停电时仍然运转良好。

generous.example: My generous neighbor gave me a lot of fresh vegetables from his garden.
generous.exampleZh: 我慷慨的邻居给了我很多他花园里的新鲜蔬菜。

genetic.example: Genetic testing can help doctors find serious health problems early.
genetic.exampleZh: 基因检测可以帮助医生及早发现严重的健康问题。

genius.example: Everyone says the young boy is a genius at math.
genius.exampleZh: 大家都说这个小男孩是数学天才。

gentle.example: She has a gentle voice and always speaks quietly to the children.
gentle.exampleZh: 她的声音很温柔，总是轻声细语地对孩子们说话。

gentleman.example: The old gentleman opened the door for us and smiled kindly.
gentleman.exampleZh: 那位年长的绅士为我们开门，并和蔼地笑了笑。

genuine.example: Her smile was genuine, and everyone in the room felt it.
genuine.exampleZh: 她的微笑是真诚的，房间里的每个人都感受到了。

geography.example: I like geography because I can learn about mountains, rivers and countries.
geography.exampleZh: 我喜欢地理，因为我可以了解山脉、河流和国家。

geology.example: She studies geology at university and often goes on field trips to mountains.
geology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习地质学，并且经常去山里进行野外考察。

geometry.example: I like geometry because it helps me understand shapes and space.
geometry.exampleZh: 我喜欢几何，因为它帮助我理解形状和空间。

germ.example: Wash your hands to stop germs from spreading to other people.
germ.exampleZh: 洗手可以防止细菌传播给其他人。

german.example: My German friend speaks English and French very well.
german.exampleZh: 我的德国朋友英语和法语都说得很好。

germany.example: My uncle lives in Germany and works in a big factory there.
germany.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在德国，在那里的一家大工厂工作。

gesture.example: She made a small gesture with her hand to show she understood.
gesture.exampleZh: 她用手做了一个小动作，表示她明白了。

get.example: I hope to get a new bike for my birthday this year.
get.exampleZh: 我希望今年生日能得到一辆新自行车。

ghost.example: She says a ghost lives in the old house near the river.
ghost.exampleZh: 她说河边那座老房子里住着一个鬼。

giant.example: Look at that giant tree in the park near my house.
giant.exampleZh: 看看我家附近公园里的那棵大树。

gift.example: My sister gave me a small gift for my birthday.
gift.exampleZh: 我姐姐送了我一份小礼物作为生日礼物。

gifted.example: She is a gifted singer and can sing many difficult songs.
gifted.exampleZh: 她是一位有天赋的歌手，能唱很多难度高的歌。

gigantic.example: The new stadium is gigantic and can hold thousands of people.
gigantic.exampleZh: 这座新体育场非常庞大，可以容纳数千人。

girl.example: The little girl is playing with her dog in the park.
girl.exampleZh: 这个小女孩正在公园里和她的狗玩耍。

girlfriend.example: My girlfriend and I go to the park every Sunday morning.
girlfriend.exampleZh: 我和女朋友每个星期天早上都去公园。

give.example: Please give this book to your sister when you see her.
give.exampleZh: 你见到妹妹时，请把这本书给她。

given.example: Given the bad weather, the game was moved to next week.
given.exampleZh: 考虑到天气恶劣，比赛被改到了下周。

glad.example: I am glad you like the gift I made for you.
glad.exampleZh: 我很高兴你喜欢我为你做的礼物。

glance.example: She gave the letter a quick glance and then put it down.
glance.exampleZh: 她匆匆瞥了一眼那封信，然后把它放下了。

glass.example: She poured cold water into a clean glass and drank it slowly.
glass.exampleZh: 她把冷水倒进一个干净的玻璃杯里，慢慢喝了下去。

glimpse.example: She caught a quick glimpse of the deer before it ran into the trees.
glimpse.exampleZh: 她匆匆瞥见那只鹿，随后它就跑进了树林里。

glitter.example: The Christmas lights glitter on the tree all night.
glitter.exampleZh: 圣诞彩灯整夜在树上闪闪发光。

global.example: Climate change is a global problem that all countries must work together to solve.
global.exampleZh: 气候变化是一个全球性问题，所有国家都必须共同合作来解决。

globe.example: She has traveled all around the globe to see many famous places.
globe.exampleZh: 她走遍世界各地，参观了许多著名的地方。

gloomy.example: The room was gloomy because the only window was small and dirty.
gloomy.exampleZh: 这个房间很阴暗，因为唯一的窗户又小又脏。

glorious.example: The soldiers came home after a glorious victory, and everyone cheered them.
glorious.exampleZh: 士兵们在光荣的胜利后回到家乡，大家为他们欢呼。

glory.example: The old soldiers fought for glory and for their country.
glory.exampleZh: 老兵们为荣誉、为祖国而战。

glove.example: She wears a warm pair of gloves when she walks to school in winter.
glove.exampleZh: 冬天她步行去学校时会戴一副暖和的手套。

glow.example: The warm fire made her face glow with joy in the dark room.
glow.exampleZh: 温暖的火光让她在黑暗的房间里高兴得脸上发亮。

glue.example: Please use some glue to stick the broken cup back together.
glue.exampleZh: 请用一些胶水把破碎的杯子粘回去。

go.example: I go to school by bus every morning.
go.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐公交车去学校。

goal.example: My goal is to learn fifty new English words this month.
goal.exampleZh: 我的目标是这个月学会五十个新的英语单词。

goat.example: The old farmer keeps a goat and two sheep on his small hill.
goat.exampleZh: 那位老农在他的小山坡上养了一只山羊和两只绵羊。

god.example: Many people pray to God every night before they go to sleep.
god.exampleZh: 许多人每天晚上睡觉前都会向上帝祈祷。

gold.example: She wore a gold ring on her finger and smiled at everyone.
gold.exampleZh: 她手指上戴着一枚金戒指，对每个人微笑。

golden.example: The leaves turn golden in the autumn sun.
golden.exampleZh: 叶子在秋日的阳光下变成金色。

golf.example: My father plays golf with his friends every Sunday morning.
golf.exampleZh: 我父亲每个星期天早上都和朋友打高尔夫球。

good.example: Reading books every day is a good way to learn new things.
good.exampleZh: 每天读书是学习新事物的好方法。

goodbye.example: I said goodbye to my friends at the station this morning.
goodbye.exampleZh: 今天早上我在车站和朋友们告别。

goodness.example: She thanked him for his goodness and kindness to her family.
goodness.exampleZh: 她感谢他对她家人的善良和好意。

goods.example: The goods in this shop are cheap and very useful.
goods.exampleZh: 这家商店里的商品很便宜，也非常实用。

gorgeous.example: The garden looks gorgeous in spring when all the flowers open.
gorgeous.exampleZh: 春天百花盛开时，这个花园看起来美丽极了。

govern.example: Strong emotions can govern how we act in difficult times.
govern.exampleZh: 强烈的情绪会影响我们在困难时期的行为。

government.example: The government plans to build more schools and hospitals next year.
government.exampleZh: 政府计划明年建造更多的学校和医院。

governor.example: The governor visited our school and spoke to the students.
governor.exampleZh: 州长参观了我们的学校，并对学生们讲了话。

grab.example: She grabbed her bag and ran to catch the early bus.
grab.exampleZh: 她抓起包就跑，去赶早班公交车。

grace.example: Her grace on the stage made the whole audience fall silent.
grace.exampleZh: 她在舞台上的优雅让全场观众安静了下来。

graceful.example: The dancer made a graceful turn and smiled at the audience.
graceful.exampleZh: 那位舞者优雅地转了个身，微笑着面向观众。

grade.example: The teacher gave each student a grade on the math test.
grade.exampleZh: 老师给每个学生的数学考试打了分。

gradual.example: There was a gradual change in the weather over the past week.
gradual.exampleZh: 过去一周里天气逐渐发生了变化。

gradually.example: The weather gradually became warmer as spring arrived in the small town.
gradually.exampleZh: 随着春天来到这个小镇，天气逐渐变暖了。

graduate.example: She will graduate from college next year and then look for a job.
graduate.exampleZh: 她明年大学毕业，然后找工作。

grain.example: The farmer stores grain in a large wooden box.
grain.exampleZh: 农民把谷物储存在一个大木箱里。

gram.example: I need two hundred grams of sugar for this cake.
gram.exampleZh: 做这个蛋糕我需要两百克糖。

grammar.example: My teacher says good grammar helps you write clear sentences.
grammar.exampleZh: 我的老师说，良好的语法有助于你写出清晰的句子。

grammatical.example: Your sentence is correct because the grammatical rules are followed.
grammatical.exampleZh: 你的句子是正确的，因为遵循了语法规则。

grand.example: The grand hall was full of light and music for the wedding.
grand.exampleZh: 宏伟的大厅里充满了灯光和音乐，为婚礼增添了气氛。

grandfather.example: My grandfather likes to tell us funny stories about his childhood.
grandfather.exampleZh: 我的祖父喜欢给我们讲他童年的有趣故事。

grandmother.example: My grandmother makes good soup for us every Sunday.
grandmother.exampleZh: 我祖母每个星期天都给我们做美味的汤。

grant.example: The school will grant her a small grant to finish the project.
grant.exampleZh: 学校将给她一笔小额补助金，让她完成这个项目。

grape.example: She likes to eat a bunch of sweet grapes after dinner.
grape.exampleZh: 她喜欢在晚饭后吃一串甜葡萄。

graph.example: The teacher drew a simple graph to show how the temperature changed.
graph.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的图表，用来显示温度是如何变化的。

grasp.example: She quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson.
grasp.exampleZh: 她很快理解了这节课的主要内容。

grass.example: The children are playing on the grass in front of our house.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们家前面的草地上玩耍。

grateful.example: I am very grateful for all the help you gave me.
grateful.exampleZh: 我非常感激你给我的所有帮助。

gratitude.example: I wrote her a letter to express my gratitude for all her help.
gratitude.exampleZh: 我给她写了一封信，感谢她所有的帮助。

grave.example: The doctor said his illness was grave, so the family stayed quiet and serious.
grave.exampleZh: 医生说他的病情很严重，所以家人保持安静和严肃。

gravity.example: The apple fell from the tree because of gravity.
gravity.exampleZh: 苹果因为地心引力从树上掉了下来。

gray.example: The sky looks gray before it rains in the afternoon.
gray.exampleZh: 下午下雨前，天空看起来是灰色的。

great.example: This is a great hotel with clean rooms and very friendly staff.
great.exampleZh: 这是一家很棒的酒店，房间干净，员工也非常友好。

greatly.example: The new road greatly shortened our trip to the city.
greatly.exampleZh: 这条新路大大缩短了我们去城里的路程。

greedy.example: The greedy boy ate all the cookies before dinner.
greedy.exampleZh: 那个贪吃的男孩在晚饭前把饼干全吃光了。

greek.example: My best friend is Greek and she cooks very good food.
greek.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友是希腊人，她做的菜非常好吃。

green.example: The walls of my room are light green, and I keep some green plants by the window.
green.exampleZh: 我房间的墙是浅绿色的，窗边还放着一些绿色植物。

greenhouse.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes in a small greenhouse behind her house.
greenhouse.exampleZh: 我奶奶在她房子后面的一个小温室里种西红柿。

greet.example: She smiled and greeted every guest at the door.
greet.exampleZh: 她微笑着在门口迎接每一位客人。

greeting.example: She gave me a warm greeting at the door this morning.
greeting.exampleZh: 今天早上她在门口热情地向我打了招呼。

grief.example: She felt deep grief after her old dog died last winter.
grief.exampleZh: 去年冬天她的老狗死后，她感到深深的悲痛。

grieve.example: She still grieves for her old dog after all these years.
grieve.exampleZh: 这么多年过去了，她仍然为她的老狗而伤心。

grill.example: We cooked chicken on the grill and my father grilled me about school.
grill.exampleZh: 我们在烤架上烤了鸡肉，父亲还盘问了我的学校情况。

grim.example: The grim news made everyone in the room fall silent.
grim.exampleZh: 这个可怕的消息让房间里的每个人都沉默了。

grin.example: She looked at me and gave a big grin before she left.
grin.exampleZh: 她看着我，离开前咧嘴笑了一下。

grind.example: She grinds fresh coffee beans every morning before work.
grind.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都会磨新鲜的咖啡豆。

grip.example: She gripped the rope with both hands and climbed the wall.
grip.exampleZh: 她用双手紧紧抓住绳子，爬上了墙。

grocery.example: I need to stop at the grocery store to buy milk and bread.
grocery.exampleZh: 我需要在食品杂货店停一下，买些牛奶和面包。

gross.example: The gross income of the company rose last year, but the net profit fell.
gross.exampleZh: 这家公司的总收入去年增长了，但净利润下降了。

ground.example: The children are playing on the ground in front of the school.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们在学校前面的地面上玩耍。

group.example: Our teacher put us in groups of four to finish the science project.
group.exampleZh: 老师把我们分成四人一组来完成科学项目。

grow.example: Children grow very fast when they eat well and sleep enough every day.
grow.exampleZh: 孩子们吃得好、每天睡得够，就会长得很快。

growth.example: Sunlight and water are very important for the growth of young plants.
growth.exampleZh: 阳光和水对幼苗的生长非常重要。

guarantee.example: The store guarantees this watch for two years, so keep the receipt.
guarantee.exampleZh: 这家商店为这块手表提供两年保修，所以请保留收据。

guard.example: Two guards stand at the gate and keep the building safe at night.
guard.exampleZh: 两名警卫守在大门口，在夜里保护这栋大楼的安全。

guardian.example: As her legal guardian, he must sign the school papers.
guardian.exampleZh: 作为她的法定监护人，他必须签署学校的文件。

guess.example: I can only guess what he really wants from us.
guess.exampleZh: 我只能猜测他真正想从我们这里得到什么。

guest.example: We had a special guest at dinner last night, and everyone enjoyed talking with him.
guest.exampleZh: 昨晚我们晚餐时来了一位特别的客人，大家都很喜欢和他聊天。

guidance.example: Her teacher gave her useful guidance on choosing a new job.
guidance.exampleZh: 她的老师在择业方面给了她有用的指导。

guide.example: Our guide showed us the old temple and told its history.
guide.exampleZh: 我们的向导带我们参观了那座古庙，并讲述了它的历史。

guideline.example: The new guideline helps workers do their jobs safely and well.
guideline.exampleZh: 这项新准则帮助员工安全、出色地完成工作。

guilty.example: He felt guilty because he had lied to his best friend.
guilty.exampleZh: 他因为对最好的朋友撒了谎而感到内疚。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after dinner.
guitar.exampleZh: 我哥哥每天晚饭后都会弹吉他。

gulf.example: There is a growing gulf between the rich and the poor.
gulf.exampleZh: 贫富之间的鸿沟正在不断加深。

gum.example: The dentist told me to brush my gums gently twice a day.
gum.exampleZh: 牙医让我每天轻轻地刷两次牙龈。

gun.example: The police officer put his gun away before he talked to the children.
gun.exampleZh: 警察在和孩子们说话之前把枪收了起来。

gust.example: A gust of wind blew my hat off the table.
gust.exampleZh: 一阵狂风把我的帽子从桌上吹掉了。

guy.example: That guy over there is my brother's best friend.
guy.exampleZh: 那边那个家伙是我哥哥最好的朋友。

habit.example: Reading before bed is a good habit that helps me relax.
habit.exampleZh: 睡前阅读是一个好习惯，能帮助我放松。

habitat.example: This forest is a good habitat for many small birds and animals.
habitat.exampleZh: 这片森林是许多小型鸟类和动物的良好栖息地。

hair.example: Her long hair is black and very soft.

half.example: I ate half of the cake and saved the rest for later.
half.exampleZh: 我吃了一半蛋糕，把剩下的留着以后吃。

hall.example: The students waited in the hall before the meeting began.
hall.exampleZh: 会议开始前，学生们在门厅里等候。

halt.example: The train halted at the small station for only two minutes.
halt.exampleZh: 火车在那个小站只停了两分钟。

ham.example: She put a slice of ham on her plate for breakfast.
ham.exampleZh: 她早餐时在盘子里放了一片火腿。

hammer.example: He used a heavy hammer to fix the wooden fence yesterday.
hammer.exampleZh: 他昨天用一把重锤修好了木栅栏。

hamper.example: The heavy rain may hamper our plans for a picnic this weekend.
hamper.exampleZh: 大雨可能会妨碍我们这周末去野餐的计划。

hand.example: Please hand me the book on the table before you leave.
hand.exampleZh: 你离开前请把桌上的那本书递给我。

handbag.example: She put her phone and keys into her new handbag.
handbag.exampleZh: 她把手机和钥匙放进了她的新手提包里。

handbook.example: The teacher gave every new student a small handbook about the school.
handbook.exampleZh: 老师给每个新生发了一本关于学校的小手册。

handful.example: Only a handful of students came to the meeting this morning.
handful.exampleZh: 今天上午只有少数几个学生来开会。

handicap.example: His lack of experience was a serious handicap at work.
handicap.exampleZh: 缺乏经验是他在工作中的一大障碍。

handle.example: She knows how to handle difficult problems at work and never gives up.
handle.exampleZh: 她知道如何处理工作中的难题，从不放弃。

handsome.example: Her brother is a handsome young man who often helps others.
handsome.exampleZh: 她的弟弟是个英俊的年轻人，经常帮助别人。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is small and neat, so everyone can read her notes easily.
handwriting.exampleZh: 她的笔迹又小又工整，所以每个人都能轻松读懂她的笔记。

handy.example: This small bag is handy when I go shopping.
handy.exampleZh: 我去购物时，这个小包很方便。

hang.example: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
hang.exampleZh: 请把你的外套挂在门边的钩子上。

happen.example: I don't know what will happen next, but we should stay calm.
happen.exampleZh: 我不知道接下来会发生什么，但我们应该保持冷静。

happiness.example: Simple things like a warm meal and a kind word can bring real happiness.
happiness.exampleZh: 像一顿热饭和一句好话这样的简单事物就能带来真正的幸福。

happy.example: The children look very happy when they play in the park.
happy.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园里玩耍时看起来非常快乐。

harbor.example: The small boat found a safe harbor before the storm arrived.
harbor.exampleZh: 小船在暴风雨来临前找到了一个安全的港口。

hard.example: This bread is very hard, but the work is harder.
hard.exampleZh: 这块面包很硬，但这项工作更难。

harden.example: Cold weather can harden the ground and make it difficult to dig.
harden.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会使地面变硬，让人很难挖掘。

hardly.example: I can hardly hear you because the music is too loud.
hardly.exampleZh: 音乐太吵了，我几乎听不见你说话。

hardship.example: Many families face great hardship during the cold winter months.
hardship.exampleZh: 许多家庭在寒冷的冬季面临巨大的艰难。

hardware.example: This old store sells hardware like nails, screws and tools.
hardware.exampleZh: 这家老店出售钉子、螺丝和工具等五金器具。

hardy.example: These hardy farmers work outside all winter and never complain about the cold.
hardy.exampleZh: 这些能吃苦耐劳的农民整个冬天都在户外干活，从不抱怨寒冷。

harm.example: Too much sun can harm your skin.
harm.exampleZh: 晒太阳过多会伤害你的皮肤。

harmful.example: Smoking is harmful to your health, so try to stop it.
harmful.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的健康有害，所以尽量戒掉它。

harmony.example: The two sisters sing in perfect harmony at every family party.
harmony.exampleZh: 两姐妹在每次家庭聚会上都唱得非常和谐。

harsh.example: The harsh winter weather made it hard for the animals to find food.
harsh.exampleZh: 恶劣的冬季天气让动物们很难找到食物。

harvest.example: Farmers harvest the rice in autumn and share the good harvest with their families.
harvest.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割稻谷，并与家人分享丰收的成果。

has.example: She has two brothers and a small dog at home.
has.exampleZh: 她有两个兄弟和一只小狗在家。

haste.example: In her haste to leave, she forgot her keys on the table.
haste.exampleZh: 她匆忙离开时把钥匙忘在了桌子上。

hasty.example: His hasty decision caused a lot of problems for the team.
hasty.exampleZh: 他仓促的决定给团队带来了很多问题。

hat.example: He put on his hat before going out in the cold wind.
hat.exampleZh: 他在出门前戴上帽子，外面刮着冷风。

hatch.example: The baby birds will hatch from the eggs in a few days.
hatch.exampleZh: 这些小鸟过几天就会从蛋里孵出来。

hate.example: I hate getting up early on cold winter mornings.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌在寒冷的冬日早晨早起。

hatred.example: She felt deep hatred for the man who hurt her family.
hatred.exampleZh: 她对那个伤害她家人的人怀有深深的憎恨。

haul.example: We had to haul the heavy boxes up the stairs.
haul.exampleZh: 我们不得不把沉重的箱子拖上楼梯。

haunt.example: Old memories of that summer still haunt me when I walk past the school.
haunt.exampleZh: 当我走过那所学校时，那个夏天的旧日回忆仍然萦绕在我心头。

have.example: I have two small dogs and a big garden.
have.exampleZh: 我有两只小狗和一个大花园。

hawk.example: The hawk sat quietly on a high branch and watched the field below.
hawk.exampleZh: 那只鹰静静地停在高高的树枝上，注视着下方的田野。

hay.example: The farmer put dry hay in the barn for the cows.
hay.exampleZh: 农夫把干草放进谷仓里给奶牛吃。

he.example: He lives with his family in a small house near the river.
he.exampleZh: 他和家人住在河边的一所小房子里。

head.example: She turned her head to look at the top of the stairs.
head.exampleZh: 她转过头去看楼梯的顶部。

headache.example: I have a bad headache today, so I will stay home and rest.
headache.exampleZh: 我今天头痛得厉害，所以我会待在家里休息。

heading.example: Please write a clear heading at the top of each page.
heading.exampleZh: 请在每一页的顶部写一个清晰的标题。

headline.example: The news about the storm was the headline on every newspaper today.
headline.exampleZh: 关于暴风雨的新闻是今天每家报纸的头版头条。

headquarters.example: The company moved its headquarters to a new city last year.
headquarters.exampleZh: 这家公司去年把总部迁到了一个新的城市。

heal.example: Time and rest can heal a broken heart.
heal.exampleZh: 时间和休息能治愈一颗受伤的心。

health.example: Good food and daily exercise are important for your health.
health.exampleZh: 好的食物和每天锻炼对你的健康很重要。

healthy.example: Eating vegetables every day helps you stay healthy and strong.
healthy.exampleZh: 每天吃蔬菜有助于你保持健康和强壮。

heap.example: There is a heap of old books in the corner.

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能听见窗外鸟儿在唱歌。

hearing.example: Her hearing got worse after years of working in the noisy factory.
hearing.exampleZh: 在嘈杂的工厂工作多年后，她的听力变差了。

heart.example: She has a kind heart and always helps the people around her.
heart.exampleZh: 她有一颗善良的心，总是帮助身边的人。

heat.example: The heat from the sun makes the room warm in the afternoon.
heat.exampleZh: 太阳的热量使房间在下午变得温暖。

heater.example: The heater in my room keeps me warm on cold nights.
heater.exampleZh: 我房间里的加热器在寒冷的夜晚让我保持温暖。

heating.example: The heating in our old house stops working every winter.
heating.exampleZh: 我们老房子里的暖气每年冬天都会坏。

heave.example: They had to heave the heavy box onto the truck.
heave.exampleZh: 他们不得不把那个沉重的箱子使劲抬到卡车上。

heaven.example: She believes her kind grandmother is now in heaven.
heaven.exampleZh: 她相信她那慈祥的祖母现在在天堂里。

heavily.example: It rained heavily all night, so the streets were full of water.
heavily.exampleZh: 整夜下着大雨，所以街道上满是水。

heavy.example: This heavy box is too hard for me to carry alone.
heavy.exampleZh: 这个重箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。

hedge.example: He planted a hedge around his garden to keep strangers out.
hedge.exampleZh: 他在花园周围种了一道树篱，把陌生人挡在外面。

heel.example: My new shoes hurt my heel when I walk too far.
heel.exampleZh: 我走太远路时，新鞋会磨我的脚后跟。

height.example: The height of the mountain makes it hard to climb.
height.exampleZh: 这座山的高度使它很难攀登。

heighten.example: The new lights will heighten the beauty of the garden at night.
heighten.exampleZh: 这些新灯会增强花园夜晚的美感。

heir.example: The old man left all his money to his only heir.
heir.exampleZh: 这位老人把所有的钱都留给了他唯一的继承人。

helicopter.example: The helicopter landed on the roof of the tall building.
helicopter.exampleZh: 直升机降落在那栋高楼的楼顶上。

hell.example: He said the war had turned his city into a hell on earth.
hell.exampleZh: 他说战争把他的城市变成了人间地狱。

hello.example: She smiled and said hello to everyone in the room.
hello.exampleZh: 她微笑着向房间里的每个人问好。

helmet.example: You should wear a helmet when you ride your bike to school.
helmet.exampleZh: 你骑自行车上学时应该戴头盔。

help.example: Could you help me carry these boxes to the car?
help.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些箱子搬到车上吗？

helpful.example: My teacher is very helpful when I have questions about math.
helpful.exampleZh: 当我数学有疑问时，我的老师非常乐于助人。

hen.example: The hen laid three eggs in the nest this morning.
hen.exampleZh: 这只母鸡今天早上在窝里下了三个蛋。

hence.example: The road was closed, hence we took a longer way home.
hence.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们走了一条更远的路回家。

her.example: I gave her a book for her birthday.
her.exampleZh: 我在她生日时送了她一本书。

herd.example: A large herd of cows walked slowly across the green field.
herd.exampleZh: 一大群牛慢慢地走过绿色的田野。

here.example: Please wait here for a few minutes while I find the key.
here.exampleZh: 请在这里等几分钟，我去找钥匙。

heritage.example: This old town is an important part of our national heritage.
heritage.exampleZh: 这座古镇是我们民族遗产的重要组成部分。

hero.example: The young soldier became a hero after he saved three children from the fire.
hero.exampleZh: 那名年轻士兵从火中救出三个孩子后成了英雄。

heroic.example: The heroic firefighter ran into the burning house to save the child.
heroic.exampleZh: 那位英勇的消防员冲进燃烧的房子去救那个孩子。

hers.example: This book is mine and that blue bag is hers.
hers.exampleZh: 这本书是我的，那个蓝色的包是她的。

herself.example: She made the cake herself for her mother's birthday.
herself.exampleZh: 她亲自为妈妈的生日做了蛋糕。

hesitate.example: I hesitate to ask him for help again.
hesitate.exampleZh: 我犹豫着不愿再找他帮忙。

hi.example: Hi, my name is Tom and I am new here.
hi.exampleZh: 嗨，我叫汤姆，我是新来的。

hide.example: The children like to hide behind the sofa when we play games.
hide.exampleZh: 我们玩游戏时，孩子们喜欢躲在沙发后面。

hierarchy.example: In a strict hierarchy, everyone knows exactly who is above them.
hierarchy.exampleZh: 在严格的等级制度中，每个人都清楚谁位于自己之上。

high.example: This high mountain is hard to climb in winter.
high.exampleZh: 这座高山在冬天很难攀登。

highlight.example: The teacher used a red pen to highlight the most important words.
highlight.exampleZh: 老师用红笔突出最重要的词。

highly.example: Our teacher spoke highly of the work we did on the science project.
highly.exampleZh: 我们的老师高度评价了我们在科学项目上所做的工作。

highway.example: The new highway makes the trip to the city much faster.
highway.exampleZh: 这条新公路让去城里的路程快多了。

hike.example: We plan to hike in the mountains this weekend.
hike.exampleZh: 我们计划这个周末去山里远足。

hill.example: There is an old house at the top of the hill.

him.example: I gave him the book yesterday after school.
him.exampleZh: 昨天放学后我把那本书给了他。

himself.example: He built the wooden table himself without any help.
himself.exampleZh: 他亲自做的这张木桌，没有让任何人帮忙。

hinder.example: Bad weather can hinder our plans to travel this weekend.
hinder.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气可能会妨碍我们这周末出行的计划。

hint.example: He gave me a hint about the answer, so I understood.
hint.exampleZh: 他给了我一个关于答案的暗示，所以我明白了。

hip.example: My grandmother fell and hurt her hip while walking in the garden yesterday afternoon.
hip.exampleZh: 我奶奶昨天下午在花园散步时摔倒伤了髋部。

hire.example: We decided to hire a car for the weekend trip.
hire.exampleZh: 我们决定为周末旅行租一辆车。

his.example: His bike is red, and he rides it to school every day.
his.exampleZh: 他的自行车是红色的，他每天骑它去上学。

historian.example: The historian wrote a book about life in ancient China.
historian.exampleZh: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古代中国生活的书。

historic.example: This is a historic day for our small town.
historic.exampleZh: 对我们这个小镇来说，这是有历史意义的一天。

historical.example: The museum has many historical objects from ancient China.
historical.exampleZh: 这座博物馆有许多来自古代中国的历史文物。

history.example: She is reading a book about the history of China.
history.exampleZh: 她正在读一本关于中国历史的书。

hit.example: The new song was a big hit and everyone sang it.
hit.exampleZh: 这首新歌大获成功，人人都在唱。

hobby.example: My favorite hobby is reading books at home on quiet weekend afternoons.
hobby.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的业余爱好是在安静的周末午后在家读书。

hold.example: Please hold my bag while I open the door.
hold.exampleZh: 我开门的时候请帮我拿一下包。

hole.example: The rabbit ran into a deep hole near the old tree.
hole.exampleZh: 兔子跑进了老树旁的一个深洞里。

holiday.example: We will go to the beach for a holiday next week.
