holiday.exampleZh: 下周我们会去海边度假。

hollow.example: The old tree has a hollow trunk where small animals hide.
hollow.exampleZh: 那棵老树的树干是空心的，小动物们躲在里面。

holy.example: This old church is a holy place for many people.
holy.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂对许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

home.example: I go home after work and have dinner with my family.
home.exampleZh: 我下班后回家，和家人一起吃晚饭。

homework.example: I always finish my homework before I watch TV in the evening.
homework.exampleZh: 我总是在晚上看电视之前完成家庭作业。

homogeneous.example: The mixture is homogeneous because all its parts are the same.
homogeneous.exampleZh: 这个混合物是均匀的，因为它的所有部分都相同。

honest.example: She is an honest girl and always tells the truth to her friends.
honest.exampleZh: 她是个诚实的女孩，总是对朋友说真话。

honesty.example: Her honesty made everyone in the team trust her completely.
honesty.exampleZh: 她的诚实让团队里的每个人都完全信任她。

honey.example: My little daughter likes to put honey in her warm milk.
honey.exampleZh: 我的小女儿喜欢在温牛奶里加蜂蜜。

honor.example: It is a great honor to meet you and your family today.
honor.exampleZh: 今天能见到您和您的家人，我感到非常荣幸。

honorable.example: He is an honorable man who always tells the truth.
honorable.exampleZh: 他是个诚实的人，总是说真话。

hook.example: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door before you come in.
hook.exampleZh: 进门之前，请把你的外套挂在门边的挂钩上。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party next week.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你下周能来参加我的生日聚会。

hopeful.example: I am hopeful that my team will win the game tomorrow.
hopeful.exampleZh: 我对我队明天会赢得比赛抱有希望。

horizon.example: The sun went down below the horizon and the sky turned dark.
horizon.exampleZh: 太阳落到地平线以下，天空变黑了。

horizontal.example: The books are in a horizontal line on the shelf.
horizontal.exampleZh: 这些书在书架上排成一条水平线。

horn.example: The car horn was very loud in the quiet street.
horn.exampleZh: 汽车喇叭在安静的街道上非常响。

horrible.example: The weather was horrible, so we stayed inside all day.
horrible.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们一整天都待在屋里。

horror.example: She screamed in horror when she saw the dark figure in the doorway.
horror.exampleZh: 当她看到门口那个黑色身影时，她恐惧地尖叫起来。

horse.example: The horse ran across the field and jumped over the fence.
horse.exampleZh: 那匹马跑过田野，跳过了篱笆。

hospital.example: My mother works as a nurse in a large hospital near our home.
hospital.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一家大医院当护士。

hospitality.example: The small hotel is famous for its warm hospitality and good food.
hospitality.exampleZh: 这家小旅馆以热情好客和美食而闻名。

host.example: Our host welcomed every guest warmly at the front door.
host.exampleZh: 我们的主人热情地在门口迎接每一位客人。

hostile.example: The dog became hostile when strangers came near its food.
hostile.exampleZh: 当陌生人靠近它的食物时，那只狗变得有敌意。

hot.example: The soup is too hot to eat right now.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤太烫了，现在没法喝。

hotel.example: We stayed at a small hotel near the train station last night.
hotel.exampleZh: 昨晚我们住在火车站附近的一家小旅馆里。

hour.example: I study English for one hour every evening after dinner.
hour.exampleZh: 我每天晚上晚饭后学一小时英语。

house.example: My uncle bought a small house near the river last year.
house.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年在河边买了一栋小房子。

household.example: Every household in our small town uses water carefully in summer.
household.exampleZh: 我们小镇上的每一户人家在夏天都节约用水。

housewife.example: My mother is a housewife and she cooks for us every day.
housewife.exampleZh: 我妈妈是家庭主妇，她每天给我们做饭。

housework.example: I do the housework every Saturday morning with my sister.
housework.exampleZh: 我每周六早上和姐姐一起做家务。

housing.example: The city needs more housing for young families.
housing.exampleZh: 这座城市需要为年轻家庭提供更多住房。

how.example: How do you go to school every morning?
how.exampleZh: 你每天早上怎样去学校？

however.example: It was raining hard; however, we still went out for a walk.
however.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，然而我们还是出去散步了。

huddle.example: The children huddle together under the blanket to keep warm.
huddle.exampleZh: 孩子们挤在毯子下面取暖。

hug.example: She gave her little brother a warm hug at the door.
hug.exampleZh: 她在门口给了小弟弟一个温暖的拥抱。

huge.example: There is a huge tree in front of my school.
huge.exampleZh: 我学校前面有一棵巨大的树。

human.example: Every human needs clean water and fresh air to stay healthy.
human.exampleZh: 每个人都需要清洁的水和新鲜的空气来保持健康。

humanity.example: The teacher said that humanity must work together to protect the Earth.
humanity.exampleZh: 老师说人类必须共同努力保护地球。

humble.example: He is very humble even though he is a famous doctor.
humble.exampleZh: 尽管他是位有名的医生，他仍然非常谦逊。

humidity.example: The humidity in the room makes my clothes feel wet and cold.
humidity.exampleZh: 房间里的湿气让我的衣服感觉又湿又冷。

humor.example: His sense of humor makes everyone in the office feel relaxed and happy.
humor.exampleZh: 他的幽默感让办公室里的每个人都感到轻松愉快。

humorous.example: My uncle is a humorous man who always makes us laugh.
humorous.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个幽默的人，总能让我们发笑。

hundred.example: There are a hundred students in the school hall today.
hundred.exampleZh: 今天学校礼堂里有一百名学生。

hunger.example: After the long hike, his hunger was stronger than his tiredness.
hunger.exampleZh: 长途徒步之后，他的饥饿感比疲惫感更强烈。

hungry.example: The hungry children ate all the bread on the table.
hungry.exampleZh: 饥饿的孩子们把桌上的面包全吃光了。

hunt.example: We went to the forest to hunt for deer early this morning.
hunt.exampleZh: 今天一大早我们去森林里猎鹿。

hurricane.example: The hurricane broke many windows in our house last night.
hurricane.exampleZh: 昨晚的飓风打破了我们家很多窗户。

hurry.example: I am in a hurry to catch the early bus.

hurt.example: Be careful with that knife, or you will hurt your hand.
hurt.exampleZh: 小心那把刀，否则你会伤到你的手。

husband.example: My husband cooks dinner for the family every evening.
husband.exampleZh: 我丈夫每天晚上为家人做晚饭。

hydrogen.example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, so every drop contains both.
hydrogen.exampleZh: 水由氢和氧组成，所以每一滴水都含有这两种元素。

hypothesis.example: The scientist tested her hypothesis with a simple experiment in the lab.
hypothesis.exampleZh: 科学家在实验室里用一个简单的实验检验了她的假设。

ice.example: The lake turns to ice every winter when the weather gets very cold.
ice.exampleZh: 每当天气变得非常冷的时候，这个湖在每年冬天都会结冰。

idea.example: I have a good idea for our class trip this year.
idea.exampleZh: 对于今年的班级旅行，我有一个好主意。

ideal.example: This small town is an ideal place to raise a family.
ideal.exampleZh: 这个小镇是养家糊口的理想之地。

identical.example: The two brothers wore identical blue shirts to the party last night.
identical.exampleZh: 两兄弟昨晚穿着完全相同的蓝色衬衫去参加聚会。

identify.example: I can identify the bird by its song.
identify.exampleZh: 我能通过它的叫声识别这只鸟。

identity.example: Her identity as a writer is very important to her.
identity.exampleZh: 她作为作家的身份对她非常重要。

ideology.example: This ideology shapes how people think about work and family.
ideology.exampleZh: 这种思想体系影响着人们如何看待工作和家庭。

idiom.example: Learning a new idiom each day can make your English sound more natural.
idiom.exampleZh: 每天学一个习语能让你的英语听起来更自然。

idiot.example: My brother called me an idiot when I made that silly mistake.
idiot.exampleZh: 我犯下那个愚蠢的错误时，哥哥叫我白痴。

idle.example: He sat idle by the window all afternoon, watching the rain.
idle.exampleZh: 他整个下午都闲坐在窗边，看着雨。

idol.example: She is a famous idol and many young people love her songs.
idol.exampleZh: 她是一位著名的偶像，许多年轻人喜欢她的歌。

if.example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home and watch a movie.
if.exampleZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里看电影。

ignorance.example: His ignorance of the rules caused him to make a serious mistake.
ignorance.exampleZh: 他对规则的无知让他犯了一个严重的错误。

ignorant.example: He was not stupid, only ignorant of the new rules.
ignorant.exampleZh: 他并不愚笨，只是对新规则一无所知。

ignore.example: You should not ignore the teacher when she asks you a question.
ignore.exampleZh: 老师问你问题时，你不应该不理睬她。

ill.example: She felt ill and stayed home from school yesterday.
ill.exampleZh: 她昨天不舒服，就待在家里没去上学。

illegal.example: It is illegal to park your car here on Sundays.
illegal.exampleZh: 周日在这里停车是违法的。

illness.example: She missed school for a week because of a serious illness.
illness.exampleZh: 她因为一场重病缺课一周。

illuminate.example: These new street lights illuminate the whole road at night.
illuminate.exampleZh: 这些新路灯在夜里照亮了整条路。

illusion.example: The mirror creates the illusion that the room is much bigger.
illusion.exampleZh: 这面镜子造成一种错觉，让人觉得房间大得多。

illustrate.example: The teacher used a simple picture to illustrate her idea.
illustrate.exampleZh: 老师用一张简单的图来说明她的想法。

illustration.example: This book uses a simple illustration to explain how the machine works.
illustration.exampleZh: 这本书用一幅简单的插图来解释这台机器是如何运转的。

image.example: The city wants to improve its image with young people.
image.exampleZh: 这座城市想改善自己在年轻人心中的形象。

imaginary.example: The child said his best friend was an imaginary one.
imaginary.exampleZh: 那个孩子说他最好的朋友是一个想象出来的朋友。

imagination.example: Children need time to play and use their imagination every day.
imagination.exampleZh: 孩子们每天都需要时间去玩耍并发挥他们的想象力。

imagine.example: I can imagine how happy you felt when you heard the good news.
imagine.exampleZh: 我能想象你听到这个好消息时有多开心。

imitate.example: Young children often imitate the way their parents speak at home.
imitate.exampleZh: 小孩子常常模仿父母在家说话的方式。

imitation.example: Young children learn to speak by imitation of the people around them.
imitation.exampleZh: 幼儿通过模仿周围的人学会说话。

immediate.example: We need an immediate answer from the manager about this plan.
immediate.exampleZh: 我们需要经理对这个计划立即给出答复。

immediately.example: Please call me immediately when you get home tonight.
immediately.exampleZh: 你今晚到家后请马上给我打电话。

immense.example: The immense hall was full of people waiting for the show.
immense.exampleZh: 巨大的大厅里挤满了等待演出的人。

immigrant.example: The immigrant worked hard to learn English and find a good job.
immigrant.exampleZh: 这位移民努力学习英语并找一份好工作。

immigrate.example: Many people immigrate to this country to find better jobs and a safer life.
immigrate.exampleZh: 许多人移居到这个国家，为了找到更好的工作和更安全的生活。

immigration.example: The government has strict rules about immigration into the country.
immigration.exampleZh: 政府对进入该国的移民有严格的规定。

impact.example: The new road had a big impact on our small town.
impact.exampleZh: 这条新路对我们的小镇产生了很大影响。

impatient.example: He was impatient with the slow service at the restaurant.
impatient.exampleZh: 他对餐厅缓慢的服务感到不耐烦。

imperialism.example: Many people in that country fought against imperialism and foreign control.
imperialism.exampleZh: 那个国家的许多人反对帝国主义和外国控制。

implement.example: The team will implement the new plan next week.
implement.exampleZh: 团队将在下周实施这项新计划。

implication.example: The implication of his words was clear to everyone in the room.
implication.exampleZh: 他话里的含义房间里每个人都听得很清楚。

imply.example: Her quiet smile implied that she already knew the answer.
imply.exampleZh: 她安静的微笑暗示她早就知道答案了。

import.example: The country imports most of its oil from other nations.
import.exampleZh: 这个国家的大部分石油都是从其他国家进口的。

importance.example: Many students do not understand the importance of getting enough sleep every night.
importance.exampleZh: 许多学生不明白每晚睡足觉的重要性。

important.example: It is important to sleep well before a big test.
important.exampleZh: 大考前睡个好觉很重要。

impose.example: The government decided to impose a new tax on imported cars.
impose.exampleZh: 政府决定对进口汽车征收一项新税。

impossible.example: Without your help, it would be impossible for me to finish this work today.
impossible.exampleZh: 没有你的帮助，我今天不可能完成这项工作。

impress.example: Her kind words impressed everyone in the room that day.
impress.exampleZh: 那天她善意的话让房间里的每个人都印象深刻。

impression.example: Her warm smile left a good impression on everyone at the meeting.
impression.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑给会上的每个人都留下了好印象。

impressive.example: Her speech about the project was very impressive to everyone in the room.
impressive.exampleZh: 她关于这个项目的演讲让房间里的每个人都印象深刻。

improve.example: I want to improve my English before the new school year starts.
improve.exampleZh: 我想在新学年开始前提高我的英语水平。

improvement.example: This small change is a big improvement for our team.
improvement.exampleZh: 这个小小的改变对我们团队来说是一个很大的进步。

impulse.example: She bought the red dress on impulse without thinking about the price.
impulse.exampleZh: 她一时冲动买下了那条红裙子，根本没考虑价格。

in.example: My keys are in the bag, and my mother is in the kitchen.
in.exampleZh: 我的钥匙在包里，我妈妈在厨房里。

incentive.example: The company offers a cash incentive to employees who work extra hours.
incentive.exampleZh: 公司向加班工作的员工提供现金奖励。

inch.example: The table is only one inch too wide for the door.
inch.exampleZh: 这张桌子只比门宽了一英寸。

incident.example: The police are looking into the incident that happened last night.
incident.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨晚发生的那起事件。

incline.example: The old road begins to incline steeply after the bridge.
incline.exampleZh: 过了桥之后，这条老路开始陡峭地倾斜。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free Wi-Fi in every room.
include.exampleZh: 这个价格包含早餐以及每个房间的免费无线网络。

income.example: My income is not enough to pay for a new car this year.
income.exampleZh: 我的收入不足以在今年买一辆新车。

increase.example: The number of students in our school will increase next year.
increase.exampleZh: 我们学校的学生人数明年将会增加。

increasingly.example: People are increasingly using their phones to pay for everyday things.
increasingly.exampleZh: 人们越来越多地使用手机支付日常物品的费用。

incredible.example: The view from the top of the mountain was incredible.
incredible.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色令人难以置信。

indeed.example: The weather is indeed very cold outside today, so wear a warm coat.
indeed.exampleZh: 今天外面确实很冷，所以穿件暖和的衣服吧。

independence.example: Learning to live alone gave her a strong sense of independence.
independence.exampleZh: 独自生活让她学会了独立，也给了她强烈的自主感。

independent.example: She is an independent thinker who always asks questions before she agrees.
independent.exampleZh: 她是一个独立思考的人，总是先提问再表示同意。

index.example: The index at the back of the book helps you find topics quickly.
index.exampleZh: 书后面的索引能帮你快速找到主题。

indian.example: My teacher says an Indian friend of hers lives in London now.
indian.exampleZh: 我的老师说，她的一位印度朋友现在住在伦敦。

indicate.example: The sign indicates that the park is closed today.
indicate.exampleZh: 这个标志表明公园今天关闭。

indication.example: There is no indication that he plans to leave the company.
indication.exampleZh: 没有迹象表明他打算离开公司。

indifferent.example: He was indifferent to the whole plan and said nothing.
indifferent.exampleZh: 他对整个计划漠不关心，什么也没说。

indirect.example: He gave an indirect answer, so no one knew his real plan.
indirect.exampleZh: 他给了一个拐弯抹角的回答，所以没人知道他的真实计划。

indispensable.example: Good sleep is indispensable for staying healthy and thinking clearly every day.
indispensable.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠对于每天保持健康和思维清晰是必不可少的。

individual.example: Each individual student in the class has a different learning style.
individual.exampleZh: 班上每个学生的学习方式都不一样。

indoor.example: The children played indoor games on the rainy day.
indoor.exampleZh: 下雨天孩子们在室内玩游戏。

indoors.example: It is raining hard, so the children must stay indoors and play today.
indoors.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，所以孩子们今天必须待在室内玩耍。

industrial.example: This city is a big industrial area with many old factories.
industrial.exampleZh: 这座城市是一个有许多老工厂的大型工业区。

industrialize.example: Many small towns began to industrialize quickly after the new factory opened.
industrialize.exampleZh: 新工厂开办后，许多小城镇开始迅速工业化。

industry.example: The car industry is very important to this city and its people.
industry.exampleZh: 汽车产业对这座城市及其人民非常重要。

inevitable.example: With so little rain this summer, a water shortage seems inevitable.
inevitable.exampleZh: 今年夏天雨水这么少，水资源短缺似乎不可避免。

infant.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms all afternoon.
infant.exampleZh: 这个婴儿整个下午都在母亲怀里安静地睡着。

infect.example: The virus can infect people through the air.
infect.exampleZh: 这种病毒可以通过空气传染给人们。

infection.example: The doctor said the infection was in my throat.
infection.exampleZh: 医生说我的喉部有感染。

infectious.example: Her happy laugh was infectious and made everyone in the room smile.
infectious.exampleZh: 她那快乐的笑声很有感染力，让房间里的每个人都笑了。

infer.example: From his silence we can infer that he does not agree.
infer.exampleZh: 从他的沉默我们可以推断他并不同意。

inference.example: The police made an inference about the thief from the muddy footprints.
inference.exampleZh: 警方根据泥泞的脚印对窃贼做出了推断。

influence.example: Her teacher's advice had a big influence on her future.
influence.exampleZh: 老师的建议对她的未来有很大的影响。

influential.example: Her teacher was an influential person in her life.
influential.exampleZh: 她的老师是她一生中一个有影响的人。

inform.example: Please inform your teacher if you will be late for class.
inform.exampleZh: 如果你上课要迟到，请通知你的老师。

information.example: I need more information about this job before I apply for it.
information.exampleZh: 在申请这份工作之前，我需要更多关于它的信息。

infrared.example: The camera can see infrared light that our eyes cannot see.
infrared.exampleZh: 这台相机能看到我们的眼睛看不见的红外线。

ingredient.example: Flour is the main ingredient in this simple bread recipe.
ingredient.exampleZh: 面粉是这个简单面包食谱中的主要原料。

inhabit.example: Many small birds inhabit the trees near our house in spring.
inhabit.exampleZh: 春天里，许多小鸟栖息在我们家附近的树上。

inhabitant.example: The island has only a few hundred inhabitants, and most of them are fishermen.
inhabitant.exampleZh: 这个岛上只有几百名居民，其中大多数是渔民。

inherit.example: She will inherit the old house from her grandmother next year.
inherit.exampleZh: 明年她将从祖母那里继承那栋老房子。

initial.example: My initial plan was to walk, but I took the bus instead.
initial.exampleZh: 我最初的计划是步行，但我改乘了公交车。

initially.example: Initially, I felt nervous, but the new job soon became easy.
initially.exampleZh: 最初我感到紧张，但这份新工作很快就变得轻松了。

initiate.example: The school will initiate a new program to help students read better.
initiate.exampleZh: 学校将发起一个新项目来帮助学生提高阅读能力。

initiative.example: She took the initiative to organize the meeting for our team.
initiative.exampleZh: 她主动为我们的团队组织了这次会议。

injection.example: The doctor gave the child an injection to help him feel better.
injection.exampleZh: 医生给孩子打了一针，帮助他好起来。

injure.example: He fell off his bike and injured his left arm badly.
injure.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，左臂受了重伤。

injury.example: She could not play in the game because of a knee injury.
injury.exampleZh: 因为膝盖受伤，她无法参加比赛。

injustice.example: She fought against injustice in her small town for many years.
injustice.exampleZh: 她多年来一直在她的小镇上为反抗不公正而斗争。

ink.example: The pen is out of ink, so I cannot write.
ink.exampleZh: 这支笔没墨水了，所以我写不了字。

inn.example: We stayed at a small inn near the river last summer.
inn.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们住在河边的一家小旅馆里。

inner.example: She kept her inner feelings hidden from everyone around her.
inner.exampleZh: 她把自己内心的感受对身边的每个人都隐藏了起来。

innocent.example: The court found him innocent of all charges after the trial.
innocent.exampleZh: 审判结束后，法庭判定他所有指控均不成立，他是无罪的。

innovation.example: This new phone shows great innovation in how we use technology.
innovation.exampleZh: 这款新手机在我们使用技术的方式上展现了很大的创新。

innovative.example: Our team is looking for innovative ways to save energy at home.
innovative.exampleZh: 我们的团队正在寻找节省家庭能源的创新方法。

input.example: Please input your name and password before you start the game.
input.exampleZh: 开始游戏之前，请先输入你的姓名和密码。

inquire.example: I called the hotel to inquire about the room price for next week.
inquire.exampleZh: 我打电话给酒店，询问下周的房价。

inquiry.example: She made an inquiry about the train times at the front desk.
inquiry.exampleZh: 她向服务台询问了火车时刻。

insane.example: It sounds insane to drive across the country in one day.
insane.exampleZh: 一天之内开车穿越全国听起来太疯狂了。

insect.example: This small insect lives under the leaves of the old tree.
insect.exampleZh: 这只小昆虫住在老树的叶子下面。

insert.example: Please insert your card into the machine and wait for a moment.
insert.exampleZh: 请将您的卡插入机器，然后稍等片刻。

inside.example: The cat is sleeping inside the small brown box.
inside.exampleZh: 猫正在那个棕色的小箱子里睡觉。

insight.example: Her book gives us real insight into how children learn to read.
insight.exampleZh: 她的书让我们对儿童如何学会阅读有了真正的深入了解。

insist.example: She insists on walking to school every day, even in the rain.
insist.exampleZh: 她坚持每天走路上学，即使下雨也不例外。

inspect.example: The teacher came to inspect our classroom before the exam began.
inspect.exampleZh: 考试开始前，老师来检查了我们的教室。

inspection.example: The teacher made a careful inspection of every student's homework today.
inspection.exampleZh: 老师今天仔细检查了每个学生的作业。

inspector.example: The inspector checked the old building for safety problems.
inspector.exampleZh: 检查员检查了这栋旧楼的安全问题。

inspiration.example: My teacher is a great inspiration to me and all my classmates.
inspiration.exampleZh: 我的老师对我以及所有同学都是极大的鼓舞。

inspire.example: Her teacher's kind words inspired her to work even harder.
inspire.exampleZh: 老师温暖的话语激励了她更加努力。

install.example: You can install the new app on your phone in a few minutes.
install.exampleZh: 你可以在几分钟内把这款新应用安装到手机上。

installation.example: The installation of the new heating system took two days.
installation.exampleZh: 新供暖系统的安装花了两天时间。

installment.example: I pay for my new phone in monthly installments.
installment.exampleZh: 我按月分期付款购买这部新手机。

instance.example: This is a clear instance of how small changes can save money.
instance.exampleZh: 这是一个清楚的实例，说明小改变如何能省钱。

instant.example: This instant coffee tastes good, and I can make it in seconds.
instant.exampleZh: 这种速溶咖啡味道不错，我几秒钟就能冲好一杯。

instead.example: Let's walk to the park instead of taking the bus today.
instead.exampleZh: 今天我们别坐公交车，走公园去吧。

instinct.example: She trusted her instinct and chose the safer road home.
instinct.exampleZh: 她相信自己的直觉，选了那条更安全的回家路。

institute.example: She works at a small institute that studies climate change.
institute.exampleZh: 她在一家研究气候变化的小型研究所工作。

institution.example: The bank is a large financial institution in our city.
institution.exampleZh: 这家银行是我们城市里一家大型金融机构。

instruct.example: The teacher instructed us to read the book before class.
instruct.exampleZh: 老师指示我们在上课前读这本书。

instruction.example: Please read the instructions carefully before you use this new machine.
instruction.exampleZh: 使用这台新机器之前，请仔细阅读操作指南。

instructor.example: Our driving instructor is very patient with new students.
instructor.exampleZh: 我们的驾驶教练对新学员非常有耐心。

instrument.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my eyes.
instrument.exampleZh: 医生用一个小仪器检查了我的眼睛。

insult.example: He did not mean to insult you with that joke.
insult.exampleZh: 他并非有意用那个玩笑侮辱你。

insurance.example: I pay for car insurance every month because it keeps me safe.
insurance.exampleZh: 我每个月都付汽车保险费，因为它让我有保障。

insure.example: We insure our house against fire and other common risks.
insure.exampleZh: 我们给房子投保火灾及其他常见风险。

intact.example: The old vase was still intact after the move.
intact.exampleZh: 搬家之后，那只旧花瓶仍然完好无损。

integrate.example: It takes time for new students to integrate into the school community.
integrate.exampleZh: 新学生需要时间来融入学校社区。

integration.example: The integration of these two systems will save the company a lot of time.
integration.exampleZh: 这两个系统的整合将为公司节省大量时间。

intellectual.example: He enjoys intellectual conversations with his friends at the coffee shop every weekend.
intellectual.exampleZh: 他喜欢每个周末在咖啡店和朋友们进行智力上的交谈。

intelligence.example: She has enough intelligence to solve this hard problem quickly.
intelligence.exampleZh: 她有足够的智慧快速解决这个难题。

intelligent.example: She is a very intelligent student who always asks good questions in class.
intelligent.exampleZh: 她是个非常聪明的学生，在课堂上总是提出好问题。

intend.example: I intend to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
intend.exampleZh: 我打算今晚晚饭前完成作业。

intense.example: The heat was so intense that we stayed inside all afternoon.
intense.exampleZh: 天气热得太厉害，我们整个下午都待在屋里。

intensity.example: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone in the small town.
intensity.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨的强度让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

intensive.example: The hospital offers intensive care for very sick patients.
intensive.exampleZh: 这家医院为重症病人提供密集护理。

intention.example: I have no intention of changing my mind about this trip.
intention.exampleZh: 我不打算改变我关于这次旅行的主意。

interact.example: Children learn social skills when they interact with other kids at school.
interact.exampleZh: 孩子们在学校与其他孩子互动时学习社交技能。

interaction.example: Good interaction between teachers and students makes learning easier and more fun.
interaction.exampleZh: 师生之间良好的互动让学习变得更轻松、更有趣。

interest.example: She has a strong interest in music and plays the piano every day.
interest.exampleZh: 她对音乐有浓厚的兴趣，每天都弹钢琴。

interesting.example: This book is interesting and I want to read it again.
interesting.exampleZh: 这本书很有趣，我想再读一遍。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere with my work when I am busy.
interfere.exampleZh: 我忙的时候请不要打扰我的工作。

interference.example: The bad weather caused interference with the radio signal.
interference.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气对无线电信号造成了干扰。

interior.example: The interior of the old house was dark and very quiet.
interior.exampleZh: 这座老房子的内部又暗又安静。

intermediate.example: This class is for intermediate students who already know the basics.
intermediate.exampleZh: 这个班是为已经掌握基础的中级学生开设的。

internal.example: The doctor said the pain was caused by an internal injury.
internal.exampleZh: 医生说这种疼痛是由内部损伤引起的。

international.example: Our school has many international students from different countries this year.
international.exampleZh: 我们学校今年有许多来自不同国家的留学生。

internet.example: I use the internet every day to read news and send emails.
internet.exampleZh: 我每天都用互联网看新闻和发邮件。

interpret.example: She helped me interpret the difficult words in the old letter.
interpret.exampleZh: 她帮我解释了那封旧信里难懂的词句。

interpretation.example: Her interpretation of the poem was different from mine.
interpretation.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的理解和我的不同。

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking on the phone.
interrupt.exampleZh: 我打电话时请不要打断我。

interval.example: After a short interval, the rain stopped and we went outside again.
interval.exampleZh: 短暂的间歇之后，雨停了，我们又走到了外面。

interview.example: I have a job interview tomorrow morning at a big company.
interview.exampleZh: 明天上午我要去一家大公司参加面试。

intimate.example: My sister and I are very intimate friends and share everything.
intimate.exampleZh: 我姐姐和我是非常亲密的朋友，什么都会分享。

into.example: She walked into the kitchen and made a cup of tea.
into.exampleZh: 她走进厨房，泡了一杯茶。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my new teacher.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把你介绍给我的新老师。

introduction.example: The teacher gave a short introduction before the new lesson began.
introduction.exampleZh: 老师在新课开始前做了简短的介绍。

invade.example: Soldiers invaded the small country early in the morning.
invade.exampleZh: 士兵们在清晨入侵了这个小国。

invasion.example: The country fought hard to stop the invasion of its land.
invasion.exampleZh: 这个国家奋力抵抗对其领土的入侵。

invent.example: My brother wants to invent a small machine to help clean his room.
invent.exampleZh: 我弟弟想发明一台小机器来帮助打扫他的房间。

invention.example: The invention of the telephone changed how people talk to each other.
invention.exampleZh: 电话的发明改变了人们彼此交谈的方式。

inventor.example: The inventor made a small machine that helps farmers water their crops.
inventor.exampleZh: 这位发明家造了一台小机器，帮助农民给庄稼浇水。

invest.example: She decided to invest her savings in a small local business.
invest.exampleZh: 她决定把积蓄投资到一家本地小企业。

investigate.example: The police came to investigate the strange noise in the old house.
investigate.exampleZh: 警察来调查那座老房子里的奇怪声响。

investigation.example: The police started an investigation into the accident last week.
investigation.exampleZh: 警方上周开始对这起事故进行调查。

investment.example: She made a small investment in the local bakery last year.
investment.exampleZh: 她去年在本地那家面包店做了一笔小额投资。

investor.example: The investor put a lot of money into the small company last year.
investor.exampleZh: 这位投资者去年向这家小公司投入了大量资金。

invisible.example: The small insect is almost invisible on the green leaf.
invisible.exampleZh: 这只小昆虫在绿叶上几乎看不见。

invitation.example: I got an invitation to her wedding next Sunday.
invitation.exampleZh: 我收到了她下周日婚礼的请帖。

invite.example: She wants to invite her best friend to the party on Saturday.
invite.exampleZh: 她想邀请她最好的朋友参加周六的聚会。

involve.example: The new job will involve a lot of travel and long meetings.
involve.exampleZh: 这份新工作将涉及大量出差和冗长的会议。

inward.example: She turned her gaze inward and thought about her own feelings.
inward.exampleZh: 她把目光转向内心，思考自己的感受。

iron.example: I need to iron my shirt before the important meeting tomorrow morning.
iron.exampleZh: 明天早上那个重要会议之前，我需要把衬衫熨一下。

irony.example: The irony is that the fire station burned down last night.
irony.exampleZh: 具有讽刺意味的是，消防站昨晚被烧毁了。

island.example: The small island is far from the city, and few people live there.
island.exampleZh: 这座小岛离城市很远，很少有人住在那里。

isolate.example: Doctors isolate sick people to stop the illness from spreading.
isolate.exampleZh: 医生隔离病人以阻止疾病传播。

isolation.example: The old man lived in isolation for many years after his wife died.
isolation.exampleZh: 妻子去世后，这位老人在孤独中生活了很多年。

issue.example: The new policy is a big issue for many people here.
issue.exampleZh: 这项新政策对这里的许多人来说是个大问题。

it.example: I found your key on the table, so I put it in your bag.
it.exampleZh: 我在桌子上找到了你的钥匙，所以就把它放进了你的包里。

italian.example: My new neighbor is Italian and he cooks pasta every Sunday.
italian.exampleZh: 我的新邻居是意大利人，他每个星期天都做意大利面。

item.example: Please check each item on the list before you leave the store.
item.exampleZh: 离开商店前，请核对清单上的每一项。

its.example: The dog is looking for its ball in the garden.
its.exampleZh: 那只狗正在花园里找它的球。

itself.example: The little cat can wash itself with its tongue.
itself.exampleZh: 那只小猫会用舌头给它自己洗澡。

jacket.example: He put on a warm jacket before going out in the cold wind.
jacket.exampleZh: 他在寒风中外面前穿上了一件暖和的夹克。

jail.example: The thief was sent to jail for two years for stealing money.
jail.exampleZh: 那个小偷因偷钱被送进监狱关两年。

jam.example: We were late because a traffic jam blocked the main road.
jam.exampleZh: 我们迟到了，因为交通堵塞堵住了主干道。

january.example: My birthday is in January, so we often have a small party.
january.exampleZh: 我的生日在一月，所以我们常常办一个小聚会。

jar.example: She put the fresh cookies in a glass jar on the shelf.
jar.exampleZh: 她把新鲜的饼干放进架子上的一只玻璃罐里。

jargon.example: The doctor used too much medical jargon, so I could not understand him.
jargon.exampleZh: 医生用了太多医学术语，所以我听不懂他的话。

jaw.example: The boxer hit his jaw and knocked him to the ground.
jaw.exampleZh: 拳击手击中了他的下巴，把他打倒在地。

jazz.example: My father loves jazz and plays old records every Sunday morning.
jazz.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢爵士乐，每个星期天早上都会放老唱片。

jealous.example: He is jealous of his brother because he has a new bike.
jealous.exampleZh: 他妒忌弟弟，因为弟弟有一辆新自行车。

jeans.example: He wears blue jeans and a white shirt to school every day.
jeans.exampleZh: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤和白衬衫去上学。

jet.example: The jet flew high above the clouds on its way to Tokyo.
jet.exampleZh: 那架喷气式飞机飞越云层，前往东京。

jewel.example: She wore a beautiful jewel around her neck.
jewel.exampleZh: 她脖子上戴着一颗美丽的宝石。

jewelry.example: She keeps her jewelry in a small box on the table.
jewelry.exampleZh: 她把首饰放在桌上的一个小盒子里。

job.example: Finding a good job is not an easy task these days.
job.exampleZh: 如今找到一份好工作不是件容易的事。

join.example: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight after work?
join.exampleZh: 你今晚下班后愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？

joint.example: The two countries signed a joint agreement to protect the river.
joint.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项联合协议来保护这条河流。

joke.example: My friends often tell a funny joke to make me laugh.
joke.exampleZh: 我的朋友们经常讲一个有趣的笑话来逗我笑。

journal.example: She writes in her journal every night before she goes to sleep.
journal.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

journalist.example: The journalist asked my mother several questions about the new school.
journalist.exampleZh: 那名记者就新学校问了我母亲几个问题。

journey.example: The long journey across the desert took us three days.
journey.exampleZh: 穿越沙漠的漫长旅程花了我们三天时间。

joy.example: The children jumped with joy when they saw the snow outside.
joy.exampleZh: 孩子们看到外面的雪时，高兴得跳了起来。

judge.example: The judge listened carefully to both sides before making a final decision.
judge.exampleZh: 法官在做出最终裁决前仔细听取了双方的意见。

judgement.example: I trust her judgement because she is always calm and fair.
judgement.exampleZh: 我信任她的判断力，因为她总是冷静又公正。

juice.example: I like to drink a glass of orange juice every morning.
juice.exampleZh: 我每天早上喜欢喝一杯橙汁。

july.example: My family usually goes to the beach for a week in July.
july.exampleZh: 我家通常会在七月去海边待一个星期。

jump.example: The cat tried to jump over the small fence.
jump.exampleZh: 那只猫试着跳过那道小栅栏。

junction.example: Turn left at the next junction and you will see the station.
junction.exampleZh: 在下一个交叉口向左转，你就会看到车站。

june.example: My birthday is in June, and we always have a small party.
june.exampleZh: 我的生日在六月，我们总是会办一个小派对。

jungle.example: The explorers got lost in the dense jungle for three days.
jungle.exampleZh: 探险者在茂密的丛林中迷路了三天。

junior.example: My junior brother is still in high school and loves playing basketball.
junior.exampleZh: 我的弟弟还在上高中，他很喜欢打篮球。

jury.example: The jury will decide whether the man is guilty.
jury.exampleZh: 陪审团将决定这名男子是否有罪。

just.example: I just got home and the soup is just right.
just.exampleZh: 我刚到家，这汤的味道正好。

justice.example: The judge promised to bring justice to the family after the long trial.
justice.exampleZh: 漫长的审判结束后，法官承诺为这个家庭伸张正义。

justify.example: Nothing can justify the way he treated his old friends.
justify.exampleZh: 他所做的任何事都无法为他对待老朋友的方式辩护。

juvenile.example: The court tries to protect juvenile offenders and help them change.
juvenile.exampleZh: 法院努力保护少年犯并帮助他们改过自新。

keen.example: She is keen to learn English and practices every day.
keen.exampleZh: 她热衷于学英语，每天都练习。

keep.example: Please keep the door closed while the baby is sleeping.
keep.exampleZh: 宝宝睡觉时请把门关好。

kennel.example: The little dog sleeps in a warm kennel behind the house.
kennel.exampleZh: 小狗睡在屋后一个温暖的狗舍里。

kerb.example: She parked her bike next to the kerb and walked into the shop.
kerb.exampleZh: 她把自行车停在路缘旁边，然后走进了商店。

kettle.example: She put the kettle on the stove and made tea for us.
kettle.exampleZh: 她把水壶放在炉子上，给我们泡了茶。

key.example: The key to the front door is in my bag.
key.exampleZh: 前门的钥匙在我的包里。

keyboard.example: I type my homework on the keyboard every evening after dinner.
keyboard.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后都用键盘打作业。

kick.example: She gave the ball a hard kick and it flew over the fence.
kick.exampleZh: 她用力踢了一下球，球飞过了篱笆。

kid.example: The kid next to me likes to kid his friends about their funny hats.
kid.exampleZh: 我旁边那个小孩喜欢拿朋友们滑稽的帽子开玩笑。

kidney.example: Doctor says my left kidney is healthy but I still feel tired.
kidney.exampleZh: 医生说我左肾是健康的，但我还是觉得累。

kill.example: The cold weather killed most of the flowers in our small garden.
kill.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气杀死了我们小花园里的大部分花。

kilogram.example: This bag of rice weighs about one kilogram, which is easy for me to carry.
kilogram.exampleZh: 这袋米大约重一千克，我很容易就能拿动。

kilometre.example: The nearest town is only five kilometres away from our small village.
kilometre.exampleZh: 最近的城镇离我们的小村庄只有五公里。

kind.example: Our teacher is kind and helps every student in the class.
kind.exampleZh: 我们的老师和蔼可亲，帮助班上每一位学生。

kindness.example: Her kindness to the new students made them feel welcome.
kindness.exampleZh: 她对新同学的友善让他们感到受欢迎。

king.example: The king lived in a big castle with his family and many servants.
king.exampleZh: 国王和他的家人以及许多仆人住在一座大城堡里。

kingdom.example: The old king ruled his kingdom for over forty years.
kingdom.exampleZh: 这位老国王统治他的王国四十多年。

kiss.example: She gave her little son a gentle kiss on the forehead before bed.
kiss.exampleZh: 睡前她在小儿子的额头上轻轻吻了一下。

kit.example: He keeps a small tool kit in the back of his car.
kit.exampleZh: 他在汽车后备箱里放了一个小工具箱。

kitchen.example: My mother cooks dinner in the kitchen every evening after work.
kitchen.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天下班后都在厨房做晚饭。

kite.example: The little boy is flying a red kite in the park today.
kite.exampleZh: 这个小男孩今天正在公园里放一只红色的风筝。

knee.example: My left knee hurts a little when I run or climb the stairs.
knee.exampleZh: 我跑步或爬楼梯时，左膝会有一点疼。

kneel.example: She had to kneel down on the floor to look under the bed.
kneel.exampleZh: 她不得不跪在地板上，好看看床底下有什么。

knife.example: Please use a sharp knife to cut the bread.
knife.exampleZh: 请用一把锋利的刀切面包。

knit.example: My grandmother likes to knit warm sweaters for us in winter.
knit.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢在冬天为我们编织温暖的毛衣。

knob.example: She turned the knob slowly and opened the door.
knob.exampleZh: 她慢慢转动门把，打开了门。

knock.example: Please knock on the door before you come into my room.
knock.exampleZh: 进我房间之前请先敲门。

knot.example: She tied a small knot in the rope before hanging the picture.
knot.exampleZh: 她在挂画之前，在绳子上打了一个小结。

know.example: I know this small town very well because I grew up here.
know.exampleZh: 我很了解这个小镇，因为我在这里长大。

knowledge.example: She has a lot of knowledge about plants and animals.
knowledge.exampleZh: 她对动植物有很多了解。

lab.example: The students did a simple test in the lab yesterday.
lab.exampleZh: 学生们昨天在实验室里做了一个简单的测试。

label.example: The teacher put a label on every book and called it new.
label.exampleZh: 老师在每本书上贴了标签，并把它称为新书。

labor.example: The workers put in long hours of hard labor every day.
labor.exampleZh: 工人们每天都要付出长时间的辛苦劳动。

laboratory.example: The students did a simple test in the laboratory this morning.
laboratory.exampleZh: 学生们今天早上在实验室做了一个简单的测试。

lace.example: She tied the lace on her shoe and walked out the door.
lace.exampleZh: 她系好鞋带，然后走出门去。

lack.example: Many young people lack the money and time to travel far.
lack.exampleZh: 许多年轻人缺乏远行的金钱和时间。

ladder.example: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.

lady.example: The old lady asked me to help her carry the heavy bag.
lady.exampleZh: 那位老太太请我帮她提那个沉重的包。

lag.example: Our old computer lags behind the new ones in the office.
lag.exampleZh: 我们那台旧电脑比办公室里的新电脑落后。

lake.example: We walked around the lake and took many photos of the quiet water.
lake.exampleZh: 我们绕着湖走了一圈，拍了许多平静水面的照片。

lamb.example: The little lamb stayed close to its mother in the green field.
lamb.exampleZh: 那只小羊在绿色的田野里紧紧跟着它的妈妈。

lame.example: His lame leg made it hard for him to walk up the stairs.
lame.exampleZh: 他瘸了一条腿，所以上楼梯很困难。

lamp.example: She turned on a small lamp and read a book.

land.example: The plane will land in Beijing soon and then we will be on land.
land.exampleZh: 飞机很快就会在北京降落，之后我们就会踏上陆地。

landlady.example: The landlady gave us the key to our room.
landlady.exampleZh: 女房东把房间钥匙给了我们。

landlord.example: The landlord fixed the broken heater in our apartment yesterday morning.
landlord.exampleZh: 房东昨天早上修好了我们公寓里坏掉的暖气。

landmark.example: The old tower is a famous landmark in our city.
landmark.exampleZh: 那座古塔是我们城市著名的地标。

landscape.example: The landscape here is beautiful in every season of the year.
landscape.exampleZh: 这里的风景一年四季都很美。

lane.example: The old man walked slowly down the narrow lane behind our house.
lane.exampleZh: 那位老人沿着我们屋后的窄巷慢慢走着。

language.example: Learning a new language takes time, but it is always worth trying.
language.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要时间，但总是值得一试。

lantern.example: We hung a red lantern outside the door during the spring festival.
lantern.exampleZh: 春节期间，我们在门外挂了一盏红灯笼。

lap.example: The cat sat on my lap and began to lick its paw.
lap.exampleZh: 猫坐在我的大腿上，开始舔它的爪子。

lapse.example: A short lapse in attention caused him to miss the last question.
lapse.exampleZh: 一时的疏忽让他漏掉了最后一道题。

laptop.example: I take my laptop to the library every day after class.
laptop.exampleZh: 我每天下课后都把笔记本电脑带到图书馆。

large.example: The large dog ran across the field to greet us.
large.exampleZh: 那只大狗跑过田野来迎接我们。

largely.example: The town's economy is largely based on farming and tourism.
largely.exampleZh: 这个小镇的经济主要依靠农业和旅游业。

laser.example: The doctor used a laser to cut the tissue during the operation.
laser.exampleZh: 医生在手术中使用激光切割组织。

lash.example: The strong wind lashed the trees and shook every window in the house.
lash.exampleZh: 狂风猛烈地抽打着树木，吹得屋里每扇窗户都晃动起来。

last.example: The last bus leaves at ten, and the rain will last all night.
last.exampleZh: 最后一班公交车十点开走，而这场雨会持续一整夜。

late.example: Sorry, I am late again because the bus was very slow.
late.exampleZh: 抱歉，我又迟到了，因为公交车开得很慢。

lately.example: I have been very busy lately and have not had time to call you.
lately.exampleZh: 我最近很忙，一直没时间给你打电话。

latency.example: The latency of the disease made it hard to detect early.
latency.exampleZh: 这种疾病的潜伏期使它难以被早期发现。

latent.example: The doctor said the disease may stay latent in the body for years.
latent.exampleZh: 医生说这种疾病可能在体内潜伏多年。

later.example: I will call you later when I get home from work.
later.exampleZh: 我下班回家后会给你打电话。

lateral.example: The lateral side of the box has a small hole.
lateral.exampleZh: 箱子的侧面有一个小洞。

latin.example: Many English words come from Latin and Greek roots.
latin.exampleZh: 许多英语单词来自拉丁语和希腊语词根。

latitude.example: The small island lies at a latitude of about thirty degrees north.
latitude.exampleZh: 这座小岛位于北纬约三十度。

latter.example: Of the two plans, the latter one seems much easier to follow.
latter.exampleZh: 这两个方案中，后一个似乎更容易遵循。

laugh.example: The children laugh at the funny story their teacher tells them.
laugh.exampleZh: 孩子们被老师讲的搞笑故事逗笑了。

laughter.example: The sound of laughter filled the room and made everyone happy.
laughter.exampleZh: 笑声充满了房间，让每个人都感到快乐。

launch.example: The company plans to launch its new phone next month.
launch.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月推出它的新手机。

laundry.example: I need to take my dirty clothes to the laundry this afternoon.
laundry.exampleZh: 我今天下午得把脏衣服送到洗衣店去。

lava.example: The hot lava flowed slowly down the side of the volcano.
lava.exampleZh: 炽热的熔岩沿着火山坡缓缓流下。

lavatory.example: The lavatory is at the end of the hall, next to the stairs.
lavatory.exampleZh: 厕所在大厅尽头，紧挨着楼梯。

law.example: Newton's law of gravity explains why apples fall to the ground.
law.exampleZh: 牛顿的万有引力定律解释了苹果为什么会落向地面。

lawn.example: The children are playing football on the lawn in front of our house.
lawn.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们房子前面的草坪上踢足球。

lawsuit.example: The company faces a lawsuit over the unsafe products it sold last year.
lawsuit.exampleZh: 该公司因去年销售的不安全产品而面临一场诉讼。

lawyer.example: My sister wants to become a lawyer because she likes helping people.
lawyer.exampleZh: 我姐姐想成为一名律师，因为她喜欢帮助别人。

lay.example: Please lay the books on the table before you leave.
lay.exampleZh: 请在你离开前把书放在桌子上。

layer.example: Each layer of the cake is soft and sweet.
layer.exampleZh: 蛋糕的每一层都松软香甜。

layoff.example: The company announced a big layoff because sales were very low.
layoff.exampleZh: 由于销售额很低，公司宣布了一次大规模裁员。

layout.example: The new layout of our office makes the rooms feel much bigger.
layout.exampleZh: 我们办公室的新布局让房间显得大多了。

lazy.example: He is too lazy to clean his room on weekends.
lazy.exampleZh: 他太懒了，周末都不打扫自己的房间。

lead.example: Good teachers lead students to ask questions and find answers by themselves.
lead.exampleZh: 好老师引导学生提出问题并自己找到答案。

leader.example: Our team leader always helps us solve problems and listens to everyone.
leader.exampleZh: 我们的团队领导者总是帮助我们解决问题，并倾听每个人的意见。

leadership.example: Her leadership helped the small team finish the hard project on time.
leadership.exampleZh: 她的领导能力帮助这个小团队按时完成了这个困难的项目。

leading.example: She is a leading expert in this field of science.
leading.exampleZh: 她是这个科学领域最重要的专家。

leaf.example: The green leaf fell from the tall tree and landed on the ground.
leaf.exampleZh: 那片绿叶从高高的树上落下，掉到了地上。

leaflet.example: She gave me a leaflet about the new library.
leaflet.exampleZh: 她给了我一份关于新图书馆的传单。

league.example: The small towns formed a league to protect their shared water supply.
league.exampleZh: 这些小镇组成了一个联盟，以保护它们共用的水源。

leak.example: The pipe is old and may leak water into the kitchen wall.
leak.exampleZh: 这根管子旧了，可能会漏水到厨房墙里。

lean.example: The old man leaned on his stick and walked slowly down the road.
lean.exampleZh: 老人倚着拐杖，沿着路慢慢走。

leap.example: She leaped over the small stream and ran to the car.
leap.exampleZh: 她跳过那条小溪，然后跑向汽车。

learn.example: I want to learn how to cook simple meals at home.
learn.exampleZh: 我想学会如何在家做简单的饭菜。

learned.example: The learned professor explained the difficult idea in a very simple way.
learned.exampleZh: 这位博学的教授用非常简单的方式解释了这个难懂的概念。

learning.example: Learning is important for every student who wants to grow.
learning.exampleZh: 学习对每个想要成长的学生都很重要。

lease.example: We signed a two-year lease for the small apartment near the park.
lease.exampleZh: 我们为公园附近那套小公寓签了一份两年的租约。

least.example: This old computer has the least memory of all the machines here.
least.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑是这里所有机器中内存最小的。

leather.example: He bought a brown leather bag for his sister.
leather.exampleZh: 他给妹妹买了一个棕色皮包。

leave.example: She will leave the office early and leave a note on the desk.
leave.exampleZh: 她会提早离开办公室，并在桌上留一张便条。

lecture.example: I listened to a lecture about the history of China.
lecture.exampleZh: 我听了一场关于中国历史的讲座。

left.example: Turn left at the bank, and my house is on the left side.
left.exampleZh: 在银行处向左转，我的房子就在左边。

leg.example: My left leg hurts after the long walk.
leg.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，我的左腿疼。

legacy.example: Her father left her a small legacy that helped her buy a house.
legacy.exampleZh: 她父亲留给她一笔小额遗产，帮她买下了一套房子。

legal.example: It is legal to drive a car in most countries after you turn eighteen.
legal.exampleZh: 在大多数国家，年满十八岁后开车是合法的。

legend.example: The old man told us a legend about the mountain near his village.
legend.exampleZh: 那位老人给我们讲了一个关于他村庄附近那座山的传说。

legislation.example: The new legislation will protect children from harm at work.
legislation.exampleZh: 这项新法规将保护儿童在工作中免受伤害。

legitimate.example: She has a legitimate reason to ask for more time.
legitimate.exampleZh: 她有正当理由要求更多时间。

leisure.example: I like to read books in my leisure time after work.
leisure.exampleZh: 下班后的闲暇时间里，我喜欢读书。

lemon.example: The lemon tree in our garden gives us a lot of fruit every year.
lemon.exampleZh: 我们花园里的柠檬树每年都给我们结很多果实。

lend.example: Can you lend me your bike for the weekend?
lend.exampleZh: 你能把自行车借给我用这个周末吗？

length.example: The length of the table is about two meters.
length.exampleZh: 这张桌子的长度大约是两米。

lens.example: The camera lens was dirty, so all my photos looked a little blurry.
lens.exampleZh: 相机镜头脏了，所以我所有照片看起来都有点模糊。

less.example: I have less free time this week than last week.
less.exampleZh: 我这周比上周的空闲时间更少。

lesson.example: That lesson taught me to be more careful with my money.
lesson.exampleZh: 那堂课教会了我要更小心地花钱。

lest.example: She spoke quietly lest she wake the sleeping baby.
lest.exampleZh: 她轻声说话，唯恐吵醒睡着的婴儿。

let.example: Let me help you carry those heavy boxes to the car.
let.exampleZh: 让我帮你把那些重箱子搬到车上去。

letter.example: I wrote a short letter to my teacher about the homework.
letter.exampleZh: 我给老师写了一封短信，谈了谈作业的事。

level.example: The water level in the river is very high this year.

liable.example: Drivers are liable for any damage they cause in an accident.
liable.exampleZh: 司机对事故中造成的任何损失负有法律责任。

liar.example: Nobody believes him now because he is a well-known liar.
liar.exampleZh: 现在没人相信他，因为他是个出了名的骗子。

liberal.example: She holds liberal views and often helps her neighbors with great generosity.
liberal.exampleZh: 她持有开明的观点，并且常常非常慷慨地帮助邻居。

liberate.example: The soldiers worked together to liberate the small town from enemy control.
liberate.exampleZh: 士兵们齐心协力把这座小镇从敌人的控制中解放出来。

liberty.example: The people fought for their liberty and won it after many long years.
liberty.exampleZh: 人民为自由而战，经过许多漫长的岁月终于赢得了自由。

librarian.example: The librarian helped me find a good book about animals.
librarian.exampleZh: 图书管理员帮我找到了一本关于动物的好书。

library.example: I often study in the library near my school after class.
library.exampleZh: 放学后我常常在学校附近的图书馆学习。

licence.example: You need a licence to drive a car in this country.
licence.exampleZh: 在这个国家开车需要执照。

lick.example: The little boy likes to lick the sweet ice cream off his spoon.
lick.exampleZh: 小男孩喜欢把勺子上的甜冰淇淋舔掉。

lid.example: She dropped the lid and it broke into three pieces.
lid.exampleZh: 她把盖子掉在地上，摔成了三块。

lie.example: The old dog likes to lie on the warm floor after lunch.
lie.exampleZh: 那只老狗喜欢在午饭后躺在温暖的地板上。

lieutenant.example: The young lieutenant led his soldiers across the field before sunrise.
lieutenant.exampleZh: 那位年轻的中尉在日出前带领士兵们穿过田野。

life.example: Reading good books every day makes my life happier and more interesting.
life.exampleZh: 每天读好书让我的生活更快乐、更有趣。

lifetime.example: She spent her lifetime helping children learn to read and write.
lifetime.exampleZh: 她一生都在帮助孩子们学习读书写字。

lift.example: She helped me lift the heavy box into the car.
lift.exampleZh: 她帮我把那个沉重的箱子抬进了车里。

light.example: Please turn on the light, it is too dark in here.
light.exampleZh: 请把灯打开，这里太黑了。

lightning.example: The lightning was very bright and lit up the whole sky.
lightning.exampleZh: 那道闪电非常明亮，照亮了整个天空。

like.example: I like reading books like this one because the stories are fun.
like.exampleZh: 我喜欢读像这样的书，因为故事很有趣。

likelihood.example: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow afternoon.
likelihood.exampleZh: 明天下午下雨的可能性很大。

likeness.example: There is a strong likeness between the two sisters.
likeness.exampleZh: 这两姐妹之间非常相像。

likewise.example: She works hard, and her brother likewise does well in school.
likewise.exampleZh: 她学习努力，她的弟弟在学校也同样表现出色。

limb.example: The doctor said the injured limb would heal in a few weeks.
limb.exampleZh: 医生说受伤的肢体会在几周内痊愈。

lime.example: The old wall was covered with a thin layer of lime.
lime.exampleZh: 那面旧墙上覆盖着一层薄薄的石灰。

limit.example: There is a speed limit on this road, so please drive slowly.
limit.exampleZh: 这条路有速度限制，所以请开慢一点。

limitation.example: One major limitation of this plan is its high cost.
limitation.exampleZh: 这个计划的一个主要局限是成本太高。

limited.example: The shop has limited seats, so we need to buy tickets early.
limited.exampleZh: 这家商店座位有限，所以我们需要早点买票。

line.example: Please stand in line and wait for your turn to buy the ticket.

linear.example: The graph shows a linear rise in temperature over five hours.
linear.exampleZh: 图表显示气温在五个小时内呈线性上升。

linger.example: A few guests lingered in the garden after dinner.
linger.exampleZh: 晚饭后有几个客人在花园里逗留。

link.example: The new bridge links the two small towns across the river.
link.exampleZh: 这座新桥连接了河两岸的两个小镇。

lion.example: The lion is a big wild cat that lives in Africa.
lion.exampleZh: 狮子是一种生活在非洲的大型野生猫科动物。

lip.example: She put a little red color on her lips before the party.
lip.exampleZh: 聚会前，她在嘴唇上涂了一点红色。

lipstick.example: She put on red lipstick before going to the party.
lipstick.exampleZh: 她去参加聚会前涂了红色口红。

liquid.example: Water is a liquid, and it helps every living thing grow.
liquid.exampleZh: 水是一种液体，它帮助每一个生物生长。

liquor.example: He drank too much liquor at the party last night.
liquor.exampleZh: 他昨晚在聚会上喝了太多烈酒。

list.example: Please list your name and phone number on this form for me.
list.exampleZh: 请在这张表上为我列出你的姓名和电话号码。

listen.example: Please listen carefully when your teacher is talking in class.
listen.exampleZh: 上课时老师讲话，请仔细听。

literacy.example: Good literacy helps people find better jobs and understand the world.
literacy.exampleZh: 良好的读写能力能帮助人们找到更好的工作，并理解这个世界。

literally.example: He literally ran ten miles to work this morning.
literally.exampleZh: 他今天早上确实跑了十英里路去上班。

literary.example: Her literary skills impressed all the teachers at our small school.
literary.exampleZh: 她的文学才能让我们这所小学校的所有老师都印象深刻。

literature.example: I like reading English literature because it helps me understand another culture.
literature.exampleZh: 我喜欢读英国文学，因为它帮助我了解另一种文化。

litre.example: I bought two litres of milk at the shop near my home.
litre.exampleZh: 我在家附近的商店买了两升牛奶。

litter.example: Please do not leave litter in the park after your picnic.
litter.exampleZh: 野餐结束后，请不要把垃圾留在公园里。

little.example: There is little water left in the bottle, so we must buy more.
little.exampleZh: 瓶子里剩下的水不多了，所以我们必须再买一些。

live.example: We live in a small house near the river.
live.exampleZh: 我们住在河边的一间小房子里。

livelihood.example: Fishing is the main livelihood for many families in this small village.
livelihood.exampleZh: 捕鱼是这个小镇上许多家庭的主要生计。

lively.example: The children are lively and full of fun at the party.
lively.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上很活泼，充满乐趣。

liver.example: The doctor said too much alcohol can hurt your liver.
liver.exampleZh: 医生说喝太多酒会伤害你的肝脏。

livestock.example: The farmer keeps livestock such as cows and sheep on his small farm.
livestock.exampleZh: 这个农民在他的小农场里饲养牛和羊等牲畜。

living.example: She is still living with her parents in a small town.
living.exampleZh: 她仍然和父母住在一个小镇上。

load.example: Too much homework is a heavy load for young students.
load.exampleZh: 太多作业对年轻学生来说是沉重的负担。

loaf.example: He bought a loaf of bread and then loafed around the park all afternoon.
loaf.exampleZh: 他买了一条面包，然后整个下午都在公园里闲逛。

loan.example: The bank gave him a loan to buy a small house for his family.
loan.exampleZh: 银行给他一笔贷款，让他为家人买一栋小房子。

lobby.example: The group waited in the hotel lobby before the meeting started.
lobby.exampleZh: 会议开始前，这群人在酒店大堂等候。

local.example: The local people are very friendly to visitors.
local.exampleZh: 当地人对游客非常友好。

locality.example: The police asked him to describe the locality where he lost his phone.
locality.exampleZh: 警方让他描述他丢失手机的那个地点。

locate.example: Please help me locate the nearest train station on this map.
locate.exampleZh: 请帮我在这张地图上找到最近的火车站的位置。

location.example: This is a good location for a small hotel near the beach.
location.exampleZh: 这里是靠近海滩、适合建一家小旅馆的好位置。

lock.example: Please lock the door before you leave the house tonight.
lock.exampleZh: 今晚离开房子前请把门锁上。

locomotive.example: The old locomotive pulled five heavy cars up the hill.
locomotive.exampleZh: 那台旧机车拉着五节沉重的车厢爬上山坡。

locust.example: A large group of locust landed on the farmer's field and ate everything.
locust.exampleZh: 一大群蝗虫落在农民的田地里，把一切都吃光了。

lodge.example: We will lodge a complaint with the hotel about the noise tonight.
lodge.exampleZh: 我们今晚将就噪音问题向酒店正式提出投诉。

lofty.example: The lofty mountain is covered with snow all year round.
lofty.exampleZh: 这座高耸的山全年被积雪覆盖。

log.example: The captain wrote the ship's position in the log every morning.
log.exampleZh: 船长每天早上把船的位置写入航海日志。

logic.example: The logic behind her argument was clear and easy to follow.
logic.exampleZh: 她论点背后的逻辑清晰易懂。

logical.example: It is logical to check your answers before you hand in the test.
logical.exampleZh: 交卷前检查答案是合乎情理的。

lonely.example: He felt lonely in the big city because he had no friends.
lonely.exampleZh: 他在大城市里感到很寂寞，因为他没有朋友。

long.example: This long road leads to the small village where I grew up.
long.exampleZh: 这条长长的路通向那个我长大的小村庄。

look.example: You look tired today, so please take a good rest tonight.
look.exampleZh: 你今天看起来很累，所以今晚请好好休息。

loop.example: The wire forms a small loop around the tree.
loop.exampleZh: 电线在树周围绕成一个小圈。

loose.example: His loose shirt made him look thinner than he really was.
loose.exampleZh: 他那件宽松的衬衫让他看起来比实际更瘦。

loosen.example: Please loosen the screws on the back of the chair before you move it.
loosen.exampleZh: 搬动椅子之前，请先松开背面的螺丝。

lord.example: The lord ruled the village and the people obeyed him.
lord.exampleZh: 这位领主统治着村庄，人们都服从他。

lorry.example: The lorry stopped in front of our house and the driver got out.
lorry.exampleZh: 那辆卡车停在我们家门前，司机下了车。

lose.example: Be careful with your keys, or you will lose them again.
lose.exampleZh: 小心你的钥匙，否则你又会把它们弄丢。

loss.example: The loss of his old dog made him very sad.
loss.exampleZh: 老狗的离世让他非常难过。

lost.example: The lost dog walked slowly down our quiet street last night.
lost.exampleZh: 那只迷路的狗昨晚沿着我们安静的街道慢慢走着。

lot.example: She won the lot in a lucky draw at the fair.
lot.exampleZh: 她在集市上的抽奖中赢得了这份奖品。

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太响了，请把它调低一点。

loudspeaker.example: The teacher spoke into a loudspeaker so everyone in the hall could hear her.
loudspeaker.exampleZh: 老师对着扬声器讲话，以便礼堂里的每个人都能听到她。

lounge.example: We waited in the hotel lounge before our room was ready.
lounge.exampleZh: 我们在酒店休息室里等着房间准备好。

love.example: I love my family, and I love reading books with them.
love.exampleZh: 我爱我的家人，也爱和他们一起读书。

lovely.example: The little girl has a lovely smile and everyone likes her.
lovely.exampleZh: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容，大家都喜欢她。

lover.example: She is a great lover of music and often goes to concerts.
lover.exampleZh: 她是个音乐爱好者，经常去听音乐会。

low.example: The chair is too low for the tall boy to sit on.
low.exampleZh: 这把椅子太矮了，那个高个子男孩坐不了。

lower.example: Please lower your voice because the baby is sleeping in the next room.
lower.exampleZh: 请把声音放低，因为宝宝在隔壁房间睡觉。

loyal.example: A loyal friend will always stand by you when life gets hard.
loyal.exampleZh: 当生活变得艰难时，忠诚的朋友总会站在你身边。

loyalty.example: Her loyalty to her friends made her a person everyone trusted.
loyalty.exampleZh: 她对朋友的忠诚让她成为一个大家都信任的人。

luck.example: I wish you good luck in your new job.

lucky.example: She felt lucky to find a seat on the crowded bus.
lucky.exampleZh: 在拥挤的公交车上能找到座位，她觉得很幸运。

luggage.example: I put my luggage in the car and drove to the airport.
luggage.exampleZh: 我把行李放进车里，然后开车去了机场。

lumber.example: They used lumber from the old barn to build a new fence.
lumber.exampleZh: 他们用旧谷仓的木料建了一道新栅栏。

lump.example: The doctor found a small lump on my neck and told me not to worry.
lump.exampleZh: 医生在我脖子上发现了一个小肿块，并告诉我不用担心。

lunar.example: The lunar calendar is very important in Chinese culture and daily life.
lunar.exampleZh: 阴历在中国文化和日常生活中非常重要。

lunch.example: We usually eat lunch at school at twelve every day.
lunch.exampleZh: 我们通常每天十二点在学校吃午饭。

lung.example: Smoking is very bad for your lungs and your heart.
lung.exampleZh: 吸烟对肺和心脏都非常有害。

luxury.example: She saved money for a year to buy one small luxury for herself.
luxury.exampleZh: 她攒了一年的钱，为自己买了一件小小的奢侈品。

machine.example: This machine helps workers make shoes in the factory every day.
machine.exampleZh: 这台机器每天帮助工人在工厂里制作鞋子。

machinery.example: The new machinery in the factory is very loud.
machinery.exampleZh: 工厂里的新机器声音很大。

madam.example: The saleswoman smiled and asked the madam if she needed any help.
madam.exampleZh: 女售货员微笑着问这位女士是否需要帮助。

magazine.example: She reads a fashion magazine every month to find new clothes for work.
magazine.exampleZh: 她每个月都读一本时尚杂志，为上班寻找新衣服。

magic.example: The children believe the old book is full of magic and funny stories.
magic.exampleZh: 孩子们相信这本旧书充满了魔力和有趣的故事。

magician.example: The magician pulled a white rabbit out of his hat.
magician.exampleZh: 魔术师从帽子里拽出一只白兔。

magistrate.example: The magistrate listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
magistrate.exampleZh: 地方法官在做出决定前仔细倾听了双方的陈述。

magnet.example: This small magnet can hold the note on the fridge door.
magnet.exampleZh: 这块小磁铁能把便条吸在冰箱门上。

magnetic.example: The magnetic toy sticks to the fridge door.
magnetic.exampleZh: 这个磁性玩具会吸附在冰箱门上。

magnetism.example: The magnetism of the old city attracts many young artists every year.
magnetism.exampleZh: 这座古城的魅力每年吸引许多年轻艺术家。

magnificent.example: The old church has a magnificent view of the whole city.
magnificent.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂能看到全城壮丽的景色。

magnify.example: A microscope can magnify very small things so we can see them clearly.
magnify.exampleZh: 显微镜能放大很小的东西，让我们看清它们。

maiden.example: The maiden sang a sweet song at the village fair.
maiden.exampleZh: 那位少女在乡村集市上唱了一首甜美的歌。

mail.example: I check my mail every morning before I go to work.
mail.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会查看邮件。

main.example: The main road is very busy in the morning.
main.exampleZh: 这条路是主干道，早上非常繁忙。

mainland.example: Many people travel from the islands to the mainland for work.
mainland.exampleZh: 许多人从岛上到大陆去工作。

maintain.example: We must maintain good habits to stay healthy and happy.
maintain.exampleZh: 我们必须保持良好的习惯才能保持健康和快乐。

maintenance.example: The old car needs regular maintenance to keep it running well.
maintenance.exampleZh: 这辆旧车需要定期保养才能保持良好运转。

majesty.example: The majesty of the mountains made everyone stop and look up in silence.
majesty.exampleZh: 群山的雄伟让每个人都停下脚步，默默仰望。

major.example: Her major is English, and she also studies French.
major.exampleZh: 她的主修科目是英语，另外她还学习法语。

majority.example: The majority of students in our class walk to school every day.
majority.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生每天步行上学。

make.example: My mother makes good soup for us every Sunday.
make.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都给我们做美味的汤。

male.example: The male students in our class play football every Friday afternoon.
male.exampleZh: 我们班的男生每周五下午都踢足球。

mall.example: We spent the whole afternoon shopping at the mall near our house.
mall.exampleZh: 我们整个下午都在家附近的购物中心逛街。

man.example: The old man walked slowly down the road with his dog.
man.exampleZh: 那位老人带着他的狗沿着路慢慢走着。

manage.example: She manages a small shop and also manages her time well.
manage.exampleZh: 她经营一家小店，也能很好地管理自己的时间。

management.example: Good management helps small teams finish their work on time.
management.exampleZh: 良好的管理能帮助小团队按时完成工作。

manager.example: The manager will meet the new team members this afternoon.
manager.exampleZh: 经理今天下午将会见新团队成员。

manifest.example: His smile manifested that he was truly happy with the news.
manifest.exampleZh: 他的笑容表明他对这个消息真的很高兴。

manipulate.example: He tried to manipulate the results to make his team look better.
manipulate.exampleZh: 他试图篡改结果，好让他的团队看起来更出色。

mankind.example: Some people believe that mankind must work together to protect the earth.
mankind.exampleZh: 一些人认为人类必须共同努力保护地球。

manner.example: Her friendly manner makes everyone feel welcome at the new office.
manner.exampleZh: 她友好的态度让每个人在新办公室里都感到受欢迎。

manual.example: I read the manual before I fixed the machine by hand.
manual.exampleZh: 我在手工修理这台机器之前先读了说明书。

manufacture.example: The company manufactures cheap shoes for sale in many countries.
manufacture.exampleZh: 这家公司生产廉价鞋子，销往许多国家。

manuscript.example: She sent the manuscript to three publishers before one accepted it.
manuscript.exampleZh: 她把这份手稿寄给了三家出版社，最后一家才接受。

many.example: Many students in our class walk to school every morning.
many.exampleZh: 我们班许多学生每天早上步行去学校。

map.example: We used a map to find the shortest way to the old town.
map.exampleZh: 我们用地图找到了去老城区最近的路。

marble.example: The old church is built of white marble and stands near the river.
marble.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂是用白色大理石建造的，坐落在河边。

march.example: The soldiers march forward together every morning before the sun rises.
march.exampleZh: 士兵们每天早上在太阳升起前一起向前行进。

margin.example: Please write your notes in the margin of the page.
margin.exampleZh: 请把笔记写在页面的页边空白处。

marginal.example: His role in the project was marginal, so nobody noticed when he left.
marginal.exampleZh: 他在这个项目中的作用很小，所以他离开时没人注意到。

marine.example: The marine animals in this area are protected by law.
marine.exampleZh: 这个区域的海洋动物受法律保护。

mark.example: The teacher put a red mark on my test paper.
mark.exampleZh: 老师在我的试卷上打了一个红色的分数。

market.example: The small town holds a busy market every Saturday morning.
market.exampleZh: 这个小镇每周六上午都有一个热闹的集市。

marriage.example: Their marriage has been happy for over thirty years.
marriage.exampleZh: 他们的婚姻三十多年来一直很幸福。

married.example: My sister is married and lives in a small house with her husband.
married.exampleZh: 我姐姐已经结婚了，和丈夫住在一间小房子里。

marry.example: They plan to marry next spring after they both finish school.
marry.exampleZh: 他们打算明年春天两人都毕业后结婚。

marvel.example: We marvel at the stars and the marvel of the night sky.
marvel.exampleZh: 我们惊叹于星辰，也惊叹于夜空的奇景。

marvelous.example: It was a marvelous day for a walk in the park with my friends.
marvelous.exampleZh: 那天天气极好，非常适合和朋友们去公园散步。

marxist.example: He wrote a short book about Marxist ideas and their history.
marxist.exampleZh: 他写了一本关于马克思主义思想及其历史的短书。

masculine.example: He has a deep voice and a strong, masculine way of speaking.
masculine.exampleZh: 他嗓音低沉，说话方式很有男子气概。

mask.example: He wore a mask on the bus and tried to mask his fear.
mask.exampleZh: 他在公交车上戴着口罩，并试图掩饰自己的恐惧。

mass.example: A large mass of dark clouds covered the sky before the storm.
mass.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，一大团乌云遮住了天空。

massacre.example: The soldiers were ordered to massacre the people in the village.
massacre.exampleZh: 士兵们奉命屠杀村子里的百姓。

massive.example: The old bridge is massive and very heavy.

master.example: She worked hard to master English and became a master of it.
master.exampleZh: 她努力学习掌握英语，并成为了英语大师。

masterpiece.example: This old painting is a masterpiece of modern art.
masterpiece.exampleZh: 这幅古老的画是现代艺术的一件杰作。

mat.example: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before you come into the house.
mat.exampleZh: 进屋前请在蹭脚垫上擦干净鞋子。

match.example: This old key does not match the lock on my front door.
match.exampleZh: 这把旧钥匙和我家前门的锁不匹配。

mate.example: My mate at work always helps me finish the reports on time.
mate.exampleZh: 我的同事总是帮我按时完成报告。

material.example: This material is soft and cheap, so we use it to make bags.
material.exampleZh: 这种材料又软又便宜，所以我们用它来做包。

math.example: I am not good at math, but my sister loves it.
math.exampleZh: 我不擅长数学，但我妹妹很喜欢。

mathematical.example: She has a mathematical way of thinking that makes hard problems look simple.
mathematical.exampleZh: 她有一种数学式的思维方式，能让难题看起来很简单。

mathematics.example: She studies mathematics at university and hopes to become a teacher.
mathematics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习数学，希望成为一名教师。

matter.example: It does not matter if we are a little late today.
matter.exampleZh: 我们今天稍微迟到一点没关系。

mature.example: She is very mature for her age and always thinks before she acts.
mature.exampleZh: 就她的年龄而言，她非常成熟，做事总是三思而后行。

maximum.example: The maximum speed of this small car is 120 kilometers per hour.
maximum.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车的最高时速是每小时120公里。

may.example: You may sit here and wait for your friend to come.
may.exampleZh: 你可以坐在这里等你的朋友来。

maybe.example: Maybe she will come to the party with her brother tonight.
maybe.exampleZh: 也许她今晚会和她的哥哥一起来参加聚会。

mayor.example: The mayor opened the new library in our town last week.
mayor.exampleZh: 市长上周为我们镇的新图书馆揭幕。

meadow.example: The cows are eating grass in the green meadow behind our house.
meadow.exampleZh: 奶牛正在我们房子后面的绿色草地上吃草。

meal.example: We had a delicious meal with our family last night.
meal.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和家人吃了一顿美味的一餐。

mean.example: I did not mean to hurt you with those unkind words.
mean.exampleZh: 我不是故意用那些刻薄的话伤害你的。

meaning.example: I don't understand the meaning of this word.
meaning.exampleZh: 我不明白这个单词的意思。

means.example: This small tool is a good means of fixing old chairs.
means.exampleZh: 这个小工具是修理旧椅子的好方法。

meantime.example: In the meantime, she made some tea and waited for his call.
meantime.exampleZh: 在此期间，她泡了些茶，等着他的电话。

meanwhile.example: She cooked dinner; meanwhile, the children finished their homework.
meanwhile.exampleZh: 她在做晚饭，与此同时，孩子们完成了作业。

measurable.example: The new plan had a measurable effect on our daily work.
measurable.exampleZh: 这项新计划对我们的日常工作产生了显著影响。

measure.example: We need to measure the room before we buy new furniture.
measure.exampleZh: 买新家具之前，我们需要测量一下房间。

measurement.example: The tailor took my measurements before he made the new suit.
measurement.exampleZh: 裁缝在做新西装之前量了我的尺寸。

meat.example: The main meat of his speech was about saving money.
meat.exampleZh: 他演讲的主要部分是关于省钱的。

mechanic.example: The mechanic fixed my car in less than an hour.
mechanic.exampleZh: 这位技工不到一小时就修好了我的车。

mechanical.example: The robot makes mechanical movements when it picks up the boxes.
mechanical.exampleZh: 机器人搬箱子时的动作很机械。

mechanism.example: The body has a natural mechanism to fight infection and stay healthy.
mechanism.exampleZh: 身体有一种天然的机制来抵抗感染并保持健康。

medal.example: She won a gold medal in the swimming race last week.
medal.exampleZh: 她上周在游泳比赛中赢得了一枚金牌。

media.example: Social media helps people share news quickly with their friends and family.
media.exampleZh: 社交媒体帮助人们快速与朋友和家人分享新闻。

medical.example: My sister wants to study medical science at a good university next year.
medical.exampleZh: 我姐姐想明年在一所好大学学习医学。

medicine.example: The doctor gave me medicine for my bad cough.
medicine.exampleZh: 医生给了我治严重咳嗽的药。

medieval.example: This old castle was built in medieval times.
medieval.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡建于中世纪时期。

meditate.example: Before making a big decision, I like to meditate on it quietly.
meditate.exampleZh: 在做重大决定之前，我喜欢安静地仔细思考一下。

medium.example: The blue shirt is a medium size, and it fits me well.
medium.exampleZh: 这件蓝色衬衫是中号，很适合我。

meet.example: I will meet my friend at the train station tomorrow morning.
meet.exampleZh: 我明天早上会在火车站见我的朋友。

meeting.example: I have a meeting with my teacher after school today.
meeting.exampleZh: 今天放学后我和老师有个会面。

melt.example: The ice will melt quickly in the warm sun.
melt.exampleZh: 冰在温暖的阳光下会很快融化。

member.example: Every member of the club must pay the fee before Friday.
member.exampleZh: 俱乐部的每位成员必须在周五之前缴纳会费。

membership.example: My membership at the sports club lets me use the pool for free.
membership.exampleZh: 我在体育俱乐部的会员资格让我可以免费使用游泳池。

memorial.example: We visited the war memorial in the park last Sunday.
memorial.exampleZh: 上周日我们参观了公园里的战争纪念碑。

memory.example: Music can bring back happy memories of my childhood in the countryside.
memory.exampleZh: 音乐能唤起我对乡下童年的快乐回忆。

men.example: Three men are waiting outside the door for their friend.
men.exampleZh: 三个男人在门外等他们的朋友。

mend.example: My father will mend the old chair this afternoon.
mend.exampleZh: 我父亲今天下午会修理那把旧椅子。

mental.example: Regular exercise is good for both your physical and mental health.
mental.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的身体健康和精神健康都有好处。

mention.example: She did not mention the problem to her parents.
mention.exampleZh: 她没有向父母提起这个问题。

menu.example: The waiter gave us a menu with many Chinese dishes.
menu.exampleZh: 服务员给了我们一份有很多中国菜的菜单。

merchant.example: The merchant sold fresh fruit and vegetables at the market every morning.
merchant.exampleZh: 这位商贩每天早上在市场卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

mercy.example: The kind doctor showed mercy and helped the poor family for free.
mercy.exampleZh: 那位善良的医生出于怜悯，免费帮助了这个贫困家庭。

mere.example: The mere thought of losing her made him feel very sad.
mere.exampleZh: 仅仅想到失去她，他就感到非常难过。

merely.example: He is merely a friend, not my boyfriend.
merely.exampleZh: 他只不过是个朋友，不是我的男朋友。

merge.example: The two small companies will merge into one large team next year.
merge.exampleZh: 这两家小公司明年将合并成一个大的团队。

merit.example: Everyone agrees that her honesty is her greatest merit as a leader.
merit.exampleZh: 大家都同意，诚实是她作为领导者最大的优点。

merry.example: The children were merry at the party last night.
merry.exampleZh: 孩子们在昨晚的聚会上很欢乐。

mess.example: The kitchen was a mess after the party, so we cleaned it together.
mess.exampleZh: 派对结束后厨房一片狼藉，所以我们一起打扫了。

message.example: I got a message from my teacher this morning.
message.exampleZh: 今天早上我收到了老师的一条消息。

metal.example: This box is made of metal and is very strong.
metal.exampleZh: 这个盒子是用金属做的，非常结实。

meter.example: The water meter shows that we used less water this month.
meter.exampleZh: 水表显示我们这个月用水量减少了。

method.example: She has a good method for learning new words every day.
method.exampleZh: 她有一套每天学习新单词的好方法。

metre.example: The room is three metres wide and very bright.
metre.exampleZh: 这个房间有三米宽，非常明亮。

metric.example: The scientist used metric units to measure the length of the table.
metric.exampleZh: 科学家用公制单位测量了桌子的长度。

metro.example: I take the metro to work every morning.
metro.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐地铁上班。

mexico.example: My aunt lives in Mexico and teaches English at a small school.
mexico.exampleZh: 我姑姑住在墨西哥，在一所小学校教英语。

microphone.example: The teacher spoke into the microphone so all the students could hear her.
microphone.exampleZh: 老师对着麦克风讲话，这样所有学生都能听到她的声音。

microscope.example: The students looked at the tiny cells through a microscope in class.
microscope.exampleZh: 学生们在课堂上通过显微镜观察了这些微小的细胞。

microwave.example: She heated the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
microwave.exampleZh: 她用微波炉把汤加热了两分钟。

middle.example: There is a small table in the middle of the room.
middle.exampleZh: 房间中间有一张小桌子。

midnight.example: The train leaves at midnight, so we must go to the station early.
midnight.exampleZh: 火车午夜出发，所以我们必须早点去车站。

might.example: She might come to the party with her sister tonight.
might.exampleZh: 她今晚可能会和妹妹一起来参加聚会。

migrant.example: Every winter, these migrants fly south to find warmer weather.
migrant.exampleZh: 每年冬天，这些候鸟飞往南方寻找更温暖的天气。

mild.example: The weather is mild today, so we can walk outside.
mild.exampleZh: 今天天气温和，所以我们可以到外面散步。

mile.example: The nearest gas station is one mile away from our house.
mile.exampleZh: 最近的加油站在离我们家一英里远的地方。

military.example: The military often helps people after a big storm.
military.exampleZh: 军方经常在强风暴过后帮助人们。

milk.example: The farmer gets up early every morning to milk the cows.
milk.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上早起给奶牛挤奶。

mill.example: The old mill by the river still makes flour for the village.
mill.exampleZh: 河边的那座老磨坊仍然为村里磨面粉。

millimetre.example: The box is only a few millimetres wider than my phone.
millimetre.exampleZh: 这个盒子只比我的手机宽几毫米。

million.example: Millions of people watched the game on TV last night.
million.exampleZh: 昨晚有数百万人在电视上观看了这场比赛。

millionaire.example: The old millionaire gives a lot of money to help poor children.
millionaire.exampleZh: 这位老富翁捐出很多钱来帮助贫困儿童。

mind.example: Please keep an open mind when you hear new ideas from others.
mind.exampleZh: 听到别人的新想法时，请保持开放的心态。

mine.example: This book is mine, but that old mine is owned by my uncle.
mine.exampleZh: 这本书是我的，但那座老矿是我叔叔的。

mineral.example: This rock contains many valuable minerals, and it is a mineral sample.
mineral.exampleZh: 这块石头含有许多有价值的矿物，它是一个矿物样本。

minimum.example: Please keep your answers to a minimum of two pages.
minimum.exampleZh: 请把你的答案保持在至少两页的最低限度。

minister.example: The minister will speak to the students about the new school plan.
minister.exampleZh: 部长将向学生们介绍新的学校计划。

ministry.example: The ministry of health announced a new plan to help poor families.
ministry.exampleZh: 卫生部宣布了一项帮助贫困家庭的新计划。

minor.example: The singer wrote a minor song about his quiet hometown.
minor.exampleZh: 这位歌手写了一首关于他宁静家乡的小调歌曲。

minority.example: Only a small minority of students voted against the new plan.
minority.exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生投票反对这个新计划。

minus.example: The temperature is minus five degrees, so wear a warm coat today.
minus.exampleZh: 气温是零下五度，所以今天要穿件暖和的外套。

minute.example: The meeting will start in a minute, so please take your seat.
minute.exampleZh: 会议一分钟后开始，请就座。

miracle.example: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt in the car accident.
miracle.exampleZh: 车祸中没有人受伤，真是个奇迹。

mirror.example: The lake is like a mirror that reflects the trees and the sky.
mirror.exampleZh: 湖面就像一面镜子，映出树木和天空。

miserable.example: The cold rain made everyone feel miserable all day long.
miserable.exampleZh: 冰冷的雨让大家一整天都感到痛苦难受。

misery.example: The war brought great misery to many poor families.
misery.exampleZh: 战争给许多贫困家庭带来了巨大的苦难。

mislead.example: Bad ads can mislead people and make them buy things they do not need.
mislead.exampleZh: 不良广告会误导人们，使他们买下自己并不需要的东西。

miss.example: I miss my old friends, but I never miss the morning bus.
miss.exampleZh: 我想念我的老朋友，但我从不错过早班公交车。

missile.example: The missile flew through the night sky and hit its target.
missile.exampleZh: 导弹穿过夜空，击中了目标。

missing.example: One page is missing from this book, so I cannot finish the story.
missing.exampleZh: 这本书缺了一页，所以我没法读完这个故事。

mission.example: Her mission is to help children learn to read.
mission.exampleZh: 她的使命是帮助孩子们学会阅读。

missionary.example: The missionary traveled to a small village to teach children and help sick people.
missionary.exampleZh: 这位传教士前往一个小村庄教孩子们并帮助病人。

mist.example: The mist over the lake was so thick that we could not see the other side.
mist.exampleZh: 湖面上的薄雾非常浓，我们看不到对岸。

mistake.example: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so please don't be too hard on yourself.
mistake.exampleZh: 每个人有时都会犯错，所以请不要太苛责自己。

misunderstand.example: I often misunderstand my friend because we speak different languages.
misunderstand.exampleZh: 我经常误解我的朋友，因为我们说不同的语言。

mix.example: You can mix the flour and water together in a big bowl.
mix.exampleZh: 你可以把面粉和水在一个大碗里混合在一起。

mixture.example: This cake is a mixture of flour, eggs and sugar.
mixture.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕是面粉、鸡蛋和糖的混合物。

moan.example: She began to moan softly when the nurse changed the bandage.
moan.exampleZh: 护士更换绷带时，她开始轻声呻吟。

mob.example: An angry mob gathered outside the city hall and shouted at the officials.
mob.exampleZh: 一群愤怒的暴民聚集在市政厅外，对着官员们大喊大叫。

mobile.example: My mobile phone is always in my bag when I go out.
mobile.exampleZh: 我出门时，我的手机总是在包里。

mobilize.example: The teacher helped mobilize students to clean the school garden last weekend.
mobilize.exampleZh: 老师帮助动员学生们上周末清理学校花园。

mock.example: The older students mocked him, but he did not care at all.
mock.exampleZh: 年长的学生嘲笑他，但他一点也不在乎。

mode.example: This phone has a silent mode that is very useful in meetings.
mode.exampleZh: 这款手机有一个静音模式，在开会时非常有用。

model.example: She built a small model of the bridge for her science class.
model.exampleZh: 她为科学课做了一个小型的桥模型。

moderate.example: She does moderate exercise every morning to stay healthy and happy.
moderate.exampleZh: 她每天早上做适度的运动，以保持健康和快乐。

modern.example: Modern technology makes our daily life much easier and faster.
modern.exampleZh: 现代科技让我们的日常生活变得更轻松、更快捷。

modest.example: She is a modest person who never talks about her success.
modest.exampleZh: 她是个谦虚的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

modify.example: We need to modify the plan before the meeting starts tomorrow.
modify.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天会议开始前修改这个计划。

moist.example: The cake stays moist if you keep it in a closed box.
moist.exampleZh: 如果把蛋糕放在密闭的盒子里，它就能保持湿润。

moisture.example: The moisture in the air makes the room feel very wet.
moisture.exampleZh: 空气中的湿气让房间感觉很潮湿。

mold.example: The old bread had green mold on it, so we threw it away.
mold.exampleZh: 那块旧面包上长了绿色霉菌，所以我们把它扔掉了。

molecule.example: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.exampleZh: 一个水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

mom.example: My mom makes breakfast for me every morning before school.
mom.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上在我上学前为我做早饭。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find your file.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我找一下你的文件。

momentum.example: The team's momentum slowed when their best player got hurt.
momentum.exampleZh: 当最好的球员受伤时，球队的势头减弱了。

monarch.example: The monarch ruled the country for forty years and was loved by many people.
monarch.exampleZh: 这位君主统治了该国四十年，深受许多人民的爱戴。

monastery.example: The old monastery stands quietly on the hill above our village.
monastery.exampleZh: 那座古老的修道院静静地矗立在我们村庄上方的山上。

monday.example: I will see the doctor next Monday morning.
monday.exampleZh: 我下周一早上要去看医生。

money.example: He saved enough money to buy a new bike for his sister.
money.exampleZh: 他攒了足够的钱给妹妹买了一辆新自行车。

monitor.example: The teacher monitors the students during the exam and keeps the classroom quiet.
monitor.exampleZh: 老师在考试期间监视学生，并保持教室安静。

monkey.example: The little monkey climbed the tall tree and ate a banana.
monkey.exampleZh: 那只小猴子爬上高高的树，吃了一根香蕉。

month.example: I will visit my grandmother next month with my parents.
month.exampleZh: 下个月我会和父母一起去看望我的祖母。

monthly.example: We pay the rent monthly, and the amount is the same every month.
monthly.exampleZh: 我们每月付房租，金额每个月都一样。

monument.example: The old monument stands in the middle of the city square.
monument.exampleZh: 这座古老的纪念碑矗立在城市广场的中央。

mood.example: Her mood improved after she heard the good news.
mood.exampleZh: 她听到这个好消息后，心情变好了。

moon.example: The moon is very bright tonight, so we can walk home without a flashlight.
moon.exampleZh: 今晚月亮很亮，所以我们不用手电筒就能走回家。

moral.example: She is a moral person who always tries to help others in need.
moral.exampleZh: 她是个有道德的人，总是尽力帮助有需要的人。

more.example: We need more time and more help to finish this work.
more.exampleZh: 我们需要更多的时间和更多的帮助来完成这项工作。

moreover.example: The room is small and clean; moreover, it is very cheap.
moreover.exampleZh: 这个房间又小又干净，而且非常便宜。

morning.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before I go to work.
morning.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都喝一杯咖啡。

mortal.example: Every mortal must face the fact that life is short.
mortal.exampleZh: 每个凡人都必须面对生命短暂这一事实。

mortgage.example: They took out a mortgage to buy their first house last year.
mortgage.exampleZh: 他们去年办了一笔按揭，买下了自己的第一套房子。

mosque.example: We visited a beautiful old mosque during our trip to the city.
mosque.exampleZh: 我们在此次城市之旅中参观了一座美丽的古老清真寺。

mosquito.example: A mosquito bit my arm last night and left a red mark.
mosquito.exampleZh: 昨晚一只蚊子咬了我的胳膊，留下了一个红印。

most.example: Most students in our class like to play basketball after school.
most.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后打篮球。

mostly.example: My friends are mostly from the same city, and we meet quite often.
mostly.exampleZh: 我的朋友大多来自同一个城市，我们经常见面。

mother.example: My mother makes good food for the family every day.
mother.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天为家人做好吃的饭菜。

motion.example: The teacher made a motion with her hand to ask the class to be quiet.
motion.exampleZh: 老师用手做了个手势，让全班安静下来。

motivate.example: Good teachers motivate students to work hard and never give up.
motivate.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生努力学习，永不放弃。

motive.example: I do not understand his motive for leaving the job so suddenly.
motive.exampleZh: 我不明白他如此突然离职的动机。
