motor.example: The motor in this old car makes a loud noise every morning.
motor.exampleZh: 这辆旧汽车的发动机每天早上都会发出很大的噪音。

motorway.example: We drove north on the motorway for three hours to visit my grandparents.
motorway.exampleZh: 我们在高速公路上向北开了三个小时去看望我的祖父母。

mount.example: They plan to mount new cameras on the front wall today.
mount.exampleZh: 他们计划今天在前墙上安装新的摄像头。

mountain.example: The mountain is very high and covered with white snow.
mountain.exampleZh: 这座山很高，山上覆盖着白雪。

mourn.example: We mourn for the people we lost, but we also remember their love.
mourn.exampleZh: 我们为失去的人哀悼，但也铭记他们的爱。

mouse.example: The mouse ran quickly under the table when it heard the loud noise.
mouse.exampleZh: 老鼠听到巨响后迅速跑到了桌子底下。

mouth.example: He opened his mouth wide and took a big bite of the apple.
mouth.exampleZh: 他张大嘴，咬了一大口苹果。

move.example: We plan to move to a new house next spring.
move.exampleZh: 我们打算明年春天搬到一栋新房子里。

movement.example: The slow movement of the clouds told us a storm was coming.
movement.exampleZh: 云朵缓慢的移动告诉我们暴风雨要来了。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie at home last night.
movie.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在家看了一部有趣的电影。

much.example: I don't have much time to finish my homework today.
much.exampleZh: 我今天没有太多时间完成作业。

mud.example: After the heavy rain, the kids came home with mud on their shoes.
mud.exampleZh: 大雨过后，孩子们回到家时鞋上沾满了泥。

mug.example: He poured hot coffee into a big mug and sat by the window.
mug.exampleZh: 他把热咖啡倒进一个大马克杯里，然后坐在窗边。

multiple.example: She has multiple jobs and works every day of the week.
multiple.exampleZh: 她有多份工作，一周每天都上班。

multiply.example: If you multiply five by three, you get fifteen.
multiply.exampleZh: 如果你用五乘以三，结果就是十五。

multitude.example: A multitude of people gathered in the square to watch the show.
multitude.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看表演。

municipal.example: The municipal government is building a new park near our school.
municipal.exampleZh: 市政府正在我们学校附近建一个新公园。

murder.example: The police found the man who committed the murder last night.
murder.exampleZh: 警方找到了昨晚犯下那起谋杀案的那个男人。

murderer.example: The police finally caught the murderer of the old man.
murderer.exampleZh: 警方最终抓住了杀害那位老人的凶手。

muscle.example: He goes to the gym every day to build strong muscles in his arms and legs.
muscle.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房，锻炼手臂和腿部的强壮肌肉。

museum.example: We visited a small museum about local history last Saturday.
museum.exampleZh: 上周六我们参观了一个关于当地历史的小博物馆。

music.example: She listens to music every morning while she makes breakfast.
music.exampleZh: 她每天早上做早餐时都会听音乐。

musical.example: She is very musical and can play three instruments well.
musical.exampleZh: 她很有音乐天赋，能演奏好三种乐器。

musician.example: My uncle is a musician and he plays the piano very well.
musician.exampleZh: 我叔叔是一位音乐家，他钢琴弹得很好。

must.example: You must finish your homework before you watch TV tonight.
must.exampleZh: 你今晚必须先完成作业才能看电视。

mutual.example: They have mutual respect, so they always listen to each other.
mutual.exampleZh: 他们相互尊重，所以总是彼此倾听。

my.example: My brother and I ride our bikes to school every day.
my.exampleZh: 我和我弟弟每天骑自行车上学。

myself.example: I hurt myself while playing basketball with my friends yesterday.
myself.exampleZh: 我昨天和朋友们打篮球时伤到了自己。

mysterious.example: The old house on the hill looks mysterious at night.
mysterious.exampleZh: 山上那座老房子在夜里显得很神秘。

mystery.example: The old house is a mystery to everyone in our small town.
mystery.exampleZh: 那栋老房子对我们小镇上的每个人来说都是个谜。

myth.example: Many people believe the old myth about dragons living in the mountains.
myth.exampleZh: 许多人相信关于龙生活在山中的古老神话。

nag.example: My mother keeps nagging me to clean my room every day.
nag.exampleZh: 我妈每天都唠叨着让我打扫房间。

nail.example: He used a hammer to nail the picture to the wall.
nail.exampleZh: 他用锤子把画钉到墙上。

naive.example: It is naive to believe everything you read online.
naive.exampleZh: 相信网上读到的一切是天真的。

naked.example: The little boy ran across the sand with naked feet.
naked.exampleZh: 那个小男孩光着脚跑过沙滩。

name.example: Please write your name at the top of the page.
name.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面顶端。

namely.example: We need two things, namely time and money, to finish this work.
namely.exampleZh: 我们需要两样东西，即时间和金钱，才能完成这项工作。

nap.example: After lunch, the baby took a short nap on the sofa.
nap.exampleZh: 午饭后，宝宝在沙发上小睡了一会儿。

narrate.example: She will narrate the story to the children tonight.
narrate.exampleZh: 她今晚要给孩子们讲述这个故事。

narrative.example: The movie tells a simple narrative about a young boy and his dog.
narrative.exampleZh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于一个小男孩和他的狗的简单故事。

narrow.example: The street is too narrow for two cars to pass.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条街太窄了，两辆车无法同时通过。

nasty.example: That was a nasty fall, but he is fine now.
nasty.exampleZh: 那一跤摔得很严重，但他现在没事了。

nation.example: The whole nation celebrated the victory with music and dancing in the streets.
nation.exampleZh: 全国上下在街头载歌载舞庆祝这场胜利。

national.example: The national team will play a big game in the city this weekend.
national.exampleZh: 国家队这个周末将在这座城市进行一场重要的比赛。

nationality.example: Please write your name and nationality on this form.
nationality.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和国籍。

native.example: She is a native speaker of English and teaches the language at a local school.
native.exampleZh: 她的母语是英语，并在一所本地学校教授这门语言。

natural.example: It feels natural to walk barefoot on the soft grass.
natural.exampleZh: 光脚走在柔软的草地上感觉很自然。

naturally.example: She naturally speaks English well because she grew up in London.
naturally.exampleZh: 她天生英语说得好，因为她是在伦敦长大的。

nature.example: It is in his nature to help people who are in trouble.

naval.example: My uncle works at a naval base near the sea.
naval.exampleZh: 我叔叔在海边的一个海军基地工作。

navigation.example: The ship's navigation system helps sailors find the right way at sea.
navigation.exampleZh: 这艘船的导航系统帮助水手在海上找到正确的航线。

navy.example: My uncle joined the navy when he was eighteen years old.
navy.exampleZh: 我叔叔十八岁时加入了海军。

near.example: My new school is near a big park and the train station.
near.exampleZh: 我的新学校靠近一个大公园和火车站。

nearby.example: There is a small park nearby where children like to play.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有一个小公园，孩子们喜欢在那里玩。

nearly.example: The bus was nearly full when we got on.
nearly.exampleZh: 我们上车时，公共汽车几乎坐满了。

neat.example: Her neat little room is always clean and easy to find things.
neat.exampleZh: 她那间整洁的小房间总是干干净净，东西也很容易找到。

necessary.example: It is necessary to drink enough water every day.
necessary.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水是必要的。

necessity.example: Water is a basic necessity for all life on Earth.
necessity.exampleZh: 水是地球上所有生命的基本必需品。

neck.example: My neck hurts after sitting in front of the computer all day.
neck.exampleZh: 在电脑前坐了一整天后，我的脖子很疼。

need.example: People need clean water and fresh food to stay healthy and strong.
need.exampleZh: 人们需要干净的水和新鲜的食物来保持健康和强壮。

needle.example: The nurse used a clean needle to give him the medicine.
needle.exampleZh: 护士用一根干净的针给他注射药物。

negative.example: His negative answer made everyone in the room feel a little worried.
negative.exampleZh: 他的否定回答让房间里的每个人都感到有些担忧。

neglect.example: He often neglects his health because he works too hard.
neglect.exampleZh: 他常常因为工作太努力而忽视自己的健康。

negotiate.example: The two sides will negotiate a new deal next week.
negotiate.exampleZh: 双方将在下周协商一项新协议。

negro.example: The old book used the word negro to describe the man.
negro.exampleZh: 那本旧书用 negro 这个词来描述那个人。

neighbor.example: Our new neighbor is very friendly and often helps us.
neighbor.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居非常友好，经常帮助我们。

neighborhood.example: People in my neighborhood often walk their dogs in the evening.
neighborhood.exampleZh: 我所在街区的居民经常在傍晚遛狗。

neither.example: Neither of my two brothers likes coffee, and neither do I.
neither.exampleZh: 我的两个兄弟都不喜欢咖啡，我也不喜欢。

nephew.example: My nephew is coming to visit us this weekend.
nephew.exampleZh: 我侄子这个周末要来看望我们。

nerve.example: It took a lot of nerve to speak in front of the whole school.
nerve.exampleZh: 在全校师生面前讲话需要很大的勇气。

nervous.example: I always feel nervous before I speak in front of many people.
nervous.exampleZh: 在很多人面前讲话之前，我总是感到紧张。

nest.example: The bird built a warm nest high in the old tree.
nest.exampleZh: 那只鸟在老树高处筑了一个温暖的巢。

net.example: The fisherman pulled the heavy net out of the water.
net.exampleZh: 渔夫把沉重的网从水里拉了出来。

network.example: She built a wide network of friends through her work.
network.exampleZh: 她通过工作建立了一个广泛的朋友关系网。

neutral.example: The judge must stay neutral and listen to both sides of the story.
neutral.exampleZh: 法官必须保持中立，听取双方的说法。

never.example: I never drink coffee after six in the evening.
never.exampleZh: 我从不在晚上六点以后喝咖啡。

nevertheless.example: The test was hard; nevertheless, she passed it easily.
nevertheless.exampleZh: 考试很难，然而她轻松通过了。

new.example: I bought a new phone last week and I like it.
new.exampleZh: 我上周买了一部新手机，我很喜欢它。

news.example: I watch the news every morning before I go to work.
news.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会看新闻。

newspaper.example: My father reads a newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
newspaper.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会读一份报纸。

next.example: I will see you next week at the same place.
next.exampleZh: 我下周在同一个地方见你。

nice.example: She is a nice teacher and always helps us with our English.
nice.exampleZh: 她是一位友好的老师，总是帮助我们学英语。

niece.example: My niece loves to draw pictures of animals on the wall.
niece.exampleZh: 我的侄女喜欢在墙上画动物的图画。

night.example: We walked home in the dark night and heard nothing at all.
night.exampleZh: 我们在漆黑的夜晚走回家，什么也没听见。

nine.example: My little sister is nine years old and she loves to draw.
nine.exampleZh: 我妹妹九岁了，她喜欢画画。

nineteen.example: My brother is nineteen years old and studies at a local university.
nineteen.exampleZh: 我哥哥十九岁，在当地一所大学学习。

ninety.example: My grandfather is ninety years old and still walks every morning.
ninety.exampleZh: 我爷爷九十岁了，每天早上还坚持散步。

nitrogen.example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil to grow strong and green.
nitrogen.exampleZh: 植物需要从土壤中获取氮才能长得健壮翠绿。

no.example: There is no milk in the fridge, so I will buy some.
no.exampleZh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了，所以我会去买一些。

noble.example: He is a noble man who always helps people in need.
noble.exampleZh: 他是一个高尚的人，总是帮助有需要的人。

nobody.example: Nobody came to the meeting, so the teacher went home early.
nobody.exampleZh: 没有人来开会，所以老师提前回家了。

nod.example: He gave a quick nod and went back to his work.
nod.exampleZh: 他快速地点了一下头，然后继续工作。

noise.example: The loud noise from the street kept me awake all night.
noise.exampleZh: 街上很大的噪音让我整夜没睡着。

noisy.example: The children were too noisy for me to hear the teacher.
noisy.exampleZh: 孩子们太吵了，我听不见老师说话。

nominate.example: The teacher will nominate two students for the school prize.
nominate.exampleZh: 老师将提名两名学生参评学校奖项。

none.example: I looked for fresh fruit, but none was left in the fridge.
none.exampleZh: 我去找新鲜水果，但冰箱里一点也没剩下。

nonsense.example: Don't listen to him; what he just said is complete nonsense.
nonsense.exampleZh: 别听他的，他刚才说的全是胡说八道。

noodle.example: I eat a bowl of hot noodle soup for lunch every day.
noodle.exampleZh: 我每天午饭都吃一碗热汤面。

noon.example: We usually have lunch at noon and go back to work at one.
noon.exampleZh: 我们通常中午吃午饭，一点回去上班。

nor.example: She did not call, nor did she send a message.
nor.exampleZh: 她没有打电话，也没有发消息。

norm.example: In this school, arriving on time is the norm for every student.
norm.exampleZh: 在这所学校里，准时到校是每个学生的常态。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day at work.
normal.exampleZh: 工作一整天后感到累是正常的。

normally.example: I normally walk to school, but today I took the bus.
normally.exampleZh: 我通常步行去学校，但今天我坐公共汽车。

north.example: The cold wind comes from the north in winter.

northern.example: The northern part of the country is very cold in winter.
northern.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部地区冬天非常寒冷。

nose.example: The dog has a good nose and can find food in the dark.
nose.exampleZh: 这只狗的嗅觉很好，能在黑暗中找到食物。

nostalgia.example: Her old songs filled him with nostalgia for his childhood home.
nostalgia.exampleZh: 她的老歌让他对童年的家充满怀旧之情。

not.example: I am not ready to go to the party tonight.
not.exampleZh: 我还没准备好今晚去参加聚会。

notable.example: She is a notable writer in our city and many people know her.
notable.exampleZh: 她是我们城市里一位著名的作家，很多人都认识她。

note.example: Please note down the main points in your notebook.
note.exampleZh: 请把要点记在你的笔记本上。

notebook.example: I always carry a small notebook to write down my ideas.
notebook.exampleZh: 我总是随身带一个小笔记本，用来记录我的想法。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the box, so we can put our books in it.
nothing.exampleZh: 盒子里什么都没有，所以我们可以把书放进去。

notice.example: I did not notice the small sign on the door.
notice.exampleZh: 我没有注意到门上的小告示。

noticeable.example: There is a noticeable difference between the two pictures on the wall.
noticeable.exampleZh: 墙上的两幅画之间有明显的差别。

notify.example: Please notify your teacher if you cannot come to class today.
notify.exampleZh: 如果你今天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

notion.example: She has a strange notion about how to save money.
notion.exampleZh: 她对如何省钱有一个奇怪的想法。

notorious.example: This street is notorious for its traffic jams.
notorious.exampleZh: 这条街因交通堵塞而臭名昭著。

nourish.example: Good food and clean water nourish the body and help children grow strong.
nourish.exampleZh: 好的食物和干净的水滋养身体，帮助孩子们长得强壮。

novel.example: This novel tells a new and interesting story about life in a small town.
novel.exampleZh: 这本小说讲述了一个关于小镇生活的新颖有趣的故事。

novelty.example: The novelty of the new game soon wore off for the children.
novelty.exampleZh: 这款新游戏的新鲜感对孩子们来说很快就消失了。

now.example: I am busy now, so please call me again later.
now.exampleZh: 我现在很忙，请稍后再打给我。

nowadays.example: Nowadays many people use their phones to pay for things.
nowadays.exampleZh: 如今许多人用手机付款买东西。

nowhere.example: There is nowhere to sit because the small room is full of boxes.
nowhere.exampleZh: 房间里堆满了箱子，没有地方可以坐。

nuclear.example: Nuclear power can give us clean and cheap energy.
nuclear.exampleZh: 核能可以为我们提供清洁又廉价的能源。

nude.example: The artist painted a nude woman standing by the window.
nude.exampleZh: 画家画了一位站在窗边的裸体女子。

nuisance.example: That loud noise next door is a real nuisance at night.
nuisance.exampleZh: 隔壁那吵闹的声音在晚上真是件麻烦事。

number.example: The number on my new phone is easy to remember.
number.exampleZh: 我新手机上的号码很容易记住。

numerous.example: There are numerous books on the desk in our classroom.
numerous.exampleZh: 我们教室里的桌子上有许多书。

nurse.example: The nurse took good care of my mother in the hospital.
nurse.exampleZh: 那位护士在医院里细心照顾我的母亲。

nursery.example: The children spend the whole day at the nursery near our house.
nursery.exampleZh: 孩子们在我们家附近的托儿所待了一整天。

nut.example: He put a nut on the bolt and ate a nut.
nut.exampleZh: 他在螺栓上拧了一个螺母，又吃了一颗坚果。

nutrition.example: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and stay healthy.
nutrition.exampleZh: 良好的营养有助于孩子强壮成长并保持健康。

nylon.example: These socks are made of nylon and they dry very quickly.
nylon.exampleZh: 这些袜子是尼龙做的，干得很快。

o'clock.example: I usually get up at seven o'clock every morning.
o'clock.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上七点钟起床。

oak.example: There is a big oak tree in front of my house.
oak.exampleZh: 我家门前有一棵大橡树。

oar.example: The man pulled hard on the oar to move the small boat forward.
oar.exampleZh: 那个男人用力划桨，让小船向前移动。

oasis.example: The small library became an oasis of calm in our busy school day.
oasis.exampleZh: 那个小图书馆成了我们忙碌校园生活里一片宁静的避风港。

oath.example: He made an oath to tell the truth in court.
oath.exampleZh: 他发誓在法庭上说真话。

obedience.example: The dog was praised for its obedience during training.
obedience.exampleZh: 这只狗在训练中因服从命令而受到表扬。

obedient.example: She is an obedient daughter and always listens to her parents.
obedient.exampleZh: 她是个孝顺的女儿，总是听父母的话。

obese.example: The doctor said he was obese and needed to eat less and exercise more.
obese.exampleZh: 医生说他过度肥胖，需要少吃多运动。

obesity.example: Doctors say obesity is a growing problem among children in many countries.
obesity.exampleZh: 医生表示，肥胖在许多国家的儿童中正成为一个日益严重的问题。

obey.example: Students must obey the school rules if they want to use the lab.
obey.exampleZh: 学生如果想使用实验室，就必须遵守学校的规定。

object.example: Please do not put that heavy object on the small glass table.
object.exampleZh: 请不要把那个重物放在这张小玻璃桌上。

objection.example: She raised an objection to the new plan at the meeting.
objection.exampleZh: 她在会上对新计划提出了反对意见。

objective.example: Our objective is to finish the project before Friday.
objective.exampleZh: 我们的目标是在周五之前完成这个项目。

obligation.example: Parents have a legal obligation to send their children to school.
obligation.exampleZh: 父母有送子女上学的法律义务。

oblige.example: The bad weather obliged us to stay at home all day.
oblige.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气迫使我们整天待在家里。

obscene.example: The police arrested him for posting obscene pictures on the website.
obscene.exampleZh: 警方因他在网站上发布淫秽图片而逮捕了他。

obscure.example: The meaning of this old poem is obscure to most readers today.
obscure.exampleZh: 这首古老诗篇的含义对今天的大多数读者来说是模糊难懂的。

obscurity.example: The poem's obscurity makes it hard for most readers to understand.
obscurity.exampleZh: 这首诗的晦涩难懂让大多数读者难以理解。

observation.example: Her careful observation of the birds helped her learn a lot.
observation.exampleZh: 她对鸟类的仔细观察帮助她学到了很多东西。

observe.example: We observe the stars at night and write down what we see.
observe.exampleZh: 我们在夜里观测星星，并写下我们看到的东西。

observer.example: The observer watched the birds from a quiet spot near the river.
observer.exampleZh: 观察者在河边一个安静的地方观察鸟儿。

obstacle.example: The biggest obstacle to learning English is fear of making mistakes.
obstacle.exampleZh: 学习英语最大的障碍是害怕犯错。

obstinate.example: He is too obstinate to listen to anyone's advice.
obstinate.exampleZh: 他太固执了，听不进任何人的建议。

obstruct.example: A big truck broke down and obstructed the narrow road for two hours.
obstruct.exampleZh: 一辆大卡车抛锚，把狭窄的路堵了两个小时。

obtain.example: You can obtain a free map at the front desk.
obtain.exampleZh: 你可以在前台获得一张免费地图。

obvious.example: It is obvious that she is very happy today.

occasion.example: Her birthday was a happy occasion for the whole family.
occasion.exampleZh: 她的生日对全家人来说都是一个快乐的场合。

occasional.example: She pays occasional visits to her old friends in the countryside.
occasional.exampleZh: 她偶尔去乡下看望老朋友。

occasionally.example: I occasionally walk to work when the weather is nice.
occasionally.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我偶尔会步行去上班。

occupation.example: Her occupation is a nurse at the city hospital.
occupation.exampleZh: 她的职业是市医院的一名护士。

occupy.example: The big desk occupies most of the small room.
occupy.exampleZh: 这张大书桌占据了小房间的大部分空间。

occur.example: The accident occurred late at night on a quiet street.
occur.exampleZh: 这起事故发生在深夜一条安静的街道上。

occurrence.example: The police said the accident was a rare occurrence in this small town.
occurrence.exampleZh: 警方说，这类事故在这个小镇上很少发生。

ocean.example: The ocean is very deep and full of many strange fish.
ocean.exampleZh: 海洋非常深，里面有许多奇怪的鱼。

oceania.example: Many small island countries are located in Oceania.
oceania.exampleZh: 许多小岛国位于大洋洲。

october.example: The weather gets cooler here in October, so we bring jackets to school.
october.exampleZh: 这里十月的天气会变凉，所以我们带夹克去学校。

odd.example: It is odd that he left the party without saying goodbye to anyone.
odd.exampleZh: 他没跟任何人告别就离开了聚会，这很奇怪。

odds.example: The odds of winning this game are very small.
odds.exampleZh: 赢这场游戏的可能性非常小。

odor.example: A strange odor came from the old fridge in the kitchen.
odor.exampleZh: 厨房里那台旧冰箱散发出一股奇怪的气味。

of.example: The roof of our old house needs a new coat of paint.
of.exampleZh: 我们老房子的屋顶需要刷一层新漆。

off.example: Please turn off the lights before you leave the room.
off.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with my words yesterday.
offend.exampleZh: 我昨天说的话并不是想冒犯你。

offense.example: Stealing is a serious offense and the police will arrest him.
offense.exampleZh: 偷窃是严重的违法行为，警察会逮捕他。

offensive.example: His offensive words made everyone in the room feel very uncomfortable.
offensive.exampleZh: 他冒犯的话让房间里的每个人都感到很不舒服。

offer.example: She offered me a cup of tea and a warm smile.
offer.exampleZh: 她给我端来一杯茶，还露出温暖的微笑。

office.example: She left her office at six and walked to the bus stop.
office.exampleZh: 她六点离开办公室，走到公交车站。

officer.example: The police officer helped the old man cross the busy street safely.
officer.exampleZh: 那位警官帮助老人安全地穿过了繁忙的街道。

official.example: The official report gives simple facts about the new school rules.
official.exampleZh: 这份官方报告提供了关于新校规的简单事实。

offspring.example: Many animals protect their offspring until they are strong enough to live alone.
offspring.exampleZh: 许多动物会保护自己的后代，直到它们足够强壮能独立生活。

often.example: I often walk to school with my sister in the morning.
often.exampleZh: 我经常早上和姐姐一起走路去学校。

oil.example: The car needs oil before we start the long drive.
oil.exampleZh: 我们开始长途驾驶前，这辆车需要加油。

ok.example: I feel ok today, so I will go to work.
ok.exampleZh: 我今天感觉还可以，所以我会去上班。

old.example: My old bike is still very fast on the road.
old.exampleZh: 我的旧自行车在路上还是骑得很快。

olive.example: She put a green olive on the table beside the bread.
olive.exampleZh: 她把一颗绿橄榄放在面包旁边的桌子上。

olympic.example: The Olympic Games bring many people from different countries together every four years.
olympic.exampleZh: 奥林匹克运动会每四年把来自不同国家的许多人聚在一起。

omit.example: Please do not omit any important details from your report.
omit.exampleZh: 请不要遗漏你报告中的任何重要细节。

once.example: I have been to that small town only once in my life.
once.exampleZh: 我这辈子只去过那个小镇一次。

one.example: She has one brother and two sisters.
one.exampleZh: 她有一个哥哥和两个姐姐。

onion.example: I put some onion in the soup and it tasted very good.
onion.exampleZh: 我在汤里放了一些洋葱，味道很好。

only.example: She is the only person who knows the answer to this question.
only.exampleZh: 她是唯一知道这个问题答案的人。

onto.example: The cat jumped onto the table and knocked over a glass.
onto.exampleZh: 猫跳到桌子上，打翻了一个玻璃杯。

open.example: The door is open, so please come in and sit down.
open.exampleZh: 门是开着的，请进来坐下。

opening.example: The opening of the new school was a happy day for everyone.
opening.exampleZh: 新学校的开幕对每个人来说都是快乐的一天。

opera.example: My parents took me to the opera for the first time last night.
opera.exampleZh: 昨晚我父母第一次带我去看了歌剧。

operate.example: The doctor will operate on my father early tomorrow morning.
operate.exampleZh: 医生明天一早将为我父亲动手术。

operation.example: The doctor said the operation went well and she can go home tomorrow.
operation.exampleZh: 医生说手术很顺利，她明天就可以回家。

operational.example: The new machine is now operational and ready for daily use.
operational.exampleZh: 这台新机器现在已可运转，可供日常使用。

operator.example: The telephone operator helped me find the right number for the office.
operator.exampleZh: 电话接线员帮我找到了办公室的正确号码。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this simple plan will work well for everyone.
opinion.exampleZh: 在我看来，这个简单的计划对每个人都行得通。

opponent.example: He shook hands with his opponent after the long and difficult game.
opponent.exampleZh: 漫长而艰难的比赛结束后，他和对手握了手。

opportunity.example: This job gives you a good opportunity to learn new skills.
opportunity.exampleZh: 这份工作给了你一个学习新技能的好机会。

oppose.example: Many people oppose the new plan because it may hurt small local businesses.
oppose.exampleZh: 许多人反对这项新计划，因为它可能会伤害当地的小企业。

opposite.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street from the school.
opposite.exampleZh: 银行在街道对面，与学校相对。

opposition.example: The new plan met strong opposition from many local residents.
opposition.exampleZh: 新计划遭到许多当地居民的强烈反对。

oppress.example: The loud noise began to oppress her and made her feel very tired.
oppress.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音开始让她感到压抑，并让她非常疲惫。

optical.example: The new optical lens helps people see small words more clearly.
optical.exampleZh: 新的光学镜片帮助人们更清楚地看到小字。

optimism.example: Her optimism helped the whole team stay calm during a difficult week.
optimism.exampleZh: 她的乐观帮助整个团队在艰难的一周里保持冷静。

optimistic.example: She is optimistic about her new job and works hard every day.
optimistic.exampleZh: 她对她的新工作很乐观，并且每天努力工作。

optimum.example: This room temperature is the optimum level for the plants to grow well.
optimum.exampleZh: 这个室温是植物良好生长的最佳水平。

optional.example: The extra practice is optional, so you can go home early today.
optional.exampleZh: 额外的练习是可选择的，所以你今天可以早点回家。

or.example: You can drink tea or coffee, but you should not drink both.
or.exampleZh: 你可以喝茶或咖啡，但你不应该两样都喝。

oral.example: The doctor gave me oral medicine for my bad cough.
oral.exampleZh: 医生给我开了治咳嗽的口服药。

orange.example: I eat a sweet orange every morning before I go to school.
orange.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃一个甜甜的橙子。

orbit.example: The moon moves in a steady orbit around the earth.
orbit.exampleZh: 月亮沿着稳定的轨道绕地球运行。

orchestra.example: The school orchestra will play three songs at the concert tonight.
orchestra.exampleZh: 学校管弦乐队今晚将在音乐会上演奏三首歌曲。

order.example: Please put these books in order before you leave the room.
order.exampleZh: 请在离开房间前把这些书按顺序放好。

orderly.example: The orderly students lined up quietly outside the classroom.
orderly.exampleZh: 学生们整齐地安静在教室外排队。

ordinary.example: This is just an ordinary day for most people.
ordinary.exampleZh: 对大多数人来说，这只是平凡的一天。

ore.example: The workers found iron ore in the deep mine near the village.
ore.exampleZh: 工人们在村庄附近的深矿里发现了铁矿石。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ that pumps blood around the body.
organ.exampleZh: 心脏是一个重要的器官，它将血液泵送到全身。

organic.example: This farm grows organic vegetables for the local families every year.
organic.exampleZh: 这个农场每年为当地家庭种植有机蔬菜。

organism.example: A tiny organism can live in water and grow very fast.
organism.exampleZh: 一种微小生物能在水中生存并快速生长。

organization.example: She works for a large organization that helps young people find jobs.
organization.exampleZh: 她在一个帮助年轻人找工作的庞大机构工作。

organize.example: We need to organize the meeting before Friday so everyone can attend.
organize.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五前组织好会议，以便每个人都能参加。

orient.example: New students need time to orient themselves to the school and its rules.
orient.exampleZh: 新生需要时间来适应学校及其规则。

origin.example: The origin of this old story is still unknown to us.
origin.exampleZh: 这个古老故事的起源对我们来说仍然未知。

original.example: This painting is the original, and the copies are not as beautiful.
original.exampleZh: 这幅画是原作，那些复制品没有那么美。

originality.example: Her originality made the design stand out from all the others.
originality.exampleZh: 她的独创性使这个设计在众多设计中脱颖而出。

originate.example: Many popular music styles originate from older songs and cultural traditions around the world.
originate.exampleZh: 许多流行音乐风格起源于世界各地的老歌和文化传统。

ornament.example: She put a small ornament on the tree before the family came home.
ornament.exampleZh: 她在家人回家前把一个小装饰品放在了树上。

orphan.example: The orphan found a warm home with a kind family.
orphan.exampleZh: 这个孤儿在一个善良的家庭里找到了温暖的家。

ostrich.example: The ostrich ran across the field when it saw the dog.
ostrich.exampleZh: 鸵鸟看到狗时跑过了田野。

other.example: Some students like math, but other students prefer art and music.
other.exampleZh: 有些学生喜欢数学，但其他学生更喜欢美术和音乐。

otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the last bus home.
otherwise.exampleZh: 快点，否则我们会错过回家的最后一班公交车。

ought.example: You ought to tell your teacher the truth about what happened yesterday.
ought.exampleZh: 你应该把昨天发生的事情真相告诉你的老师。

ounce.example: She put one ounce of sugar into the small bowl on the table.
ounce.exampleZh: 她把一盎司糖放进桌上的小碗里。

our.example: Our teacher gave us a simple test on Friday morning.
our.exampleZh: 我们的老师在周五早上给我们做了一次简单的测验。

ours.example: This house is ours, and we have lived here for many years.
ours.exampleZh: 这所房子是我们的，我们在这里住了很多年。

ourselves.example: We should learn to take care of ourselves when we live alone.
ourselves.exampleZh: 我们独自生活时应该学会照顾自己。

out.example: The fire is out and the lights are out.

outbreak.example: The sudden outbreak of flu made many students stay at home.
outbreak.exampleZh: 流感的突然爆发让许多学生待在家里。

outcome.example: The outcome of the game was fair to everyone.
outcome.exampleZh: 比赛的结果对每个人来说都是公平的。

outdoor.example: We enjoy outdoor activities with our friends on sunny days.
outdoor.exampleZh: 晴天时我们喜欢和朋友们一起进行户外活动。

outdoors.example: The children like to play outdoors after school on sunny days.
outdoors.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在晴天放学后到户外玩耍。

outer.example: The outer layer of the cake is hard and sweet.

outfit.example: She bought a new outfit for the party on Saturday.
outfit.exampleZh: 她为周六的聚会买了一套新衣服。

outlet.example: The factory has a small outlet for waste water near the back wall.
outlet.exampleZh: 工厂后墙附近有一个排放废水的小排放口。

outline.example: Please outline the main points before you start writing the report.
outline.exampleZh: 请在你开始写报告之前概述要点。

outlook.example: My outlook on life became much brighter after I started helping other people.
outlook.exampleZh: 在我开始帮助别人之后，我对生活的看法变得明亮多了。

output.example: The factory increased its output by ten percent last year.
output.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年产量增加了百分之十。

outrage.example: The cruel attack was an outrage that made the whole town angry.
outrage.exampleZh: 那次残忍的袭击是一桩暴行，让整个镇子都愤怒了。

outset.example: From the outset, we knew the plan would take time.
outset.exampleZh: 从一开始，我们就知道这个计划需要时间。

outside.example: The children are playing outside the house in the warm sun.
outside.exampleZh: 孩子们正在温暖的阳光下在房子外面玩耍。

outstanding.example: She did outstanding work on the project and finished it early.
outstanding.exampleZh: 她在这个项目上做得非常出色，并提前完成了。

outward.example: She turned her head outward and looked at the wide open sea.
outward.exampleZh: 她把头转向外面，望着广阔的大海。

oval.example: She drew a small oval on the paper with a blue pencil.
oval.exampleZh: 她用一支蓝色铅笔在纸上画了一个小椭圆。

oven.example: She put the cake into the oven and waited for it to bake.
oven.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱，等着它烤好。

over.example: The plane flew over the tall mountains before it landed safely.
over.exampleZh: 飞机飞越了高高的群山，然后安全降落。

overall.example: Overall, the team did a good job on the small project.
overall.exampleZh: 总的来说，团队在这个小项目上做得很好。

overcoat.example: He wore a long overcoat because the weather was very cold that morning.
overcoat.exampleZh: 他穿了一件长外套，因为那天早上天气很冷。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

overflow.example: Heavy rain made the river overflow and cover the small road.
overflow.exampleZh: 大雨使河水溢出，淹没了那条小路。

overhead.example: A small plane flew overhead while we were walking in the park.
overhead.exampleZh: 我们在公园散步时，一架小飞机从头顶飞过。

overhear.example: I happened to overhear their conversation while waiting for the bus.
overhear.exampleZh: 我在等公交车时无意中听到了他们的谈话。

overlap.example: The two plans overlap in some areas, so we can combine them.
overlap.exampleZh: 这两个计划在某些方面有重叠，所以我们可以把它们合并。

overlook.example: The manager may overlook small mistakes when the team works hard.
overlook.exampleZh: 当团队努力工作的时候，经理可能会忽略一些小错误。

overnight.example: The weather changed overnight and the city looked completely different this morning.
overnight.exampleZh: 天气一夜之间变了，今天早上这座城市看起来完全不同。

overseas.example: Many students go overseas to study and learn about new cultures.
overseas.exampleZh: 许多学生去海外学习并了解新的文化。

overtake.example: The fast runner will soon overtake the others and win the race.
overtake.exampleZh: 那位跑得快的选手很快会超过其他人并赢得比赛。

overwhelm.example: Too much homework can overwhelm students and make them feel very tired.
overwhelm.exampleZh: 太多作业会让学生不堪重负，并让他们感到非常疲惫。

owe.example: I owe my brother twenty dollars for the concert ticket last week.
owe.exampleZh: 我欠我哥哥二十美元，是上周音乐会的票钱。

owing.example: There is still some money owing on my old car.
owing.exampleZh: 我的旧车还欠着一些钱。

owl.example: An owl sat silently on the old oak tree branch last night.
owl.exampleZh: 昨晚一只猫头鹰静静地停在老橡树的树枝上。

own.example: I want to have my own room and make it clean and bright.
own.exampleZh: 我想要拥有自己的房间，并把它收拾得干净明亮。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop always greets every customer with a smile.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主总是微笑着迎接每一位顾客。

ownership.example: The ownership of the old house passed to her family last year.
ownership.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的所有权去年传给了她的家人。

ox.example: The strong ox pulls the heavy cart slowly along the dusty road.
ox.exampleZh: 那头强壮的公牛拉着沉重的车，沿着尘土飞扬的路慢慢走。

oxygen.example: Plants give off oxygen into the air when they make food from sunlight.
oxygen.exampleZh: 植物利用阳光制造食物时会把氧气释放到空气中。

oyster.example: He opened an oyster and found a small pearl inside.
oyster.exampleZh: 他打开一只牡蛎，发现里面有一颗小珍珠。

pact.example: The two countries signed a peace pact last week to end the war.
pact.exampleZh: 两国上周签署了一项和平协定，以结束战争。

pad.example: She wrote her phone number on a small pad beside the bed.
pad.exampleZh: 她把电话号码写在床边的一个小拍纸簿上。

palm.example: She held the small bird gently in the palm of her hand.
palm.exampleZh: 她轻轻地把小鸟握在手掌心里。

pamphlet.example: The teacher gave us a small pamphlet about how to keep the classroom clean.
pamphlet.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一本关于如何保持教室清洁的小册子。

panel.example: The panel listened carefully and asked the young scientist several important questions.
panel.exampleZh: 专门小组认真倾听，并向这位年轻科学家提出了几个重要问题。

panic.example: People began to panic when the fire alarm rang loudly in the building.
panic.exampleZh: 当大楼里的火警大声响起时，人们开始恐慌。

pants.example: He put on his pants and a clean shirt before going to work.
pants.exampleZh: 他去上班前穿上了裤子和一件干净的衬衫。

paperback.example: I bought a cheap paperback at the station before the long train ride.
paperback.exampleZh: 我在长途火车旅行前，在车站买了一本便宜的平装书。

parade.example: The whole town came out to watch the parade on Sunday.
parade.exampleZh: 整个镇子的人都出来观看周日的游行。

paradise.example: This quiet island feels like a paradise for tired people who love nature.
paradise.exampleZh: 这座安静的小岛对热爱大自然的疲惫之人来说就像天堂。

paradox.example: It is a paradox that the richest country has so many poor people.
paradox.exampleZh: 最富有的国家却有这么多穷人，这是个悖论。

parallel.example: The two roads run parallel to each other for several miles.
parallel.exampleZh: 这两条路彼此平行延伸了好几英里。

paralyze.example: The sudden fear can paralyze a person and stop clear thinking.
paralyze.exampleZh: 突然的恐惧会使一个人瘫痪，并让人无法清晰思考。

parasite.example: A parasite lives on or inside another animal and gets food from it.
parasite.exampleZh: 寄生虫生活在另一种动物身上或体内，并从它那里获取食物。

parcel.example: The postman left a small parcel at my front door this morning.
parcel.exampleZh: 今天早上邮递员把一个小包裹放在了我家前门。

pardon.example: Please pardon me for being late to the meeting this morning.
pardon.exampleZh: 请原谅我今天早上开会迟到。

parent.example: The parent teaches the child how to read every day.
parent.exampleZh: 这位家长每天教孩子如何阅读。

park.example: We parked the car near the park and walked to the lake.
park.exampleZh: 我们把车停在公园附近，然后走到了湖边。

parliament.example: The parliament passed a new law to help small businesses.
parliament.exampleZh: 议会通过了一项帮助小企业的新法律。

partial.example: The teacher was partial to the students who worked hard every day.
partial.exampleZh: 老师偏爱每天努力学习的学生。

participant.example: Every participant received a small gift after the meeting ended.
participant.exampleZh: 会议结束后，每位参加者都收到了一份小礼物。

participate.example: All students can participate in the school sports games this Friday.
participate.exampleZh: 所有学生都可以参加这周五的学校运动会。

particle.example: A small particle of dust got into my eye and made it water.
particle.exampleZh: 一小粒灰尘进了我的眼睛，让眼睛流泪。

particular.example: She has a particular way of making tea in the morning.
particular.exampleZh: 她早上泡茶有一种特别的方法。

partly.example: The sky is partly cloudy, so we can still play outside today.
partly.exampleZh: 天空局部多云，所以我们今天仍然可以在外面玩。

partner.example: My business partner helps me make important decisions every day.
partner.exampleZh: 我的生意伙伴每天帮助我做重要决定。

partnership.example: The two companies formed a strong partnership to build the new school.
partnership.exampleZh: 两家公司建立了牢固的伙伴关系来建造新学校。

passion.example: She has a real passion for music and plays the piano every day.
passion.exampleZh: 她对音乐有真正的热情，每天弹钢琴。

passive.example: He is too passive and never speaks up in class.
passive.exampleZh: 他太被动了，在课堂上从不发言。

passport.example: Please bring your passport to the airport before your flight leaves tomorrow.
passport.exampleZh: 请明天在航班起飞前把你的护照带到机场。

paste.example: Please use some paste to stick the paper to the wall.
paste.exampleZh: 请用一些浆糊把纸粘到墙上。

pastime.example: Reading is my favorite pastime after a long day at work.
pastime.exampleZh: 阅读是我工作一整天后最喜欢的消遣。

pasture.example: The sheep walked slowly across the green pasture near the farm.
pasture.exampleZh: 羊群慢慢地走过农场附近那片绿色的牧场。

pat.example: She gave the dog a gentle pat on its head after dinner.
pat.exampleZh: 晚饭后她轻轻拍了拍狗的头。

patch.example: He put a small patch on the old coat before he went out.
patch.exampleZh: 他在出门前给旧外套打了一个小补丁。

patent.example: The company applied for a patent on its new simple water bottle.
patent.exampleZh: 这家公司为其新型简易水瓶申请了一项专利。

pathetic.example: It is pathetic that he still blames others for his own mistakes.
pathetic.exampleZh: 他仍把自己犯的错归咎于别人，真是可悲。

patience.example: Learning a new language takes patience and a lot of daily practice.
patience.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要耐心和大量日常练习。

patient.example: The patient is very patient with the young children.
patient.exampleZh: 这位病人对年幼的孩子们非常有耐心。

patriotic.example: Many people feel patriotic when they hear their country's national anthem at a public event.
patriotic.exampleZh: 许多人在公共活动中听到国歌时会感到爱国。

patrol.example: The guards patrol the streets every night to keep everyone safe.
patrol.exampleZh: 警卫每晚巡逻街道以保障大家的安全。

pave.example: They will pave the road before winter comes to make it safer.
pave.exampleZh: 他们会在冬天到来之前铺好这条路，让它更安全。

paw.example: The dog hurt its paw while running on the rough path today.
paw.exampleZh: 那只狗今天在崎岖的小路上跑时伤了爪子。

payment.example: I made the payment online before the store closed yesterday.
payment.exampleZh: 昨天商店关门前，我在网上付了款。

peak.example: We reached the mountain peak after a long and tiring climb.
peak.exampleZh: 经过漫长而疲惫的攀登，我们到达了山峰。

peanut.example: My little brother is allergic to peanut butter and cannot eat it.
peanut.exampleZh: 我弟弟对花生酱过敏，不能吃它。

pearl.example: She wore a simple pearl necklace to the party last night.
pearl.exampleZh: 她昨晚戴了一条简单的珍珠项链去参加聚会。

peasant.example: The old peasant worked hard in the field from morning to night.
peasant.exampleZh: 那位老农民从早到晚在田里辛勤劳作。

peculiar.example: There was a peculiar smell in the old house last night.
peculiar.exampleZh: 昨晚那座老房子里有一股奇怪的气味。

pedal.example: She pressed the pedal hard and the bike moved forward quickly.
pedal.exampleZh: 她用力踩下踏板，自行车很快向前移动。

peel.example: She used a knife to peel the apple before eating it.
peel.exampleZh: 她吃苹果前用刀削了苹果皮。

peer.example: She peered at the small print and asked her peer for help.
peer.exampleZh: 她盯着那行小字看，并向她的同龄人求助。

penalty.example: The player received a penalty for breaking the rules during the game.
penalty.exampleZh: 那名球员因在比赛中违反规则而受到处罚。

pencil.example: I use a sharp pencil to draw a small picture in my notebook.
pencil.exampleZh: 我用一支削尖的铅笔在笔记本上画一幅小画。

pension.example: He saves part of his salary for a pension after retirement.
pension.exampleZh: 他把一部分工资存起来，用于退休后的养老金。

pepper.example: I put some pepper on my eggs before breakfast.
pepper.exampleZh: 我在早餐前往鸡蛋上撒了些胡椒粉。

perceive.example: Many people perceive the world in different ways.
perceive.exampleZh: 许多人以不同的方式感知世界。

percentage.example: The percentage of students who walk to school is quite small.
percentage.exampleZh: 步行上学的学生比例相当小。

perception.example: My perception of the city changed after I walked around it.
perception.exampleZh: 我在城里走了一圈后，对这座城市的看法改变了。

perfection.example: She works hard every day because she wants perfection in her cooking.
perfection.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，因为她想在烹饪上追求完美。

perform.example: She will perform her duties carefully and help the new team.
perform.exampleZh: 她会认真履行职责并帮助新团队。

performance.example: Her performance in the school play made everyone very happy.
performance.exampleZh: 她在学校戏剧中的表演让每个人都很开心。

perfume.example: She wore a light perfume that smelled like fresh flowers.
perfume.exampleZh: 她涂了一种淡淡的香水，闻起来像新鲜花朵。

perhaps.example: Perhaps we can meet at the park after school tomorrow.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许我们明天放学后可以在公园见面。

period.example: This period of history is important for all of us.
period.exampleZh: 这段历史时期对我们所有人来说都很重要。

periodical.example: She reads a popular periodical every week at the local library.
periodical.exampleZh: 她每周在当地图书馆读一本受欢迎的期刊。

perish.example: Many plants perish quickly in very cold weather.
perish.exampleZh: 许多植物在极冷的天气里会很快死亡。

permanent.example: The museum is a permanent home for many old and famous paintings.
permanent.exampleZh: 这座博物馆是许多古老而著名画作的永久家园。

permission.example: You must ask for permission before you use my computer.
permission.exampleZh: 你必须先征得我的许可才能使用我的电脑。

permit.example: The school does not permit students to use phones during class.
permit.exampleZh: 学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

persist.example: She will persist with her studies until she reaches her goal.
persist.exampleZh: 她会坚持学习，直到实现自己的目标。

persistent.example: She is persistent and keeps trying until she solves the problem.
persistent.exampleZh: 她很坚持，不断尝试，直到解决问题。

personality.example: Her warm personality makes everyone feel happy and comfortable at work.
personality.exampleZh: 她热情的性格让每个人在工作中都感到快乐和自在。

personnel.example: The personnel department will help new workers learn about the company rules.
personnel.exampleZh: 人事部门将帮助新员工了解公司规定。

perspective.example: From my perspective, the new plan is simple and easy to follow.
perspective.exampleZh: 在我看来，新计划简单易行。

persuade.example: I tried to persuade my friend to join us for dinner.
persuade.exampleZh: 我试着说服我的朋友和我们一起吃晚饭。

persuasion.example: Her calm persuasion helped us change our plan and avoid a big mistake.
persuasion.exampleZh: 她冷静的说服帮助我们改变了计划，避免了一个大错误。

pessimistic.example: She feels pessimistic about the future because her job is not going well.
pessimistic.exampleZh: 她对未来感到悲观，因为她的工作进展不顺。

pest.example: Farmers often use simple traps to catch this common pest in their fields.
pest.exampleZh: 农民经常用简单的陷阱在田里捕捉这种常见的害虫。

petition.example: Many people signed the petition to ask the city for a new park.
petition.exampleZh: 许多人签署了请愿书，要求市政府建一座新公园。

petrol.example: I need to buy some petrol before we start our long drive.
petrol.exampleZh: 我们需要在开始长途驾驶前买些汽油。

petroleum.example: This country uses petroleum to make fuel for cars and trucks.
petroleum.exampleZh: 这个国家用石油为汽车和卡车制造燃料。

petty.example: He got angry over a petty problem at work yesterday.
petty.exampleZh: 他昨天因为工作中一个琐碎的问题生气了。

phase.example: We are still in the early phase of this new project.
phase.exampleZh: 我们仍处于这个新项目的早期阶段。

phenomenon.example: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon that we can see after rain.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 彩虹是我们雨后能看到的一种自然现象。

philosophy.example: My philosophy is to stay calm and keep learning every day.
philosophy.exampleZh: 我的人生哲学是保持冷静并每天坚持学习。

photograph.example: I took a photograph of my family at the park yesterday.
photograph.exampleZh: 昨天我在公园给家人拍了一张照片。

phrase.example: This common English phrase is easy to remember and use every day.
phrase.exampleZh: 这个常见的英语短语很容易记住，而且每天都能用到。

physical.example: Regular physical activity keeps your body and mind healthy.
physical.exampleZh: 经常进行身体活动能让你的身心保持健康。

physician.example: The physician told me to rest and drink plenty of water.
physician.exampleZh: 医生让我休息并多喝水。

physicist.example: The young physicist explained the simple experiment to the students in class.
physicist.exampleZh: 这位年轻的物理学家在课堂上向学生们解释了那个简单的实验。

physiology.example: I study physiology to understand how the human body works every day.
physiology.exampleZh: 我学习生理学，以了解人体每天如何运作。

piano.example: She plays the piano every evening after dinner.

pick.example: You can pick any book you like from this small shelf.
pick.exampleZh: 你可以从这个小小的书架上挑选任何你喜欢的书。

pickpocket.example: A pickpocket stole my wallet on the crowded bus yesterday morning.
pickpocket.exampleZh: 昨天早上，一个扒手在拥挤的公交车上偷了我的钱包。

picnic.example: We will have a picnic in the park this Saturday with our friends.
picnic.exampleZh: 这个星期六我们将和朋友们在公园野餐。

picture.example: There is a beautiful picture of a mountain on the wall.
picture.exampleZh: 墙上有一幅美丽的山景画。

pie.example: My mother made an apple pie for our family dinner last night.
pie.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨晚为我们的家庭晚餐做了一个苹果派。

piece.example: She cut the cake into a small piece for each child.
piece.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕切成小块，分给每个孩子。

pier.example: We walked to the end of the old pier and watched the boats.
pier.exampleZh: 我们走到旧码头尽头，看着那些船。

pigeon.example: A gray pigeon landed on the old stone bridge and looked at us.
pigeon.exampleZh: 一只灰鸽子落在古老的石桥上，看着我们。

pile.example: There is a pile of books on the desk near the window.
pile.exampleZh: 窗边的桌子上有一堆书。

pilgrim.example: The tired pilgrim walked a long way to the old temple.
pilgrim.exampleZh: 那位疲惫的朝圣者走了很远的路到那座古老的寺庙。

pill.example: She takes a pill every morning after breakfast to stay healthy.
pill.exampleZh: 她每天早饭后吃一片药来保持健康。

pillar.example: The old stone pillar in the square supports the heavy roof.
pillar.exampleZh: 广场上的古老石柱支撑着沉重的屋顶。

pillow.example: I put a soft pillow under my head and slept well.
pillow.exampleZh: 我把一个柔软的枕头放在头下，睡得很香。

pilot.example: The pilot flew the small plane safely across the wide blue sea.
pilot.exampleZh: 飞行员驾驶这架小飞机安全地飞越了广阔的蓝色大海。

pin.example: She used a pin to fix the note to the board.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚大头针把便条固定在板上。

pinch.example: She gave his arm a quick pinch and then smiled at him.
pinch.exampleZh: 她在他胳膊上轻轻掐了一下，然后朝他笑了笑。

pine.example: After she left, he would pine for her by the old pine tree.
pine.exampleZh: 她离开后，他常常在老松树旁思念她。

pint.example: I bought a pint of cold milk at the small store yesterday.
pint.exampleZh: 我昨天在小店买了一品脱冷牛奶。

pioneer.example: He was a pioneer in the early days of computer science.
pioneer.exampleZh: 他是计算机科学早期的先驱。

pipe.example: The old man filled his pipe and sat by the fire.
pipe.exampleZh: 老人装满烟斗，坐在火边。

plague.example: The terrible plague spread through the town and killed many people.
plague.exampleZh: 那场可怕的瘟疫蔓延全镇，夺去了许多人的生命。

plain.example: The teacher gave us a plain answer that was easy to understand.
plain.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一个简单易懂的明确答案。

plaintiff.example: The plaintiff told the judge the simple truth about the broken window.
plaintiff.exampleZh: 原告向法官讲述了关于破窗的简单事实。

plan.example: We need a clear plan before we start the new project.
plan.exampleZh: 在开始新项目之前，我们需要一个清晰的计划。

plane.example: The plane landed on time and all the passengers got off safely.
plane.exampleZh: 飞机准时降落，所有乘客都安全下机。

planet.example: Many scientists believe that life may exist on another planet in space.
planet.exampleZh: 许多科学家认为太空中另一颗行星上可能存在生命。

plant.example: They plant small trees near the new factory every spring.
plant.exampleZh: 他们每年春天都在新工厂附近种小树。

plantation.example: The old plantation grows coffee and bananas on a large hill.
plantation.exampleZh: 这座古老的种植园在一座大山上种植咖啡和香蕉。

plaster.example: The doctor put a plaster on the small cut on my arm.
plaster.exampleZh: 医生在我手臂上的小伤口上贴了创可贴。

plate.example: The plate is on the table next to the red cup.
plate.exampleZh: 盘子就在桌上红色杯子的旁边。

plateau.example: After years of growth, our sales have reached a plateau.
plateau.exampleZh: 经过多年的增长，我们的销售额已达到稳定水平。

platform.example: The train will arrive at the platform in five minutes.
platform.exampleZh: 火车将在五分钟后到达站台。

plausible.example: His excuse sounded plausible, but nobody in the room believed it.
plausible.exampleZh: 他的借口听起来貌似合理，但屋里没人相信。

playwright.example: The playwright wrote a funny play about a small town and its people.
playwright.exampleZh: 那位剧作家写了一部关于小镇及其居民的搞笑戏剧。

plea.example: She made a desperate plea for help after the storm.
plea.exampleZh: 暴风雨后她绝望地恳求帮助。

plead.example: She will plead with her boss for one more chance.
plead.exampleZh: 她会恳求老板再给她一次机会。

pleasant.example: We had a pleasant afternoon walking in the park near our home.
pleasant.exampleZh: 我们在家附近的公园散步，度过了一个愉快的下午。

please.example: She tries to please her parents by studying hard every day.
please.exampleZh: 她每天努力学习，想讨父母欢心。

pleasure.example: Reading a good book brings me great pleasure after a long day.
pleasure.exampleZh: 读一本好书在漫长的一天后给我带来极大的快乐。

pledge.example: She made a pledge to help her community every weekend.
pledge.exampleZh: 她承诺每个周末都帮助她的社区。

plenty.example: We have plenty of food and water for everyone at the party.
plenty.exampleZh: 我们在聚会上有充足的食物和水供每个人享用。

plight.example: Many people worked together to help the refugees out of their terrible plight.
plight.exampleZh: 许多人齐心协力帮助难民摆脱可怕的困境。

plot.example: The movie has a simple plot, and my friends like it very much.
plot.exampleZh: 这部电影情节简单，我的朋友们非常喜欢它。

plow.example: Farmers use a strong plow to turn the soil before planting.
plow.exampleZh: 农民在播种前用结实的犁翻土。

plug.example: Please plug the lamp into the wall socket near the door.
plug.exampleZh: 请把台灯插到门附近的墙上插座里。

plunge.example: The stock market took a sudden plunge after the bad news came out.
plunge.exampleZh: 坏消息传来后，股市突然暴跌。

plural.example: The word mice is the plural form of the word mouse.
plural.exampleZh: mice 这个词是 mouse 这个词的复数形式。

plus.example: The price is ten dollars plus tax, so bring a little extra money.
plus.exampleZh: 价格是十美元加税，所以多带一点钱。

pocket.example: He put the small key into his coat pocket and left the room.
pocket.exampleZh: 他把小钥匙放进外套口袋，然后离开了房间。

poetry.example: She reads poetry every night before bed because it helps her relax.
poetry.exampleZh: 她每晚睡前都会读诗，因为这能帮助她放松。

point.example: The main point of his speech was very clear to everyone.
point.exampleZh: 他演讲的要点对每个人来说都非常清楚。

poison.example: Someone put poison in the old well and made many people sick.
poison.exampleZh: 有人把毒药放进旧井里，使许多人病了。

poisonous.example: Some mushrooms are poisonous, so never eat wild ones without expert help.
poisonous.exampleZh: 有些蘑菇有毒，所以没有专家帮助绝不要吃野蘑菇。

poke.example: She poked the fire with a stick and smiled at me.
poke.exampleZh: 她用一根棍子拨了拨火，然后对我笑了笑。

polar.example: The polar bear lives in a very cold place near the North Pole.
polar.exampleZh: 北极熊生活在北极附近一个非常寒冷的地方。

pole.example: He tied the boat to a wooden pole near the shore.
pole.exampleZh: 他把船拴在岸边的一根木杆上。

police.example: The police came quickly and helped the lost child find his parents.
police.exampleZh: 警察很快赶来，帮助走失的孩子找到了父母。

policy.example: The company has a new policy about working from home on Fridays.
policy.exampleZh: 公司有一项关于周五在家办公的新政策。

polish.example: I need to polish my shoes before the meeting tomorrow morning.
polish.exampleZh: 明天早上开会前我需要把鞋子擦亮。

polite.example: The polite boy always says thank you when someone helps him.
polite.exampleZh: 那个有礼貌的男孩在别人帮助他时总会说谢谢。

political.example: The political meeting was long, but everyone stayed until the end.
political.exampleZh: 这次政治会议很长，但每个人都留到了最后。

politician.example: The politician promised to improve schools and create more jobs for local people.
politician.exampleZh: 这位政治家承诺改善学校，并为当地人民创造更多就业机会。

politics.example: My brother studies politics at college because he wants to understand government.
politics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在大学学习政治学，因为他想了解政府。

poll.example: The latest poll shows that most people support the new plan.
poll.exampleZh: 最新的民意测验显示，大多数人支持这项新计划。

pollute.example: Factories should not pollute the river with dirty water.
pollute.exampleZh: 工厂不应该用脏水污染河流。

pollution.example: Air pollution is a big problem in many large cities today.
pollution.exampleZh: 空气污染是当今许多大城市的一个大问题。

pond.example: The children saw many small fish swimming in the pond near their house.
pond.exampleZh: 孩子们看到许多小鱼在他们家附近的池塘里游来游去。

ponder.example: I often ponder what I should do next in my life.
ponder.exampleZh: 我常常思考我接下来的人生该做什么。

pool.example: The children swam in the pool while their parents sat nearby.
pool.exampleZh: 孩子们在游泳池里游泳，而他们的父母坐在附近。

poor.example: The poor family lives in a small house near the river.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭住在河边的一间小房子里。

pop.example: She likes pop music and plays it every day after school.
pop.exampleZh: 她喜欢流行音乐，每天放学后都会播放。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people in our city.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌在我们城市的年轻人中很受欢迎。

popularity.example: The popularity of this song grew quickly among young people.
popularity.exampleZh: 这首歌在年轻人中迅速流行起来。

population.example: The population of our city has grown quickly in recent years.
population.exampleZh: 我们城市的人口近年来增长很快。

porch.example: We sat on the porch and watched the rain fall for a while.
porch.exampleZh: 我们坐在门廊上，看了一会儿雨落下。

pork.example: My mother cooked pork with fresh vegetables for our family dinner.
pork.exampleZh: 我妈妈用新鲜蔬菜为我们家的晚餐做了猪肉。

port.example: The ship arrived at the port early in the morning.

portable.example: This small portable radio is easy to carry on trips.
portable.exampleZh: 这个小巧的便携式收音机在旅行时很容易携带。

porter.example: The porter helped us carry our heavy bags to the room.
porter.exampleZh: 行李员帮我们把沉重的行李搬到房间里。

portion.example: She gave me a small portion of the cake.
portion.exampleZh: 她给了我蛋糕的一小部分。

portrait.example: The artist painted a portrait of my grandmother last summer.
portrait.exampleZh: 那位艺术家去年夏天画了一幅我祖母的肖像。

portray.example: The movie tries to portray the young teacher as a kind hero.
portray.exampleZh: 这部电影试图把这位年轻教师描绘成一位善良的英雄。

pose.example: She likes to pose for photos in front of the old house.
pose.exampleZh: 她喜欢在老房子前摆姿势拍照。

position.example: She applied for a new position at the company last week.
position.exampleZh: 她上周申请了公司的一个新职位。

positive.example: She always stays positive even when things are hard.
positive.exampleZh: 即使事情很难，她也总是保持积极。

possess.example: Many people possess skills that they do not use at work.
possess.exampleZh: 许多人拥有他们在工作中不使用的技能。

possession.example: He lost all his possessions in the fire last night.
possession.exampleZh: 他在昨晚的火灾中失去了所有财产。

possibility.example: There is a real possibility that it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
possibility.exampleZh: 明天下午真的有可能下雨。

possible.example: It is possible to finish this work before noon today.
possible.exampleZh: 今天中午之前完成这项工作是有可能的。

post.example: Please post the letter today at the post office.
post.exampleZh: 请今天去邮局把这封信寄了。

postage.example: The postage for this small package is five dollars.
postage.exampleZh: 这个小包裹的邮费是五美元。

poster.example: I put a colorful poster on my bedroom wall yesterday afternoon.
poster.exampleZh: 昨天下午我把一张色彩鲜艳的海报贴在了卧室墙上。

postman.example: The postman brings our letters every morning before we leave for work.
postman.exampleZh: 邮递员每天早上在我们去上班前送来我们的信件。

postpone.example: We had to postpone the meeting because the manager was still sick.
postpone.exampleZh: 我们不得不推迟会议，因为经理还病着。

posture.example: Good posture can help you feel more confident and avoid back pain.
posture.exampleZh: 良好的姿势能帮助你更自信，并避免背痛。

pot.example: She put the flowers in a big pot on the table.
pot.exampleZh: 她把花插在桌上的一个大花盆里。

potent.example: This is a potent medicine that can cure the disease quickly.
potent.exampleZh: 这是一种强效的药物，能迅速治愈这种疾病。

potential.example: She has great potential as a singer and works hard every day.
potential.exampleZh: 她作为歌手有很大的潜力，而且每天都努力练习。

pottery.example: She makes beautiful pottery in a small shop near her house.
pottery.exampleZh: 她在她家附近的一家小店里制作漂亮的陶器。

pound.example: I bought a pound of apples at the small shop yesterday.
pound.exampleZh: 昨天我在那家小商店买了一磅苹果。

pour.example: She poured the hot water slowly into the cup.
pour.exampleZh: 她把热水慢慢倒进杯子里。

poverty.example: Many families still live in poverty and need help from others.
poverty.exampleZh: 许多家庭仍然生活在贫困中，需要别人的帮助。

powder.example: The baker added some white powder to the flour and mixed it well.
powder.exampleZh: 面包师在面粉里加了一些白色粉末，并充分搅拌。

power.example: Knowledge is a kind of power that can change our lives.
power.exampleZh: 知识是一种能够改变我们生活的力量。

powerful.example: This is a powerful car that can go very fast.
powerful.exampleZh: 这是一辆动力强劲、能跑得很快的汽车。

practical.example: This practical tool helps us finish the work faster every day.
practical.exampleZh: 这个实用的工具帮助我们每天更快地完成工作。

practically.example: The old computer is practically useless, so we need to buy a new one.
practically.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑几乎没用了，所以我们需要买一台新的。

practice.example: Daily practice helps you improve your English speaking skills step by step.
practice.exampleZh: 每天练习能帮助你一步一步提高英语口语能力。

praise.example: The teacher gave the students high praise for their hard work.
praise.exampleZh: 老师因学生们的努力而高度赞扬了他们。

pray.example: I pray for good health and happiness for my family every night.
pray.exampleZh: 我每晚都为家人的健康和幸福祈祷。

prayer.example: She said a quiet prayer before dinner with her family.
prayer.exampleZh: 她在与家人吃晚饭前轻声做了祈祷。

preach.example: My father will preach at the small church this Sunday morning.
preach.exampleZh: 我父亲这个星期天早上将在那座小教堂布道。

precaution.example: You should take every precaution to keep your family safe at home.
precaution.exampleZh: 你应该采取一切预防措施来保障家人在家的安全。

precede.example: The dark clouds usually precede a heavy rain in summer.
precede.exampleZh: 夏天，乌云通常先于大雨出现。

precedent.example: The court's decision set a new precedent for similar cases.
precedent.exampleZh: 法院的判决为类似案件确立了新的先例。

precious.example: Family time is precious, so we try to spend it together.
precious.exampleZh: 家庭时光很珍贵，所以我们尽量一起度过。

precise.example: Her instructions were precise and easy to follow for everyone in the group.
precise.exampleZh: 她的指示精确明了，组里每个人都容易照做。

precision.example: The precision of his work helps the team avoid small mistakes.
precision.exampleZh: 他工作的精确性帮助团队避免小错误。

predecessor.example: My predecessor left me a lot of useful notes for the job.
predecessor.exampleZh: 我的前任给我留下了许多有用的工作笔记。

predict.example: Scientists predict that the weather will be warmer next week.
predict.exampleZh: 科学家预测下周天气会更暖和。

predominant.example: The predominant color in the room is soft blue.
predominant.exampleZh: 这个房间的主要颜色是柔和的蓝色。

preference.example: I have a preference for tea over coffee in the morning.
preference.exampleZh: 我早上更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。

pregnant.example: My sister is pregnant and she is very happy about the baby.
pregnant.exampleZh: 我姐姐怀孕了，她对这个宝宝感到非常高兴。

prejudice.example: Some people still have prejudice against others because of their skin color.
prejudice.exampleZh: 有些人仍然因为肤色而对他人抱有偏见。

preliminary.example: The preliminary test showed that the new machine works well.
preliminary.exampleZh: 初步测试表明这台新机器运行良好。

premier.example: The premier met the workers and promised to build more homes this year.
premier.exampleZh: 总理会见了工人，并承诺今年建造更多住房。

premise.example: The main premise of his argument is easy to understand.
premise.exampleZh: 他论证的主要前提很容易理解。

premium.example: I paid an extra premium for faster delivery of my new phone.
premium.exampleZh: 我为新手机更快的配送支付了额外费用。

preparation.example: Good preparation before the exam helps students feel much more confident.
preparation.exampleZh: 考试前做好充分准备能帮助学生感到自信得多。

prepare.example: We need to prepare dinner before our guests arrive at six.
prepare.exampleZh: 我们需要在客人六点到之前准备好晚饭。

prescribe.example: The doctor will prescribe some medicine to help you feel better soon.
prescribe.exampleZh: 医生会开一些药来帮助你很快好起来。

prescription.example: The doctor gave me a prescription for some cough medicine.
prescription.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一些止咳药的处方。

presence.example: Her presence in the room made everyone feel calm and safe.
presence.exampleZh: 她在房间里让每个人都感到平静和安全。

present.example: She is happy to present her new idea to the class today.
present.exampleZh: 她今天很高兴向全班介绍她的新想法。

presently.example: The bus will arrive presently, so please wait here for a few minutes.
presently.exampleZh: 公交车不久就会到，所以请在这里等几分钟。

preserve.example: We must preserve the old trees in our town.
preserve.exampleZh: 我们必须保护我们镇上的老树。

preside.example: She will preside over the meeting in the small room today.
preside.exampleZh: 她今天将在小房间主持这次会议。

president.example: The president gave a short speech to the students this morning.
president.exampleZh: 校长今天上午给学生们作了一个简短的演讲。

press.example: Please press the red button gently to start the machine.
press.exampleZh: 请轻轻按下红色按钮来启动机器。

pressure.example: Many students feel a lot of pressure before their final exams each year.
pressure.exampleZh: 许多学生每年期末考试前都会感到很大的压力。

presumably.example: Presumably, the train is late because of the heavy snow.
presumably.exampleZh: 据推测，火车因为大雪而晚点了。

presume.example: I presume you are tired after such a long trip today.
presume.exampleZh: 我猜你今天坐了这么久的车，一定累了。

pretend.example: The little boy likes to pretend that he is a superhero.
pretend.exampleZh: 那个小男孩喜欢假装自己是个超级英雄。

pretext.example: He used his busy schedule as a pretext to avoid the meeting.
pretext.exampleZh: 他以工作繁忙为借口避免了这次会议。

pretty.example: She is a pretty girl and she sings very well.
pretty.exampleZh: 她是个漂亮的女孩，而且她唱得很好。

prevail.example: Small shops still prevail in this old town because people like them.
prevail.exampleZh: 在这座老城里，小商店仍然很盛行，因为人们喜欢它们。

prevalent.example: This disease is prevalent in many hot and wet countries.
prevalent.exampleZh: 这种疾病在许多炎热潮湿的国家很流行。

prevent.example: We must wash our hands to prevent the spread of germs.
prevent.exampleZh: 我们必须洗手以防止细菌传播。

preview.example: You can preview the new lesson before class starts tomorrow morning.
preview.exampleZh: 你可以在明天早上上课前预习新课。

previous.example: I met her the previous day at the small shop near my home.
previous.exampleZh: 我前一天在我家附近的小商店遇见了她。

prey.example: The hungry lion hunts its prey in the open field every morning.
prey.exampleZh: 饥饿的狮子每天早晨在开阔的田野里捕食猎物。

price.example: The price of this small house is too high for us.
price.exampleZh: 这栋小房子的价格对我们来说太高了。

pride.example: She takes great pride in her work and always tries her best.
pride.exampleZh: 她对自己的工作感到非常自豪，总是尽力而为。

priest.example: The priest spoke kindly to the children after the Sunday morning service.
priest.exampleZh: 周日上午的礼拜结束后，神父和蔼地对孩子们讲话。

primarily.example: This book is primarily about how people learn new languages.
primarily.exampleZh: 这本书主要是关于人们如何学习新语言的。

primary.example: Our primary goal is to keep the children safe and healthy.
primary.exampleZh: 我们的首要目标是让孩子们安全健康。

prime.example: Good health is the prime thing in life.
prime.exampleZh: 健康是生活中最重要的东西。

primitive.example: People in primitive times used simple tools to hunt for food every day.
primitive.exampleZh: 在原始时代，人们每天用简单的工具捕猎食物。

prince.example: The young prince lived in a large castle near the sea.
prince.exampleZh: 年轻的王子住在海边一座大城堡里。

princess.example: The young princess wore a beautiful dress at the royal party.
princess.exampleZh: 年轻的公主在皇家聚会上穿了一条漂亮的裙子。

principal.example: The principal reason for our meeting is to discuss the new plan.
principal.exampleZh: 我们开会的主要原因是讨论新计划。

principle.example: Honesty is an important principle in our family and at school.
principle.exampleZh: 诚实是我们家庭和学校里的重要原则。

print.example: Please print two copies of this page for the meeting.
print.exampleZh: 请为会议打印这份页面的两份副本。

prior.example: You need prior approval before you can enter the building.
prior.exampleZh: 进入这栋大楼前，你需要事先获得批准。

priority.example: Safety is our top priority when we plan every new project.
priority.exampleZh: 安全是我们规划每个新项目时的首要优先事项。

prison.example: The thief was sent to prison for two years after the trial.
prison.exampleZh: 那个小偷在审判后被送进监狱两年。

prisoner.example: The prisoner was very tired after a long day in the cold cell.
prisoner.exampleZh: 那个囚犯在寒冷的牢房里待了一整天后非常疲惫。

private.example: I keep my private life separate from my work at the office.
private.exampleZh: 我把私人生活与办公室的工作分开。

privilege.example: It is a great privilege to work with such kind people.
privilege.exampleZh: 能和这么善良的人一起工作是我的荣幸。

prize.example: She won first prize in the school spelling contest last Friday.
prize.exampleZh: 她在上周五的学校拼写比赛中获得了一等奖。

probability.example: There is a high probability that it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
probability.exampleZh: 明天下午下雨的可能性很高。

probable.example: It is probable that we will finish the work before noon today.
probable.exampleZh: 我们今天中午前完成这项工作是很可能的。

probe.example: The doctor used a small probe to check the wound carefully.
probe.exampleZh: 医生用一个小探针仔细检查了伤口。

problem.example: We need to solve this problem before the end of the day.
problem.exampleZh: 我们需要在今天结束前解决这个问题。

procedure.example: Please follow the safety procedure before you start the new machine.
procedure.exampleZh: 请在你启动新机器之前遵循安全程序。

proceed.example: After a short break, we will proceed with the meeting as planned.
proceed.exampleZh: 短暂休息后，我们将按计划继续进行会议。

process.example: Learning a new language is a slow process for most people.
process.exampleZh: 对大多数人来说，学习一门新语言是一个缓慢的过程。

procession.example: A long procession moved slowly through the quiet streets of the old town.
procession.exampleZh: 一支长长的队伍缓缓穿过老城安静的街道。

proclaim.example: They proclaimed the good news to everyone in the small town.
proclaim.exampleZh: 他们向小镇上的每个人宣布了这个好消息。

produce.example: Local farmers produce fresh vegetables and sell them at the market every morning.
produce.exampleZh: 当地农民生产新鲜蔬菜，每天早晨在市场上出售。

product.example: This new product is very popular with young people in our city.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品在我们城市的年轻人中很受欢迎。

production.example: The factory increased its production of shoes by ten percent last year.
production.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年将鞋子的产量提高了百分之十。

productive.example: A short break can make your afternoon more productive and less stressful.
productive.exampleZh: 短暂休息能让你的下午更高效，压力也更小。

profession.example: Teaching is a profession that requires patience and a lot of care.
profession.exampleZh: 教学是一门需要耐心和大量关怀的职业。

professional.example: She is a professional nurse and she works in a large hospital.
professional.exampleZh: 她是一名专业护士，在一家大医院工作。

professor.example: The professor explained the lesson clearly to all the students in class.
professor.exampleZh: 教授在课堂上向所有学生清楚地讲解了这一课。

profile.example: The police kept a detailed profile of the suspect in their files.
profile.exampleZh: 警方在档案中保存了嫌疑人的详细概况。

profit.example: The small shop made a good profit this year.
profit.exampleZh: 这家小店今年赚了不少利润。

profitable.example: The small shop became profitable after it started selling coffee.
profitable.exampleZh: 这家小店在开始卖咖啡后变得有利可图。

profound.example: The teacher's words had a profound effect on my young mind.
profound.exampleZh: 老师的话对我年轻的心灵产生了深刻的影响。

program.example: I wrote a simple program to help my mother plan her week.
program.exampleZh: 我写了一个简单的程序，帮我妈妈安排她这一周的计划。

progress.example: She made great progress in English after practicing every day with her friends.
progress.exampleZh: 她每天和朋友练习后，英语取得了很大进步。

progressive.example: Her progressive ideas helped the small town build a better school.
progressive.exampleZh: 她进步的思想帮助这个小镇建了一所更好的学校。

prohibit.example: The school prohibits students from using phones during class.
prohibit.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

project.example: Our new project will start next week and we are very excited.
project.exampleZh: 我们的新项目将于下周开始，我们非常兴奋。

prolong.example: We should not prolong the meeting if everyone is tired.
prolong.exampleZh: 如果大家都累了，我们就不应该延长会议。

prominent.example: She is a prominent scientist at our university and teaches many students.
prominent.exampleZh: 她是我们大学一位著名的科学家，教许多学生。

promise.example: I promise I will help you with your homework after dinner.
promise.exampleZh: 我保证晚饭后帮你做作业。

promising.example: The young singer is very promising and has a bright future.
promising.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手很有前途，前途光明。

promote.example: The school started a new program to promote healthy eating among young students.
promote.exampleZh: 学校启动了一个新项目，以促进年轻学生健康饮食。

prompt.example: The teacher gave us a prompt answer and told us to start now.
prompt.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一个迅速的回答，并让我们现在开始。

pronounce.example: Please pronounce your name slowly so everyone in the room can hear you.
pronounce.exampleZh: 请慢慢说出你的名字，让房间里的每个人都能听见。

proof.example: The police found no proof that he broke the law.
proof.exampleZh: 警方没有找到他违法的证据。

proper.example: Please put the books in the proper place on the shelf.
proper.exampleZh: 请把书放在书架上适当的位置。

property.example: This property has a large garden and a small old house.
property.exampleZh: 这处房产有一个大花园和一栋小旧房子。

prophet.example: The old prophet told people that rain would come soon.
prophet.exampleZh: 那位年老的先知告诉人们雨很快就会来。

proportion.example: A large proportion of students walk to school every day.
proportion.exampleZh: 很大一部分学生每天步行上学。

proposal.example: She accepted his proposal and they planned a small wedding for next spring.
proposal.exampleZh: 她接受了他的求婚，他们计划明年春天办一场小型婚礼。

propose.example: I propose that we meet at the library after school tomorrow.
propose.exampleZh: 我提议我们明天放学后在图书馆见面。

proposition.example: The teacher explained the proposition in a way that was easy to understand.
proposition.exampleZh: 老师用简单易懂的方式解释了这个命题。

prose.example: She likes to read prose more than poetry in her free time.
prose.exampleZh: 她空闲时更喜欢读散文而不是诗歌。

prosecute.example: The police will prosecute the man for stealing a car.
prosecute.exampleZh: 警方将以偷车罪起诉这名男子。

prospect.example: The prospect of a long holiday made everyone in the office very happy.
prospect.exampleZh: 有望放长假这件事让办公室里的每个人都很高兴。

prosperity.example: Hard work and good trade brought peace and prosperity to the small town.
prosperity.exampleZh: 勤劳和良好的贸易给这个小镇带来了和平与繁荣。

prosperous.example: Our small town became prosperous after the new factory opened last year.
prosperous.exampleZh: 新工厂去年开业后，我们的小镇变得繁荣起来。

protect.example: We must protect the trees and animals in our city.
protect.exampleZh: 我们必须保护我们城市里的树木和动物。

protein.example: You can get protein from foods like eggs, milk, and beans.
protein.exampleZh: 你可以从鸡蛋、牛奶和豆类等食物中获取蛋白质。

protest.example: Many people protest against the new rule because it is not fair.
protest.exampleZh: 许多人抗议这项新规定，因为它不公平。

prototype.example: The engineers built a prototype of the new car to test its safety.
prototype.exampleZh: 工程师们制造了一辆新车的原型来测试它的安全性。

proud.example: She is proud of her son for working so hard.
proud.exampleZh: 她为儿子如此努力工作而感到自豪。

prove.example: The scientist worked hard to prove that his new idea was true.
prove.exampleZh: 这位科学家努力工作，以证明他的新想法是正确的。

provide.example: We will provide food and water for everyone at the meeting.
provide.exampleZh: 我们将为会议上的每个人提供食物和水。

provided.example: You can go out provided you finish your homework before dinner.
provided.exampleZh: 你可以出去，只要你晚饭前完成作业。

province.example: He lives in a small province near the sea and works on a farm.
province.exampleZh: 他住在海边的一个小省，在农场工作。

provision.example: The school made provision for free meals for all students.
provision.exampleZh: 学校为所有学生提供了免费餐食。

provoke.example: His rude words may provoke a strong reaction from the crowd.
provoke.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的话可能会激怒人群，引起强烈反应。

prudent.example: It is prudent to save some money for a rainy day.
prudent.exampleZh: 为不时之需存些钱是审慎的。

psychiatry.example: She studies psychiatry because she wants to help people with mental illness.
psychiatry.exampleZh: 她学习精神病学，因为她想帮助患有精神疾病的人。

psychological.example: The doctor said her pain was psychological and not caused by any physical problem.
psychological.exampleZh: 医生说她的疼痛是心理上的，并非由任何身体问题引起。

psychology.example: She wants to study psychology because she is interested in how people think and feel.
psychology.exampleZh: 她想学习心理学，因为她对人类如何思考和感受感兴趣。

pub.example: We met some old friends at a small pub near the station.
pub.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的一家小酒馆见到了几位老朋友。

public.example: The new public library is open to everyone in our town.
public.exampleZh: 我们镇上的新公共图书馆向所有人开放。

publication.example: The publication of her new book was announced last week.
publication.exampleZh: 她新书的出版消息于上周公布。

publicity.example: The new movie got a lot of publicity before it opened.
publicity.exampleZh: 这部新电影在上映前得到了大量宣传。

publish.example: The writer will publish his new book next month.
publish.exampleZh: 这位作家下个月将出版他的新书。

puff.example: She took a puff of fresh air and felt much better.
puff.exampleZh: 她吸了一口新鲜空气，感觉好多了。

pull.example: Please pull the heavy box to the door for me.
pull.exampleZh: 请帮我把那个重箱子拉到门口。

pulse.example: The doctor checked my pulse and told me to rest.
pulse.exampleZh: 医生检查了我的脉搏，并让我休息。

pump.example: The farmer uses a pump to bring water from the well to his field.
pump.exampleZh: 农民用泵把水从井里抽到田里。

punch.example: He gave the wall a hard punch and hurt his hand.
punch.exampleZh: 他用力打了墙一拳，伤到了自己的手。

punctual.example: She is always punctual for class and never arrives late.
punctual.exampleZh: 她上课总是很准时，从不迟到。

punish.example: The teacher will punish students who cheat on the exam.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚考试作弊的学生。

punishment.example: The punishment for breaking the school rules was a week of extra homework.
punishment.exampleZh: 违反校规的惩罚是额外做一周的作业。

pupil.example: The pupil raised her hand and asked the teacher a simple question.
pupil.exampleZh: 那个小学生举手，向老师问了一个简单的问题。

puppet.example: The little boy moved the puppet with strings and made it dance.
puppet.exampleZh: 小男孩用绳子移动木偶，让它跳舞。

purchase.example: I want to purchase a new computer for my small home office.
purchase.exampleZh: 我想为我的小家庭办公室购买一台新电脑。

pure.example: The water in this mountain lake is pure and safe to drink.
pure.exampleZh: 这个山湖里的水是纯净的，可以安全饮用。

purify.example: We can purify the water before we drink it.
purify.exampleZh: 我们可以在喝水之前净化水。

purple.example: She wore a purple dress to the party last night.
purple.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条紫色连衣裙去参加聚会。

purpose.example: The main purpose of this meeting is to share our new plan.
purpose.exampleZh: 这次会议的主要目的是分享我们的新计划。

purse.example: She opened her purse to find some money for the bus.
purse.exampleZh: 她打开钱包想找些钱坐公交车。

pursue.example: Many young people pursue their dreams even when life is hard.
pursue.exampleZh: 许多年轻人即使生活艰难也会追求自己的梦想。

pursuit.example: Her pursuit of happiness made her life more meaningful and full of hope.
pursuit.exampleZh: 她对幸福的追求让她的生活更有意义、充满希望。

push.example: She had to push the heavy door open with both hands.
push.exampleZh: 她不得不用双手推开那扇沉重的门。

put.example: Please put the book on the table before you leave the room.
put.exampleZh: 请在你离开房间前把书放在桌子上。

puzzle.example: This puzzle is too hard for young children to solve alone.
puzzle.exampleZh: 这个谜题太难了，年幼的孩子无法独自解决。

pyramid.example: The children built a small pyramid with sand on the beach.
pyramid.exampleZh: 孩子们在海滩上用沙子建了一个小金字塔。

quaint.example: The quaint little village has many old houses and a small bridge.
quaint.exampleZh: 这个古雅的小村庄有许多老房子和一座小桥。

qualification.example: She has the right qualifications for this job.
qualification.exampleZh: 她具备这份工作所需的资格。

qualify.example: You must pass the test to qualify for the job.
qualify.exampleZh: 你必须通过考试才能取得这份工作的资格。

qualitative.example: The study gives a qualitative view of how students learn at home.
qualitative.exampleZh: 这项研究定性地展示了学生在家学习的情况。

quality.example: The quality of this cheap bag is not very good.
quality.exampleZh: 这个便宜包的质量不太好。

quantify.example: We need to quantify the benefits before we make a final decision.
quantify.exampleZh: 我们需要在做出最终决定之前量化这些好处。

quantitative.example: The study collected quantitative data on how students spend their free time.
quantitative.exampleZh: 这项研究收集了关于学生如何度过空闲时间的定量数据。

quantity.example: We need a large quantity of water for the whole team.
quantity.exampleZh: 我们需要为整个团队准备大量的水。

quarrel.example: They had a quarrel about money but soon became friends again.
quarrel.exampleZh: 他们因为钱吵了一架，但很快就又和好了。

quarter.example: She works in the city center for three days every quarter.
quarter.exampleZh: 她每个季度在市中心工作三天。

quarterly.example: The company sends a quarterly report to all its workers.
quarterly.exampleZh: 公司向所有员工发送季度报告。

quartz.example: The old watch has a clear quartz cover that still looks very beautiful.
quartz.exampleZh: 这块旧手表有一层透明的石英表盖，看起来仍然非常漂亮。

queen.example: The queen lives in a big castle with her family.
queen.exampleZh: 女王和她的家人住在一座大城堡里。

queer.example: There was a queer smell in the old room last night.
queer.exampleZh: 昨晚那个旧房间里有一股奇怪的气味。

quench.example: A glass of cold water can quench your thirst on a hot day.
quench.exampleZh: 一杯冷水能在热天解渴。

query.example: She sent a query to the support team about her order.
query.exampleZh: 她向客服团队发了一个关于她订单的询问。

quest.example: Their quest for clean water took many years.
quest.exampleZh: 他们对清洁水源的探求持续了很多年。

question.example: I have a question about the homework for today.
question.exampleZh: 我对今天的作业有一个问题。

questionnaire.example: Please fill out this questionnaire before you leave the office today.
questionnaire.exampleZh: 请在今天离开办公室前填写这份问卷。

queue.example: We had to queue for a long time at the busy ticket office.
queue.exampleZh: 我们不得不在繁忙的售票处排队等了很长时间。

quick.example: She is very quick at learning new things at school.
quick.exampleZh: 她在学校学新东西非常快。

quiet.example: The library is very quiet in the morning before people arrive.
quiet.exampleZh: 早上人们到来之前，图书馆非常安静。

quilt.example: My mother made a warm quilt for me last winter.
quilt.exampleZh: 去年冬天我妈妈给我做了一床暖和的被子。

quit.example: She decided to quit her job and look for a new one.
quit.exampleZh: 她决定辞掉工作，去找一份新工作。

quite.example: The test was quite easy, and I finished it in ten minutes.
quite.exampleZh: 这次考试相当容易，我十分钟就做完了。

quiver.example: Her voice began to quiver when she spoke about the sad news.
quiver.exampleZh: 当她谈到那个悲伤的消息时，她的声音开始颤抖。

quiz.example: Our teacher gave us a short quiz before the class ended today.
quiz.exampleZh: 今天下课前，老师给我们做了一次小测验。

quota.example: Each team has a quota of ten new members this year.
quota.exampleZh: 每个团队今年有十个新成员的配额。

quotation.example: I asked the seller for a quotation on the new office chairs.
quotation.exampleZh: 我向卖家询问了新办公椅的报价。

quote.example: Please quote the price from the letter in your next email.
quote.exampleZh: 请在下一封邮件中引用信里的价格。

rabbit.example: A small white rabbit is eating a carrot in the garden.
rabbit.exampleZh: 一只小白兔正在花园里吃胡萝卜。

race.example: The race was long, but every runner finished it safely.
race.exampleZh: 这场比赛很长，但每位跑者都安全完成了。

racial.example: They had a long talk about racial equality in schools.
racial.exampleZh: 他们就学校里的种族平等进行了长时间交谈。

rack.example: He put the old books on the wooden rack near the door.
rack.exampleZh: 他把旧书放在门边的木架子上。

radar.example: The ship used radar to find the safe way through the fog.
radar.exampleZh: 这艘船用雷达在雾中找到安全的航道。

radiant.example: She looked radiant in her simple white dress at the party.
radiant.exampleZh: 她在派对上穿着简单的白裙子，看起来容光焕发。

radiate.example: The warm fire radiates heat to everyone in the small room.
radiate.exampleZh: 温暖的炉火向小房间里的每个人散发著热量。

radiation.example: The sun sends out radiation that can hurt your skin.
radiation.exampleZh: 太阳发出会伤害皮肤的辐射。

radical.example: The company made radical changes to its old rules last year.
radical.exampleZh: 公司去年对其旧规则做出了彻底的改变。

radio.example: I listen to the radio every morning while I eat breakfast.
radio.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃早餐时听收音机。

radioactive.example: The old machine is radioactive and must be kept in a safe place.
radioactive.exampleZh: 这台旧机器有放射性，必须放在安全的地方。

radius.example: The police searched within a radius of five miles around the old house.
radius.exampleZh: 警方在旧房子周围五英里的半径范围内进行了搜查。

rag.example: She wiped the dusty table with an old rag.
rag.exampleZh: 她用一块旧抹布擦掉了满是灰尘的桌子。

rage.example: His rage grew as he waited in the long line.
rage.exampleZh: 他在长队中等待时，怒火越来越大。

raid.example: The police raided the old house early this morning and found stolen goods.
raid.exampleZh: 警察今天清晨突袭了那栋老房子，并发现了赃物。

rail.example: He held the rail while walking down the stairs.

railroad.example: The new railroad will connect our small town to the big city.
railroad.exampleZh: 这条新铁路将把我们的小镇连接到大城市。

railway.example: The new railway connects the small town with the big city.
railway.exampleZh: 这条新铁路把小镇和大城市连接起来。

rain.example: The rain stopped and we walked home under a bright rainbow.
rain.exampleZh: 雨停了，我们在一道明亮的彩虹下走回家。

rainbow.example: After the rain, a bright rainbow appeared in the sky above our house.
rainbow.exampleZh: 雨后，一道明亮的彩虹出现在我们房子上方的天空中。

raise.example: They plan to raise money to build a new school in the village.
raise.exampleZh: 他们计划筹集资金在村里建一所新学校。

rally.example: The team will rally together to finish the project on time.
rally.exampleZh: 团队将齐心协力按时完成这个项目。

ram.example: The farmer saw a big ram standing near the old wooden gate.
ram.exampleZh: 农夫看到一只大公羊站在旧木门附近。

random.example: I picked a random book from the shelf and started to read it.
random.exampleZh: 我从书架上随手拿了一本书，开始读起来。

range.example: The store sells a wide range of fresh fruit and vegetables.
range.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

rank.example: He joined the army and slowly rose to the rank of captain.
rank.exampleZh: 他参军后慢慢升到了上尉军衔。

rapid.example: The rapid growth of the city brought many new jobs for local people.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市的迅速增长为当地人带来了许多新工作。

rare.example: This is a rare bird, and we are lucky to see it.
rare.exampleZh: 这是一只稀有的鸟，我们很幸运能看到它。

rarely.example: She rarely eats fast food because she likes to cook at home.
rarely.exampleZh: 她很少吃快餐，因为她喜欢在家做饭。

rash.example: It is rash to make such a big decision without asking anyone.
rash.exampleZh: 不征求任何人的意见就做出这么大的决定是轻率的。

rate.example: The interest rate on this loan is too high for most families.
rate.exampleZh: 这笔贷款的利率对大多数家庭来说太高了。

rather.example: I would rather stay home tonight because the weather is rather cold.
rather.exampleZh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里，因为天气相当冷。

ratio.example: The ratio of students to teachers in our school is ten to one.
