ratio.exampleZh: 我们学校学生与教师的比例是十比一。

rational.example: It is rational to save some money for a rainy day.
rational.exampleZh: 存一些钱以备不时之需是合理的。

raw.example: The raw fish was too cold to eat, so we cooked it.
raw.exampleZh: 那条生鱼太凉了，不能吃，所以我们把它煮了。

ray.example: A ray of sunlight came through the small window.
ray.exampleZh: 一束阳光透过小窗户照了进来。

razor.example: He used a sharp razor to shave his face this morning.
razor.exampleZh: 今天早上他用一把锋利的剃刀刮了脸。

reach.example: We will reach the station before noon and then call our friends.
reach.exampleZh: 我们将在中午前到达车站，然后给朋友们打电话。

react.example: How did she react when she heard the good news?
react.exampleZh: 她听到这个好消息时是什么反应？

reaction.example: Her quick reaction saved the team from a serious problem.
reaction.exampleZh: 她迅速的反应使团队避免了一个严重问题。

read.example: I like to read books before I go to sleep at night.
read.exampleZh: 我喜欢在晚上睡觉前读书。

reader.example: The reader asked the librarian for a book about modern art.
reader.exampleZh: 这位读者向图书管理员要了一本关于现代艺术的书。

readily.example: She readily agreed to help us with the project today.
readily.exampleZh: 她乐意地答应今天帮我们做这个项目。

reading.example: Reading is one of the best habits for learning a new language.
reading.exampleZh: 阅读是学习一门新语言的最佳习惯之一。

ready.example: I am always ready to help my friends with their difficult homework.
ready.exampleZh: 我总是乐意帮助朋友们完成困难的作业。

real.example: The story is based on real events that happened in our town.
real.exampleZh: 这个故事是根据发生在我们镇上的真实事件改编的。

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan before we start the new project.
realistic.exampleZh: 在开始新项目之前，我们需要一个实际的计划。

reality.example: The reality of city life is harder than many young people expect.
reality.exampleZh: 城市生活的现实比许多年轻人预想的更艰难。

realization.example: The realization that she was late made him run to the station quickly.
realization.exampleZh: 意识到她迟到了，他赶紧跑向车站。

realize.example: I did not realize how much time I had wasted yesterday.
realize.exampleZh: 我没有意识到昨天自己浪费了多少时间。

really.example: I really like this book because it is very interesting and easy to read.
really.exampleZh: 我真的很喜欢这本书，因为它非常有趣而且容易读。

realm.example: This book opens a new realm of ideas for young readers.
realm.exampleZh: 这本书为年轻读者打开了一个新的思想领域。

reap.example: If you work hard now, you will reap the rewards later.
reap.exampleZh: 如果你现在努力工作，以后就会收获回报。

rear.example: The rear of the car was damaged, and she reared three children alone.
rear.exampleZh: 汽车的后部受损了，她独自抚养了三个孩子。

reason.example: There is no reason for you to be afraid of that dog.
reason.exampleZh: 你没有理由害怕那只狗。

reasonable.example: It is reasonable to ask for a little more time.
reasonable.exampleZh: 要求多给一点时间是合理的。

rebel.example: The young rebel refused to follow the old rules and spoke out.
rebel.exampleZh: 那个年轻的叛逆者拒绝遵守旧规则，并大声说出了自己的想法。

recall.example: I cannot recall where I put my keys this morning.
recall.exampleZh: 我想不起来今天早上把钥匙放在哪里了。

recede.example: The flood water began to recede after the heavy rain stopped.
recede.exampleZh: 大雨停后，洪水开始退去。

receipt.example: Please keep the receipt because you may need it later for a refund.
receipt.exampleZh: 请保留收据，因为你以后可能需要它来退款。

receive.example: I was happy to receive a letter from my old friend yesterday.
receive.exampleZh: 昨天收到老朋友的来信，我很高兴。

receiver.example: The receiver answered the phone quickly and wrote down the message.
receiver.exampleZh: 接听者迅速接起电话并记下了留言。

recent.example: I saw my friend at a recent party in town.
recent.exampleZh: 我在城里最近的一次聚会上见到了我的朋友。

reception.example: The hotel reception is on the first floor near the main door.
reception.exampleZh: 酒店接待处在一楼，靠近大门。

recession.example: Many people lose their jobs during a recession and need help.
recession.exampleZh: 许多人在经济衰退期间失去工作并需要帮助。

reckon.example: I reckon we should leave early to avoid the heavy traffic today.
reckon.exampleZh: 我认为我们今天应该早点出发以避开拥堵的交通。

recognition.example: She received public recognition for her hard work and kind help.
recognition.exampleZh: 她因努力工作和热心帮助而获得了公众的认可。

recognize.example: I did not recognize you at first because you changed your hair.
recognize.exampleZh: 我一开始没认出你，因为你换了发型。

recommend.example: I recommend this book to anyone who likes simple stories.
recommend.exampleZh: 我向任何喜欢简单故事的人推荐这本书。

recommendation.example: I asked my teacher for a recommendation before I applied to college.
recommendation.exampleZh: 我申请大学前请老师写了一封推荐信。

reconcile.example: She tried to reconcile her love for him with the truth.
reconcile.exampleZh: 她试图使自己对她的爱和事实相协调。

record.example: I will record the meeting so everyone can listen later.
record.exampleZh: 我会把会议录下来，这样每个人以后都能听。

recorder.example: The teacher used a small recorder to save her voice during the lesson.
recorder.exampleZh: 老师用一个小录音机在课上录下了她的声音。

recover.example: She needs time to recover from the long illness.
recover.exampleZh: 她需要时间从久病中恢复。

recovery.example: The patient made a slow recovery after the long illness.
recovery.exampleZh: 病人在久病之后慢慢康复了。

recreation.example: Parents should give children time for recreation after school.
recreation.exampleZh: 父母应该给孩子放学后娱乐的时间。

recruit.example: The company plans to recruit ten new workers next month.
recruit.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月招聘十名新员工。

rectify.example: We must rectify the mistake before it causes more problems.
rectify.exampleZh: 我们必须在它造成更多问题之前纠正这个错误。

recur.example: If the pain starts to recur, please tell your doctor right away.
recur.exampleZh: 如果疼痛再次出现，请立刻告诉你的医生。

recycle.example: We can recycle old paper and plastic bottles at school.
recycle.exampleZh: 我们可以在学校回收旧纸张和塑料瓶。

reduce.example: We must reduce the amount of waste we produce every day.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们必须减少每天产生的垃圾量。

reduction.example: The new plan led to a big reduction in waste.
reduction.exampleZh: 新计划使浪费大幅减少。

refer.example: Please refer to the map if you cannot find the station.
refer.exampleZh: 如果你找不到车站，请查看地图。

reference.example: She gave me a good reference for the new job.
reference.exampleZh: 她为这份新工作给我写了一封很好的推荐信。

refine.example: We need to refine our plan before the meeting tomorrow morning.
refine.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天上午开会前完善我们的计划。

reflect.example: The calm lake can reflect the bright colors of the sky.
reflect.exampleZh: 平静的湖面能映出天空的明亮色彩。

reflection.example: The calm lake shows a clear reflection of the green trees.
reflection.exampleZh: 平静的湖面映出绿树的清晰倒影。

reform.example: The new leader promised to reform the old rules and help the people.
reform.exampleZh: 新领导人承诺改革旧规则并帮助人民。

refresh.example: A short walk in the cool morning air can refresh your mind and body.
refresh.exampleZh: 在凉爽的晨风中短暂散步能使你的身心恢复活力。

refuge.example: The small village became a safe refuge for families during the long storm.
refuge.exampleZh: 那个小村庄在漫长的暴风雨期间成了许多家庭的安全避难所。

refugee.example: The refugee family arrived at the camp after a long journey.
refugee.exampleZh: 这家人作为难民，经过长途跋涉后抵达了营地。

refund.example: The store gave me a full refund after I returned the broken phone.
refund.exampleZh: 我把坏手机退回去后，商店给了我全额退款。

refusal.example: Her refusal to help surprised everyone at the meeting.
refusal.exampleZh: 她拒绝帮忙让会上所有人都很惊讶。

refuse.example: She refused to answer the question because she was very tired.
refuse.exampleZh: 她拒绝回答这个问题，因为她非常累。

regard.example: I regard her as a good friend and trust her advice.
regard.exampleZh: 我把她看作好朋友，并信任她的建议。

regarding.example: I have a question regarding the new schedule for next week.
regarding.exampleZh: 我有一个关于下周新日程的问题。

regardless.example: Regardless of the weather, we will go to the park tomorrow.
regardless.exampleZh: 不管天气如何，我们明天都会去公园。

region.example: This region is famous for its beautiful mountains and clean rivers.
region.exampleZh: 这个地区以美丽的山峦和清澈的河流而闻名。

register.example: Please register your name at the front desk before you enter the building.
register.exampleZh: 请在进入大楼前到前台登记你的姓名。

regret.example: I regret not saying goodbye to my old friend.
regret.exampleZh: 我后悔没有向我的老朋友道别。

regular.example: She takes regular breaks from work to stretch and rest her eyes.
regular.exampleZh: 她工作期间定期休息，伸展身体并让眼睛休息。

regulate.example: The government makes new rules to regulate the use of water.
regulate.exampleZh: 政府制定新规则来调节用水。

regulation.example: The new regulation requires all drivers to wear seat belts.
regulation.exampleZh: 新规定要求所有司机系安全带。

reinforce.example: We use strong ropes to reinforce the old bridge.
reinforce.exampleZh: 我们用结实的绳子加固那座旧桥。

reject.example: The company may reject your plan if it costs too much money.
reject.exampleZh: 如果这个计划花费太多钱，公司可能会拒绝它。

relate.example: I can relate to her story because I felt the same way.
relate.exampleZh: 我能理解她的故事，因为我也有过同样的感受。

relation.example: The relation between the two countries has improved in recent years.
relation.exampleZh: 两国之间的关系近年来有所改善。

relationship.example: A good relationship needs trust and honest talk every day.
relationship.exampleZh: 一段良好的关系需要信任和每天坦诚的交流。

relative.example: She is a relative of mine, and we meet every year.
relative.exampleZh: 她是我的一个亲戚，我们每年都见面。

relatively.example: This test was relatively easy for most of the students in our class.
relatively.exampleZh: 这次测试对我们班大多数学生来说相对容易。

relax.example: You should relax and take a short break after work.
relax.exampleZh: 下班后你应该放松一下，短暂休息。

release.example: The company will release a new phone next week.
release.exampleZh: 公司将在下周发布一款新手机。

relevant.example: Please give me the relevant information before the meeting starts today.
relevant.exampleZh: 请在今天的会议开始前给我相关信息。

reliance.example: Our reliance on computers makes modern life both easier and more complicated.
reliance.exampleZh: 我们对电脑的依赖使现代生活既更方便也更复杂。

relief.example: The medicine gave her some relief from the pain in her back.
relief.exampleZh: 这种药使她的背痛得到了一些缓解。

relieve.example: This medicine will relieve your headache and help you feel much better.
relieve.exampleZh: 这种药会减轻你的头痛，并让你感觉好多了。

religion.example: People around the world practice many different religions and share their beliefs with others.
religion.exampleZh: 世界各地的人们信奉许多不同的宗教，并与他人分享自己的信仰。

religious.example: My grandmother is a religious woman who goes to church every Sunday.
religious.exampleZh: 我的祖母是个虔诚的女人，每个星期天都去教堂。

relish.example: She ate the meal with great relish and asked for more.
relish.exampleZh: 她津津有味地吃了这顿饭，还要求再来一些。

rely.example: Many small businesses rely on local customers to keep their doors open.
rely.exampleZh: 许多小企业依靠本地顾客来维持营业。

remain.example: He remained calm and stayed in the room until everyone left.
remain.exampleZh: 他保持冷静，留在房间里直到所有人都离开。

remainder.example: The remainder of the cake was kept in the fridge for tomorrow.
remainder.exampleZh: 剩下的蛋糕被放在冰箱里留到明天。

remark.example: She made a kind remark about my new dress yesterday.
remark.exampleZh: 她昨天对我的新连衣裙说了一句友善的评论。

remarkable.example: She has made remarkable progress in English this year.
remarkable.exampleZh: 她今年在英语上取得了显著进步。

remedy.example: A good remedy for a cold is rest and warm water.
remedy.exampleZh: 感冒的好疗法是休息和温水。

remember.example: I always remember to call my grandmother on Sunday mornings.
remember.exampleZh: 我总是记得在周日早上给奶奶打电话。

remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother when I get home.
remind.exampleZh: 请提醒我到家后给我妈妈打电话。

remote.example: The small village is remote, so few people visit it each year.
remote.exampleZh: 这个小村庄很偏僻，所以每年很少有人来。

removal.example: The removal of the old tree made the garden much brighter.
removal.exampleZh: 移除那棵老树使花园明亮了许多。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you come into the house.
remove.exampleZh: 请你在进屋前把鞋脱掉。

render.example: The new law will render many small shops unable to compete with big companies.
render.exampleZh: 新法律将使许多小商店无法与大公司竞争。

renew.example: I need to renew my library books before they are due.
renew.exampleZh: 我需要在图书馆的书到期前续借。

rent.example: We pay rent at the start of every month for our small apartment.
rent.exampleZh: 我们每月初为我们的小公寓付房租。

repair.example: My father will repair the old bike in the garage this afternoon.
repair.exampleZh: 我父亲今天下午会在车库里修理那辆旧自行车。

repay.example: He worked hard to repay the money he borrowed from his friend.
repay.exampleZh: 他努力工作来偿还从朋友那里借的钱。

repeat.example: Please repeat the question because I did not hear you clearly.
repeat.exampleZh: 请重复这个问题，因为我没听清楚。

repeatedly.example: She repeatedly asked the same question because she did not understand the answer.
repeatedly.exampleZh: 她反复问同一个问题，因为她没听懂答案。

repel.example: The strong smell can repel insects and keep them away from food.
repel.exampleZh: 这种强烈的气味能驱赶昆虫，让它们远离食物。

repetition.example: The repetition of the same song all day made everyone feel tired.
repetition.exampleZh: 同一首歌一整天反复播放让每个人都感到厌倦。

replace.example: We need to replace the old light bulb in the kitchen today.
replace.exampleZh: 我们今天需要更换厨房里的旧灯泡。

replacement.example: The teacher found a replacement for the sick student in our class.
replacement.exampleZh: 老师为我们班生病的学生找了一个替代者。

reply.example: She did not reply to my message until the next morning.
reply.exampleZh: 她直到第二天早上才回复我的消息。

report.example: The teacher asked me to report the problem to the school office.
report.exampleZh: 老师让我把这个问题报告给学校办公室。

reporter.example: The reporter asked the mayor several questions after the meeting ended.
reporter.exampleZh: 会议结束后，记者向市长问了几个问题。

represent.example: These small gifts represent our thanks for all your help this year.
represent.exampleZh: 这些小礼物代表我们对你今年所有帮助的感谢。

representative.example: She is a representative from our school and will attend the meeting.
representative.exampleZh: 她是我们学校的代表，将参加这次会议。

reproduce.example: Many animals reproduce in spring when food is easy to find.
reproduce.exampleZh: 许多动物在食物容易找到的春天繁殖。

republic.example: The country became a republic after the people voted for a new government.
republic.exampleZh: 人民投票选出新政府后，这个国家成为了共和国。

reputation.example: He has a good reputation at school because he always helps others.
reputation.exampleZh: 他在学校里名声很好，因为他总是帮助别人。

request.example: I will request more time to finish the work tomorrow.
request.exampleZh: 我明天会请求更多时间来完成这项工作。

require.example: Our school requires students to wear a uniform every school day.
require.exampleZh: 我们学校要求学生在每个上学日穿校服。

requirement.example: Meeting the safety requirement is necessary before we start the work.
requirement.exampleZh: 开始工作前，满足安全要求是必要的。

rescue.example: Firefighters worked all night to rescue the trapped family from the burning house.
rescue.exampleZh: 消防员整夜工作，从燃烧的房子里营救被困的一家人。

research.example: I read a lot of research about healthy food before I changed my diet.
research.exampleZh: 我在改变饮食前读了很多关于健康食品的研究。

resemble.example: These two brothers resemble each other in both looks and personality.
resemble.exampleZh: 这两兄弟在外貌和性格上都很像。

reservation.example: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant near my home.
reservation.exampleZh: 我在家附近的那家餐厅预订了两个座位。

reserve.example: We reserve a table for two at the restaurant every Friday evening.
reserve.exampleZh: 我们每周五晚上都在这家餐厅预订一张两人桌。

resident.example: The resident doctor works at the small hospital near my house.
resident.exampleZh: 这位常驻医生在我家附近的小医院工作。

resign.example: He decided to resign from his job after many years.
resign.exampleZh: 他决定在工作多年后辞职。

resist.example: Many people resist change because they are afraid of the unknown.
resist.exampleZh: 许多人抵制改变，因为他们害怕未知。

resistance.example: The small town showed strong resistance to the new road plan.
resistance.exampleZh: 这个小镇对新道路计划表现出强烈的抵制。

resistant.example: This strong plant is resistant to cold weather in winter.
resistant.exampleZh: 这种强壮的植物在冬天耐寒。

resolution.example: The committee passed a resolution to protect the local park.
resolution.exampleZh: 委员会通过了一项保护当地公园的决议。

resolve.example: She hopes to resolve the problem before the meeting starts tomorrow.
resolve.exampleZh: 她希望在明天会议开始前解决这个问题。

resort.example: When problems arise, we should not resort to violence but talk calmly.
resort.exampleZh: 当问题出现时，我们不应诉诸暴力，而应冷静交谈。

resource.example: We need to use every resource wisely to finish the project on time.
resource.exampleZh: 我们需要明智地利用每一份资源，才能按时完成项目。

respect.example: We should respect our teachers and listen to them every day.
respect.exampleZh: 我们应该尊敬老师，并且每天听他们的话。

respective.example: The two students went back to their respective homes after the class ended.
respective.exampleZh: 下课后，两名学生各自回到了自己的家。

respond.example: Please respond to my email before the end of today.
respond.exampleZh: 请在今天结束前回复我的邮件。

response.example: She gave a quick response to my question and smiled at me.
response.exampleZh: 她对我的问题作出了迅速的回答，并对我笑了笑。

responsibility.example: Each worker has a responsibility to keep the office clean and safe.
responsibility.exampleZh: 每个员工都有责任保持办公室干净和安全。

responsible.example: She is responsible for keeping the office clean and safe every day.
responsible.exampleZh: 她负责每天保持办公室干净安全。

rest.example: You should rest for a while after finishing this long and tiring task.
rest.exampleZh: 完成这项漫长而累人的任务后，你应该休息一会儿。

restaurant.example: We had dinner at a new restaurant near our house last night.
restaurant.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在家附近的一家新餐馆吃了晚饭。

restless.example: The child felt restless and could not sit still during the long car ride.
restless.exampleZh: 那个孩子在漫长的车程中感到焦躁不安，无法安静坐着。

restore.example: The workers will restore the old bridge next spring.
restore.exampleZh: 工人们将在明年春天修复这座旧桥。

restrain.example: The police had to restrain the angry man from hurting others.
restrain.exampleZh: 警察不得不制止那个愤怒的男人伤害他人。

restraint.example: He showed great restraint and did not say anything angry to her.
restraint.exampleZh: 他表现出极大的克制，没有对她说任何生气的话。

restrict.example: The school restricts phone use during class to help students focus.
restrict.exampleZh: 学校限制课堂上使用手机，以帮助学生集中注意力。

restriction.example: The new law places a restriction on where people can park their cars.
restriction.exampleZh: 新法律对人们可以停车的地方施加了限制。

result.example: The result of the game made all the students very happy.
result.exampleZh: 比赛的结果让所有学生都非常高兴。

resume.example: After a short break, we will resume the meeting at two.
resume.exampleZh: 短暂休息后，我们将在两点继续开会。

retail.example: The small shop sells many everyday items at retail prices.
retail.exampleZh: 这家小商店以零售价格出售许多日常用品。

retain.example: We must retain our old friends and make new ones.
retain.exampleZh: 我们必须留住老朋友，并结交新朋友。

retire.example: My father will retire from his job next year.
retire.exampleZh: 我父亲明年将要从他的工作岗位退休。

retirement.example: My father plans to enjoy his retirement by traveling and gardening every day.
retirement.exampleZh: 我父亲打算通过每天旅行和园艺来享受退休生活。

retort.example: She retorted that I was wrong, and I had no answer.
retort.exampleZh: 她反驳说是我错了，我无言以对。

retreat.example: The soldiers had to retreat quickly when the enemy attacked at night.
retreat.exampleZh: 敌人在夜间进攻时，士兵们不得不迅速撤退。

return.example: Please return the book to the library before Friday this week.
return.exampleZh: 请在本周五之前把书还给图书馆。

reunion.example: We had a happy family reunion at my grandparents' house last summer.
reunion.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们在祖父母家举行了一次快乐的家庭团聚。

reveal.example: The new study may reveal why some people sleep badly at night.
reveal.exampleZh: 这项新研究可能揭示为什么有些人晚上睡不好。

revenue.example: The company revenue grew quickly after it launched a new product last year.
revenue.exampleZh: 公司去年推出新产品后，收入迅速增长。

reverse.example: The court decided to reverse the earlier decision after hearing new evidence.
reverse.exampleZh: 法院在听取新证据后决定撤销先前的判决。

review.example: I need to review my notes before the big test tomorrow.
review.exampleZh: 我需要在明天的大考之前复习我的笔记。

revise.example: I need to revise my notes before the exam tomorrow morning.
revise.exampleZh: 我需要在明天早上考试前复习我的笔记。

revolt.example: The people rose in revolt against the cruel king and his unfair laws.
revolt.exampleZh: 人民起来反抗残酷的国王及其不公平的法律。

revolution.example: The internet caused a big revolution in how people work and learn.
revolution.exampleZh: 互联网在人们工作和学习的方式上引发了一场大变革。

revolutionary.example: The revolutionary idea changed the way people live and work.
revolutionary.exampleZh: 这个革命性的想法改变了人们生活和工作的方式。

revolve.example: The earth and the other planets revolve around the sun.
revolve.exampleZh: 地球和其他行星围绕太阳旋转。

reward.example: She gave him a small reward for helping her carry the boxes.
reward.exampleZh: 她给了他一份小报酬，感谢他帮她搬箱子。

rhythm.example: The music has a steady rhythm that makes everyone want to dance.
rhythm.exampleZh: 这首音乐有稳定的节奏，让每个人都想跳舞。

rib.example: He broke a rib while playing football with his friends last weekend.
rib.exampleZh: 上周末他和朋友们踢足球时摔断了一根肋骨。

ribbon.example: She tied a red ribbon around the gift before giving it to her friend.
ribbon.exampleZh: 她在把礼物送给朋友之前，用一条红丝带把它系好了。

rid.example: We must get rid of the old boxes in the garage today.
rid.exampleZh: 我们今天必须把车库里的旧箱子处理掉。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every day with my best friend.
ride.exampleZh: 我每天和我最好的朋友一起骑自行车上学。

ridge.example: We walked along the narrow ridge and saw the valley below.
ridge.exampleZh: 我们沿着狭窄的山脊行走，看到了下面的山谷。

ridiculous.example: It is ridiculous to blame the weather for our own mistakes.
ridiculous.exampleZh: 把我们自己的错误归咎于天气是可笑的。

rifle.example: The soldier cleaned his rifle after the long training exercise.
rifle.exampleZh: 士兵在漫长的训练结束后擦拭他的步枪。

right.example: You are right about the answer, and the school is on the right.
right.exampleZh: 你关于这个答案是对的，学校在右边。

rigid.example: The teacher has a rigid rule about being late for class.
rigid.exampleZh: 这位老师对上课迟到有一条死板的规定。

ring.example: The phone began to ring while we were eating dinner.
ring.exampleZh: 我们吃晚饭时电话开始响了。

riot.example: The city had a riot after the game last night.
riot.exampleZh: 昨晚比赛后城里发生了一场骚乱。

rip.example: The strong wind can rip the old flag apart.

ripe.example: The apples are ripe and ready to eat this morning.
ripe.exampleZh: 今天早上这些苹果已经成熟，可以吃了。

rise.example: The sun will rise in the east early tomorrow morning.
rise.exampleZh: 明天清晨太阳将从东方升起。

risk.example: You should not risk your health for a little extra money.
risk.exampleZh: 你不应该为了一点额外的钱而拿健康冒险。

rival.example: She is my strongest rival in the school tennis team this year.
rival.exampleZh: 她是我今年学校网球队里最强的竞争对手。

river.example: The river flows slowly through the green valley near our small town.
river.exampleZh: 这条河流缓慢地穿过我们小镇附近的绿色山谷。

road.example: The road to the village is narrow and very quiet at night.
road.exampleZh: 通往村庄的路很窄，夜里十分安静。

roar.example: The angry lion began to roar loudly when it saw the strangers.
roar.exampleZh: 那只愤怒的狮子看到陌生人时开始大声吼叫。

roast.example: My mother will roast a chicken for our family dinner tonight.
roast.exampleZh: 我妈妈今晚会为我们的家庭晚餐烤一只鸡。

rob.example: Two men tried to rob the small bank on Main Street yesterday.
rob.exampleZh: 昨天两名男子试图抢劫主街上的那家小银行。

robe.example: The old king wore a long red robe during the ceremony.
robe.exampleZh: 年迈的国王在典礼上穿着一件长长的红色长袍。

robot.example: The robot can clean the floor and help us at home.
robot.exampleZh: 这个机器人会打扫地板，还能在家里帮助我们。

robust.example: The old bridge is still strong and robust after many years.
robust.exampleZh: 这座老桥多年后依然坚固而结实。

rock.example: The old church was built on a big rock near the sea.
rock.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂建在海边的一块大岩石上。

rocket.example: The rocket rose quickly into the clear blue sky while everyone watched.
rocket.exampleZh: 火箭迅速升入晴朗的蓝天，大家都在观看。

rod.example: He used a long wooden rod to reach the ball under the bed.
rod.exampleZh: 他用一根长木杆去够床底下的球。

role.example: She plays an important role in teaching young children at our school.
role.exampleZh: 她在我们学校教小孩子方面发挥着重要作用。

roll.example: The children roll the big ball down the hill.
roll.exampleZh: 孩子们把大球滚下山坡。

romance.example: Their summer romance began at the beach and ended too soon.
romance.exampleZh: 他们的夏日恋情始于海滩，结束得太早了。

romantic.example: She wants a romantic dinner with candles and soft music tonight.
romantic.exampleZh: 她今晚想要一顿有蜡烛和轻音乐的浪漫晚餐。

roof.example: The cat sat on the roof and watched the birds fly by.
roof.exampleZh: 猫坐在屋顶上，看着鸟儿飞过。

room.example: There is enough room in this small car for all of us.
room.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车里有足够的空间容纳我们所有人。

root.example: The root of the old tree is deep and strong.
root.exampleZh: 这棵老树的根又深又壮。

rope.example: He used a long rope to pull the heavy box up the hill.
rope.exampleZh: 他用一根长绳子把沉重的箱子拉上山坡。

rose.example: She gave me a red rose on my birthday last week.
rose.exampleZh: 上周我生日时她送了我一朵红玫瑰。

rotate.example: The workers rotate their tasks every week to learn new skills.
rotate.exampleZh: 工人们每周轮换任务，以学习新技能。

rough.example: The road was rough, so we drove slowly and carefully.
rough.exampleZh: 这条路很崎岖，所以我们开得很慢很小心。

roughly.example: The trip will take roughly three hours by train from here.
roughly.exampleZh: 从这里坐火车这趟旅程大约需要三个小时。

round.example: The children sat round the table and ate their lunch together.
round.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在桌旁，一起吃了午饭。

rouse.example: The loud noise roused the sleeping baby from his afternoon nap.
rouse.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音把熟睡的婴儿从午睡中吵醒了。

route.example: The bus route goes from the train station to the city center.
route.exampleZh: 这条公交路线从火车站开往市中心。

routine.example: My morning routine helps me start the day in a good mood.
routine.exampleZh: 我的早晨常规帮助我以好心情开始新的一天。

row.example: We sat in the front row and watched the boat row across the lake.
row.exampleZh: 我们坐在前排，看着那条船划过湖面。

royal.example: The royal family will attend a big ceremony in the city next week.
royal.exampleZh: 王室成员下周将参加城里的一场盛大典礼。

rub.example: She rubbed her cold hands together to keep them warm in winter.
rub.exampleZh: 她在冬天把冰冷的手搓在一起取暖。

rubber.example: My little sister uses a pink rubber to erase her mistakes.
rubber.exampleZh: 我妹妹用一块粉色橡皮擦掉她的错误。

rude.example: It is rude to talk loudly on the phone in a quiet bus.
rude.exampleZh: 在安静的公交车上大声打电话是不礼貌的。

rug.example: I put a soft rug in front of the fireplace in my living room.
rug.exampleZh: 我在客厅的壁炉前放了一块柔软的小地毯。

ruin.example: The heavy rain ruined our picnic and made everyone go home early.
ruin.exampleZh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐，让大家早早回家了。

rule.example: The teacher explained the new rule to all the students in class.
rule.exampleZh: 老师向班上所有学生解释了这条新规定。

ruler.example: The ruler of the small country visited our school last week.
ruler.exampleZh: 这个小国的统治者上周参观了我们的学校。

rumo(u)r.example: I heard a rumor that our teacher will leave the school next week.
rumo(u)r.exampleZh: 我听到一个传闻，说我们老师下周要离开学校。

run.example: She runs a small shop and works there every day.
run.exampleZh: 她经营一家小店，每天在那里工作。

rural.example: Life in rural areas is often quiet and close to nature.
rural.exampleZh: 农村地区的生活往往安静且贴近自然。

rush.example: People rush to the store when a big sale starts early in the morning.
rush.exampleZh: 当大促销一大早开始时，人们会冲向商店。

rust.example: The old bike was covered in rust after years in the rain.
rust.exampleZh: 那辆旧自行车在雨中放了多年，满是铁锈。

ruthless.example: The ruthless king ignored the poor people and took all their food.
ruthless.exampleZh: 那个无情的国王无视穷人，拿走了他们所有的食物。

sack.example: The farmer put the potatoes in a large sack and carried it home.
sack.exampleZh: 农民把土豆装进一个大麻袋，然后把它搬回了家。

sacred.example: This old temple is a sacred place for many local people.
sacred.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙对许多当地人来说是一个神圣的地方。

sacrifice.example: Many parents sacrifice their free time to give their children a better life.
sacrifice.exampleZh: 许多父母牺牲自己的空闲时间，为了给孩子更好的生活。

saddle.example: He put the saddle on the horse and rode away.
saddle.exampleZh: 他把马鞍放在马上，然后骑马走了。

safari.example: We saw many wild animals during our safari in Africa last summer.
safari.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们在非洲的游猎之旅中看到了许多野生动物。

safeguard.example: We must safeguard our water and forests for the next generation.
safeguard.exampleZh: 我们必须为下一代保护水和森林。

safely.example: Please drive slowly and safely on the wet road tonight.
safely.exampleZh: 今晚请在这条湿滑的路上缓慢而安全地驾驶。

safety.example: We must always think about safety when we are at work.
safety.exampleZh: 我们在工作时必须时刻考虑安全。

sail.example: The small boat will sail across the lake at sunrise tomorrow.
sail.exampleZh: 明天日出时，这艘小船将横渡湖面。

sailor.example: The old sailor told us a story about the sea.
sailor.exampleZh: 那位老水手给我们讲了一个关于大海的故事。

saint.example: The kind old man was seen as a saint by everyone in town.
saint.exampleZh: 镇上所有人都把这位善良的老人视为圣人。

sake.example: For the sake of peace, they agreed to talk and solve the problem.
sake.exampleZh: 为了和平，他们同意交谈并解决问题。

salad.example: I made a fresh salad with tomatoes and lettuce for lunch today.
salad.exampleZh: 我今天午餐做了一份新鲜的番茄生菜沙拉。

salary.example: He earns a good salary and can save money every month.
salary.exampleZh: 他挣着一份不错的薪水，每月都能存下钱。

sale.example: The store is having a big sale on shoes this weekend.
sale.exampleZh: 这家商店这个周末鞋子大减价。

salesman.example: The salesman helped my mother find a good coat for winter.
salesman.exampleZh: 那位售货员帮我妈妈找到了一件适合冬天穿的好外套。

salt.example: Please add a little salt to the soup before you serve it.
salt.exampleZh: 请在端上汤之前加一点盐。

salute.example: The soldiers salute the flag every morning before they start their training.
salute.exampleZh: 士兵们每天早上开始训练前都会向国旗敬礼。

salvation.example: The lost hikers hoped that rescue would bring them salvation before the cold night came.
salvation.exampleZh: 迷路的徒步者希望救援能在寒夜降临前带给他们拯救。

same.example: We go to the same school and eat lunch together every day.
same.exampleZh: 我们去同一所学校，每天一起吃午饭。

sample.example: The shop gave me a free sample of the new coffee.
sample.exampleZh: 商店给了我一份新咖啡的免费样品。

sanction.example: The government will sanction the new trade deal next week.
sanction.exampleZh: 政府将于下周批准这项新的贸易协议。

sandwich.example: I made a cheese sandwich for lunch and shared it with my friend.
sandwich.exampleZh: 我做了一个奶酪三明治当午餐，和我的朋友分享了它。

satellite.example: The satellite sends pictures of the Earth back to scientists every day.
satellite.exampleZh: 这颗卫星每天把地球的照片传回给科学家。

satisfaction.example: Her hard work gave her a deep sense of satisfaction.
satisfaction.exampleZh: 她的辛勤工作给她带来了深深的满足感。

satisfy.example: We hope the new plan will satisfy everyone in our team.
satisfy.exampleZh: 我们希望这个新计划能让团队里的每个人都满意。

saturate.example: Heavy rain can quickly saturate the dry soil in the garden.
saturate.exampleZh: 大雨能迅速浸透花园里干燥的土壤。

saturday.example: We will visit our grandparents this Saturday and stay for lunch.
saturday.exampleZh: 这个星期六我们会去看望祖父母，并留下吃午饭。

sauce.example: She added a little tomato sauce to the pasta before serving dinner.
sauce.exampleZh: 她在上晚餐前给意面加了一点番茄酱。

sausage.example: I ate a sausage with bread for breakfast this morning.
sausage.exampleZh: 今天早上我吃了香肠配面包当早餐。

saving.example: She is saving money every month for a new car.
saving.exampleZh: 她每个月都在存钱买一辆新车。

saw.example: I saw a man use a saw to cut the old wood.
saw.exampleZh: 我看见一个人用锯子锯那块旧木头。

scale.example: Please scale the image down before you put it on the website.
scale.exampleZh: 请先把图片缩小，再放到网站上。

scan.example: I will scan the document and send it to you today.
scan.exampleZh: 我会扫描这份文件，今天发给你。

scandal.example: The political scandal forced the mayor to leave his office last week.
scandal.exampleZh: 这起政治丑闻迫使市长上周离开了他的办公室。

scarce.example: Fresh water is scarce in this dry area, so people save it carefully.
scarce.exampleZh: 在这个干旱地区，淡水很稀缺，所以人们会小心节约用水。

scare.example: The loud noise did not scare the sleeping baby in the room.
scare.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音没有吓到房间里熟睡的婴儿。

scatter.example: Please scatter the seeds evenly over the soil before it rains.
scatter.exampleZh: 请在雨前把种子均匀地撒在土壤上。

scene.example: The police arrived at the scene and asked everyone to leave quickly.
scene.exampleZh: 警察到达现场，并要求大家迅速离开。

scenery.example: We stopped by the lake to enjoy the beautiful scenery.
scenery.exampleZh: 我们在湖边停下来欣赏美丽的风景。

scent.example: The scent of fresh bread filled the small kitchen.
scent.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味充满了小厨房。

schedule.example: I check my schedule every morning before I start work.
schedule.exampleZh: 我每天早上开始工作前都会查看我的日程安排。

scheme.example: They made a simple scheme to save money for the trip.
scheme.exampleZh: 他们制定了一个简单的方案，为旅行存钱。

scholar.example: The young scholar studies old books in the quiet library every day.
scholar.exampleZh: 这位年轻学者每天在安静的图书馆里研究古书。

scholarship.example: She won a scholarship to study at a famous university.
scholarship.exampleZh: 她获得奖学金去一所著名大学学习。

science.example: Science helps us understand the world and solve many everyday problems.
science.exampleZh: 科学帮助我们理解世界并解决许多日常问题。

scientific.example: We need a scientific way to solve this simple problem today.
scientific.exampleZh: 我们需要一种科学的方法来解决今天这个简单的问题。

scientist.example: The scientist is doing a simple test in the lab.
scientist.exampleZh: 这位科学家正在实验室里做一个简单的测试。

scissors.example: I use scissors to cut paper when I make cards.
scissors.exampleZh: 我做卡片时用剪刀剪纸。

scold.example: The teacher scolded the boy for running in the hallway.
scold.exampleZh: 老师因为男孩在走廊里奔跑而训斥了他。

scope.example: The scope of this project is too large for our small team.
scope.exampleZh: 这个项目的范围对我们的小团队来说太大了。

score.example: He got a high score on the math test yesterday.
score.exampleZh: 他昨天数学考试得了高分。

scorn.example: She looked at his cheap gift with scorn and walked away.
scorn.exampleZh: 她轻蔑地看了他那份廉价的礼物一眼，然后走开了。

scout.example: The scout walked through the forest and looked for a safe path.
scout.exampleZh: 这名侦察员穿过森林，寻找一条安全的道路。

scramble.example: The children scramble up the hill to find the hidden prize.
scramble.exampleZh: 孩子们爬上山坡去寻找隐藏的奖品。

scrap.example: He kept every scrap of paper because he thought it might be useful.
scrap.exampleZh: 他保留每一片纸，因为他觉得它可能有用。

scratch.example: I had to scratch my arm because it felt very itchy after the walk.
scratch.exampleZh: 我不得不挠一下手臂，因为散步后它感觉非常痒。

scream.example: She heard a loud scream from the dark room and ran away quickly.
scream.exampleZh: 她听到黑暗的房间里传来一声尖叫，便迅速跑开了。

screen.example: The teacher will screen the video on the big screen tomorrow.
screen.exampleZh: 老师明天将在大屏幕上放映这段视频。

screw.example: I need a screw to fix this small chair.
screw.exampleZh: 我需要一颗螺丝来修这把小椅子。

script.example: The actor read the script carefully before the first rehearsal.
script.exampleZh: 演员在第一次排练前仔细阅读了剧本。

scrutiny.example: The manager put the report under careful scrutiny before signing it.
scrutiny.exampleZh: 经理在签字前仔细检查了这份报告。

sea.example: We drove to the sea and watched the big waves all afternoon.
sea.exampleZh: 我们开车去了海边，整个下午都在看大浪。

seal.example: The old man put a wax seal on the letter and smiled.
seal.exampleZh: 老人在信上盖了一个蜡封，然后笑了。

search.example: I will search the whole house for my lost keys today.
search.exampleZh: 我今天会搜遍整座房子来找我丢失的钥匙。

season.example: Summer is my favorite season because the weather is warm and the days are long.
season.exampleZh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节，因为天气温暖而且白天很长。

seat.example: Please take your seat and wait for the teacher to begin.

second.example: Please wait a second while I find the second door on the left.
second.exampleZh: 请稍等一秒，我去找左边第二扇门。

secondary.example: This is a secondary road, so few cars use it.
secondary.exampleZh: 这是一条次要道路，所以很少有汽车使用它。

secret.example: She kept her secret from everyone for many years.
secret.exampleZh: 她多年来一直对所有人保守着她的秘密。

secretary.example: The secretary answered the phone and wrote down every important message for her boss.
secretary.exampleZh: 秘书接了电话，并为她的老板记下了每一条重要留言。

section.example: This section of the book is easy to read and understand.
section.exampleZh: 这本书的这一部分很容易阅读和理解。

sector.example: The health sector needs more workers and better pay this year.
sector.exampleZh: 医疗部门今年需要更多工作人员和更好的薪酬。

secure.example: We keep our money in a safe place to secure our future.
secure.exampleZh: 我们把钱放在安全的地方，以保障我们的未来。

security.example: The company improved security at the office after several small thefts last month.
security.exampleZh: 上个月发生了几起小盗窃后，公司加强了办公室的安全保障。

see.example: I can see the tall mountains from my bedroom window every morning.
see.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能从卧室窗户看见那些高山。

seed.example: Every seed needs water and sunlight before it can grow into a strong plant.
seed.exampleZh: 每一颗种子都需要水和阳光才能长成强壮的植物。

seek.example: We are seeking a quiet place to rest after the long walk.
seek.exampleZh: 长途步行后，我们正在寻找一个安静的地方休息。

seem.example: You seem very tired today, so you should go home and rest.
seem.exampleZh: 你今天似乎很累，所以你应该回家休息。

seemingly.example: The seemingly simple problem turned out to be much harder than we expected.
seemingly.exampleZh: 这个看似简单的问题结果比我们预想的难得多。

segment.example: This segment of the road is closed for repairs today.
segment.exampleZh: 这段路今天因维修而封闭。

seize.example: The police seized the stolen money and returned it to the owner.
seize.exampleZh: 警察没收了被盗的钱并把它还给了失主。

seldom.example: He seldom goes to the park because he is very busy these days.
seldom.exampleZh: 他很少去公园，因为这些天他很忙。

select.example: Please select one book from the shelf before you leave today.
select.exampleZh: 请在今天离开前从书架上选一本书。

selection.example: The store has a large selection of fresh fruit and vegetables.
selection.exampleZh: 这家商店有大量新鲜水果和蔬菜可供选择。

self.example: He needs to learn how to be his true self around other people.
self.exampleZh: 他需要学会在别人面前做真实的自己。

selfish.example: He is too selfish to share his toys with other children.
selfish.exampleZh: 他太自私了，不愿和其他孩子分享他的玩具。

sell.example: They plan to sell their old car before they move to a new city.
sell.exampleZh: 他们打算搬到新城市前卖掉旧车。

semester.example: I will study hard this semester and try to get good grades.
semester.exampleZh: 这学期我会努力学习，争取取得好成绩。

semiconductor.example: A semiconductor is a material used in many modern electronic devices.
semiconductor.exampleZh: 半导体是一种用于许多现代电子设备的材料。

seminar.example: Our teacher will hold a seminar on study skills next Friday afternoon.
seminar.exampleZh: 我们的老师下周五下午将举办一场关于学习技巧的研讨会。

senate.example: The senate voted to pass the new law after a long debate.
senate.exampleZh: 参议院在经过长时间辩论后投票通过了这项新法律。

send.example: I will send this letter to my friend tomorrow.
send.exampleZh: 我明天会把这封信寄给我的朋友。

senior.example: The senior students gave us a warm welcome on our first day.
senior.exampleZh: 高年级学生在我们第一天热情地欢迎了我们。

sense.example: I have a strong sense that something good will happen today.
sense.exampleZh: 我有一种强烈的感觉，今天会有好事发生。

sensible.example: It is sensible to take an umbrella when the sky looks dark.
sensible.exampleZh: 当天色看起来暗时，带把伞是明智的。

sensitive.example: She is very sensitive to cold weather and always wears a warm coat.
sensitive.exampleZh: 她对寒冷天气很敏感，总是穿着一件暖和的外套。

sentence.example: The judge will sentence the man in court tomorrow morning.
sentence.exampleZh: 法官明天早上将在法庭上宣判那名男子。

sentiment.example: Public sentiment changed quickly after the company shared its new plan with everyone.
sentiment.exampleZh: 公司向大家公布新计划后，公众情绪很快发生了变化。

separate.example: Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones before washing them.
separate.exampleZh: 洗之前请把白色衣服和彩色衣服分开。

sequence.example: Please put these numbers in the correct sequence before you start the game.
sequence.exampleZh: 请在你开始游戏前把这些数字按正确顺序排好。

series.example: She watched a new television series with her family every Sunday evening.
series.exampleZh: 她每周日晚上都和家人一起看一部新的电视连续剧。

serious.example: The doctor said my father's illness is serious and he needs more rest.
serious.exampleZh: 医生说父亲的病很严重，他需要多休息。

servant.example: The servant brought us water and then cleaned the large room.
servant.exampleZh: 仆人给我们端来水，然后打扫了大房间。

serve.example: Good hotels serve their guests with care and make them feel welcome.
serve.exampleZh: 好的酒店用心接待客人，让他们感到宾至如归。

service.example: The hotel offers good service to every guest who stays there.
service.exampleZh: 这家酒店为每位入住的客人提供良好的服务。

set.example: She set a small cup on the table and smiled at me.
set.exampleZh: 她把一个小杯子放在桌上，然后对我笑了笑。

settle.example: They decided to settle in a small town near the river.
settle.exampleZh: 他们决定在河边的一个小镇定居。

seven.example: My sister has seven apples in her red bag.
seven.exampleZh: 我妹妹的红色袋子里有七个苹果。

several.example: Several of my friends came to the party and we had a good time.
several.exampleZh: 我的几个朋友来参加了聚会，我们玩得很开心。

severe.example: The storm was severe and caused a lot of damage to the town.
severe.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨非常严重，给小镇造成了很大损失。

sew.example: My mother will sew a new button on my shirt today.
sew.exampleZh: 我妈妈今天会在我的衬衫上缝一颗新纽扣。

sex.example: The form asks for your name, age, and sex.
sex.exampleZh: 表格要求填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

shade.example: We sat in the shade of a big tree and read.
shade.exampleZh: 我们坐在一棵大树的阴凉处看书。

shadow.example: The tall tree cast a long shadow on the warm grass.
shadow.exampleZh: 那棵高大的树在温暖的草地上投下长长的影子。

shake.example: The little boy began to shake with fear when he heard the loud thunder.
shake.exampleZh: 小男孩听到响亮的雷声时害怕得开始发抖。

shall.example: You shall finish your homework before you go out to play.
shall.exampleZh: 你必须在出去玩之前完成作业。

shallow.example: The water in the small pool is too shallow for diving.
shallow.exampleZh: 这个小水池里的水太浅，不能跳水。

shame.example: He felt deep shame after he lied to his best friend.
shame.exampleZh: 他向最好的朋友撒谎后深感羞愧。

shape.example: The artist used clay to shape a small bird.
shape.exampleZh: 艺术家用黏土塑造了一只小鸟。

share.example: I will share my lunch with you and your friend today.
share.exampleZh: 今天我会和你以及你的朋友分享我的午餐。

sharp.example: The knife is very sharp, so please be careful when you use it.
sharp.exampleZh: 这把刀很锋利，所以使用时请小心。

she.example: She likes to read books in the park every sunny afternoon.
she.exampleZh: 她喜欢在每个晴朗的下午在公园里读书。

shed.example: The old tree shed its leaves before the cold winter came.
shed.exampleZh: 这棵老树在寒冬到来前落下了叶子。

sheep.example: The farmer keeps many sheep on his small farm in the valley.
sheep.exampleZh: 农夫在山谷里的小农场上养了许多绵羊。

sheer.example: The sheer size of the mountain made us stop and stare in wonder.
sheer.exampleZh: 这座山巨大的规模让我们停下脚步，惊叹不已。

sheet.example: She put a clean sheet on the bed before the guests arrived.
sheet.exampleZh: 她在客人到来前给床铺上了一条干净床单。

shelf.example: She put the old books on the top shelf in her room.
shelf.exampleZh: 她把旧书放在她房间最上面的架子上。

shell.example: The boy found a small shell on the beach this morning.
shell.exampleZh: 男孩今天早上在沙滩上发现了一个小贝壳。

shelter.example: We found shelter from the heavy rain under a big tree.
shelter.exampleZh: 我们在一棵大树下找到了躲避大雨的地方。

shield.example: The knight raised his shield to block the heavy blow.
shield.exampleZh: 骑士举起盾牌挡住了重重的一击。

shift.example: The company will shift its focus to online sales next year.
shift.exampleZh: 公司明年将把重点转向线上销售。

shine.example: The sun shines brightly in the clear blue sky today.
shine.exampleZh: 今天，太阳在晴朗的蓝天上明亮地照耀着。

ship.example: They will ship the boxes to the new store on Monday.
ship.exampleZh: 他们将在周一把箱子运到新店。

shirt.example: I bought a new white shirt for my father yesterday.
shirt.exampleZh: 我昨天给我父亲买了一件新的白衬衫。

shiver.example: She began to shiver in the cold wind outside the house.
shiver.exampleZh: 她开始在屋外的冷风中发抖。

shock.example: The sudden news of the accident gave everyone a great shock.
shock.exampleZh: 事故的突然消息让大家大为震惊。

shoe.example: I put my left shoe on first because it is easier for me.
shoe.exampleZh: 我先穿左脚的鞋，因为这样对我来说更容易。

shoot.example: The boy likes to shoot the ball into the net after school.
shoot.exampleZh: 那个男孩喜欢放学后把球射进球网。

shop.example: I often shop at the small store near my house on weekends.
shop.exampleZh: 我周末经常在我家附近的小商店购物。

shore.example: We walked along the shore and watched small boats on the water.
shore.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着水面上的小船。

short.example: This road is too short for a long race like that.
short.exampleZh: 这条路对于那样一场长跑比赛来说太短了。

shortage.example: The city has a serious shortage of clean water this summer.
shortage.exampleZh: 今年夏天这座城市严重缺乏干净的水。

shortcoming.example: Everyone has at least one shortcoming, so we should be kind to others.
shortcoming.exampleZh: 每个人都有至少一个缺点，所以我们应该善待他人。

shortly.example: She will come back shortly after lunch.
shortly.exampleZh: 她午饭后不久就会回来。

should.example: You should drink more water every day if you want to stay healthy.
should.exampleZh: 如果你想保持健康，你应该每天多喝水。

shoulder.example: She carried the heavy bag on her shoulder and walked home slowly.
shoulder.exampleZh: 她把沉重的包背在肩上，慢慢走回家。

shout.example: The boy began to shout when he saw the ball roll away.
shout.exampleZh: 男孩看到球滚走时开始大喊。

show.example: Please show me your new book before you put it in the bag.
show.exampleZh: 请在你把新书放进包里之前给我看看。

shower.example: I take a quick shower every morning before breakfast.
shower.exampleZh: 我每天早晨早餐前都会快速洗个淋浴。

shrink.example: My new cotton shirt will shrink if I wash it in hot water.
shrink.exampleZh: 我的新棉衬衫如果用热水洗就会缩水。

shrug.example: She gave a small shrug and walked away without saying another word.
shrug.exampleZh: 她轻轻耸了耸肩，没说一句话就走开了。

shut.example: Please shut the door and the windows before you leave the room.
shut.exampleZh: 请在你离开房间前关上门和窗户。

sick.example: I feel sick today, so I will stay home and rest.
sick.exampleZh: 我今天感觉不舒服，所以我会待在家里休息。

side.example: The left side of the house is always cool in the afternoon.
side.exampleZh: 房子左边下午总是很凉快。

sigh.example: She gave a long sigh and closed her eyes slowly.
sigh.exampleZh: 她长长地叹了口气，慢慢闭上了眼睛。

sight.example: The old man lost his sight, but he still enjoys the beautiful scenery.
sight.exampleZh: 那位老人失去了视力，但他仍然享受美丽的风景。

sign.example: Please sign your name at the bottom of this page before you leave.
sign.exampleZh: 请在离开前在这页纸的底部签上你的名字。

signal.example: The red light is a clear signal that we must stop here now.
signal.exampleZh: 红灯是一个明确的信号，表示我们现在必须在这里停下。

significance.example: The discovery has great significance for our understanding of the disease.
significance.exampleZh: 这一发现对我们理解这种疾病具有重要意义。

significant.example: This is a significant change for our small team and our future plans.
significant.exampleZh: 这对我们的小团队和未来计划来说是一个重要的变化。

silence.example: A deep silence filled the room after the teacher left.
silence.exampleZh: 老师离开后，一片深深的寂静充满了房间。

silent.example: The old house was silent after everyone left for the night.
silent.exampleZh: 大家夜里离开后，那栋老房子一片寂静。

silicon.example: Silicon is a common material used to make computer chips and solar cells.
silicon.exampleZh: 硅是一种常见材料，用于制造计算机芯片和太阳能电池。

silk.example: She bought a beautiful dress made of soft silk for the party.
silk.exampleZh: 她为聚会买了一条用柔软丝绸做的漂亮连衣裙。

silly.example: It was silly of me to forget my keys at home.
silly.exampleZh: 我把钥匙忘在家里了，真是傻。

silver.example: The old woman keeps her silver spoons in a wooden box.
silver.exampleZh: 那位老妇人把她的银勺放在一个木盒里。

similar.example: My sister and I have similar tastes in music and movies.
similar.exampleZh: 我和我姐姐在音乐和电影方面有相似的品味。

simple.example: The instructions are simple, so everyone can follow them easily.
simple.exampleZh: 说明很简单，所以每个人都能轻松照做。

simplicity.example: The simplicity of her design makes the room feel calm and open.
simplicity.exampleZh: 她设计的简洁让房间显得宁静而开阔。

simplify.example: We can simplify the rules so everyone understands them easily.
simplify.exampleZh: 我们可以简化规则，让每个人都能轻松理解。

simply.example: You can simply ask me if you need help.
simply.exampleZh: 如果你需要帮助，你只要问我就行。

simulate.example: Scientists use computers to simulate the weather before a big storm.
simulate.exampleZh: 科学家在强风暴来临前用计算机模拟天气。

simultaneous.example: The two teams made simultaneous changes to the plan.
simultaneous.exampleZh: 两队同时对该计划做出了改变。

sin.example: He felt guilty after he committed a serious sin against his family.
sin.exampleZh: 他在对家人犯下严重罪过后感到内疚。

since.example: I have lived in this city since I was a young child.
since.exampleZh: 我从小就住在这座城市。

sincere.example: She gave me a sincere smile and thanked me for my help.
sincere.exampleZh: 她给了我一个真诚的微笑，并感谢我的帮助。

sing.example: The little girl likes to sing happy songs with her friends.
sing.exampleZh: 那个小女孩喜欢和朋友们一起唱欢快的歌。

singer.example: The singer sang a beautiful song for all the people at the party.
singer.exampleZh: 这位歌手在聚会上为所有人唱了一首优美的歌。

single.example: He lives in a single room near the school and walks there every day.
single.exampleZh: 他住在学校附近的一间单人房里，每天步行去那里。

singular.example: This singular idea made the whole project much easier.
singular.exampleZh: 这个非凡的想法让整个项目容易多了。

sink.example: The heavy stone will sink to the bottom of the lake quickly.
sink.exampleZh: 那块沉重的石头会很快沉到湖底。

sir.example: Excuse me, sir, could you please tell me where the train station is?
sir.exampleZh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我火车站在哪里吗？

sister.example: My sister and I walk to school together every morning.
sister.exampleZh: 我和姐姐每天早上一起走路去学校。

sit.example: Please sit down on this chair and wait for your turn.
sit.exampleZh: 请坐在这把椅子上，等待轮到你。

site.example: This site is a good place for our new school.
site.exampleZh: 这个地点是我们新学校的好地方。

situation.example: We are in a difficult situation, but we can still find a way out.
situation.exampleZh: 我们处境艰难，但我们仍能找到出路。

six.example: There are six apples on the table for the children to share.
six.exampleZh: 桌子上有六个苹果供孩子们分享。

size.example: The size of this room is just right for our new table.
size.exampleZh: 这个房间的大小正好适合我们的新桌子。

skate.example: I like to skate on the frozen lake near my house in winter.
skate.exampleZh: 冬天我喜欢在房子附近结冰的湖面上滑冰。

skeptical.example: She is skeptical about the new plan because it seems too good.
skeptical.exampleZh: 她对新计划持怀疑态度，因为它似乎好得令人难以置信。

sketch.example: She made a quick sketch of the tree before painting it.
sketch.exampleZh: 她在画那棵树之前先画了一张快速的草图。

ski.example: My family goes to the mountains every winter to ski together.
ski.exampleZh: 我家每年冬天都去山里一起滑雪。

skill.example: Practice is the best way to improve your skill in English.
skill.exampleZh: 练习是提高你的英语技能的最好方法。

skilled.example: She is a skilled worker and finishes every task quickly.
skilled.exampleZh: 她是一名熟练的工人，每项任务都能很快完成。

skillful.example: She is a skillful cook and can make many delicious dishes for her family.
skillful.exampleZh: 她是一位熟练的厨师，能为家人做许多美味的菜肴。

skin.example: The skin on the apple is red and shiny, and it is good for you.
skin.exampleZh: 苹果的皮是红色且有光泽的，而且对你有好处。

skirt.example: She wore a long blue skirt to the party last night.
skirt.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条蓝色长裙去参加聚会。

sky.example: The sky is clear and blue today, so we can play outside.
sky.exampleZh: 今天天空晴朗又蓝，所以我们可以到外面玩。

slam.example: She slammed the door and walked away without saying a word.
slam.exampleZh: 她砰地关上门，一言不发地走开了。

slap.example: He gave me a light slap on the back and smiled.
slap.exampleZh: 他轻轻拍了我的背一下，笑了笑。

slash.example: The company slashed prices and many people bought more.
slash.exampleZh: 公司大幅削减了价格，许多人买了更多。

slave.example: The slave worked all day in the hot fields without any rest.
slave.exampleZh: 那个奴隶在炎热的田地里干了一整天活，没有休息。

slavery.example: Slavery is a cruel system that treats people as property.
slavery.exampleZh: 奴隶制是一种把人当作财产的残酷制度。

sleep.example: I need to sleep for eight hours every night to feel good.
sleep.exampleZh: 我每天晚上需要睡八个小时才能感觉良好。

sleeve.example: She rolled up her sleeve and washed the dirty dishes.
sleeve.exampleZh: 她卷起袖子，洗了那些脏盘子。

slender.example: The slender girl walked quietly through the old garden in the morning.
slender.exampleZh: 那个苗条的女孩清晨静静地走过旧花园。

slice.example: She cut a thin slice of bread and gave it to me.
slice.exampleZh: 她切了一片薄面包递给我。

slide.example: The children like to slide down the big slide in the park.
slide.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里从大滑梯上滑下来。

slight.example: There is a slight difference between the two pictures on the wall.
slight.exampleZh: 墙上那两幅画之间有轻微的差别。

slim.example: She hopes to get slim before her sister gets married next month.
slim.exampleZh: 她希望在妹妹下个月结婚前变得苗条。

slip.example: I saw a small slip of paper on the floor.
slip.exampleZh: 我看到地板上有一张小纸条。

slogan.example: The company's new slogan is short, easy to remember, and very popular.
slogan.exampleZh: 公司的新口号简短、易记，而且非常受欢迎。

slope.example: The children ran down the grassy slope and laughed all the way.
slope.exampleZh: 孩子们跑下长满草的斜坡，一路笑着。

slot.example: I put the coin into the slot and waited for the machine.
slot.exampleZh: 我把硬币放进投币口，然后等机器。

slow.example: The old bus is very slow on this long road.
slow.exampleZh: 这辆旧公交车在这条长路上开得很慢。

small.example: This small room has one bed and a desk.
small.exampleZh: 这个小房间有一张床和一张书桌。

smart.example: She is smart and always finds quick answers to hard problems.
smart.exampleZh: 她很聪明，总能很快找到难题的答案。

smash.example: The angry boy smashed the old window with a heavy stone.
smash.exampleZh: 那个愤怒的男孩用一块沉重的石头砸碎了那扇旧窗户。

smell.example: I can smell fresh bread from the kitchen every morning.
smell.exampleZh: 我每天早上都能闻到厨房里新鲜面包的香味。

smile.example: She gave me a warm smile and said hello to everyone.
smile.exampleZh: 她给了我一个温暖的微笑，并向大家问好。

smoke.example: The smoke from the fire made my eyes water.
smoke.exampleZh: 火产生的烟让我的眼睛流泪。

smooth.example: The road to the beach is smooth and easy to walk on.
smooth.exampleZh: 通往海滩的路很平坦，走起来很轻松。

snake.example: The snake is very dangerous, so we stay away from it.
snake.exampleZh: 这条蛇很危险，所以我们远离它。

snap.example: She tried to snap the dry branch but it was too strong.
snap.exampleZh: 她试着啪地折断那根干树枝，但它太结实了。

snow.example: The children love to play in the snow after school on every winter day.
snow.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在冬天每天放学后在雪里玩。

so.example: It was so cold outside that we stayed home and drank hot tea.
so.exampleZh: 外面太冷了，所以我们待在家里喝热茶。

soak.example: I will soak the dirty clothes in warm water before I wash them.
soak.exampleZh: 我会在洗之前把脏衣服泡在温水里。

soap.example: Please wash your hands with soap and warm water before dinner.
soap.exampleZh: 请在晚饭前用肥皂和温水洗手。

soar.example: Prices continue to soar as more people want to buy homes in the city.
soar.exampleZh: 随着越来越多的人想在城里买房，房价继续猛增。

soccer.example: I play soccer with my friends after school every Friday.
soccer.exampleZh: 我每周五放学后和朋友们踢足球。

social.example: Social media helps people stay in touch with friends and family.
social.exampleZh: 社交媒体帮助人们与朋友和家人保持联系。

society.example: Modern society depends on people working together and helping each other.
society.exampleZh: 现代社会依靠人们共同努力和互相帮助。

sociology.example: She studies sociology at a small college near her home.
sociology.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所小学院学习社会学。

sock.example: I put my socks in the drawer after I do the laundry.
sock.exampleZh: 我洗完衣服后把袜子放进抽屉里。

sofa.example: There is a big blue sofa in the living room.
sofa.exampleZh: 客厅里有一张蓝色的大沙发。

soft.example: The soft pillow made it easy for the baby to fall asleep.
soft.exampleZh: 柔软的枕头让宝宝很容易入睡。

software.example: The new software helps our team finish work faster every day.
software.exampleZh: 新软件帮助我们团队每天更快地完成工作。

soil.example: The soil in our garden is rich and good for growing vegetables.
soil.exampleZh: 我们花园里的土壤很肥沃，适合种蔬菜。

solar.example: We can use solar energy to cook food and heat water.
solar.exampleZh: 我们可以利用太阳能做饭和烧水。

soldier.example: The soldier carried a heavy bag and walked slowly toward the small village.
soldier.exampleZh: 那名士兵背着一个沉重的包，慢慢走向那个小村庄。

sole.example: She is the sole person who knows the answer to this question.
sole.exampleZh: 她是唯一知道这个问题答案的人。

solemn.example: The whole school stood in solemn silence during the important ceremony.
solemn.exampleZh: 在重要的仪式上，全校师生庄严地静立。

solid.example: The table is solid and strong enough for our heavy books.
solid.exampleZh: 这张桌子很坚固，足够承受我们的重书。

solution.example: We need a simple solution to this common problem today.
solution.exampleZh: 我们需要一个简单的办法来解决今天这个常见问题。

solve.example: We must solve this problem before the meeting starts tomorrow.
solve.exampleZh: 我们必须在明天会议开始前解决这个问题。

some.example: Some of my friends like to play football after school on Fridays.
some.exampleZh: 我的一些朋友喜欢在周五放学后踢足球。

somebody.example: Somebody left a small package outside the front door this morning.
somebody.exampleZh: 今天早上有人在前门外留下了一个小包裹。

somehow.example: Somehow she found her lost keys under the old wooden table.
somehow.exampleZh: 不知怎么地，她在旧木桌下找到了丢失的钥匙。

someone.example: Someone left a small bag on the table this morning.
someone.exampleZh: 今天早上有人把一个小包落在桌子上了。

something.example: I want to tell you something important about our new plan.
something.exampleZh: 我想告诉你一件关于我们新计划的重要事情。

sometime.example: I will visit my grandmother sometime next week after school.
sometime.exampleZh: 我下周放学后会找个时间去看望我的祖母。

sometimes.example: I sometimes walk to school with my best friend when the weather is nice.
sometimes.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我有时和最好的朋友一起步行去学校。

somewhat.example: I am somewhat tired after work today, but I can still help you.
somewhat.exampleZh: 我今天下班后有点累，但我仍然可以帮你。

son.example: Their son likes to play football with his friends after school every day.
son.exampleZh: 他们的儿子喜欢每天放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

song.example: She sang a happy song while walking home with her friends.
song.exampleZh: 她和朋友们一起走回家时唱了一首快乐的歌。

soon.example: We will go home soon after the meeting ends.
soon.exampleZh: 会议结束后我们很快就会回家。

sophisticated.example: This is a sophisticated machine that can solve many hard problems quickly.
sophisticated.exampleZh: 这是一台能快速解决许多难题的精密机器。

sore.example: My throat is sore today, so I will drink warm water.
sore.exampleZh: 我今天喉咙痛，所以我会喝温水。

sorrow.example: She felt deep sorrow after her old dog died last winter.
sorrow.exampleZh: 去年冬天她的老狗死后，她感到深深的悲伤。

sorry.example: I am sorry that I forgot your birthday and made you sad.
sorry.exampleZh: 我很抱歉忘了你的生日，让你难过了。

sort.example: She likes to sort her books by size and color.
sort.exampleZh: 她喜欢按大小和颜色整理她的书。

soul.example: She believes that a kind soul is more important than a beautiful face.
soul.exampleZh: 她相信一颗善良的心灵比一张漂亮的脸更重要。

sound.example: The sound of the rain made me feel calm and sleepy.
sound.exampleZh: 雨声让我感到平静而困倦。

soup.example: My mother made a hot bowl of soup for us after school.
soup.exampleZh: 放学后，妈妈给我们做了一碗热汤。

sour.example: The milk in the fridge went sour, so we threw it away.
sour.exampleZh: 冰箱里的牛奶变酸了，所以我们把它扔掉了。

source.example: The source of the river is high in the mountains.
source.exampleZh: 这条河的源头在高山上。

south.example: The birds fly south every winter when the weather gets cold.
south.exampleZh: 每年冬天天气变冷时，鸟儿都会向南飞。

sow.example: Farmers sow seeds in the field when spring comes every year.
sow.exampleZh: 农民每年春天来临时在田里播种。

space.example: There is not enough space in this small room for another bed.
space.exampleZh: 这间小房间里没有足够的空间再放一张床。

spade.example: The gardener used a spade to dig a hole for the new tree.
spade.exampleZh: 园丁用铲子为新树挖了一个坑。

span.example: The bridge has a span of about two hundred meters.
span.exampleZh: 这座桥的跨度约为两百米。

spare.example: I always keep a spare key in my bag for emergencies.
spare.exampleZh: 我总是在包里放一把备用钥匙以防万一。

spark.example: A small spark from the fire started the dry grass burning quickly.
spark.exampleZh: 火中的一个小火花使干草迅速燃烧起来。

sparkle.example: Her eyes sparkle with joy when she sees the surprise gift.
sparkle.exampleZh: 当她看到这份惊喜礼物时，她的眼睛闪耀着喜悦。

speak.example: I can speak a little English, but I am still learning every day.
speak.exampleZh: 我会说一点英语，但我每天都在继续学习。

special.example: This is a special day for all of us to remember.
special.exampleZh: 这是我们所有人值得记住的特殊一天。

specialist.example: My doctor sent me to a heart specialist for a careful check.
specialist.exampleZh: 我的医生让我去找一位心脏专科医生做仔细检查。

specialize.example: Many doctors specialize in one kind of medicine after they finish their training.
specialize.exampleZh: 许多医生在完成培训后专攻某一种医学。

species.example: Many species of birds live in this forest and sing every morning.
species.exampleZh: 许多种鸟生活在这片森林里，每天早晨唱歌。

specific.example: Please give me a specific example so I can understand your idea.
specific.exampleZh: 请给我一个具体的例子，这样我就能理解你的想法。

specify.example: Please specify the exact time and place for our next meeting.
specify.exampleZh: 请具体说明我们下次会议的确切时间和地点。

spectacular.example: The view from the mountain was spectacular and we took many photos.
spectacular.exampleZh: 山上的景色非常壮观，我们拍了很多照片。

speculate.example: Some people speculate that prices will rise again next year.
speculate.exampleZh: 一些人推测明年价格会再次上涨。

speech.example: His speech at the meeting was short but very clear.
speech.exampleZh: 他在会上的演讲简短但非常清楚。

speed.example: The car can reach a high speed on this straight road.
speed.exampleZh: 这辆车在这条直路上能达到很高的速度。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me, please?
spell.exampleZh: 你能为我拼写一下你的姓吗？

spend.example: I spend an hour reading English books every evening after dinner.
spend.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后花一小时读英文书。

sphere.example: The teacher said the Earth is a sphere that moves around the sun.
sphere.exampleZh: 老师说地球是一个围绕太阳运动的球体。

spice.example: A little spice can make a simple meal taste much better.
spice.exampleZh: 一点香料能让简单的饭菜味道好很多。

spill.example: Be careful not to spill the hot coffee on the table.
spill.exampleZh: 小心别把热咖啡洒在桌子上。

spin.example: The dancers spin around the room and laugh with joy.
spin.exampleZh: 舞者们在房间里旋转，开心地笑着。

spine.example: The doctor said my spine looked healthy after he examined my back carefully.
spine.exampleZh: 医生仔细检查我的背部后说我的脊柱看起来很健康。

spirit.example: His spirit remained strong through many hard days.
spirit.exampleZh: 在许多艰难的日子里，他的精神依然坚强。

spiritual.example: She finds spiritual peace when she walks alone in the quiet forest.
spiritual.exampleZh: 她在安静的森林里独自散步时找到了心灵的平静。

spit.example: The boy was told not to spit on the playground.
spit.exampleZh: 那个男孩被告知不要在操场上吐口水。

spite.example: He said it out of spite and later felt sorry for his words.
spite.exampleZh: 他出于恶意说了那句话，后来为自己的话感到后悔。

splash.example: The children splash water in the pool and laugh happily.
splash.exampleZh: 孩子们在泳池里泼水，开心地笑着。

split.example: The two friends split the bill after a simple dinner at a small restaurant.
split.exampleZh: 两个朋友在一家小餐馆简单吃完饭后平摊了账单。

spoil.example: Too much rain can spoil the fruit before we pick it.
spoil.exampleZh: 雨水过多会在我们采摘前就使水果变质。

spoke.example: He spoke to his teacher after class about the difficult homework.
spoke.exampleZh: 他课后就那道难题跟老师谈了。

spokesman.example: The company spokesman answered a few simple questions from the reporters.
spokesman.exampleZh: 公司发言人回答了记者们几个简单的问题。

sponge.example: The sponge in the sink is old and needs to be replaced.
sponge.exampleZh: 水槽里的海绵旧了，需要更换。

sponsor.example: The local company will sponsor the school team this year.
sponsor.exampleZh: 这家本地公司今年将赞助学校队。

spontaneous.example: Her laughter was spontaneous and made everyone in the room feel happy.
spontaneous.exampleZh: 她的笑声是自发的，让房间里的每个人都感到快乐。

sport.example: My favorite sport is basketball because it is fun and healthy.
sport.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的运动是篮球，因为它有趣又健康。

spot.example: I saw a red spot on the wall near the door.
spot.exampleZh: 我看见门附近的墙上有一个红点。

spray.example: The gardener will spray water on the flowers early tomorrow morning.
spray.exampleZh: 园丁明天一早会给花喷水。

spread.example: The news spread quickly through the small town after lunch.
spread.exampleZh: 午饭后，这个消息迅速传遍了小镇。

spring.example: The cold winter is over and spring brings warm days and green leaves.
spring.exampleZh: 寒冷的冬天结束了，春天带来温暖的日子和绿叶。

spur.example: His coach's praise was a spur for him to work even harder.
spur.exampleZh: 教练的表扬激励他更加努力。

spy.example: The police caught a spy who was watching the old building.
spy.exampleZh: 警方抓住了一名正在监视那栋旧楼的间谍。

square.example: The children play in the square and sit on benches near the fountain.
square.exampleZh: 孩子们在广场上玩耍，坐在喷泉附近的长椅上。

stable.example: Her breathing became stable after she sat down and drank some water.
stable.exampleZh: 她坐下喝了点水后，呼吸变得平稳了。

stack.example: Please stack the chairs in the corner after the meeting.
stack.exampleZh: 会议结束后，请把椅子叠放在角落里。

staff.example: The staff at this small hotel are very friendly to every guest.
staff.exampleZh: 这家小旅馆的全体职员对每位客人都非常友好。

stage.example: The actors walked onto the stage and smiled at the large audience.
stage.exampleZh: 演员们走上舞台，向众多观众微笑。

stagger.example: The tired old man staggered home after a long day at work.
stagger.exampleZh: 那位疲惫的老人上完一整天班后蹒跚地走回家。

stain.example: There is a dark stain on the old wooden table.
stain.exampleZh: 旧木桌上有一块深色污渍。

stair.example: He sat on the bottom stair and tied his shoes.
stair.exampleZh: 他坐在最下面的梯级上系鞋带。

stake.example: He has a big stake in the company and works there every day.
stake.exampleZh: 他在那家公司有很大的股份，每天都在那里工作。

stale.example: The bread on the table is stale and hard.
stale.exampleZh: 桌上的面包不新鲜了，而且很硬。

stall.example: The car stalled again, so we bought snacks at a small stall nearby.
stall.exampleZh: 车又熄火了，于是我们就在附近一个小摊位买了点零食。

stamp.example: She put a stamp on the letter and dropped it in the mailbox.
stamp.exampleZh: 她在信上贴了一张邮票，然后把它投进了邮箱。

stand.example: I cannot stand the noise, so I stand outside the shop.
stand.exampleZh: 我受不了那噪音，所以我站在商店外面。

standard.example: This school has high standards for its students and teachers.
standard.exampleZh: 这所学校对师生有很高的标准。

star.example: The brightest star in the sky appeared after the sun went down.
star.exampleZh: 太阳落山后，天空中那颗最亮的星星出现了。

stare.example: She stared at the painting for a long time.
stare.exampleZh: 她盯着那幅画看了很久。

start.example: We start work at nine and finish at five.
start.exampleZh: 我们九点开始工作，五点结束。

startle.example: The loud noise from the kitchen did startle the sleeping cat.
startle.exampleZh: 厨房里传来的巨响确实把熟睡的猫吓了一跳。

starve.example: Many wild animals will starve if the long winter kills all the plants.
starve.exampleZh: 如果漫长的冬天让所有植物都死掉，许多野生动物就会挨饿。

state.example: Please state your name and address clearly to the officer.
state.exampleZh: 请向警官清楚地陈述你的姓名和地址。

statement.example: Her statement about the new plan was clear and easy to understand.
statement.exampleZh: 她对这项新计划的陈述清晰易懂。

static.example: The water in the old pond is static and never moves.
static.exampleZh: 那个旧池塘里的水是静止的，从不流动。

statistic.example: This statistic shows that most students prefer to study at home.
statistic.exampleZh: 这个统计数值表明，大多数学生更喜欢在家学习。

statue.example: There is a large stone statue in the middle of the park.
statue.exampleZh: 公园中央有一座大石雕像。

status.example: Her status in the company has grown a lot this year.
status.exampleZh: 她在公司里的地位今年提升了很多。

statute.example: The new statute says all shops must close before ten at night.
statute.exampleZh: 新法规规定所有商店必须在晚上十点前关门。

stay.example: I will stay at home and read a book this afternoon.
stay.exampleZh: 今天下午我会待在家里看书。

steady.example: The old table is not steady, so please do not put the hot pot on it.
steady.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子不稳，所以请不要把热锅放在上面。

steal.example: Someone tried to steal my bike outside the shop yesterday.
steal.exampleZh: 昨天有人在商店外面试图偷我的自行车。

steam.example: The hot soup gave off steam and warmed the cold kitchen.
steam.exampleZh: 热汤冒出蒸汽，温暖了冰冷的厨房。

steel.example: The bridge is made of strong steel and can hold heavy trucks.
steel.exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的钢铁制成，能承载重型卡车。

steep.example: The steep hill is hard to climb for young children.
steep.exampleZh: 这座陡峭的小山对小孩子来说很难爬。

steer.example: My father taught me how to steer the small boat on the lake.
steer.exampleZh: 我父亲教我在湖上如何驾驶小船。

stem.example: The plant has a strong stem, and we must stem the flow of waste.
stem.exampleZh: 这株植物有一根粗壮的茎，我们必须阻止废物的流失。

step.example: Please take one step forward and then wait for the bus.
step.exampleZh: 请向前走一步，然后等待公交车。

stereo.example: My father bought a new stereo for the living room last week.
stereo.exampleZh: 我父亲上周为客厅买了一台新的立体声音响。

stereotype.example: The movie uses an old stereotype about lazy students.
stereotype.exampleZh: 这部电影使用了一个关于懒惰学生的老套刻板印象。

stern.example: The stern teacher told us to be quiet and listen carefully.
stern.exampleZh: 那位严厉的老师让我们安静下来，认真听讲。

stick.example: He used a little glue to stick the photo onto the paper, and he stuck to his plan.
stick.exampleZh: 他用一点胶水把照片粘在纸上，并且坚持了自己的计划。

stiff.example: After the long car ride, my legs felt stiff and I could hardly walk.
stiff.exampleZh: 长途乘车之后，我的腿感觉很僵硬，几乎走不动路。

still.example: She is still waiting for her friend at the quiet, still station.
still.exampleZh: 她仍然在安静、寂静的车站等着她的朋友。

stimulate.example: Good teachers stimulate students to ask more questions in class.
stimulate.exampleZh: 好老师会激励学生在课堂上多提问。

stimulus.example: Bright light is a stimulus that makes the eyes react quickly.
stimulus.exampleZh: 强光是一种刺激，会让眼睛迅速做出反应。

sting.example: A bee may sting you if you touch its nest.
sting.exampleZh: 如果你碰到蜂巢，蜜蜂可能会蜇你。

stir.example: She likes to stir the soup slowly before serving it.
stir.exampleZh: 她喜欢在上桌前慢慢搅拌汤。

stock.example: The store keeps a large stock of winter coats in the back room.
stock.exampleZh: 这家店在后面的房间里存放了大量冬季外套库存。

stomach.example: My stomach hurts because I ate too much cold food last night.
stomach.exampleZh: 我的胃疼，因为我昨晚吃了太多冷食。

stone.example: The old wall is made of stone and looks very strong.
stone.exampleZh: 这堵老墙是用石头砌成的，看起来很坚固。

stoop.example: She had to stoop down to pick up the toy from the floor.
stoop.exampleZh: 她不得不弯下腰去把玩具从地板上捡起来。

stop.example: Please stop the car near the bus stop and wait for me there.
stop.exampleZh: 请把车停在公交车站附近，在那里等我。

storage.example: We keep our winter clothes in storage under the bed.
storage.exampleZh: 我们把冬天的衣服存放在床下的储物空间里。

store.example: I store my winter clothes in a big box under the bed.
store.exampleZh: 我把冬天的衣服储存在床底下的一个大箱子里。

storm.example: The storm lasted all night, and the wind broke many trees.
storm.exampleZh: 暴风雨持续了一整夜，风刮断了很多树。

story.example: My grandmother tells me a story every night before I go to sleep.
story.exampleZh: 我奶奶每晚都在我睡觉前给我讲一个故事。

stove.example: She put the pot on the stove and cooked some soup.
stove.exampleZh: 她把锅放在炉子上，煮了一些汤。

straight.example: He drew a straight line on the paper and smiled.
straight.exampleZh: 他在纸上画了一条直线，然后笑了。

strain.example: The heavy box put a strain on his back, so he rested.
strain.exampleZh: 那个重箱子给他的背部带来了压力，所以他休息了。

strange.example: It is strange that nobody answered the phone at his office today.
strange.exampleZh: 奇怪的是，今天他办公室里没人接电话。

stranger.example: She never talks to a stranger on the street.
stranger.exampleZh: 她从不在街上和陌生人说话。

strap.example: He pulled the strap of his bag over his shoulder and walked out.
strap.exampleZh: 他把包带拉过肩膀，走了出去。

strategic.example: The company made a strategic plan to grow its business in Asia.
strategic.exampleZh: 公司制定了一项战略计划，以在亚洲发展业务。

strategy.example: Our team needs a new strategy to win more games this year.
strategy.exampleZh: 我们队需要一个新策略，以便今年赢得更多比赛。

straw.example: The farmer put dry straw on the floor of the barn.
straw.exampleZh: 农民把干稻草铺在谷仓的地上。

stream.example: A small stream flows through the field behind our house.
stream.exampleZh: 一条小溪流过我们房子后面的田野。

street.example: I walk down this street to school every morning.
street.exampleZh: 我每天早上沿着这条街走去学校。

strength.example: Her greatest strength is that she never gives up on hard problems.
strength.exampleZh: 她最大的优势是遇到难题从不放弃。

strengthen.example: Daily exercise can strengthen your body and help you feel better.
strengthen.exampleZh: 每天锻炼可以增强你的体质，让你感觉更好。

stress.example: Too much stress can make it hard to sleep well at night.
stress.exampleZh: 压力过大会让人晚上难以睡好。

stretch.example: I stretch my arms every morning before I go to work.
stretch.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会伸展一下手臂。

strict.example: My father is very strict about our homework and bedtime.
strict.exampleZh: 我父亲对我们的作业和睡觉时间要求很严格。

strike.example: The workers decided to strike for better pay and safer working conditions.
strike.exampleZh: 工人们决定罢工，要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

striking.example: There is a striking difference between the two pictures.
striking.exampleZh: 这两幅图之间有显著的差异。

string.example: She tied the box with a piece of string and carried it home.
string.exampleZh: 她用一根细绳把盒子绑好，然后带回家。

strip.example: The judge decided to strip him of his title after the trial.
strip.exampleZh: 审判后，法官决定剥夺他的头衔。

stripe.example: The zebra has black and white stripes on its body.
stripe.exampleZh: 斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

strive.example: We must strive to do our best every single day.
strive.exampleZh: 我们必须努力每天都做到最好。

stroke.example: My grandfather had a stroke last year but he is getting better.
stroke.exampleZh: 我爷爷去年中风了，但他正在好转。

strong.example: He is strong enough to carry the heavy box up the stairs.
strong.exampleZh: 他足够强壮，能把那个沉重的箱子搬上楼。

structure.example: The structure of the new building is very strong.
structure.exampleZh: 这座新建筑的结构非常坚固。

student.example: Every student in my class reads a book before the lesson starts.
student.exampleZh: 我班上的每个学生都在上课前读一本书。

studio.example: The band recorded their new songs in a small studio last week.
studio.exampleZh: 乐队上周在一间小工作室里录制了他们的新歌。

study.example: I study English for an hour every evening in my small study.
study.exampleZh: 我每天晚上在我的小书房里学一小时英语。

stuff.example: Please put your stuff in the bag before we leave.
stuff.exampleZh: 我们出发前，请把你的东西放进袋子里。

stumble.example: I stumbled on the stairs but did not fall.
stumble.exampleZh: 我在楼梯上绊了一下，但没有摔倒。

stupid.example: It was stupid of me to leave my keys at home.
stupid.exampleZh: 我把钥匙落在家里了，真是愚蠢。

style.example: Her style is simple and clean, and many people like it.
style.exampleZh: 她的风格简约清爽，很多人喜欢。

subject.example: The subject of today's lesson is very interesting to all of us.
subject.exampleZh: 今天这节课的主题对我们所有人都很有意思。

submarine.example: The submarine went under the water and stayed there for two hours.
submarine.exampleZh: 潜水艇潜入水下，并在那里停留了两个小时。

submerge.example: The heavy rain submerged the small road near our house.
submerge.exampleZh: 大雨淹没了我们家附近的那条小路。

submit.example: You must submit your report before Friday afternoon.
submit.exampleZh: 你必须在周五下午之前提交你的报告。

subsequent.example: The first meeting was short, and the subsequent talks lasted two hours.
subsequent.exampleZh: 第一次会议很短，随后的会谈持续了两个小时。

substance.example: Water is a simple substance that all living things need.
substance.exampleZh: 水是一种所有生物都需要的简单物质。

substantial.example: The company made a substantial profit last year.
substantial.exampleZh: 这家公司去年获得了大量利润。

substitute.example: You can substitute honey for sugar in this simple cake recipe.
substitute.exampleZh: 在这个简单的蛋糕食谱中，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subtract.example: Please subtract five from ten to get the correct answer.
subtract.exampleZh: 请从十中减去五，以得到正确答案。

suburb.example: My aunt lives in a quiet suburb with many trees and small parks.
suburb.exampleZh: 我的阿姨住在一个安静、有很多树木和小公园的郊区。

subway.example: I take the subway to work every morning.
subway.exampleZh: 我每天早上乘地铁上班。

succeed.example: If you work hard every day, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力，最终就会成功。

success.example: Hard work and patience are the keys to success in any job.
success.exampleZh: 努力和耐心是任何工作中取得成功的关键。

successful.example: She is a successful doctor who always helps people in need.
successful.exampleZh: 她是一位成功的医生，总是帮助有需要的人。

successive.example: The team won three successive games last month.
successive.exampleZh: 这支队伍上个月连续赢了三场比赛。

successor.example: The young successor learned the job quickly from the old manager.
successor.exampleZh: 这位年轻的继任者很快从老经理那里学会了这份工作。

such.example: I never saw such a big dog before today.
such.exampleZh: 在今天之前我从没见过这么大的狗。

suck.example: Babies suck milk from a bottle when they are hungry.
suck.exampleZh: 婴儿饿了就会从奶瓶里吸奶。

sudden.example: There was a sudden loud noise outside the window last night.
sudden.exampleZh: 昨晚窗外突然传来一声巨响。

suffer.example: Many people suffer from headaches after working too long at a computer.
suffer.exampleZh: 很多人在电脑前工作太久后会头痛。

sufficient.example: We have sufficient food and water for the long trip.
sufficient.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物和水来完成这次长途旅行。

sugar.example: My mother puts a little sugar in her morning coffee.
sugar.exampleZh: 我妈妈在早晨的咖啡里放了一点糖。

suggest.example: I suggest we meet at nine tomorrow morning.
suggest.exampleZh: 我建议我们明天早上九点见面。

suggestion.example: Her suggestion was very helpful, so we changed our plan.
suggestion.exampleZh: 她的建议非常有帮助，所以我们改变了计划。

suicide.example: The sad news about his friend made him think about the danger of suicide.
suicide.exampleZh: 关于他朋友的悲伤消息让他思考自杀的危险。

suit.example: This dark suit fits him well, but the long trip may not suit his health.
suit.exampleZh: 这套深色西装很适合他，但长途旅行可能不适合他的身体。

suitable.example: This movie is not suitable for young children.
suitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合小孩子看。

sulfur.example: The yellow powder on the rocks is sulfur from the nearby volcano.
sulfur.exampleZh: 岩石上的黄色粉末是附近火山留下的硫磺。

sum.example: The sum of these two numbers is ten.
sum.exampleZh: 这两个数字的总和是十。

summarize.example: She will summarize the report in five minutes for the whole team.
summarize.exampleZh: 她会在五分钟内向整个团队概括这份报告。

summary.example: Please write a short summary of the report for the meeting.
summary.exampleZh: 请为会议写一份简短的报告摘要。

summer.example: We often go swimming in the lake during the hot summer.
summer.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏天，我们经常去湖里游泳。

summit.example: After a long climb, we finally reached the summit of the mountain.
summit.exampleZh: 经过漫长的攀登，我们终于到达了山顶。

summon.example: The king summoned his soldiers to the castle before the battle.
summon.exampleZh: 国王在战斗前把士兵们召唤到城堡。

sun.example: The sun is very bright today, so wear a hat.
sun.exampleZh: 今天阳光很强，所以戴顶帽子吧。

sunlight.example: The plant needs plenty of sunlight to grow well.
sunlight.exampleZh: 这株植物需要充足的阳光才能长得好。

sunrise.example: We got up early to watch the sunrise over the mountains.
sunrise.exampleZh: 我们早早起床去看山间的日出。

sunset.example: We sat by the lake and watched the sunset together.
sunset.exampleZh: 我们一起坐在湖边看日落。

sunshine.example: The children played outside and enjoyed the warm sunshine all afternoon.
sunshine.exampleZh: 孩子们在外面玩耍，整个下午都享受着温暖的阳光。

super.example: This is a super idea for our class party.
super.exampleZh: 这对我们的班级聚会来说是个极好的主意。

superficial.example: His knowledge of the subject is superficial and he cannot answer simple questions.
superficial.exampleZh: 他对这个学科的了解很肤浅，回答不了简单的问题。

superior.example: This new phone is superior to my old one in every way.
superior.exampleZh: 这部新手机在各方面都比我那部旧的好。

supervise.example: My teacher supervises the students while they work in the lab.
supervise.exampleZh: 老师在学生做实验时监督他们。

supplement.example: This vitamin supplement helps you stay healthy during the winter months.
supplement.exampleZh: 这种维生素补充剂能帮助你在冬季保持健康。

supply.example: The company can supply fresh water to the whole village every day.
supply.exampleZh: 这家公司每天能为整个村庄供应新鲜的水。

support.example: My parents always support me when I try something new.
support.exampleZh: 每当我尝试新事物时，父母总是支持我。

suppose.example: I suppose you are right, so let us try again tomorrow.
suppose.exampleZh: 我想你是对的，所以我们明天再试一次吧。

supreme.example: The court has supreme power over all other courts in the country.
supreme.exampleZh: 该法院在全国所有其他法院之上拥有最高权力。

sure.example: I am sure you will do well on the test tomorrow.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信你明天的考试会考得很好。

surface.example: The surface of the lake was calm and smooth in the early morning light.
surface.exampleZh: 清晨的光线下，湖面平静而光滑。

surge.example: Demand for clean energy has surged in recent years, and prices may surge again.
surge.exampleZh: 近年来清洁能源的需求激增，价格可能再次暴涨。

surgeon.example: The surgeon washed his hands carefully before the operation began.
surgeon.exampleZh: 手术开始前，外科医生仔细地洗了手。

surgery.example: The doctor said I need surgery on my knee next week.
surgery.exampleZh: 医生说我下周需要做膝盖手术。

surplus.example: The farm produces a surplus of vegetables every summer and sells the extra at the market.
surplus.exampleZh: 这个农场每年夏天都会生产出过剩的蔬菜，并把多余的部分拿到市场上卖。

surprise.example: Her sudden visit was a big surprise to all of us.
surprise.exampleZh: 她的突然到访让我们所有人都大吃一惊。

surrender.example: The soldiers had to surrender after they ran out of food and water.
surrender.exampleZh: 士兵们在食物和水耗尽后不得不投降。

surround.example: The teacher asked the children to surround the table and sing together.
surround.exampleZh: 老师让孩子们围在桌子周围一起唱歌。

surroundings.example: The hotel is clean and quiet, and its surroundings are very beautiful.
surroundings.exampleZh: 这家酒店干净安静，周围的环境非常美。

survey.example: The team will survey the small village to learn about daily life there.
survey.exampleZh: 团队将调查这个小村庄，了解那里的日常生活。

survival.example: The survival of the small village depended on clean water and food.
survival.exampleZh: 这个小村庄的存亡取决于干净的水和食物。

survive.example: Only two people in the village survived the terrible flood last year.
survive.exampleZh: 去年那场可怕的洪水中，村里只有两个人幸存下来。

survivor.example: The last survivor of the flood told his story to the young reporter.
survivor.exampleZh: 那场洪水的最后一位幸存者向年轻记者讲述了他的经历。

suspect.example: The police suspect that he took the money, but they are not sure.
suspect.exampleZh: 警方怀疑他拿了那笔钱，但他们并不确定。

suspend.example: They will suspend the game because of the heavy rain.
suspend.exampleZh: 因为大雨，他们将暂停比赛。

suspicion.example: Her strange smile raised a suspicion that she knew the truth.
suspicion.exampleZh: 她奇怪的微笑让人怀疑她知道真相。

suspicious.example: The police found a suspicious bag near the door.
suspicious.exampleZh: 警察在门附近发现了一个可疑的包。

sustain.example: Good food and enough sleep help sustain our energy through the day.
sustain.exampleZh: 好的食物和充足的睡眠有助于我们一整天保持精力。

swallow.example: The bird is a swallow, and it can swallow small insects quickly.
swallow.exampleZh: 这只鸟是燕子，它能很快地吞下小昆虫。

swamp.example: The old wooden bridge across the swamp is not safe.
swamp.exampleZh: 横跨沼泽的那座旧木桥不安全。

swap.example: I asked my friend to swap seats with me on the bus.
swap.exampleZh: 我请朋友在公交车上和我换座位。

swear.example: She made him swear that he would never tell anyone the secret.
swear.exampleZh: 她让他发誓永远不把这个秘密告诉任何人。

sweep.example: She sweeps the kitchen floor every morning before breakfast.
sweep.exampleZh: 她每天早上在早饭前打扫厨房地板。
