sweet.example: This cake is very sweet and my little sister loves it.
sweet.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕很甜，我妹妹很喜欢它。

swell.example: My ankle began to swell after the long walk.
swell.exampleZh: 走了很长的路之后，我的脚踝开始肿了。

swift.example: The fast runner was swift enough to catch the ball.
swift.exampleZh: 那个跑得很快的人足够迅速，接住了球。

swim.example: I can swim in the lake near my house.
swim.exampleZh: 我会在我家附近的湖里游泳。

swing.example: The children like to swing on the old rope in the garden.
swing.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在花园里那根旧绳子上荡秋千。

switch.example: Please switch off the light before you leave the room.
switch.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

sword.example: The knight drew his sword and ran to the castle gate.
sword.exampleZh: 骑士拔出他的剑，跑向城堡大门。

symbol.example: The heart is a symbol of love in many cultures.
symbol.exampleZh: 心形在许多文化中是爱的象征。

sympathetic.example: She was very sympathetic when I told her about my bad day.
sympathetic.exampleZh: 当我跟她讲起我倒霉的一天时，她非常同情我。

sympathy.example: She felt deep sympathy for the old man living alone.
sympathy.exampleZh: 她对那位独居的老人深感同情。

symptom.example: A high fever is a common symptom of the flu.
symptom.exampleZh: 高烧是流感的常见症状。

system.example: The new computer system helps us work faster and make fewer mistakes.
system.exampleZh: 新的计算机系统帮助我们工作得更快，并减少错误。

table.example: Please put the books on the table before we start the meeting.
table.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前把书放在桌子上。

tackle.example: The team must tackle this problem before it gets worse.
tackle.exampleZh: 团队必须在这个问题变得更糟之前处理它。

tag.example: She wrote her name on a small tag and put it on her bag.
tag.exampleZh: 她把名字写在一张小标签上，挂在了自己的包上。

tail.example: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
tail.exampleZh: 我回家时，那只狗摇了摇尾巴。

take.example: Please take this book to your teacher and come back soon.
take.exampleZh: 请把这本书带给你的老师，然后快点回来。

tale.example: My grandmother told me a funny tale about her old village.
tale.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我讲了一个关于她 old 村庄的搞笑故事。

talent.example: She has a real talent for music and loves to sing.
talent.exampleZh: 她在音乐方面很有天赋，而且喜欢唱歌。

talk.example: We need to talk about the plan before Friday.
talk.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五之前谈谈这个计划。

tall.example: My brother is very tall and he plays basketball well.
tall.exampleZh: 我哥哥个子很高，篮球打得很好。

tame.example: The small fox became tame after living with the farmer for a year.
tame.exampleZh: 那只小狐狸和农夫住了一年后变得温顺了。

tank.example: The old tank in the garden is full of rainwater.
tank.exampleZh: 花园里的那个旧储水罐里装满了雨水。

tap.example: She gave the door a gentle tap and waited for an answer.
tap.exampleZh: 她轻轻敲了敲门，等着有人应答。

tape.example: I used tape to fix the broken box before I moved it.
tape.exampleZh: 我用胶带把破了的箱子粘好，然后才搬动它。

target.example: Our main target is to finish the work before Friday.
target.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是在周五之前完成这项工作。

task.example: My first task today is to answer all my emails.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是回复所有邮件。

taste.example: This soup tastes a little salty, but I like the taste.
taste.exampleZh: 这汤尝起来有点咸，但我喜欢这个味道。

tax.example: The government will tax the rich more to pay for new schools.
tax.exampleZh: 政府将对富人征收更多税，以支付新学校的费用。

taxi.example: We took a taxi from the airport to our hotel yesterday.
taxi.exampleZh: 昨天我们从机场坐出租车去了酒店。

tea.example: My mother drinks a cup of hot tea every morning before she goes to work.
tea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上班前都会喝一杯热茶。

teach.example: My mother teaches English at a small school near our home.
teach.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一所小学校教英语。

team.example: Our team works hard and we always help each other.
team.exampleZh: 我们的团队工作努力，而且我们总是互相帮助。

tear.example: Tears ran down her face as she tore the letter apart.
tear.exampleZh: 她撕碎那封信时，眼泪顺着脸颊流了下来。

technical.example: He needs technical help to fix the machine in his shop.
technical.exampleZh: 他需要技术帮助来修理店里的机器。

technician.example: The technician fixed the broken machine in our office this morning.
technician.exampleZh: 今天早上技术员修好了我们办公室那台坏掉的机器。

technique.example: She learned a new technique to make her drawing look more real.
technique.exampleZh: 她学会了一种新技巧，让她的画看起来更逼真。

technology.example: Technology helps us finish our work faster and easier.
technology.exampleZh: 技术帮助我们更快更容易地完成工作。

tedious.example: The meeting was long and tedious, so everyone felt sleepy.
tedious.exampleZh: 会议又长又乏味，所以大家都觉得困。

teenager.example: As a teenager, he loved playing basketball with his friends after school.
teenager.exampleZh: 青少年时期，他喜欢放学后和朋友们一起打篮球。

telephone.example: I used the telephone to call my mother this morning.
telephone.exampleZh: 今天早上我用电话给我妈妈打了电话。

telescope.example: I used a telescope to look at the moon last night.
telescope.exampleZh: 昨晚我用望远镜看了月亮。

television.example: My family watches television together in the living room every evening.
television.exampleZh: 我们家每天晚上一起在客厅看电视。

tell.example: Please tell me the truth about what happened last night.
tell.exampleZh: 请告诉我昨晚发生事情的真相。

temper.example: He lost his temper and shouted at the slow driver.
temper.exampleZh: 他发了脾气，对那个开得慢的司机大喊。

temperature.example: The temperature outside is very cold today.

temple.example: There is an old temple on the hill near my home.
temple.exampleZh: 我家附近的山上有一座古老的庙。

temporary.example: My job is only temporary, so I need to find a new one soon.
temporary.exampleZh: 我的工作只是临时的，所以我需要尽快找一份新工作。

tempt.example: The fresh bread in the shop window tempted me to buy some.
tempt.exampleZh: 商店橱窗里新鲜的面包吸引我买了一些。

ten.example: I have ten fingers and ten toes on my body.
ten.exampleZh: 我身上有十根手指和十根脚趾。

tend.example: I tend to stay up late when I have a lot of work.
tend.exampleZh: 工作很多的时候，我往往会熬夜。

tendency.example: She has a tendency to talk too much when she is nervous.
tendency.exampleZh: 她紧张时往往会说得太多。

tender.example: She gave the child a tender smile and held his hand.
tender.exampleZh: 她给了孩子一个温柔的微笑，握住他的手。

tennis.example: My brother plays tennis with his friends every Saturday morning.
tennis.exampleZh: 我弟弟每周六早上都和朋友一起打网球。

tense.example: I felt tense before the exam, so I took a few deep breaths.
tense.exampleZh: 考试前我感到很紧张，所以我做了几次深呼吸。

tension.example: There was a lot of tension in the room before the exam started.
tension.exampleZh: 考试开始前，房间里充满了紧张的气氛。

tent.example: We put up our tent near the river and slept there.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在河边搭起帐篷，在那里睡了一觉。

term.example: The new term starts next Monday, so I need to buy my books.
term.exampleZh: 新学期下周一开始，所以我需要去买书。

terminal.example: We waited for the bus at the terminal near the airport.
terminal.exampleZh: 我们在机场附近的终点站等公交车。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed at home all day.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

territory.example: The wild animals often mark their territory near the river.
territory.exampleZh: 野生动物常常在河边标记自己的地盘。

terror.example: The loud bang filled the small children with terror.
terror.exampleZh: 那声巨响让年幼的孩子们充满了恐惧。

test.example: We will have a math test on Friday morning.
test.exampleZh: 我们星期五上午有一场数学考试。

text.example: Please read the text on page ten and answer the questions.
text.exampleZh: 请阅读第十页的课文并回答问题。

textbook.example: I left my math textbook at home, so I shared one with my friend.
textbook.exampleZh: 我把数学课本忘在家里了，所以我和朋友合看一本。

than.example: She runs faster than her brother does.

thank.example: I want to thank you for all your help today.
thank.exampleZh: 我想感谢你今天所有的帮助。

that.example: I like that red bag more than this blue one.
that.exampleZh: 比起这个蓝色的包，我更喜欢那个红色的包。

the.example: The book on the table is mine.
the.exampleZh: 桌子上的那本书是我的。

theater.example: We went to the theater to see a new play last night.
theater.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去剧院看了一出新戏。

their.example: The students put their books on the desks before class.
their.exampleZh: 学生们在上课前把他们的书放在课桌上。

them.example: I saw my friends at the park and gave them some apples.
them.exampleZh: 我在公园看到我的朋友们，给了他们一些苹果。

theme.example: The main theme of this book is love and friendship.
theme.exampleZh: 这本书的主题是爱与友谊。

themselves.example: The children made the cookies themselves and shared them with their friends.
themselves.exampleZh: 孩子们自己做了饼干，并和朋友们分享。

then.example: We ate dinner, and then we watched a movie at home.
then.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，然后在家看了一部电影。

theory.example: Einstein's theory of relativity changed how scientists understand time and space.
theory.exampleZh: 爱因斯坦的相对论改变了科学家对时间和空间的理解。

there.example: Put the box over there by the window, please.
there.exampleZh: 请把那个箱子放到窗边那里。

therefore.example: It was raining, therefore we stayed at home all day.
therefore.exampleZh: 当时在下雨，因此我们一整天都待在家里。

these.example: These books on the desk are mine, and those are yours.
these.exampleZh: 桌上的这些书是我的，那些是你的。

they.example: They are my friends and we go to school together every day.
they.exampleZh: 他们是我的朋友，我们每天一起上学。

thick.example: The ice on the lake is very thick this winter.
thick.exampleZh: 今年冬天湖面上的冰很厚。

thief.example: The police caught the thief who stole my bike last night.
thief.exampleZh: 警察抓住了昨晚偷我自行车的小偷。

thin.example: This book is thin and easy to carry in my bag.
thin.exampleZh: 这本书很薄，放在包里很容易携带。

thing.example: The first thing I do every morning is drink a glass of water.
thing.exampleZh: 我每天早上做的第一件事就是喝一杯水。

think.example: I think we should go home now.
think.exampleZh: 我想我们现在应该回家了。

third.example: He lives on the third floor of that old building.
third.exampleZh: 他住在那栋旧楼的三楼。

thirsty.example: After the long run, I felt very thirsty and drank two glasses of water.
thirsty.exampleZh: 长跑之后我觉得很口渴，喝了两杯水。

thirteen.example: My sister is thirteen years old and she loves to read books.
thirteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十三岁，她喜欢读书。

thirty.example: My father worked at that factory for thirty years before he retired.
thirty.exampleZh: 我父亲在那家工厂工作了三十年才退休。

this.example: This is my new book, and I read it every day.
this.exampleZh: 这是我的新书，我每天都读它。

thorough.example: The doctor did a thorough check of my health last week.
thorough.exampleZh: 医生上周对我的健康做了彻底的检查。

those.example: Those are my new books on the desk.
those.exampleZh: 那些是我放在桌子上的新书。

though.example: Though it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
though.exampleZh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去散步了。

thought.example: I had a new thought about the problem this morning.
thought.exampleZh: 今天早上我对这个问题有了一个新的想法。

thousand.example: There are more than a thousand students in this school.
thousand.exampleZh: 这所学校有一千多名学生。

thread.example: I lost the thread of the story and had to read the page again.
thread.exampleZh: 我跟丢了故事的思路，只好把那页重读一遍。

threat.example: The dark clouds are a threat to our picnic today.
threat.exampleZh: 乌云对我们今天的野餐是个威胁。

threaten.example: Dark clouds threaten rain, so we should go home now.
threaten.exampleZh: 乌云预示着要下雨，所以我们现在应该回家。

three.example: I have three little cats and two dogs at home.
three.exampleZh: 我家里有三只小猫和两只狗。

throat.example: I have a sore throat and cannot speak loudly today.
throat.exampleZh: 我嗓子疼，今天没法大声说话。

through.example: We walked through the quiet park and then sat by the river.
through.exampleZh: 我们穿过安静的公园，然后坐在河边。

throughout.example: The museum is famous throughout the world for its ancient art.
throughout.exampleZh: 这家博物馆因其古代艺术品而闻名于世。

throw.example: Please throw the ball to me over the fence.
throw.exampleZh: 请把球从栅栏那边扔给我。

thumb.example: He hurt his thumb while opening the heavy wooden door.
thumb.exampleZh: 他打开那扇沉重的木门时伤到了拇指。

thunder.example: The thunder was so loud that it woke up the baby.
thunder.exampleZh: 雷声太大了，把婴儿吵醒了。

thus.example: It rained hard, and thus the game was cancelled.
thus.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛被取消了。

ticket.example: I bought a ticket for the concert and put it in my bag.
ticket.exampleZh: 我买了一张音乐会的票，把它放进了包里。

tide.example: The tide comes in twice a day and covers the rocks.
tide.exampleZh: 潮水一天涨两次，把岩石都淹没了。

tidy.example: Please tidy your room and keep your desk tidy every day.
tidy.exampleZh: 请整理你的房间，并且每天保持书桌整洁。

tie.example: Please tie your shoes before we go out to play.
tie.exampleZh: 我们出去玩之前，请系好你的鞋带。

tiger.example: The tiger is a big, strong animal that lives in the forest.
tiger.exampleZh: 老虎是一种生活在森林里的大型强壮动物。

tight.example: These shoes are too tight for my feet.
tight.exampleZh: 这双鞋我的脚穿太紧了。

till.example: We waited at the station till the last train came in.
till.exampleZh: 我们在车站一直等到最后一班火车到达。

timber.example: The old house was built with strong timber from the forest.
timber.exampleZh: 这座老房子是用森林里结实的木材建造的。

time.example: I do not have enough time to finish my homework today.
time.exampleZh: 我今天没有足够的时间完成作业。

timetable.example: I always check the train timetable before I leave home.
timetable.exampleZh: 我出门前总会先看一下火车时刻表。

tin.example: This old tin box is full of small buttons and coins.
tin.exampleZh: 这个旧锡盒里装满了小纽扣和硬币。

tiny.example: The tiny bird sat on a branch and sang a sweet song.
tiny.exampleZh: 那只小鸟停在树枝上，唱着甜美的歌。

tip.example: She gave the waiter a tip and wrote her name on the tip.
tip.exampleZh: 她给了服务员小费，并在小费单上写下了自己的名字。

tired.example: After the long walk, I felt very tired and went to bed early.
tired.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，我感到非常疲倦，早早就上床睡觉了。

tissue.example: The nurse cleaned the cut with a soft tissue and warm water.
tissue.exampleZh: 护士用柔软的纸巾和温水清洁了伤口。

title.example: The title of her new book is easy to remember.
title.exampleZh: 她那本新书的书名很容易记住。

to.example: She gave the book to her brother yesterday.
to.exampleZh: 她昨天把书给了她的弟弟。

toast.example: She likes to eat toast with butter and jam for breakfast.
toast.exampleZh: 她早餐喜欢吃抹黄油和果酱的吐司。

tobacco.example: He grows tobacco on his small farm and sells it at the local market.
tobacco.exampleZh: 他在自己的小农场里种烟草，然后拿到当地市场上卖。

today.example: I have a lot of work to do today.
today.exampleZh: 我今天有很多工作要做。

toe.example: I hurt my big toe when I kicked the ball in the park yesterday.
toe.exampleZh: 我昨天在公园踢球时伤到了大脚趾。

together.example: We often cook dinner together and talk about our day.
together.exampleZh: 我们经常一起做晚饭，聊聊各自的一天。

toilet.example: The toilet is at the end of the hall, next to the stairs.
toilet.exampleZh: 厕所在走廊尽头，楼梯旁边。

tolerance.example: Her tolerance of noise helps her live near the busy road.
tolerance.exampleZh: 她对噪音的容忍让她能住在繁忙的马路附近。

tolerate.example: I cannot tolerate loud music late at night in my building.
tolerate.exampleZh: 我无法容忍这栋楼里深夜放很大声的音乐。

tomato.example: I put a red tomato in my salad for lunch today.
tomato.exampleZh: 今天午餐我在沙拉里放了一个红西红柿。

tomorrow.example: I will finish my homework tomorrow morning before school starts.
tomorrow.exampleZh: 我会在明天早上开学前完成我的作业。

ton.example: This box weighs a ton, so we need two people to lift it.
ton.exampleZh: 这个箱子重达一吨，所以我们需要两个人才能把它抬起来。

tone.example: Her tone was calm, but the room's dark tones felt sad.
tone.exampleZh: 她的语气很平静，但房间里深沉的色调让人感到伤感。

tongue.example: He burned his tongue on the hot soup at lunch today.
tongue.exampleZh: 他今天午餐时被热汤烫到了舌头。

tonight.example: I will finish my homework tonight and watch a movie with my family.
tonight.exampleZh: 我今晚会完成作业，然后和家人一起看电影。

too.example: This coffee is too hot for me to drink now.
too.exampleZh: 这杯咖啡太烫了，我现在没法喝。

tool.example: A hammer is a useful tool for building and fixing things.
tool.exampleZh: 锤子是建造和修理东西时有用的工具。

tooth.example: The dentist said I should brush every tooth twice a day.
tooth.exampleZh: 牙医说我应该每天刷每颗牙齿两次。

top.example: She put the book on the top shelf and left.
top.exampleZh: 她把书放在书架顶层，然后就离开了。

topic.example: The topic of today's class is how plants grow in dry places.
topic.exampleZh: 今天这节课的主题是植物如何在干燥的地方生长。

torch.example: She took a torch and walked slowly down the dark stairs.
torch.exampleZh: 她拿了一支手电筒，沿着黑暗的楼梯慢慢往下走。

torment.example: The memory of that day brought him great torment for years.
torment.exampleZh: 那天的记忆多年来给他带来了极大的痛苦。

torture.example: The soldiers were put in prison and often faced torture there.
torture.exampleZh: 士兵们被关进监狱，在那里常常面临酷刑。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
total.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用比我们预期的要高。

touch.example: Her kind words touched my heart, and I will never forget them.
touch.exampleZh: 她善意的话语打动了我的心，我永远不会忘记。

tough.example: This old bag is tough enough to carry heavy books every day.
tough.exampleZh: 这个旧包足够结实，每天都能装很重的书。

tour.example: We went on a tour of the old city last summer.
tour.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们游览了这座老城。

tourist.example: The tourist took many photos of the old city.
tourist.exampleZh: 这位游客拍了很多老城区的照片。

toward.example: She walked slowly toward the door with a big smile.
toward.exampleZh: 她带着灿烂的笑容慢慢走向门口。

towel.example: She dried her wet hands with a clean towel after washing them.
towel.exampleZh: 她洗完手后用一条干净的毛巾擦干了湿手。

tower.example: The tall tower stands in the middle of the old city.
tower.exampleZh: 这座高塔矗立在老城的中心。

town.example: I live in a small town near the river with my family.
town.exampleZh: 我和家人住在河边的一个小镇上。

toy.example: The little boy got a new toy car for his birthday.
toy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩生日时得到了一辆新的玩具车。

trace.example: The police traced the lost bag to a small shop near the station.
trace.exampleZh: 警方追踪那个丢失的包，一直追到车站附近的一家小商店。

track.example: The dog followed the track of the rabbit through the snow.
track.exampleZh: 那只狗沿着兔子在雪地里留下的踪迹一路追踪。

trade.example: My father works in the trade of buying and selling old cars.
trade.exampleZh: 我父亲从事买卖旧汽车的行业。

tradition.example: It is a family tradition to eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
tradition.exampleZh: 除夕夜一起吃饺子是我们家的一个传统。

traditional.example: My grandmother still cooks traditional food for the family every Sunday.
traditional.exampleZh: 我奶奶每个星期天仍然为家人做传统的饭菜。

traffic.example: The traffic in this city is very heavy in the morning.
traffic.exampleZh: 这座城市早上的交通非常拥堵。

tragedy.example: The fire in the old factory was a terrible tragedy for the whole town.
tragedy.exampleZh: 那座老工厂的火灾对整个小镇来说是一场可怕的灾难。

trail.example: The dog followed the trail of the rabbit through the snow.
trail.exampleZh: 那只狗在雪地里循着兔子的踪迹追了上去。

train.example: Every morning he takes the train to work and trains new staff.
train.exampleZh: 每天早上他坐火车去上班，并培训新员工。

training.example: The new workers get two weeks of training before they start.
training.exampleZh: 新员工在开始工作前会接受两周的培训。

transfer.example: She will transfer to a new school next month.
transfer.exampleZh: 她下个月将转到一所新学校。

transform.example: The internet has transformed the way we learn and share information.
transform.exampleZh: 互联网改变了我们学习和分享信息的方式。

translate.example: Please translate this short letter into English for me.
translate.exampleZh: 请帮我把这封短信翻译成英文。

translation.example: Her translation of the poem sounds beautiful when we read it aloud in class.
translation.exampleZh: 我们在课堂上朗读时，她这首诗的译文听起来很美。

transport.example: We use a big truck to transport these boxes to the new store.
transport.exampleZh: 我们用一辆大卡车把这些箱子运到新商店。

transportation.example: Public transportation in this city is cheap and easy to use.
transportation.exampleZh: 这座城市的公共交通便宜又方便。

trap.example: The hunter set a trap to catch the fox in the woods.
trap.exampleZh: 猎人在树林里设了一个陷阱来捕捉狐狸。

travel.example: I want to travel around the world with my best friend.
travel.exampleZh: 我想和我最好的朋友一起环游世界。

tray.example: She put the cups on a tray and carried them to the table.
tray.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在托盘上，端到了桌子旁。

treasure.example: She keeps her old letters because she treasures the memories inside them.
treasure.exampleZh: 她保留着旧信件，因为她珍视其中的回忆。

treat.example: She treats her dog very well and often gives it a treat.
treat.exampleZh: 她对她的狗很好，还常常给它零食。

treatment.example: The doctor says my treatment will take about two weeks.
treatment.exampleZh: 医生说我这个治疗大约需要两周。

treaty.example: The two countries signed a peace treaty after the long war.
treaty.exampleZh: 经过那场漫长的战争后，两国签署了一项和平条约。

tree.example: The tall tree in my garden gives us shade in summer.
tree.exampleZh: 我花园里的那棵高树在夏天为我们提供阴凉。

tremble.example: She began to tremble when she heard the loud noise outside.
tremble.exampleZh: 听到外面巨大的响声时，她开始发抖。

tremendous.example: The new bridge is a tremendous help to people in our small town.
tremendous.exampleZh: 这座新桥对我们小镇上的人来说是极大的帮助。

trend.example: There is a growing trend of people working from home.
trend.exampleZh: 在家办公的人越来越多，这已成为一种趋势。

trial.example: The new teacher gave the kids a trial week before the real test.
trial.exampleZh: 新老师先给孩子们一周试用期，然后才进行正式测试。

triangle.example: The teacher drew a red triangle on the white board for her students.
triangle.exampleZh: 老师在白板上给学生们画了一个红色的三角形。

trick.example: He used a clever trick to open the old box.
trick.exampleZh: 他用了一个巧妙的窍门打开了那个旧箱子。

trip.example: My trip to the beach was fun, but I tripped on a rock.
trip.exampleZh: 我的海滩之旅很有趣，但我在石头上绊了一跤。

triumph.example: After years of hard work, she finally won a great triumph.
triumph.exampleZh: 经过多年的努力，她终于赢得了一场伟大的胜利。

troop.example: A troop of soldiers marched slowly down the dusty road at dawn.
troop.exampleZh: 一队士兵在黎明时分沿着尘土飞扬的道路缓慢行进。

tropical.example: The tropical weather is very hot and wet in summer.
tropical.exampleZh: 夏季的热带天气又热又潮湿。

trouble.example: I had some trouble finding my keys this morning.
trouble.exampleZh: 今天早上我找钥匙费了点劲。

trousers.example: These trousers are too long for my little brother.
trousers.exampleZh: 这条裤子对我弟弟来说太长了。

truck.example: The truck is carrying boxes of fresh fruit to the market.
truck.exampleZh: 那辆卡车正载着一箱箱新鲜水果去市场。

true.example: It is true that she works very hard every day.
true.exampleZh: 她每天工作非常努力，这是真的。

trust.example: I trust my best friend because he always tells me the truth.
trust.exampleZh: 我信任我最好的朋友，因为他总是对我说实话。

truth.example: She always tells the truth, even when it is hard.
truth.exampleZh: 她总是说真话，即使这很难。

try.example: You should try to sleep early before the exam tomorrow.
try.exampleZh: 明天考试前你应该尽量早点睡。

tube.example: I took the tube to work this morning.
tube.exampleZh: 今天早上我坐地铁去上班。

tune.example: She hummed a soft tune while she washed the dishes.
tune.exampleZh: 她一边洗碗一边轻轻哼着曲子。

tunnel.example: The train went through a long tunnel under the mountain.
tunnel.exampleZh: 火车穿过了一条山下的长隧道。

turn.example: Please turn left at the next corner and wait for me there.
turn.exampleZh: 请在下一个路口左转，并在那里等我。

twelve.example: My sister is twelve years old and she loves to read books.
twelve.exampleZh: 我妹妹十二岁，她喜欢读书。

twenty.example: My sister is twenty years old and she studies at a big school.
twenty.exampleZh: 我姐姐二十岁，她在一所大学校读书。

twice.example: I go to the gym twice a week with my friends.
twice.exampleZh: 我和朋友们每周去健身房两次。

twin.example: My twin and I look the same, but we have different hobbies.
twin.exampleZh: 我的双胞胎兄弟和我长得一样，但我们的爱好不同。

twist.example: She gave the wet cloth a quick twist to dry it.
twist.exampleZh: 她把湿布快速地拧了一下，把它弄干。

two.example: My sister has two cats and one small dog.
two.exampleZh: 我妹妹有两只猫和一只小狗。

type.example: What type of music do you like to listen to?
type.exampleZh: 你喜欢听哪种类型的音乐？

typical.example: This is a typical day in our small town.
typical.exampleZh: 这是我们小镇上典型的一天。

typist.example: The typist finished the long report before the office closed.
typist.exampleZh: 打字员在办公室关门前完成了那份长篇报告。

ugly.example: That ugly old chair is taking up too much space in our small room.
ugly.exampleZh: 那把难看的旧椅子占了我们这个小房间太多空间。

umbrella.example: I always take an umbrella with me when the sky looks dark.
umbrella.exampleZh: 天色看起来阴沉时，我总是随身带一把伞。

unanimous.example: The members were unanimous in their decision to change the club rules.
unanimous.exampleZh: 成员们一致决定修改俱乐部规则。

uncle.example: My uncle lives on a small farm with his wife and two children.
uncle.exampleZh: 我叔叔和他的妻子以及两个孩子住在一个小农场里。

uncover.example: The police worked hard to uncover the truth about the missing money.
uncover.exampleZh: 警方努力查明那笔失踪钱款的真相。

under.example: The cat is sleeping under the table in the warm kitchen.
under.exampleZh: 那只猫正在温暖厨房的桌子下面睡觉。

underestimate.example: Many people underestimate how much time it takes to learn a new language.
underestimate.exampleZh: 很多人低估了学会一门新语言需要多少时间。

undergo.example: She had to undergo a long and difficult operation last year.
undergo.exampleZh: 她去年不得不接受一次漫长而艰难的手术。

undergraduate.example: She is an undergraduate at a small college in the north.
undergraduate.exampleZh: 她是北方一所小型学院的本科生。

underground.example: We took the underground train to the old underground station.
underground.exampleZh: 我们乘坐地铁列车去了那个古老的地下车站。

underneath.example: The cat is sleeping underneath the warm blanket.
underneath.exampleZh: 那只猫正在温暖的毯子下面睡觉。

understand.example: I understand the question, but I need more time to think.
understand.exampleZh: 我理解这个问题，但我需要更多时间思考。

understanding.example: Her understanding of the problem helped the whole team find a simple solution.
understanding.exampleZh: 她对这个问题的理解帮助整个团队找到了一个简单的解决办法。

undertake.example: We will undertake the new project next week after the meeting.
undertake.exampleZh: 会议之后，我们下周将承担这个新项目。

undo.example: Please undo the buttons on your coat before you sit down.
undo.exampleZh: 坐下之前请解开你外套上的扣子。

undoubtedly.example: She is undoubtedly the best teacher in our small school.
undoubtedly.exampleZh: 她无疑是我们这所小学校里最好的老师。

uneasy.example: She felt uneasy when she walked home alone in the dark.
uneasy.exampleZh: 她一个人走在黑暗中回家时感到不安。

unemployment.example: The unemployment rate is high among young people in this city.
unemployment.exampleZh: 这座城市的年轻人失业率很高。

unexpected.example: The unexpected rain ruined our trip to the beach.
unexpected.exampleZh: 这场意外的雨毁了我们的海滩之行。

unfair.example: It is unfair to blame the young boy for this mistake.
unfair.exampleZh: 因为这个错误而责怪这个小男孩是不公平的。

unfortunate.example: It is unfortunate that we cannot meet you at the airport today.
unfortunate.exampleZh: 很遗憾我们今天不能在机场接你。

unhappy.example: She was unhappy with the test results and wanted to try again.
unhappy.exampleZh: 她对考试结果不满意，想再试一次。

uniform.example: All the students in my school wear the same blue uniform every day.
uniform.exampleZh: 我们学校的所有学生每天都穿同样的蓝色制服。

union.example: The workers formed a union to ask for better pay.
union.exampleZh: 工人们成立了一个工会，要求更好的薪酬。

unique.example: Each person's fingerprint is unique and cannot be exactly the same as another.
unique.exampleZh: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的，不可能与另一个人完全相同。

unit.example: Each unit in this book has a short story and some easy exercises.
unit.exampleZh: 这本书每个单元都有一篇短故事和一些简单练习。

unite.example: The workers united to ask for better pay and safer jobs.
unite.exampleZh: 工人们联合起来，要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作。

universal.example: The idea of fairness is universal and people everywhere understand it.
universal.exampleZh: 公平的观念是普遍的，各地的人都理解它。

universe.example: Many people wonder what lies at the edge of our universe.
universe.exampleZh: 许多人想知道我们宇宙的边缘之外是什么。

university.example: My sister studies medicine at a famous university in the north.
university.exampleZh: 我姐姐在北方一所著名的大学学习医学。

unless.example: You cannot go out unless you finish your homework first.
unless.exampleZh: 除非你先完成作业，否则不能出去。

unlike.example: Unlike her sister, she likes to read books at home.
unlike.exampleZh: 和她姐姐不同，她喜欢在家里看书。

unload.example: We need to unload the boxes from the truck before lunch.
unload.exampleZh: 我们需要在午饭前把箱子从卡车上卸下来。

until.example: We waited at the station until the last train arrived.
until.exampleZh: 我们在车站一直等到最后一班火车到达。

unusual.example: It is unusual for him to arrive late to work.
unusual.exampleZh: 他上班迟到是不寻常的。

up.example: Please stand up and read this page aloud to the class.
up.exampleZh: 请站起来，把这一页大声读给全班听。

update.example: Please update your address and phone number in the system today.
update.exampleZh: 请今天在系统里更新你的地址和电话号码。

upon.example: Upon arriving home, she put the keys on the table.
upon.exampleZh: 一到家，她就把钥匙放在桌子上。

upper.example: Her name is on the upper floor of the building.
upper.exampleZh: 她的名字在这栋楼的上一层。

upset.example: The bad news made her so upset that she could not sleep.
upset.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让她心烦意乱，睡不着觉。

upstairs.example: My bedroom is upstairs, so I go up the stairs every night.
upstairs.exampleZh: 我的卧室在楼上，所以我每天晚上都要上楼。

upward.example: The company has seen an upward trend in sales this year.
upward.exampleZh: 公司今年的销售额呈上升趋势。

urban.example: The urban area has many shops and buses.
urban.exampleZh: 这个城区有很多商店和公交车。

urge.example: I urge you to call your parents tonight.
urge.exampleZh: 我劝你今晚给父母打个电话。

urgent.example: We have an urgent problem and need your help right now.
urgent.exampleZh: 我们有一个紧急问题，现在就需要你的帮助。

us.example: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework today.
us.exampleZh: 老师今天给我们布置了很多作业。

use.example: Students use computers to finish their homework every day after school.
use.exampleZh: 学生们每天放学后使用电脑完成作业。

used.example: I am used to getting up early on cold mornings.
used.exampleZh: 我习惯了在寒冷的早晨早起。

useful.example: This small dictionary is very useful for learning new English words.
useful.exampleZh: 这本小词典对学习英语新单词很有用。

usual.example: I take my usual bus to work every morning.
usual.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐我平常那班公交车去上班。

usually.example: I usually walk to school with my sister in the morning.
usually.exampleZh: 我通常早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

utility.example: The utility of this small tool is easy to see.
utility.exampleZh: 这个小工具的实用性显而易见。

utilize.example: We can utilize this small room as a quiet study area.
utilize.exampleZh: 我们可以把这间小房间用作安静的学习区。

utmost.example: She listened to the doctor with the utmost care.
utmost.exampleZh: 她极其认真地听医生说话。

utter.example: She was too tired to utter a word during the whole meeting.
utter.exampleZh: 整个会议期间她累得一个字也说不出来。

vacation.example: We plan to take a long vacation at the beach this summer.
vacation.exampleZh: 我们打算今年夏天去海边度过一个长假。

vacuum.example: The machine cannot work in a vacuum, so please turn on the fan first.
vacuum.exampleZh: 这台机器不能在真空中工作，所以请先打开风扇。

vague.example: His answer was vague, so nobody knew what he really wanted.
vague.exampleZh: 他的回答很含糊，所以没人知道他真正想要什么。

vain.example: He tried in vain to fix the old car by himself.
vain.exampleZh: 他试图自己修好那辆旧车，但白费力气。

valid.example: Your ticket is still valid for the next train.
valid.exampleZh: 你的票对下一班火车仍然有效。

valley.example: A small river runs through the valley behind our village.
valley.exampleZh: 一条小河流经我们村庄后面的山谷。

valuable.example: This old watch is very valuable to my family.
valuable.exampleZh: 这块旧手表对我家来说非常珍贵。

value.example: She knows the value of hard work and always tries her best.
value.exampleZh: 她懂得努力的价值，并且总是尽力而为。

vanish.example: The sun went down and the boat vanished into the dark night.
vanish.exampleZh: 太阳落下后，小船消失在黑夜中。

vapor.example: Thick vapor rose from the hot soup on the stove.
vapor.exampleZh: 浓密的蒸汽从炉子上的热汤中升起。

various.example: The store sells various kinds of fruit at low prices.
various.exampleZh: 这家商店以低价出售各种各样的水果。

vary.example: The weather can vary a lot from day to day in spring.
vary.exampleZh: 春天时天气可能一天一天变化很大。

vast.example: The vast desert is full of sand and rocks.
vast.exampleZh: 这片广阔的沙漠满是沙子和岩石。

vegetable.example: My mother buys fresh vegetables at the market every morning.
vegetable.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上在市场买新鲜蔬菜。

vehicle.example: A car is a common vehicle for getting to work every day.
vehicle.exampleZh: 汽车是每天上班常用的交通工具。

venture.example: He ventured into the forest alone to find the lost dog.
venture.exampleZh: 他独自冒险进入森林去寻找那只走失的狗。

verb.example: In this sentence, the word run is a verb.
verb.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，run 这个词是动词。

verify.example: Please verify your address before you send the form.
verify.exampleZh: 寄出表格前请核实你的地址。

version.example: I need to check which version of the file is the newest.
version.exampleZh: 我需要确认这个文件的哪个版本是最新的。

vertical.example: The flag hangs on a tall vertical pole in front of the school.
vertical.exampleZh: 那面旗子挂在学校前面一根高高的垂直旗杆上。

very.example: This is the very book I need for my class.
very.exampleZh: 这正是我上课需要的那本书。

vessel.example: The small vessel sailed across the calm sea.
vessel.exampleZh: 那只小船驶过平静的海面。

veteran.example: My father is a veteran, and he often tells us stories about the war.
veteran.exampleZh: 我父亲是一名老兵，他经常给我们讲战争时期的故事。

via.example: We sent the letter to her via email last night.
via.exampleZh: 昨晚我们通过电子邮件把那封信发给了她。

vibrate.example: The phone will vibrate when you get a new message.
vibrate.exampleZh: 当你收到新消息时，手机就会振动。

vice.example: His only vice is eating too much sweet food at night.
vice.exampleZh: 他唯一的缺点是晚上吃太多甜食。

victim.example: The victim asked the police for help after the accident.
victim.exampleZh: 事故发生后，受害者向警方求助。

victory.example: The team worked hard all year and finally won a great victory.
victory.exampleZh: 这支队伍全年努力训练，最终赢得了一场伟大的胜利。

video.example: I watched a short video about cooking on my phone last night.
video.exampleZh: 昨晚我在手机上看了一个关于烹饪的短视频。

view.example: The view from the top of the hill is very beautiful.
view.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色非常美。

village.example: The small village is quiet at night.
village.exampleZh: 这个小村庄在夜里很安静。

violence.example: The school teaches children that violence is never a good way to solve problems.
violence.exampleZh: 学校教导孩子们，暴力绝不是解决问题的一个好办法。

violent.example: The violent storm broke many windows in our old school building last night.
violent.exampleZh: 昨晚那场猛烈的暴风雨打碎了我们旧校舍的许多窗户。

violet.example: She picked a small violet in the garden and gave it to her mother.
violet.exampleZh: 她在花园里摘了一朵小紫罗兰，把它送给了妈妈。

violin.example: My sister plays the violin in the school music room every Friday.
violin.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周五在学校音乐室拉小提琴。

virtual.example: In the game, she meets friends in a virtual world every evening.
virtual.exampleZh: 在游戏里，她每天晚上都在一个虚拟世界中与朋友见面。

virtue.example: Honesty is an important virtue that everyone should learn when they are young.
virtue.exampleZh: 诚实是每个人在小时候都应该学习的重要美德。

virus.example: A virus can make you very sick, so wash your hands often.
virus.exampleZh: 病毒会让你病得很重，所以要经常洗手。

visible.example: The mountain is clearly visible from our kitchen window on sunny days.
visible.exampleZh: 在晴天，从我们厨房的窗户可以清楚地看到那座山。

vision.example: Her vision is very good, so she can see the small words clearly.
vision.exampleZh: 她的视力很好，所以能清楚地看到这些小字。

visit.example: I visit my grandparents every weekend and we cook dinner together.
visit.exampleZh: 我每个周末都去看望我的祖父母，我们一起做晚饭。

visitor.example: The visitor took many photos of the old temple.
visitor.exampleZh: 这位游客在那座古老的寺庙拍了很多照片。

visual.example: The teacher used visual aids to help students understand the new lesson.
visual.exampleZh: 老师使用视觉辅助工具来帮助学生理解新课程。

vital.example: Regular exercise is vital for keeping your heart healthy and strong.
vital.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对于保持心脏健康和强壮至关重要。

vivid.example: She gave a vivid description of her trip to the small mountain village.
vivid.exampleZh: 她生动地描述了那次去小山村的旅行。

vocabulary.example: Reading every day helps you build a larger vocabulary.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 每天阅读有助于你积累更大的词汇量。

voice.example: Her voice was soft and calm during the meeting.
voice.exampleZh: 会议期间她的声音轻柔而平静。

volume.example: The volume of this box is too large for my bag.
volume.exampleZh: 这个盒子的体积太大，我的包放不下。

voluntary.example: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter every Saturday morning.
voluntary.exampleZh: 她每周六上午在动物收容所做志愿工作。

volunteer.example: She works as a volunteer at the local animal shelter every weekend.
volunteer.exampleZh: 她每个周末都在当地的动物收容所做志愿者。

vote.example: I will vote for her because she is honest and kind.
vote.exampleZh: 我会投她一票，因为她诚实又善良。

voyage.example: The voyage across the ocean took three weeks by ship.
voyage.exampleZh: 这次横渡大洋的航行乘船花了三个星期。

wage.example: His wage is low, but he enjoys the work.
wage.exampleZh: 他的工资很低，但他喜欢这份工作。

waist.example: She tied a red belt around her waist before going out.
waist.exampleZh: 她出门前在腰上系了一条红腰带。

wait.example: We had to wait a long time for the bus this morning.
wait.exampleZh: 今天早上我们等公交车等了很久。

waiter.example: The waiter brought us two cups of hot tea.
waiter.exampleZh: 服务员给我们端来了两杯热茶。

wake.example: I usually wake up at seven on school days.
wake.exampleZh: 上学的日子我通常七点醒来。

walk.example: I walk to school with my sister every morning.
walk.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

wall.example: The picture on the wall is very old.

wallet.example: I left my wallet on the table at home this morning.
wallet.exampleZh: 今天早上我把钱包落在家里桌子上了。

wander.example: We wander through the old streets and forget the time.
wander.exampleZh: 我们漫步穿过老街，忘记了时间。

want.example: I want a cup of hot tea after a long day at work.
want.exampleZh: 工作了一整天之后，我想要一杯热茶。

war.example: The country was at war for many years.
war.exampleZh: 这个国家多年处于战争之中。

warm.example: Her warm smile made every new student feel at home.
warm.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑让每个新来的学生都感到宾至如归。

warn.example: I warn you not to touch that hot pan.
warn.exampleZh: 我警告你不要碰那个滚烫的锅。

wash.example: Please wash your hands before you eat dinner with us.
wash.exampleZh: 请你在和我们一起吃晚饭前先洗手。

waste.example: Don't waste your time on small things you cannot change.
waste.exampleZh: 不要把时间浪费在你无法改变的小事上。

watch.example: I watch the birds in the park every morning before work.
watch.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前在公园里看鸟。

water.example: Please give me a glass of water and water the plants later.
water.exampleZh: 请给我一杯水，然后稍后给植物浇水。

wave.example: She gave me a friendly wave from the other side of the street.
wave.exampleZh: 她在街道对面友好地朝我挥了挥手。

wax.example: The candle is made of wax and burns slowly.
wax.exampleZh: 这根蜡烛是由蜡制成的，燃烧得很慢。

way.example: Can you show me the way to the train station?
way.exampleZh: 你能告诉我去火车站的路吗？

we.example: We go to school together every morning by bus.
we.exampleZh: 我们每天早上一起坐公交车去学校。

weak.example: He felt weak after the long walk and sat down to rest.
weak.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后他觉得很虚弱，就坐下来休息。

wealth.example: His great wealth came from years of hard work.
wealth.exampleZh: 他的巨额财富来自多年的辛勤工作。

weapon.example: The police found a weapon in the man's car.
weapon.exampleZh: 警察在那个男人的车里发现了一件武器。

wear.example: I wear a warm coat when the weather is very cold.
wear.exampleZh: 天气很冷的时候，我会穿上一件暖和的外套。

weather.example: The weather is cold and rainy, so we will stay at home today.
weather.exampleZh: 天气又冷又下雨，所以我们今天会待在家里。

web.example: A spider made a web between two trees in the garden.
web.exampleZh: 一只蜘蛛在花园里的两棵树之间结了一张网。

wedding.example: My sister's wedding will be in a small garden next month.
wedding.exampleZh: 我姐姐的婚礼将于下个月在一个小花园里举行。

week.example: I will visit my grandmother next week during the school holiday.
week.exampleZh: 学校假期期间我下周会去看望我的祖母。

weekend.example: I usually visit my grandparents on the weekend.
weekend.exampleZh: 我通常在周末去看望我的祖父母。

weekly.example: We have a weekly meeting on Monday and read a weekly magazine.
weekly.exampleZh: 我们每周一开一次周会，还会读一本周刊。

weigh.example: Please weigh the bag before you take it to the airport.
weigh.exampleZh: 在把这个包带到机场之前，请先称一下它的重量。

weight.example: The weight of this box is too heavy for me to carry alone.
weight.exampleZh: 这个箱子的重量太重了，我一个人搬不动。

welcome.example: We welcome all new students to our school with a big party.
welcome.exampleZh: 我们用一场盛大的派对欢迎所有新同学来到我们学校。

welfare.example: The government should spend more money on the welfare of children.
welfare.exampleZh: 政府应该在儿童福利上投入更多的钱。

well.example: She sings very well, and her mother is well again.
well.exampleZh: 她唱得很好，她的母亲也康复了。

west.example: The sun goes down in the west and the sky turns red.
west.exampleZh: 太阳从西方落下，天空变红了。

western.example: She likes western music and often listens to it at home.
western.exampleZh: 她喜欢西方音乐，经常在家听。

wet.example: My clothes are wet because it rained on my way home.
wet.exampleZh: 我的衣服湿了，因为我在回家的路上淋了雨。

whale.example: We saw a huge whale jump out of the blue sea.
whale.exampleZh: 我们看到一头巨大的鲸鱼跃出蔚蓝的大海。

what.example: What do you want to drink with your lunch today?

whatever.example: Whatever you choose to eat, I will be happy with it.
whatever.exampleZh: 无论你选择吃什么，我都会很开心。

wheat.example: The farmer grows wheat in his field and sells it at the local market.
wheat.exampleZh: 农民在田里种小麦，然后拿到当地市场上卖。

wheel.example: The front wheel of my bike is flat, so I must walk.
wheel.exampleZh: 我自行车的前轮瘪了，所以我只能走路。

when.example: I still remember the day when we first met at school.
when.exampleZh: 我仍然记得我们在学校第一次见面的那一天。

whenever.example: Whenever it rains, the children stay inside and play games.
whenever.exampleZh: 每当下雨，孩子们就待在屋里玩游戏。

where.example: I do not know where my little brother put his books.
where.exampleZh: 我不知道我弟弟把他的书放在哪里了。

whereas.example: I like tea, whereas my brother prefers coffee every morning.
whereas.exampleZh: 我喜欢茶，而我弟弟每天早上更喜欢咖啡。

whether.example: I don't know whether he will come to the party tonight.
whether.exampleZh: 我不知道他今晚是否会来参加聚会。

which.example: Which book do you want to read this afternoon?
which.exampleZh: 今天下午你想读哪一本书？

while.example: She read a book while I cooked dinner for the whole family.
while.exampleZh: 我给全家人做晚饭的时候，她在看书。

whip.example: The farmer used a long whip to move the cows.
whip.exampleZh: 农夫用一条长鞭子赶牛。

whisper.example: She leaned over and whispered the answer in my ear.
whisper.exampleZh: 她俯过身来，在我耳边低声说出了答案。

whistle.example: The referee blew his whistle and the players stopped running.
whistle.exampleZh: 裁判吹响了哨子，球员们停了下来。

white.example: She wore a white dress to the party last night.
white.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条白色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

who.example: Who is the tall man standing near the door?
who.exampleZh: 站在门边的那位高个子男人是谁？

whole.example: The whole class went to the museum together last Friday.
whole.exampleZh: 上周五全班一起去了博物馆。

whom.example: The teacher whom you met yesterday is my aunt.
whom.exampleZh: 你昨天见到的那位老师是我的姑姑。

whose.example: I do not know whose bag this is on the desk.
whose.exampleZh: 我不知道桌子上这个包是谁的。

why.example: I do not know why she is late today.
why.exampleZh: 我不知道她今天为什么迟到。

wide.example: The river is very wide, so we take a boat to cross it.
wide.exampleZh: 这条河非常宽，所以我们坐船过河。

widespread.example: The use of mobile phones is now widespread among young people.
widespread.exampleZh: 手机的使用现在在年轻人中很普遍。

widow.example: The widow lives alone with her two young children.
widow.exampleZh: 那位寡妇带着两个年幼的孩子独自生活。

width.example: The width of this room is about four meters.
width.exampleZh: 这个房间的宽度大约是四米。

wife.example: My wife and I go to the park every Sunday morning.
wife.exampleZh: 我和妻子每个星期天早上都去公园。

wild.example: Many wild animals live in the forest near our small town.
wild.exampleZh: 许多野生动物生活在我们小镇附近的森林里。

will.example: I will help you with your work, and my will is strong.
will.exampleZh: 我会帮你做你的工作，而且我的意志很坚定。

willing.example: She is willing to help us with the work today.
willing.exampleZh: 她乐意今天帮我们做这项工作。

win.example: Our team played hard and did win the game at last.
win.exampleZh: 我们队奋力拼搏，最终赢得了比赛。

wind.example: The wind is strong today, so hold your hat.
wind.exampleZh: 今天风很大，所以扶好你的帽子。

window.example: Please open the window because the room is very hot.
window.exampleZh: 请打开窗户，因为房间里很热。

wine.example: My father drinks a glass of red wine with dinner every evening.
wine.exampleZh: 我父亲每天晚饭时都喝一杯红葡萄酒。

wing.example: The bird hurt one wing and could not fly for a few days.
wing.exampleZh: 这只鸟伤了一只翅膀，好几天都不能飞。

winner.example: The winner of the race smiled and thanked everyone who helped him.
winner.exampleZh: 比赛的获胜者微笑着感谢了所有帮助过他的人。

winter.example: My family visits our grandparents in the countryside every winter.
winter.exampleZh: 每年冬天，我们一家都会去乡下看望祖父母。

wipe.example: She used a wet cloth to wipe the table after dinner.
wipe.exampleZh: 晚饭后她用一块湿布擦了桌子。

wire.example: The worker used a thin wire to fix the broken fence.
wire.exampleZh: 工人用一根细金属丝修好了破损的栅栏。

wisdom.example: My grandmother often shares her wisdom with the young people in our family.
wisdom.exampleZh: 我的祖母经常与我们家的年轻人分享她的智慧。

wise.example: It is wise to save some money for a rainy day.
wise.exampleZh: 存点钱以备不时之需是明智的。

wish.example: I wish you good luck in your new job.
wish.exampleZh: 我祝你新工作一切顺利。

with.example: She went to the park with her dog and her best friend.
with.exampleZh: 她和她的狗以及最好的朋友一起去了公园。

withdraw.example: He decided to withdraw some money from the bank yesterday.
withdraw.exampleZh: 他昨天决定从银行取一些钱。

within.example: Please finish the work within two days.
within.exampleZh: 请在两天内完成这项工作。

without.example: I cannot finish this work without your help today.
without.exampleZh: 今天没有你的帮助，我无法完成这项工作。

witness.example: She was the only witness to the accident on that quiet street.
witness.exampleZh: 她是那条安静街道上那起事故的唯一目击者。

wolf.example: We heard a wolf howl in the forest last night.
wolf.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在森林里听到一只狼嚎叫。

woman.example: The woman in the blue coat is my new teacher.
woman.exampleZh: 穿蓝色外套的那位女士是我的新老师。

wonder.example: I wonder if it will rain tomorrow, and the children wonder about the stars.
wonder.exampleZh: 我想知道明天会不会下雨，孩子们也对星星感到好奇。

wonderful.example: We had a wonderful time at the beach last summer.
wonderful.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们在海滩上玩得非常开心。

wood.example: The table is made of wood and it looks very strong.
wood.exampleZh: 这张桌子是用木头做的，看起来很结实。

wooden.example: The old man sat on a wooden chair by the window.
wooden.exampleZh: 那位老人坐在窗边的一把木椅上。

wool.example: This warm sweater is made of wool from a small farm.
wool.exampleZh: 这件暖和的毛衣是用一个小农场出产的羊毛制成的。

word.example: I do not know the meaning of this word.
word.exampleZh: 我不知道这个词的意思。

work.example: Hard work helps us grow, and it also works well when we plan first.
work.exampleZh: 努力工作帮助我们成长，而先做计划时它也很奏效。

worker.example: The worker starts his job early every morning.
worker.exampleZh: 这个工人每天早上很早就开始工作。

workshop.example: Our teacher held a small workshop on how to write short stories.
workshop.exampleZh: 我们老师举办了一个关于如何写短篇故事的小型研讨会。

world.example: The Internet lets people around the world share ideas and news.
world.exampleZh: 互联网让世界各地的人们分享想法和新闻。

worldwide.example: The company has offices worldwide and many people work there.
worldwide.exampleZh: 这家公司在世界各地设有办事处，很多人在那里工作。

worm.example: A small worm lives under the wet soil in our garden.
worm.exampleZh: 一条小虫住在我们花园潮湿的土壤下面。

worry.example: Don't worry too much about the exam; you have studied hard.
worry.exampleZh: 别太担心考试，你已经很努力地学习了。

worse.example: My cold got worse last night, so I stayed home today.
worse.exampleZh: 昨晚我的感冒加重了，所以今天我待在家里。

worship.example: Many people worship at the temple on Sunday mornings.
worship.exampleZh: 许多人星期天早上去寺庙做礼拜。

worst.example: This is the worst weather we have had all year.
worst.exampleZh: 这是我们全年遇到过的最糟糕的天气。

worth.example: This old book is worth reading again and again.
worth.exampleZh: 这本旧书值得反复阅读。

would.example: I would call you every night when I lived alone.
would.exampleZh: 我一个人住的时候，常常每晚给你打电话。

wound.example: The nurse cleaned the wound on his leg before the doctor came.
wound.exampleZh: 护士在医生来之前清洗了他腿上的伤口。

wrap.example: Please wrap the gift in colorful paper before you give it to her.
wrap.exampleZh: 请在她送礼物之前用彩纸把礼物包起来。

wreck.example: The storm wrecked the small boat and left only broken wood on the beach.
wreck.exampleZh: 暴风雨摧毁了那艘小船，只在海滩上留下破碎的木头。

wrestle.example: The two boys wrestle with each other on the grass after school.
wrestle.exampleZh: 放学后两个男孩在草地上互相摔跤。

write.example: Please write your name at the top of the page.
write.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在这页的顶端。

writing.example: Her writing is clear and easy to read, so the teacher often praises it.
writing.exampleZh: 她的写作清晰易读，所以老师经常表扬。

wrong.example: Something is wrong with my phone, so I cannot call you today.
wrong.exampleZh: 我的手机出毛病了，所以今天没法给你打电话。

x-ray.example: The doctor took an x-ray of my left arm to check for breaks.
x-ray.exampleZh: 医生给我的左臂拍了一张X光片，检查是否有骨折。

yard.example: Our little dog likes to run around the yard every morning.
yard.exampleZh: 我们的小狗每天早上都喜欢在院子里跑来跑去。

yawn.example: He began to yawn during the long meeting and could not stay awake.
yawn.exampleZh: 在漫长的会议上他开始打哈欠，怎么也保持不了清醒。

year.example: My sister is twelve years old and she loves to read books.
year.exampleZh: 我妹妹十二岁了，她喜欢读书。

yearly.example: Our team has a yearly meeting to plan the new work.
yearly.exampleZh: 我们团队每年开一次会来规划新工作。

yellow.example: The yellow leaves fall from the tree in autumn.
yellow.exampleZh: 秋天，黄色的叶子从树上落下。

yes.example: Yes, I would like to go with you.

yesterday.example: I saw your brother at the park yesterday afternoon after school.
yesterday.exampleZh: 昨天下午放学后我在公园看到了你哥哥。

yet.example: I have not finished my homework yet, but I will try.
yet.exampleZh: 我还没有完成作业，但我会努力的。

yield.example: The small farm can yield enough corn and beans for the whole village.
yield.exampleZh: 这个小农场能产出足够的玉米和豆子供全村食用。

you.example: Can you help me carry these books to the classroom?
you.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些书搬到教室吗？

young.example: My young brother likes to play football with his friends every day.
young.exampleZh: 我的弟弟喜欢每天和他的朋友们一起踢足球。

your.example: Please put your books on the desk before the class starts.
your.exampleZh: 请在上课前把你的书放在桌子上。

yours.example: This blue umbrella is yours, and the red one is mine.
yours.exampleZh: 这把蓝色的伞是你的，那把红色的是我的。

yourself.example: You should be proud of yourself for finishing the work on time.
yourself.exampleZh: 你应该为自己按时完成工作而感到自豪。

youth.example: She spent her youth in a small village near the sea.
youth.exampleZh: 她的青年时期是在海边的一个小村庄里度过的。

zebra.example: We saw a zebra with black and white stripes at the zoo.
zebra.exampleZh: 我们在动物园看到了一只有黑白条纹的斑马。

zero.example: The temperature dropped to zero last night, so the lake froze.
zero.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到了零度，所以湖面结冰了。

zip.example: Please zip up your coat before we go outside in the cold.
zip.exampleZh: 我们出门前，请把你的外套拉链拉上，外面很冷。

zone.example: This area is a quiet zone where children can play safely.
zone.exampleZh: 这个区域是一个安静地带，孩子们可以安全地玩耍。

zoo.example: The children love to see the pandas at the zoo on Sundays.
zoo.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在星期天去动物园看熊猫。
